api.name: Abs
api.description: Returns the absolute value of a number.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: The value to take the absolute value of.

returns.description: The absolute value of the given number.

remarks: Commonly used to compare a height or angle difference against a threshold, as in Abs( a - b ) < 50.

api.name: AbsAngleClamp180
api.description: Returns abs angle value clamped between [0,180].

parameters.name: angles
parameters.description: The angle, in degrees, to clamp.

returns.description: The angle clamped to the range 0 to 180 degrees.

remarks: Typically applied to the difference between two yaw values to get the unsigned angle between them.
Use AngleClamp180 instead when the sign of the difference matters.

api.name: AbsAngleClamp360
api.description: Returns <angle> as a value in the range of 0 and 360 degrees.

parameters.name: angle
parameters.description: The angle, in degrees, to clamp.

returns.description: The angle clamped to the range 0 to 360 degrees.

remarks: Often applied component by component when normalizing a set of angles before use.

api.name: ACos
api.description: Returns the angle, in degrees, whose cosine is the given value.

parameters.name: cosValue
parameters.description: The cosine value, normally in the range -1 to 1.

returns.description: The corresponding angle in degrees.

remarks: Usually applied to the dot product of two normalized vectors to get the angle between them.
Scripts sometimes clamp the input to the range -1 to 1 first to guard against floating point error.

api.name: AnimScripted
api.description: Plays a scripted animation on an entity from a given position and orientation.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity to play the animation on.

parameters.name: notify
parameters.description: The notify to send.

parameters.name: origin
parameters.description: The starting position of the anim script.

parameters.name: angles
parameters.description: The starting angle of the anim script.

parameters.name: animation
parameters.description: The animation.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: Valid modes are "normal" and "deathplant".

parameters.name: root
parameters.description: The root animation.

parameters.name: rate
parameters.description: The playback rate of animation.

parameters.name: blend
parameters.description: The blend time for the animation.

parameters.name: lerp
parameters.description: The lerp time for an aligned animation.

parameters.name: animationTime
parameters.description: The starting animation time in 0-1 range.

parameters.name: is_scene_animation
parameters.description: Should be true for player scene animations or scripted animations where the player has no control, can be ignored for non-players.

parameters.name: showPlayerWeaponInFirstPerson
parameters.description: determines if the first person player should have his weapon during cinematics.

remarks: Nearly all calls pass self.origin and self.angles as the start position and orientation, and a notify name that the script then waits on.
The optional arguments are usually skipped or passed as undefined, with only blend or rate supplied when a specific timing is needed.

api.name: Announcement

parameters.name: duration

parameters.name: flags
parameters.description: Optional display flags.

remarks: Observed calls pass a localized string from the game["strings"] table and 0 for the flags argument.

api.name: AnyAmmoForWeaponModes
api.description: Returns whether the player has any ammo left for the given weapon in any of its modes.

calledOn.name: player

parameters.name: weapon
parameters.description: The weapon to check.

returns.description: Whether any of the weapon's modes still has ammo.

remarks: Used in weapon switching code to decide whether a weapon is still usable before giving or selecting it.

api.name: ApplyBallisticTarget
api.description: Launch a vehicle with just enough force at a target.

calledOn.description: The vehicle to launch.

parameters.name: targetPos

api.name: ApplyKnockBack
api.description: Applies a knockback on a player.

parameters.name: amount
parameters.description: the amount of knockback to apply.

parameters.name: dir
parameters.description: the direction of knockback to apply.

api.name: AreAllMissionsAtScore
api.description: Returns true if all missions are at the score specified.

parameters.name: score

api.name: AreControlsFrozen

calledOn.name: player

api.name: Array
api.description: Creates an array.

parameters.name: members
parameters.description: Zero or more entries to populate the array with.

returns.name: array
returns.description: The created array.

api.name: ArrayCombine
api.description: Returns a new array holding the contents of both given arrays.

parameters.name: array1
parameters.description: array to operate on.

parameters.name: array2
parameters.description: array to operate on.

parameters.name: allowdupes
parameters.description: if true then allow duplicate entries, otherwise prune them out when combining.

parameters.name: preserve_keys
parameters.description: if true then preserve the keys (only for string keys) otherwise renumber when combining.

remarks: Very commonly used to accumulate a result, assigning back into the first array argument.
Both flags are passed as 0 or 1 literals, and the dedupe-and-renumber form (0, 0) is by far the most common.

api.name: ArrayCopy
api.description: Returns a shallow copy of an array.

parameters.name: array1
parameters.description: array to operate on.

remarks: Used before sorting, shuffling or removing entries, so that a shared level array is not modified in place.

api.name: ArrayGetClosest
api.description: Returns the entry of the array that is closest to the given origin.

parameters.name: origin
parameters.description: The origin to get closest from.

parameters.name: array
parameters.description: The array to search in.

parameters.name: dist
parameters.description: The minimum distance to check when finding closest (has to be positive).

remarks: The array normally holds entities or structs, and the distance is measured against their origins.
The optional third argument is rarely passed; most calls just take the nearest entry.

api.name: ArrayGetFarthest
api.description: Returns the entry of the array that is farthest from the given origin.

parameters.name: origin
parameters.description: The origin to get farthest from.

parameters.name: array
parameters.description: The array to search in.

parameters.name: dist
parameters.description: The maximum distance when finding farthest (has to be positive).

remarks: Typically used to pick a spawn point or flee destination away from a player position.

api.name: ArrayInsert
api.description: Inserts a value into an array at the given index, shifting later entries along.

parameters.name: array
parameters.description: array to operate on.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: value to insert.

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: index at which to insert the value (must be an integer) - moves existing entries as required.

remarks: Most calls insert at index 0 to prepend an entry; queue code inserts at a scanned index to keep a priority order.
The array is modified in place, so the return value is not used.

api.name: ArrayIntersect
api.description: Returns an array of values that are present in both arrays.

parameters.name: array1
parameters.description: An Array.

parameters.name: array2
parameters.description: An Array.

parameters.name: matchKeys
parameters.description: Optionally returns an array of matching key/value pairs from the two input arrays (preserving the keys).

remarks: Used to narrow a running result set by repeatedly intersecting it with each new candidate array.

api.name: ArrayRemoveIndex
api.description: Removes the entry at the given index from an array.

parameters.name: array
parameters.description: array to operate on.

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: index of value to remove.

parameters.name: preserve_keys
parameters.description: defaults to false, if true then it preserves the keys - otherwise creates integer keys.

remarks: Called with a string key as well as an integer index, so it also removes a named entry from an associative array.
The array is modified in place, and preserve_keys is passed explicitly when the caller depends on the existing keys.

api.name: ArrayRemoveValue
api.description: Removes every entry equal to the given value from an array.

parameters.name: array
parameters.description: array to operate on.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: value to remove (may be undefined).

parameters.name: preserve_keys
parameters.description: defaults to false, if true then it preserves the keys - otherwise creates integer keys.

remarks: The most common pattern is unregistering self from a level or parent array when an entity is removed.
Also called with undefined to strip out entries that have since been deleted.

api.name: ArraySort
api.description: Returns the array of entities sorted by distance from the given origin.

parameters.name: array
parameters.description: array to sort.

parameters.name: origin
parameters.description: the origin from which to compare.

parameters.name: closest
parameters.description: if set to true the array will be sorted by distance closest to <origin>, if false by distance farthest from <origin>.

parameters.name: max
parameters.description: if set then only the first <max> count of entities will be returned.

parameters.name: range
parameters.description: if set then only the entities within <range> will be considered.

remarks: When the closest flag is omitted the calls read as a plain nearest-first sort, and 0 is passed to sort farthest first.
Callers often index the result immediately, for example taking element 0 as the nearest entity.

api.name: ArraySortClosest
api.description: Returns the array of entities sorted nearest first from the given origin, optionally limited by count and distance.

parameters.name: array
parameters.description: array to sort.

parameters.name: origin
parameters.description: the origin from which to compare.

parameters.name: <maxReturnCount
parameters.description: if set then only the first <max> count of entities will be returned.

parameters.name: minDist
parameters.description: if set then only the entities further than <minDist> will be considered.

parameters.name: maxDist
parameters.description: if set then only the entities closer then <maxDist will be considered.

api.example: a_close_targets = ArraySortClosest( a_enemies, self.origin, a_enemies.size, 0, n_radius );
remarks: A frequent pattern passes the array size as the count and 0 as the minimum distance, so only the maximum distance filters the result.
Undefined can be passed for the count when only the distance limits matter.

api.name: ArtilleryIconLocation
api.description: Set the artillery icon location.

parameters.name: teamNum

parameters.name: isActive

parameters.name: isMortar

parameters.name: clientNum
parameters.description: The client number.

api.description: Returns an angle corresponding to a particular sin value.

parameters.name: sinValue

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: The mapping table index.

remarks: Observed indices are small literals (0, 1 and 2), with 0 used to return the entity to its default table.

api.name: AsmGetCurrentDeltaAnimation
api.description: Gets the current delta animation from the ASM.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity whose animation state machine is queried.

returns.description: The name of the animation currently supplying the movement delta.

remarks: Used by locomotion code to find out which animation is currently driving the entity's movement delta.

api.name: ASMGetCurrentState
api.description: Gets the current ASM state name.

api.name: ASMGetStatus
api.description: Gets the current ASM status.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity whose animation state machine is queried.

returns.description: The current status of the animation state machine, such as "asm_status_complete".

remarks: The returned status is compared against string constants, with "asm_status_complete" being the value scripts wait for.

api.name: ASMIsAimLayerActive
api.description: Returns whether the ASM aim layer is active.

api.name: ASMIsShootLayerActive
api.description: Returns whether the ASM shoot layer is active.

api.name: ASMIsSubStatePending
api.description: Returns whether an ASM sub-state is pending.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity whose animation state machine is queried.

returns.description: Whether a sub-state change is still pending.

remarks: Checked together with ASMIsTransitionRunning and AsmIsTransDecRunning to decide whether the state machine is settled enough to act on.

api.name: ASMIsTerminating
api.description: Returns whether the ASM is terminating.

api.name: AsmIsTransDecRunning
api.description: Returns whether an ASM transition decision is running.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity whose animation state machine is queried.

returns.description: Whether a transition decision is currently running.

remarks: Usually combined with ASMIsTransitionRunning so that behavior code only proceeds once no transition work is outstanding.

api.name: ASMIsTransitionRunning
api.description: Returns whether an ASM transition is currently running.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity whose animation state machine is queried.

returns.description: Whether a transition is currently running.

remarks: Behavior tree code guards state changes on this, waiting for the transition to end before starting new movement or cover work.

api.name: AsmRequestSubstate
api.description: Requests that the entity is changed to the given animation state machine (ASM) substate.

calledOn.name: target
calledOn.description: The entity to change the ASM substate of.

parameters.name: substateName
parameters.description: The substate name to change the entity to.

api.name: ASMSetAnimationRate
api.description: Changes the delta animation playback rate for an entity driven by the animation state machine.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity whose animation rate is set.

parameters.name: rate
parameters.description: (float).

remarks: Rates are fractions around 1, with values below 1 slowing an AI down and 1 restoring normal speed.
Randomized rates are used to desynchronize identical characters animating together.

api.name: Assert
api.description: Assert that the given statement is correct. The function will throw a script error if this is false.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: statement that is asserted to be correct.

parameters.name: desc
parameters.description: string describing the nature of the assert.

api.example: Assert( IsDefined( str_dialog_name ), "Dialog name is undefined." );
remarks: The overwhelmingly common form asserts IsDefined on an argument at the top of a function, often with a message explaining the failure.
Also used for range and type checks such as IsPlayer( self ) or a size being non-zero.

api.name: AssertMsg
api.description: Throws a script error with the given message.

parameters.name: message
parameters.description: error message.

remarks: Typically placed in the default branch of a switch or at the end of a lookup to report an unhandled name, with the offending value concatenated into the message.

api.name: AssociativeArray
api.description: Creates an array associatively from key-value pairs.

parameters.name: keyValuePairs
parameters.description: Zero or more alternating arguments of keys and values (i.e. key_1, value_1). The amount of arguments passed must be even.

returns.name: array
returns.description: The created array.

api.name: AstSearch
api.description: Searches an actor's animation state table (AST) for the given animation state machine (ASM) state name.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity to search the AST of.

parameters.name: asmStateName
parameters.description: The ASM state name to search for.

returns.name: result
returns.description: The found AST data as a map.

api.name: ATan
api.description: Returns an angle corresponding to a particular tangential value.

parameters.name: tanValue
parameters.description: A tangential value.

returns.description: The angle, in degrees, whose tangent is the given value.

remarks: The argument is normally a ratio of two lengths, for example a rise over a run to get a slope angle.

api.name: AtDangerousNode
api.description: Determine whether this actor is near a dangerous node.

api.name: AtGoal
api.description: Checks whether the AI actor has reached its goal.

calledOn.name: actor
calledOn.description: The AI actor.

parameters.name: tolerance
parameters.description: The distance tolerance for reaching the goal.

returns.name: atGoal
returns.description: Whether the actor is at the goal.

api.name: Attach
api.description: Attaches a model to an entity, optionally at a specific tag.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity to attach the model to.

parameters.name: modelname
parameters.description: The name of the model to attach.

parameters.name: tagname
parameters.description: The tag to attach the model to.

parameters.name: ignoreCollision
parameters.description: Whether to ignore collision. Defaults to false.

remarks: The tag is frequently omitted, in which case the model is attached without a named attach point.
Character setup code passes 1 for the collision flag when attaching cosmetic props such as heads and carried objects.

api.name: AttachPath
api.description: Attaches this vehicle to the path starting at the given node.

calledOn.name: vehicle
calledOn.description: The vehicle to attach to the path.

parameters.name: node

api.name: AttachShieldModel

parameters.name: modelname
parameters.description: The model name to attach (string).

parameters.name: tagname
parameters.description: The tag to attach the model to (string).

parameters.name: ignoreCollision
parameters.description: flag to ignore collision. Defaults to false (integer).

api.name: AttackButtonPressed
api.description: Returns whether the player is holding the fire button.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player to check.

returns.description: Whether the fire button is currently held.

remarks: Commonly polled inside a wait loop to block until the player presses or releases fire.
Often combined with the other button checks such as FragButtonPressed and MeleeButtonPressed to detect any input.

api.name: AttackedRecently
api.description: Returns whether the given entity has attacked this sentient within the last given number of seconds.

calledOn.name: sentient
calledOn.description: The sentient that may have been attacked.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: The entity that may have done the attacking.

parameters.name: time
parameters.description: The time window in seconds to look back over.

returns.description: Whether the entity attacked this sentient within the time window.

remarks: Call sites guard it with IsSentient on the receiver.
Observed time windows are small, between 2 and 10 seconds.

api.name: BadPlace_Box
api.description: Creates an axis-aligned bad place box. AI will flee this position if they can, and will not enter it if they can avoid it.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The name of the bad place. If name is not "", the bad place can be moved or deleted by using the unique name.

parameters.name: duration
parameters.description: If duration > 0, the bad place will automatically delete itself after this time. If duration <= 0, the bad place must have a name and will last until manually deleted.

parameters.name: origin
parameters.description: The center of the box in world space.

parameters.name: halfSize
parameters.description: The halfSize of the box.

parameters.name: team
parameters.description: You must specify at least one team for which this place is bad, but can give several.  The allowed teams are 'axis', 'allies', and 'neutral'.

remarks: The corpus passes "all" as often as a single team name.
An empty name is used together with a positive duration for a temporary place that is never deleted by hand.

api.name: BadPlace_Cylinder
api.description: Creates a bad place cylinder. AI will flee this position if they can, and will not enter it if they can avoid it.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The name of the bad place. If name is not "", the bad place can be moved or deleted by using the unique name.

parameters.name: duration
parameters.description: If duration > 0, the bad place will automatically delete itself after this time. If duration <= 0, the bad place must have a name and will last until manually deleted.

parameters.name: origin
parameters.description: The center of the base of the cylinder.

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description: The radius of the cylinder.

parameters.name: height
parameters.description: The height of the cylinder.

parameters.name: team
parameters.description: You must specify at least one team for which this place is bad, but can give several.  The allowed teams are 'axis', 'allies', and 'neutral'.

remarks: A named cylinder created with a duration of -1 lasts until BadPlace_Delete is called with the same name.
Names are often built from an instance identifier so that each owner can delete only its own bad place.

api.name: BadPlace_Delete
api.description: Deletes the named bad place. Deleting a name that does not exist is allowed, but the special name "" cannot be deleted.

parameters.name: badPlaceIdentifier
parameters.description: The name given to the bad place when it was created.

remarks: Pairs with BadPlace_Box and BadPlace_Cylinder created with a name and a duration of zero or less.

api.name: Bot_EnterUserEdge
api.description: Instructs a bot to enter a user-defined navigation edge.

parameters.name: bot
parameters.description: The bot entity.

parameters.name: edgeId
parameters.description: The edge identifier.

api.name: BotCancelPath
api.description: Cancels the current pathfinding request for the bot.

calledOn.name: bot
calledOn.description: The bot player.

api.name: BotClassAddAttachment
api.description: Adds an attachment to a weapon in the bot's custom class.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The bot whose custom class is being built.

parameters.name: classIndex
parameters.description: The index of the class to modify.

parameters.name: weapon
parameters.description: The weapon to attach to.

parameters.name: attachment
parameters.description: The name of the attachment to add.

parameters.name: slot
parameters.description: The attachment slot to place it in, such as "primaryattachment1".

remarks: Bot loadout code fills the slots in order with the strings "primaryattachment1", "primaryattachment2" and "primaryattachment3".
The weapon must already have been added to the class with BotClassAddItem.

api.name: BotClassAddItem
api.description: Adds an item to the bot's custom class.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The bot whose custom class is being built.

parameters.name: classIndex
parameters.description: The index of the class to add the item to.

parameters.name: item
parameters.description: The name of the item to add.

remarks: Used to build a bot's class from weapons, hero abilities, killstreaks and bonus card names such as "BONUSCARD_PRIMARY_GUNFIGHTER".

api.name: BotClassSetWeaponOption
api.description: Sets a weapon option for the bot's custom class.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The bot whose custom class is being built.

parameters.name: weaponClass
parameters.description: The class index the weapon belongs to.

parameters.name: weapon
parameters.description: The weapon to set the option on.

parameters.name: optionType
parameters.description: The name of the option to set.

parameters.name: optionValue
parameters.description: The identifier of the option value to apply.

api.example: self BotClassSetWeaponOption( weaponClass, primary, optionType, optionId );
remarks: The option value observed is an identifier looked up from level.botWeaponOptionsId for the given option type, such as a camo or reticle choice.

api.name: BotDropClient
api.description: Removes the bot client from the game.

calledOn.name: bot
calledOn.description: The bot player to remove.

remarks: Used to remove test clients added with AddTestClient.

api.name: BotGetFov
api.description: Gets the bot's field of view.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The bot to query.

remarks: Bot combat code reads it to decide whether a threat lies within the bot's view cone.

api.name: BotGetGoalPosition
api.description: Returns the position the bot is currently pathing toward.

calledOn.name: bot
calledOn.description: The bot player.

returns.name: position
returns.description: The goal position.

remarks: Commonly compared against a point with DistanceSquared or Distance2DSquared, using BotGetGoalRadius as the tolerance.

api.name: BotGetGoalRadius
api.description: Returns the radius within which the bot considers its current goal reached.

calledOn.name: bot
calledOn.description: The bot player.

returns.name: radius
returns.description: The goal radius.

remarks: Paired with BotGetGoalPosition to test whether a point counts as the bot's current goal.

api.name: BotGetJetEnergy
api.description: Gets the current jet energy level of the bot.

calledOn.name: bot
calledOn.description: The bot player.

returns.name: energy
returns.description: The current jet energy level.

api.name: BotGetThreats
api.description: Returns an array of the threats the bot can see within the given distance.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The bot to query.

parameters.name: maxDistance
parameters.description: The maximum distance to search for threats.

remarks: Bot combat code defaults the maximum distance to zero before calling, so zero appears to mean no distance limit.

api.name: BotGoalReached
api.description: Gets whether the bot has reached its goal.

calledOn.name: bot
calledOn.description: The bot player.

returns.name: hasReachedGoal
returns.description: Whether the bot's goal has been reached.

api.name: BotGoalSet
api.description: Gets whether the bot has a goal.

calledOn.name: bot
calledOn.description: The bot player.

returns.name: hasGoal
returns.description: Whether the bot has a goal.

api.name: BotInLastStand
api.description: Checks whether the bot is in last stand.

calledOn.name: bot
calledOn.description: The bot player.

returns.name: inLastStand
returns.description: Whether the bot is in last stand.

api.name: BotInLowReady
api.description: Checks whether the bot is in low ready stance.

calledOn.name: bot
calledOn.description: The bot player.

returns.name: inLowReady
returns.description: Whether the bot is in low ready.

api.name: BotLeaveGame
api.description: Causes the bot to leave the game.

calledOn.name: bot
calledOn.description: The bot player.

api.name: BotLookAtPoint
api.description: Makes the bot look at the given point.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The bot to aim.

parameters.name: point
parameters.description: The world position for the bot to look at.

remarks: Used with an aim point computed on the threat, or with a raised version of a traversal point.
BotLookForward and BotLookNone clear the look target set here.

api.name: BotLookForward
api.description: Makes the bot look in its forward direction.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The bot to reset.

remarks: Used to drop a look target set with BotLookAtPoint, often alongside BotReleaseManualControl when a scripted sequence ends.

api.name: BotLookNone
api.description: Clears any look target set for the bot.

calledOn.name: bot
calledOn.description: The bot player.

remarks: Used in traversal code to hand the bot's aim back to its own behavior.

api.name: BotPressButton
api.description: Instructs a bot to start pressing and holding a particular button action.

calledOn.name: bot
calledOn.description: The bot player.

parameters.name: buttonActionId
parameters.description: The button action ID, which corresponds to a unique action defined in `bot_buttons.gsc`.

api.name: BotPressButtonForGadget
api.description: Instructs the bot to press the button for a given gadget.

calledOn.name: bot
calledOn.description: The bot to press the button on.

parameters.name: gadgetIndex
parameters.description: The index of the gadget to activate.

remarks: Used for gadgets that are not gun gadgets and not hero weapons, which are handled with SwitchToWeapon and the offhand special button instead.

api.name: BotReleaseButton
api.description: Instructs a bot to release a particular button action that is currently held.

calledOn.name: bot
calledOn.description: The bot player.

parameters.name: buttonActionId
parameters.description: The button action ID to release, which corresponds to a unique action in `bot_buttons.gsc`.

api.name: BotReleaseButtons
api.description: Releases all buttons the bot is currently holding.

calledOn.name: bot
calledOn.description: The bot player.

api.name: BotReleaseManualControl
api.description: Releases manual control of the bot.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The bot to release.

remarks: Called at the end of scripted bot movement to hand control back to the bot's own behavior, typically together with BotLookForward.

api.name: BotRequestPath
api.description: Requests a pathfinding calculation for the bot.

calledOn.name: bot
calledOn.description: The bot player.

remarks: Called at the end of a traversal, before BotReleaseManualControl, so the bot repaths from its new position.

api.name: BotSetCustomization
api.description: Sets the customization options for the bot.

calledOn.name: bot
calledOn.description: The bot player.

parameters.name: headIndex
parameters.description: The head customization index.

parameters.name: bodyIndex
parameters.description: The body customization index.

parameters.name: helmetIndex
parameters.description: The helmet customization index.

parameters.name: heroIndex
parameters.description: The hero customization index.

api.name: BotSetDefaultClass
api.description: Sets a default class for a slot on a bot.

calledOn.name: bot
calledOn.description: The bot player.

parameters.name: slot
parameters.description: The class slot number.

parameters.name: className
parameters.description: The name of the class to use for this slot (e.g. `class_cqb`).

api.name: BotSetGoal
api.description: Sets a goal for the given bot.

calledOn.name: bot
calledOn.description: The bot to set the goal on.

parameters.name: goal
parameters.description: The goal location for the bot.

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description: The radius around the goal that the bot can arrive.

returns.name: goalSet
returns.description: Whether the goal could be set.

api.name: BotSetLookAngles
api.description: Sets the bot's look direction vector.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The bot to aim.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: The forward direction for the bot to look along.

remarks: Call sites pass a forward vector, either a movement direction or the result of AnglesToForward on an angles value.

api.name: BotSetLookAnglesFromPoint
api.description: Sets the bot's look angles calculated from the given point.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The bot to aim.

parameters.name: point
parameters.description: The world position to look toward.

remarks: Used with a traversal node origin or a target's centroid so the bot looks toward that position.

api.name: BotSetLookDir
api.description: Sets the direction the bot should look towards.

calledOn.name: bot
calledOn.description: The bot player.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: The direction vector to look towards.

api.name: BotSetLookPoint
api.description: Sets a world position the bot should look at.

calledOn.name: bot
calledOn.description: The bot player.

parameters.name: point
parameters.description: The world position to look at.

api.name: BotSetMoveAngle
api.description: Sets the direction the bot moves in.

calledOn.name: bot
calledOn.description: The bot player.

parameters.name: angles
parameters.description: The direction vector for the bot to move along.

remarks: Call sites pass a direction vector such as an escape or run direction, and often set the look direction separately with BotSetLookAngles.

api.name: BotSetMoveAngleFromPoint
api.description: Sets the bot's movement direction so that it moves toward the given point.

calledOn.name: bot
calledOn.description: The bot player.

parameters.name: point
parameters.description: The target point to derive movement angle from.

remarks: Traversal code calls it repeatedly with the origin of the node the bot is moving to.

api.name: BotSetMoveMagnitude
api.description: Sets the movement speed magnitude for the bot.

calledOn.name: bot
calledOn.description: The bot player.

parameters.name: magnitude
parameters.description: The movement speed magnitude.

api.name: BotSetRandomCharacterCustomization
api.description: Gives the bot a randomly chosen character customization.

calledOn.name: bot
calledOn.description: The bot to customize.

remarks: Called on a bot right after AddTestClient, before its class is assigned.

api.name: BotSightTrace
api.description: Returns whether the bot has a clear line of sight to the given entity.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: The entity to trace to.

returns.description: True if the sight trace to the entity is clear, false otherwise.

remarks: Bot code combines it with a dot product field of view check before engaging or moving to a threat.

api.name: BotSwitchToWeapon
api.description: Makes the bot switch to the given weapon.

parameters.name: weapon
parameters.description: The weapon to switch to.

remarks: Bot combat code calls it with a weapon chosen from the bot's own inventory before engaging.

api.name: BotTakeManualControl
api.description: Takes manual control of the bot, so that script drives it instead of the bot AI.
remarks: Pairs with BotUnderManualControl, which bot think loops check before running their normal behavior.

api.name: BotTapButton
api.description: Instructs a bot to 'tap' a particular button action.

calledOn.name: bot
calledOn.description: The bot player.

parameters.name: buttonActionId
parameters.description: The button action ID, which corresponds to a unique action in `bot_buttons.gsc`.

api.name: BotToggleDemiGodMode
api.description: Toggles demigod mode for the bot, making it take damage but not die.

calledOn.name: bot
calledOn.description: The bot player.

returns.name: enabled
returns.description: Whether demigod mode is now enabled.

api.name: BotToggleGodMode
api.description: Toggles god mode for the bot, making it invulnerable.

calledOn.name: bot
calledOn.description: The bot player.

returns.name: enabled
returns.description: Whether god mode is now enabled.

api.name: BotUnderManualControl
api.description: Returns whether the bot is currently under manual script control.

returns.description: True if the bot is under manual control, false otherwise.

remarks: Bot think and combat loops test it to skip their normal movement and targeting logic.
Manual control is established with BotTakeManualControl.

api.name: BoundsWouldTelefrag
api.description: Returns true if the passed in bounding box would telefrag a player if another player was spawned there.

parameters.name: mins
parameters.description: Mins of bounding box.

parameters.name: maxs
parameters.description: Maxs of bounding box.

remarks: Scripts pass the absolute mins and maxs of an entity or a spawn volume to test a location before spawning or dropping something there.

api.name: Box
api.description: Debug instrument.

parameters.name: args
parameters.description: The arguments.

api.name: BulletSpread
api.description: uses spread to return a new end position.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: The bullet starting point.

parameters.name: end
parameters.description: The bullet ending point.

parameters.name: spread
parameters.description: Amount of spread.

api.name: BulletTrace
api.description: Performs a bullet trace between two points and returns a map array of information about the trace result.

parameters.name: startPos
parameters.description: The starting position of the trace.

parameters.name: endPos
parameters.description: The ending position for the trace.

parameters.name: hitCharacters
parameters.description: Whether the trace should hit characters.

parameters.name: ignoreEnt
parameters.description: An entity that should be ignored by the trace, which can be `undefined`.

parameters.name: ignoreWater
parameters.description: Whether the trace should ignore water surfaces. Defaults to `false`.

parameters.name: ignoreGlass
parameters.description: Whether the trace should ignore glass surfaces. Defaults to `false`.

parameters.name: ignoreEnt2
parameters.description: If specified, a second entity that the trace should ignore.

returns.name: result
returns.description: A map of information about the bullet trace result.

api.example: a_trace = BulletTrace( org1, org2, true, undefined )

api.name: BulletTracePassed
api.description: Allows script to do a bullet point trace with ( MASK_SHOT & ~CONTENTS_SKY ) returns true if the trace does not hit anything.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: The bullet start point.

parameters.name: end
parameters.description: The bullet end point.

parameters.name: hitCharacters
parameters.description: An entity to ignore.

parameters.name: ignoreEntity
parameters.description: An entity to ignore.

parameters.name: ignoreEntity2
parameters.description: An entity to ignore.

parameters.name: fxVis
parameters.description: check against fx visibility also.

parameters.name: ignoreWater
parameters.description: mask contents_water.

returns.description: True if the trace reaches the end point without hitting anything, false otherwise.

api.example: passed = BulletTracePassed( player GetEye(), spawn_origin, 0, player );
remarks: Widely used as a line of sight test, typically with hitCharacters set to 0 and the observer passed as the ignored entity.
Origins are commonly raised by an eye or chest offset so the trace does not clip the ground.

api.name: ButtonBitState
api.description: Return true if the button_bit(s) indicated are pressed (note:  there is no way to know exactly which buttons are pressed on the client, since everything is remapped into these bit values).

parameters.name: button
parameters.description: : name of button to check "BUTTON_BIT_ATTACK" for example, optionally can include as many button names as desired.  Returns true if all buttons indicated are true.

api.name: ButtonPressed
api.description: Gets whether the host is pressing the given button or key.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player to check whether they are pressing a button.

parameters.name: buttonName
parameters.description: The unique name of the button.

returns.name: isPressed
returns.description: Whether the button is pressed.

api.name: CalcApproximatePathToPosition
api.description: Returns an array of world positions representing the approximate path an actor will take.  Calculating an approximate path will cause the AI to clear their current path.

parameters.name: position
parameters.description: The goal position for the path.

parameters.name: clearPath
parameters.description: Whether to clear the actor's current path. Defaults to true.

returns.description: An array of world positions describing the approximate path, ordered from the actor to the goal.

remarks: AI and zombie code usually passes false for clearPath so the actor keeps its current path, then measures the returned points to estimate travel distance.

api.name: CalcLookaheadPos
api.description: Calculate a lookahead point based on a given starting location and number of iterations. Returns an array with these keys: "position", "node" and "next_node", which contain vectors for the actual lookahead position and the next two nodes on the path, respectively.

parameters.name: startPos
parameters.description: Starting position of the lookahead traces.

parameters.name: numIter
parameters.description: Number of times to iterate (more gives better results, but is more expensive). Set to 0 to get current lookahead.

api.name: CalcPathLength
api.description: Calculates the path length from the entity to the given node.

parameters.name: node
parameters.description: The node to path to.

remarks: Used to compare an AI's travel distance to a node against a straight line distance.

api.name: CalcPlayerOptions
api.description: Calculates the player render options for the given custom class slot.

parameters.name: customClassSlot
parameters.description: The custom class slot index.

returns.description: The packed player render options value.

remarks: Loadout code calls it with the player's current class index while applying a class.

api.name: CalcWeaponOptions
api.description: Calculates the packed weapon options (camo and attachment appearance) for a weapon.

parameters.name: args
parameters.description: The camo or class index followed by additional option values.

returns.description: The packed weapon options value.

remarks: Loadout code passes the class slot and a weapon index; other callers pass a camo index followed by zeros.
The result is passed to GiveWeapon or stored as a weapon's "options" value.

api.name: CamAnimScripted
api.description: Plays the camera script on a player.

parameters.name: player
parameters.description: The player to play animation on.

parameters.name: cam_anim
parameters.description: The animation to play.

parameters.name: start_time
parameters.description: The start time of the animation.

parameters.name: align_origin
parameters.description: The origin to align to.

parameters.name: align_angles
parameters.description: The angles to align to.

parameters.name: lerp_duration
parameters.description: The lerp duration.

parameters.name: camera_name
parameters.description: The camera name.

parameters.name: ignoreProcessingInitialNoteTracks
parameters.description: Ignores processing the initial notetracks if the camera time starts earlier.

api.example: CamAnimScripted( player, cameraSwitcher, n_start_time, v_origin, v_angles );
remarks: Scene playback calls it with the scene's camera switcher animation and the scene's alignment origin and angles.

api.name: CameraActivate
api.description: Turns the script camera on or off.

parameters.name: active
parameters.description: True to activate the camera, false to turn it off and return to 1st person view.

remarks: Called with true after setting the camera up with CameraSetPosition and CameraSetLookAt, and with false to return the player to first person.

api.name: CameraSetAngles
api.description: Sets the focus point of the script camera.

parameters.name: position
parameters.description: Either an entity to focus the camera on or a vector defining the camera's focus point.

api.name: CameraSetLookAt
api.description: Sets the focus point of the script camera, or clears it when no argument is given.

parameters.name: position
parameters.description: Either an entity to focus the camera on or a vector defining the camera's focus point. Omit to clear the focus point.

remarks: Called with no argument to clear the focus point and let the camera use its own angles.
Usually called alongside CameraSetPosition before CameraActivate.

api.name: CameraSetPosition
api.description: Sets the position of the script camera.

parameters.name: position
parameters.description: A vector defining the world position for the camera.

parameters.name: angles
parameters.description: The angles to set for the camera.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: An entity to link the camera to.

parameters.name: angles
parameters.description: The angles to set for the camera.

remarks: Commonly paired with CameraSetLookAt and then CameraActivate to start the scripted view.
Passing an entity such as an intermission camera model links the camera to it.

api.name: CanAttackEnemyNode
api.description: Checks if this actor can attack its enemies node.

api.name: CancelAIMove
api.description: Tell the vehicle to stop moving towards its current goal position.
remarks: Vehicle AI calls it when a goal is abandoned, on death, and when handing control back to another system.

api.name: CancelGoal
api.description: Cancels a named goal previously set on the entity.

calledOn.name: actor
calledOn.description: The AI actor.

parameters.name: goalId
parameters.description: The name of the goal to cancel.

remarks: The goal is identified by the same string name used with SetGoal, HasGoal, GetGoal and AtGoal.
Bot objective code cancels one goal before setting another.

api.name: CanClaimNode
api.description: Returns true if the node is unclaimed, false otherwise.

parameters.name: node
parameters.description: pathnode to check.

api.name: CanPath
api.description: Check if a path can be found between these positions.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The actor to check the pathing of.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: The start position to path from.

parameters.name: end
parameters.description: The end position to path to.

returns.name: canPath
returns.description: Whether the entity can path between the two locations.

api.name: CanPlaceRiotshield
api.description: Checks whether this player can place a riot shield and returns placement data.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player attempting to place the riot shield.

parameters.name: deployType
parameters.description: The deploy type to test, such as deploy_riotshield.

returns.name: placement
returns.description: An associative array containing result and, when successful, origin and angles.

remarks: The returned array always contains result and only includes origin and angles when placement succeeds.

api.name: CanPlayerPlaceTurret
api.description: Try to place a Turret where the player is looking.  It'll return an array containing the placement "result", "origin", and "angles".

returns.description: An array containing the placement "result", "origin" and "angles".

remarks: The returned array is checked for its "result" value before using "origin" and "angles" to place the turret.

api.name: CanPlayerPlaceVehicle
api.description: Try to place a vehicle in front of the player.  It'll return an array containing the placement "result", "origin", and "angles".

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description: Radius of the bounds check.

parameters.name: height
parameters.description: Height of the bounds check.

parameters.name: forwardDistance
parameters.description: Distance away from player origin.

parameters.name: upDistance
parameters.description: Distance up from player origin.

parameters.name: sweepDistance
parameters.description: Distance to sweep downwards.

parameters.name: minNormal
parameters.description: Minimum hit normal needed to be pass.

returns.description: An array containing the placement "result", "origin" and "angles".

remarks: The returned array is checked for its "result" value before spawning the vehicle at "origin" and "angles".

api.name: CanSee
api.description: Check to see if the AI can see the given entity.

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: The entity to check visibility of.

parameters.name: cacheLength
parameters.description: The length of time in milliseconds to cache the result.

returns.description: True if the AI can see the entity, false otherwise.

remarks: Almost always called with the AI's current enemy, and frequently combined with CanShootEnemy before firing.

api.name: CanShoot
api.description: Check to see if the actor can shoot the given position.

parameters.name: shootAtPosition
parameters.description: (vector) The position to shoot at.

parameters.name: offsetFromGun
parameters.description: (vector) The offset from the gun muzzle from which to calculate collision.

api.name: CanShootEnemy
api.description: Check to see if the actor can shoot his current enemy.

parameters.name: cacheDuration
parameters.description: (int) When set, uses a custom time value for the cache.

returns.description: True if the actor can shoot its current enemy, false otherwise.

api.example: if ( self CanSee( self.enemy ) && self CanShootEnemy() )
remarks: Usually called immediately after CanSee on the same actor to confirm a clear shot at the current enemy.

api.name: CanThrowGrenade
api.description: Checks whether the actor can throw a grenade at a given position. If he can't then result will be undefined, otherwise the result is the resultant velocity vector.

parameters.name: handOffset
parameters.description: (vector) the estimated offset of the hand for the throw.

parameters.name: randomRange
parameters.description: (float) random range from target position to throw at.

api.name: CanThrowGrenadePos
api.description: Checks whether the actor can throw a grenade at a given position. If he can't then result will be undefined, otherwise the result is the resultant velocity vector.

parameters.name: handOffset
parameters.description: (vector) the estimated offset of the hand for the throw.

parameters.name: targetpos
parameters.description: (vector) The target position, should be at ground level of potential target.

returns.description: The velocity vector for the throw, or undefined if the throw is not possible.

api.example: throw_vel = self CanThrowGrenadePos( arm_offset, self LastKnownPos( self.enemy ) );
remarks: AI grenade code passes an arm offset and the enemy's last known position, then checks the result for undefined before throwing.

api.name: CantSeeEntities
api.description: Returns the set of entities that a player cannot see within a given angle, given a set of entities.

parameters.name: entArray
parameters.description: The entities to check against.

parameters.name: dotRange
parameters.description: The cosine of the angle representing the field of view.

parameters.name: trace
parameters.description: Whether to perform a trace to each entity.

returns.description: The subset of the given entities that the player cannot see.

remarks: Called repeatedly on the same array to narrow it down to entities no player has looked at.
The dot range is a cosine, so values near 1 mean a narrow field of view.

api.name: Carries
api.description: Gets the carry type of the current weapon.

api.name: CarryTurret
api.description: Links the auto turret to the player to carry around.

parameters.name: turret
parameters.description: The turret entity.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: The offset from the player at which to place the turret.

parameters.name: angleOffset
parameters.description: The angle offset of the turret.

remarks: Used while a placeable turret is being carried, with a forward offset in front of the player and no angle offset.

api.name: Ceil
api.description: Returns the ceiling of floating point value <a>. This effectively rounds up Ceil(2.7) == 3, Ceil(3.9) == 4.

parameters.name: a
parameters.description: A float or integer value.

remarks: Results are commonly wrapped in Int() when an integer count is needed.

api.name: ChangeAdvertisedStatus
api.description: Changes whether the game is advertised to other players.

parameters.name: onOff
parameters.description: Whether the game should be advertised.

remarks: Game advertisement scripts call it with a boolean as match conditions change, such as when the round number passes a threshold.

api.name: ChangeFontScaleOverTime
api.description: Set a hud element to transition in fontScale over time.  Normally setting the fontScale of an element causes an immediate visual change. However, if the fontScale gets set within <time> after calling ChangeFontScaleOverTime, then the hud element will transition to the new fontScale over the remaining <time>.

parameters.name: time
parameters.description: The time to scale the element font in seconds.

remarks: HUD fade helpers call it just before assigning a new fontScale, so the change interpolates instead of snapping.

api.name: ChangeSeatButtonPressed
api.description: Check if the player is pressing the change seat (Y) button.

returns.description: True if the player is pressing the change seat button, false otherwise.

remarks: Scripts reuse it as a generic button check outside vehicles, and often follow it with a wait loop until the button is released.

api.name: CheckGrenadeThrow
api.description: Checks whether the actor can throw a grenade at his target. If he can't then result will be undefined, otherwise the result is the resultant velocity vector.

parameters.name: handOffset
parameters.description: (vector) the estimated offset of the hand for the throw.

parameters.name: method
parameters.description: (string) The grenade toss method. Can be 'min energy', 'min time', and 'max tune'.

parameters.name: randomRange
parameters.description: (float) random range from target position to throw at.

api.name: CheckGrenadeThrowPos
api.description: Checks whether the actor can throw a grenade at a given position. If he can't then result will be undefined, otherwise the result is the resultant velocity vector.

parameters.name: handOffset
parameters.description: (vector) the estimated offset of the hand for the throw.

parameters.name: method
parameters.description: (vector) The grenade toss method. Can be 'min energy', 'min time', and 'max tune'.

parameters.name: targetpos
parameters.description: (vector) The target position, should be at ground level of potential target.

api.example: throwvel = self CheckGrenadeThrowPos( armOffset, "min energy", targetPos )

parameters.name: aliasname
parameters.description: The sound alias to play (string).

api.name: CheckNavMeshDirection
api.description: Run a trace on NavMesh to get the furthest position a character can move in that direction.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: start of the trace.

parameters.name: dir
parameters.description: direction to trace.

parameters.name: dist
parameters.description: distance to trace.

parameters.name: characterRadius
parameters.description: the radius of the capsule used in trace. default to 0.

parameters.name: materialFlags
parameters.description: the flags marking whether a face type can be used.

returns.description: The furthest position on the NavMesh reachable in that direction.

remarks: Bot traversal code passes an unnormalized direction vector between two node origins and a small character radius to find ledge edges.

api.name: CheckpointClear
api.description: Clears the current checkpoint data.
remarks: Campaign player code clears checkpoint data when a save is discarded.

api.name: CheckpointCommit
api.description: Commits the current checkpoint data.
remarks: Always called directly after CheckpointCreate and the per-player data writes that follow it.

api.name: CheckpointCreate
api.description: Creates a new checkpoint.
remarks: Begins a checkpoint that is finished with CheckpointCommit and later reloaded with CheckpointRestore.

api.name: CheckpointRestore
api.description: Restores the game state from the last checkpoint.
remarks: Used by campaign load and coop code to reload the state committed by CheckpointCommit.

api.name: CheckProne
api.description: Returns true when a character can go prone at the specified position. Specifically setup for use by AI characters.

parameters.name: position
parameters.description: (vector) The position of the prone character.

parameters.name: yaw
parameters.description: (float) The world yaw in degrees.

parameters.name: isProne
parameters.description: (bool) Flag if the character is already prone.

api.example: canFitProne = self CheckProne( origin, yaw, alreadyProne )

api.name: ChooseBetterCoverNode
api.description: Chooses a better cover node for an ai.
remarks: Called from AI cover behavior, and the returned node is checked for undefined before being used.

api.name: Circle
api.description: Draws a debug circle in the world.

parameters.name: args
parameters.description: The circle origin, radius, color and optional draw flags and duration.

remarks: Call sites pass an origin, a radius, an RGB color vector, a fill flag, a depth flag, and a number of server frames to persist.
Only the first three arguments are always supplied; the rest are optional.

api.name: ClearAllNonCheckpointData
api.description: Clears all non-checkpoint data for the player.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player.

remarks: Campaign code calls it on each player when resetting state that should not survive a checkpoint restore.

api.name: ClearAnim
api.description: Sets an animation's goal weight (and the goal weights of all of its descendents) to zero over the specified time.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity or model playing the animation.

parameters.name: animation
parameters.description: The animation or animtree node to clear.

parameters.name: time
parameters.description: The blending time for the clear.

remarks: The animation is usually given as an animtree node reference (for example %root), but a plain animation name string is also accepted.
A time of 0 clears the animation instantly, and is the common choice when stopping a deploy or death animation on a model.

api.name: ClearAnimLimited
api.description: Sets an animation's goal weight to zero over the specified time.

parameters.name: animation
parameters.description: The animation or animtree node to clear.

parameters.name: time
parameters.description: The blending time for the clear.

api.name: ClearCyberComAbility
api.description: Clears a cyber com ability from the player, or all of the player's abilities when no name is given.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player.

parameters.name: abilityName
parameters.description: The name of the ability to clear, or omitted to clear all abilities.

returns.name: result
returns.description: The result code.

remarks: Called with no argument to strip every cyber com ability at once, and with a name to clear a single ability.
Typically paired with the script side ability bookkeeping that marks an ability as taken.

api.name: ClearCyberComRig
api.description: Clears a cyber com rig from the player.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player.

parameters.name: rigName
parameters.description: The name of the rig to clear.

returns.name: result
returns.description: The result code.

remarks: Observed when a tactical rig ability is taken away, alongside a refresh of the player's cyber com flags.

api.name: ClearDamageIndicator
api.description: Clears the player's on screen damage indicator.

calledOn.name: client
calledOn.description: The player whose damage indicator is cleared.

api.name: ClearDefaultPitch
api.description: Clears the desired default pitch for a vehicle.

api.name: ClearEnemy
api.description: Clears the actor's current enemy entity.

calledOn.name: actor
calledOn.description: The AI actor to clear the enemy on.

remarks: Used when an AI should stop engaging, for example when it is put back under script control or its target becomes invalid.

api.name: ClearEntityOwner
api.description: Clears an AI's entity owner.

calledOn.name: actor
calledOn.description: The AI actor to clear the owner on.

api.name: ClearEntityTarget
api.description: Clears an AI's entity target.

calledOn.name: actor
calledOn.description: The AI actor to clear the entity target on.

remarks: Takes no arguments, and is commonly called next to ClearForcedGoal and ClearGoalVolume when releasing an AI from a scripted objective.

api.name: ClearFixedNodeSafeVolume
api.description: Clears this actor's fixed node safe volume.

calledOn.name: actor
calledOn.description: The AI actor to clear the fixed node safe volume on.

remarks: Observed only in the shared color script, when an AI's fixed node behavior is turned off.

api.name: ClearForcedGoal
api.description: Clears the forced goal previously set on this AI.

calledOn.name: sentient
calledOn.description: The AI whose forced goal is cleared.

remarks: Widely used to hand an AI back to its normal behavior after a scripted move, often together with ClearGoalVolume and ClearEntityTarget.

api.name: ClearGoalVolume
api.description: Clears this actor's goal volume.

calledOn.name: sentient
calledOn.description: The AI whose goal volume is cleared.

remarks: Frequently called immediately after ClearForcedGoal when an AI is released from a scripted area.

api.name: ClearGoalYaw
api.description: Clears the goal yaw direction for this vehicle.

calledOn.name: vehicle
calledOn.description: The vehicle to clear the goal yaw on.

remarks: Observed alongside ClearTargetYaw when a vehicle stops being steered towards a scripted facing.

api.name: ClearGunnerTarget
api.description: Clears the target for one of the vehicle's gunners.

calledOn.name: vehicle
calledOn.description: The vehicle whose gunner target is cleared.

parameters.name: gunnerIndex
parameters.description: The index of the gunner whose target is cleared.

remarks: The gunner index is always passed at the observed call sites, with 0 for the first gunner.
Often called next to ClearTargetEntity or ClearLookAtEnt when a vehicle stops tracking a target.

api.name: ClearLookAt
api.description: Clears the look-at target for the AI actor.

calledOn.name: actor
calledOn.description: The AI actor.

api.name: ClearLookAtEnt
api.description: Clears the entity or origin the vehicle is orienting towards.

calledOn.name: vehicle
calledOn.description: The vehicle to clear the look at target on.

remarks: Very common in vehicle scripts when a target is lost or the vehicle is killed, usually together with ClearTurretTarget or ClearVehGoalPos.

api.name: ClearNonCheckpointData
api.description: Clears non-checkpoint data for the given key on the player.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: The data key to clear.

remarks: Keys are often built by concatenating a system name with an index, for example "collectibles" plus the collectible index plus a field name.

api.name: ClearPath
api.description: Clears the AI's current path.

calledOn.name: actor
calledOn.description: The AI whose path is cleared.

remarks: Heavily used by archetype and behavior tree scripts to stop an AI following its current path.

api.name: ClearPerks
api.description: Removes all perks from a player.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player to remove all perks from.

remarks: Typically called while rebuilding a player's loadout or when the player enters a state that suspends their loadout, such as using a vehicle.

api.name: ClearPitchOrient
api.description: Clear pitch orientation.

api.name: ClearPlayerCorpses
api.description: Removes all player corpses from the level.
remarks: Observed in the multiplayer global logic when the match state is reset.

api.name: ClearPlayerGravity
api.description: Clears the gravity override for the player.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player whose gravity override is cleared.

remarks: Restores normal gravity for a player after a gravity override, for example when leaving a low gravity area.

api.name: ClearPotentialThreat
api.description: Clear the potential threat direction. See SetPotentialThreat for more info on potential threats.

parameters.name: dir
parameters.description: direction of the threat. This is the angle from which the NPC should expect danger.

api.name: ClearSpawnPoints
api.description: Clears all spawn points out of the given spawn point list.

parameters.name: list
parameters.description: Which list of spawn points to clear.

remarks: The list is an integer index, with 0 for the normal spawn point list and 1 for the fallback list in the shipped spawning scripts.
Usually called before repopulating a list with AddSpawnPoints and enabling it with EnableSpawnPointList.

api.name: ClearSpawnPointsBaseWeight
api.description: Clears the objective base weights set in the spawn points.

parameters.name: teamMask
parameters.description: teams that this command will affect.

api.name: ClearStowedWeapon
api.description: Clears the stowed weapon on the entity.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity whose stowed weapon is cleared.

remarks: Observed when a stowable weapon such as the riot shield is taken away or swapped out.

api.name: ClearTargetEnt
api.description: Clears the entity that this objective point is tracking.

calledOn.name: hud_element
calledOn.description: The objective point or HUD waypoint to clear.

remarks: Observed on objective points in the shared game object script when the point stops following an entity.

api.name: ClearTargetEntity
api.description: Clears the current target for this vehicle or turret.

calledOn.name: turret
calledOn.description: The turret or vehicle whose target is cleared.

remarks: Used by turrets and AI vehicles when a target dies or leaves range, often followed by ClearGunnerTarget and ClearLookAtEnt.

api.name: ClearTargetYaw
api.description: Clear the target yaw direction for this vehicle.

calledOn.name: vehicle
calledOn.description: The vehicle to clear the target yaw on.

remarks: Observed next to ClearGoalYaw and ClearVehGoalPos when a vehicle is released from a scripted heading.

api.name: ClearTopScorers
api.description: Clears the top scorers for the end of game screen.
remarks: Called from the multiplayer global logic before the top scorer list is rebuilt or at the end of a match.

api.name: ClearTurretTarget
api.description: Clears the target for the vehicle turret.

calledOn.name: vehicle
calledOn.description: The vehicle whose turret target is cleared.

parameters.name: turretIndex
parameters.description: 0 for turret, 1-4 for gunners.

remarks: The turret index is usually omitted, which clears the vehicle's main turret.
Commonly called together with ClearLookAtEnt when a vehicle stops tracking or is destroyed.

api.name: ClearUsePosition
api.description: Clears the use position override for this AI.

calledOn.name: actor
calledOn.description: The AI whose use position is cleared.

remarks: Observed in archetype and behavior tree scripts when an AI finishes using a scripted position.

api.name: ClearVehGoalPos
api.description: Clears the goal position for this vehicle.

calledOn.name: vehicle
calledOn.description: The vehicle whose goal position is cleared.

remarks: One of the most common vehicle calls, used when a vehicle should stop driving to a scripted position, including on death.

api.name: ClientAnnouncement
api.description: Sends an announcement to a single client.

parameters.name: clientnum
parameters.description: The client number that the announcement is sent to.

parameters.name: string
parameters.description: The announcement.

parameters.name: duration
parameters.description: How long, in seconds, to display the announcement.

api.name: ClientClaimTrigger
api.description: Claims a use trigger for a single player, so that only that player can use it.

calledOn.name: client
calledOn.description: The player claiming the trigger.

parameters.name: trigger
parameters.description: The trigger entity to claim.

remarks: Used for pickup and use triggers that should belong to one player, such as placeable killstreaks and dropped weapons.
Paired with ClientReleaseTrigger to hand the trigger back.

api.name: ClientPrint
api.description: Print a localized version of this string for a given client.

parameters.name: client
parameters.description: A client entity.

parameters.name: string
parameters.description: A message to print.

api.name: ClientReleaseTrigger
api.description: Releases a use trigger previously claimed for a single player.

calledOn.name: client
calledOn.description: The player releasing the trigger.

parameters.name: trigger
parameters.description: The trigger entity to release.

remarks: The counterpart to ClientClaimTrigger, called when the player should no longer own the trigger.

api.name: ClientSysRegister
api.description: Declares a system who's state will be communicated over to the client script system when it changes.  Takes a unique name, and returns the id of the system.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The unique name of the system to be registered.

returns.description: The id of the registered client system.

remarks: Scripts register each system once and store the returned id, then pass that id to ClientSysSetState.

api.name: ClientSysSetState
api.description: Sets the state of a pre registered client system for all clients.  The state will be communicated to the client script system.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The integer id of the client system.  Returned from call to ClientSysRegister.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Arbitrary string state.  Will be sent to the client script system.

remarks: The id argument is the value returned by ClientSysRegister, cached in level._clientSys by the shared utility wrapper.

api.name: CloneAndRemoveEntity
api.description: Creates a new entity at the position/orientation/pose of the original, and kills the original.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: The entity to clone and then remove.

returns.description: The newly created clone entity.

remarks: Observed in cyber com gadget scripts to swap a live AI for an inert copy in the same pose.

api.name: ClonePlayer
api.description: Clones the player's model for death animations.

calledOn.name: client
calledOn.description: The player to clone.

parameters.name: deathAnimationDuration
parameters.description: The duration of the death animation.

parameters.name: killingWeapon
parameters.description: The weapon that killed the player.

parameters.name: attacker
parameters.description: The attacker that killed the player.

returns.description: The cloned body entity.

api.example: body = self ClonePlayer( deathAnimDuration, clone_weapon, attacker );
remarks: Called from the death handling in global logic, and all observed call sites pass the killing weapon and the attacker.

api.name: CloseFile
api.description: Closes an open file.

parameters.name: fileHandle
parameters.description: The handle of the file to close.

returns.description: 1 if the file was closed successfully, -1 otherwise.

remarks: Paired with the file opening builtin in debug and spawn logic dumps, and the handle should not be used afterwards.

api.name: CloseInGameMenu
api.description: Closes the in-game menu for this client.

calledOn.name: client
calledOn.description: The player whose in-game menu is closed.

remarks: Commonly called on a player when gameplay resumes, for example on spawn, on death, or when a killcam starts.

api.name: CloseLUIMenu
api.description: Closes the given LUI menu and returns true if it finds the menu and succeeds in closing it, false otherwise.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player the menu is open for.

parameters.name: luiMenuHandle
parameters.description: The handle to the LUI menu to close.

returns.description: Whether the menu was found and closed.

remarks: The handle comes from OpenLUIMenu or GetLUIMenu, and is usually stored on the player until the menu is closed.

api.name: CloseMenu
api.description: Closes the specified menu for this client.

calledOn.name: client
calledOn.description: The player to close the menu for.

parameters.name: menuIndex
parameters.description: The precached menu index of type "menu".

remarks: Called either with a menu name string or with a precached menu stored in the game table, such as game[ "menu_changeclass" ].

api.name: Closer
api.description: Tests which of two points is the closest. Returns true if point a is closer to the reference than point b.

parameters.name: reference
parameters.description: The base position.

parameters.name: pointA
parameters.description: The first point.

parameters.name: pointB
parameters.description: The second point.

api.name: CodeGetClientField
api.description: Returns the value of the given client field on an entity.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: The entity the field is stored on.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Unique name to identify the field.

remarks: Scripts reach this through the clientfield_shared wrappers rather than calling it directly.

api.name: CodeGetPlayerStateClientField
api.description: Returns the value of the given player state client field.

parameters.name: player
parameters.description: The player the field is stored on.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Unique name to identify the field.

remarks: Scripts reach this through the clientfield_shared wrappers rather than calling it directly.

api.name: CodeGetUIModelClientField
api.description: Returns the value of the given UI model client field for a player.

parameters.name: player
parameters.description: The player the field is stored on.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Unique name to identify the field.

remarks: Scripts reach this through the clientfield_shared wrappers rather than calling it directly.

api.name: CodeGetWorldClientField
api.description: Returns the value of the given world client field.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Unique name to identify the field.

remarks: World fields take no entity; scripts reach this through the clientfield_shared wrappers.

api.name: CodeIncrementClientField
api.description: Increments the value of the given client field on an entity.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: The entity the field is stored on.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Unique name to identify the field.

remarks: Pairs with CodeSetClientField and CodeGetClientField, and is reached through the clientfield_shared wrappers.

api.name: CodeIncrementPlayerStateClientField
api.description: Increments the value of the given player state client field.

parameters.name: player
parameters.description: The player the field is stored on.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Unique name to identify the field.

remarks: Pairs with CodeSetPlayerStateClientField, and is reached through the clientfield_shared wrappers.

api.name: CodeIncrementUIModelClientField
api.description: Increments the value of the given UI model client field for a player.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: The player the field is stored on.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Unique name to identify the field.

remarks: Pairs with CodeSetUIModelClientField, and is reached through the clientfield_shared wrappers.

api.name: CodeIncrementWorldClientField
api.description: Increments the value of the given world client field.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Unique name to identify the field.

remarks: World fields take no entity; pairs with CodeSetWorldClientField.

api.name: CodeSetClientField
api.description: Sets the value of the given client field on an entity.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: The entity the field is stored on.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Unique name to identify the field.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: Value to transmit.

remarks: Values observed are small integers used as states, such as 0 to clear an effect and 1 or 2 to select one.
Usually reached through the clientfield_shared wrappers rather than called directly.

api.name: CodeSetPlayerStateClientField
api.description: Sets the value of the given player state client field.

parameters.name: player
parameters.description: The player the field is stored on.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Unique name to identify the field.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: Value to transmit.

remarks: Pairs with CodeGetPlayerStateClientField, and is reached through the clientfield_shared wrappers.

api.name: CodeSetUIModelClientField
api.description: Sets the value of the given UI model client field for a player.

parameters.name: player
parameters.description: The player the field is stored on.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Unique name to identify the field.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: Value to transmit.

remarks: UI model field names are dotted paths into the client UI model, such as "safehouse.inTrainingSim".

api.name: CodeSetWorldClientField
api.description: Sets the value of the given world client field.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Unique name to identify the field.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: Value to transmit.

remarks: World fields take no entity; pairs with CodeGetWorldClientField.

api.name: CollideWithActors
api.description: Toggles collision with other actors. Actor will go through each other, when its toggled off.

api.name: CollisionTestPointsInSphere
api.description: Returns an array of collision result structures.

api.name: CombineAngles
api.description: Returns angles b reoriented by angles a.

parameters.name: anglesA
parameters.description: Angles representing the orientation in which to place <angles b>.

parameters.name: anglesB
parameters.description: Angles which will be reoriented.

api.name: ConnectPaths
api.description: Connects the paths that intersect with the entity.

calledOn.name: target
calledOn.description: The entity to connect the paths on.

remarks: If the entity is a `script_brushmodel` then it must have `DYNAMICPATH` set to connect paths.

api.name: ConsumableDecrement
api.description: Decrement a specified consumable for the player by the specified amount.

api.name: ConsumableGet
api.description: Returns the value of the specified consumable stat for the player.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player to read the consumable stat from.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: The consumable category, for example "blackjack".

parameters.name: stat
parameters.description: The stat within the category, for example "awarded" or "consumed".

remarks: Observed only with the "blackjack" category, where the "awarded" and "consumed" stats are subtracted to get remaining time.

api.name: ConsumableIncrement
api.description: Increments the specified consumable stat for the player by the given amount.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player whose consumable stat is incremented.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: The consumable category, for example "blackjack".

parameters.name: stat
parameters.description: The stat within the category to increment.

parameters.name: amount
parameters.description: The amount to increment by.

remarks: Pairs with ConsumableGet, which is used to check the remaining amount before incrementing.

api.name: ConsumableSet
api.description: Set a specified consumable for the player to the specified amount.

api.name: Cos
api.description: Returns the cosine of an angle given in degrees.

parameters.name: angle
parameters.description: An angle in degrees.

remarks: Frequently paired with Sin to build direction vectors, and used with a dot product to test whether a target is within a field of view.

api.name: CountPlayers
api.description: Returns a count of the current players, even if they are still connecting to the game.

parameters.name: team
parameters.description: - if specifed, returns lists of players on different teams, in team based game modes.  Valid values "allies", "axis", "neutral" & "all".

api.name: CreateDynEntAndLaunch
api.description: Creates a dynamic entity from a model and launches it with the given force.

parameters.description: The model to spawn as a dynamic entity.
