parameters.name: pos
parameters.description: position to spawn at.

parameters.name: angles
parameters.description: angles to spawn at.

parameters.name: hitpos
parameters.description: the hit position.

parameters.name: force
parameters.description: The force of the launch.

parameters.name: fx
parameters.description: particle effects to play on this dynent.

api.example: CreateDynEntAndLaunch( self.deathmodel, self.origin, self.angles, self.origin, self.velocity * 0.01, level._effect[ "quadrotor_crash" ] );
remarks: Used on death to replace a destroyed vehicle with a physics wreck, passing the entity's own origin, angles, and scaled velocity.

api.name: CreateFlashbackClone
api.description: Clones the player's model for use as a temporary flashback model.

calledOn.name: client
calledOn.description: The player to clone.

remarks: Seen only in the flashback gadget, which keeps the returned clone until the flashback ends.

api.name: CreateStreamerHint
api.description: Creates a streamer hint entity at a position, so that streaming is biased toward that viewpoint.

parameters.name: origin
parameters.description: Location at which to spawn the streamer hint.

parameters.name: factor
parameters.description: The relative importance of this entity's viewpoint to the main viewpoint.

parameters.name: lightingState
parameters.description: The lighting state to stream.

returns.description: The streamer hint entity.

remarks: The returned entity is stored so it can be removed later.
Call sites pass a factor of 1 for a full-importance hint.

api.name: CreateThreatBiasGroup
api.description: Creates a new threat bias group, doing nothing if it already exists.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The name of the threat bias group to create.

remarks: Groups are created at level init, usually several at once, and named after the side or role they represent, such as "players" or "zombies".

api.name: CreateTrack
api.description: Set the node enabled or disabled for vehicle pathfinding.  SetVehGoalPos will now return true or false if it can find a path.

api.name: CurrentSessionMode
api.description: Returns the index of the current session mode.
remarks: Passed to mode-dependent lookups such as GetPlayerGenderType and GetCharacterFields.

api.name: CylinderDamage
api.description: Applies damage within a cylinder, where the cylinder vector gives the direction and length relative to the base origin.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity inflicting the damage.

parameters.name: cylinder_vec
parameters.description: contains the direction and the length of the cylinder relative to the base origin.

parameters.name: origin
parameters.description: Origin of damage.

parameters.name: near_radius
parameters.description: Radius of the damage at the near end.

parameters.name: far_radius
parameters.description: Radius of the damage at the far end.

parameters.name: max_damage
parameters.description: Max damage, this is the damage at the origin.

parameters.name: min_damage
parameters.description: Minimum damage, applied at the edge of the radius.

parameters.name: attacker
parameters.description: Attacker the dealt the damage.

parameters.name: means_of_death
parameters.description: Means of death of the damage.

parameters.name: weapon
parameters.description: Weapon used to damage.

api.example: self CylinderDamage( explosionDir * damageHeight, explodePos, damageRadius, damageRadius, damageMax, damageMin, self.owner, "MOD_EXPLOSIVE", self.weapon );
remarks: Called on the inflictor entity, and the optional attacker, means of death, and weapon are passed together when a kill needs to be attributed.

api.name: DamageConeTrace
api.description: Determines how much the entity can be seen from the given position. Performs multiple traces and returns an approximation to how much of the entity is visible from the given point (between 0 and 1). In SinglePlayer this will always be 1 if the entity is partially visible.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity whose visibility is being tested.

parameters.name: damagePosition
parameters.description: The point the sight starts at.

parameters.name: ignoreEntity
parameters.description: An entity to ignore when doing the traces.

parameters.name: damageAngles
parameters.description: The forward direction of the cone, whose base is at the <damage position>.  Must be normalized.

parameters.name: coneAngle
parameters.description: Angle in degrees from the line of sight to the edge of the cone.  Defaults to 65.

remarks: Called on the potential victim, with the damage source position first and the inflictor passed as the entity to ignore.
Results are usually compared against 0 to test whether the target is visible at all.

api.name: DamageMode
api.description: Set the damage mode of this actor.

parameters.name: damageMode
parameters.description: (const string) DamageMode must be 'normal' or 'next_shot_kills'.

api.name: DamageRiotShield
api.description: Apply damage to a player riot shield or other weapon that supports damage states.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player that should sustain the shield damage.

parameters.name: damage
parameters.description: The amount of damage to apply.

returns.name: newHealth
returns.description: The new health of the shield after damage.

api.name: DeactivateClientExploder
api.description: Deactivates a client side exploder.

parameters.name: exploderId
parameters.description: id of exploder to deactivate.

remarks: The numeric id comes from the exploder id table built by exploder_shared.

api.name: DeactivateClientRadiantExploder
api.description: Deactivates a client side radiant exploder.

parameters.name: exploderId
parameters.description: string id of exploder to deactivate.

remarks: Takes the Radiant exploder name directly, unlike DeactivateClientExploder which takes a looked-up numeric id.

api.name: DeathCamTime
api.description: Gets the death camera duration.

returns.name: time
returns.description: The death camera time in seconds.

api.name: DeathStreakActive
api.description: Returns true if player's death streak is active.

api.name: DebugBreak
api.description: Triggers a debug breakpoint in the script.

api.name: DebugStar
api.description: Draw a star on screen

parameters.name: vector
parameters.description: location vector position of the debugstar

parameters.name: duration
parameters.description: How many server frames the line should persist through. Defaults to 10

parameters.name: color
parameters.description: color of star. Defaults to white

remarks: `DebugStar` must be called from the context of a devblock. *

api.name: Delete
api.description: Removes an entity from the game in the same manner as a trigger_kill.
remarks: The most common cleanup call in the corpus, used on spawned models, triggers, effect entities, and clips once they are no longer needed.
Call sites normally guard with IsDefined first, since the entity becomes undefined afterwards.

api.name: DeletePathNode
api.description: Delete a dynamically created path node or cover node.

parameters.name: node
parameters.description: The node to delete.

api.name: DeployRiotShield
api.description: Deploys a riot shield owned by the player specified.

parameters.name: owner
parameters.description: The owner of the riot shield.

parameters.name: shield
parameters.description: The shield weapon.

returns.name: deployed
returns.description: The deployed shield.

remarks: The returned entity is kept as the placed shield item so it can be tracked and removed later.

api.name: DepthInWater
api.description: Returns the depth (in inches) that the entity is in water.  Returns depth in inches, or 0 if the entity isn't in water.  Will work for all water types.
remarks: Used on any entity, including AI, to gate behavior on water depth thresholds; use DepthOfPlayerInWater for players.

api.name: DepthOfPlayerInWater
api.description: Returns the depth (in inches) that the player is in water.  Returns depth in inches, or 0 if the entity isn't in water.  Will work for all water types.  More effecient than depthinwater but will only work for players.
remarks: Used to stop burn and fire damage over time once the player enters water.

api.name: Destroy
api.description: Removes this HUD element altogether.

calledOn.name: hud_element
calledOn.description: The HUD element to remove.

remarks: Call sites normally guard with IsDefined and clear the variable afterwards, since the element becomes undefined.

api.name: Detach
api.description: Detaches an attached model from an entity.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity to detach the model from.

parameters.name: modelname
parameters.description: The name of the model to detach.

parameters.name: tagname
parameters.description: The tag the model was attached to.

remarks: The model, and the tag when one was used, are usually stored on the entity at attach time and passed back here.
Pairs with Attach; the tag may be omitted when the model was attached without one.

api.name: DetachAll
api.description: Detaches all attached models from an entity.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity to detach all models from.

remarks: Commonly used when swapping a character's body, head, or gear models, to clear every previously attached model before calling Attach again.

api.name: DetachShieldModel
api.description: Detaches an attached shield model from a player.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player carrying the shield model.

parameters.name: modelname
parameters.description: The model name to detach (string).

parameters.name: tagname
parameters.description: The tag to detach the model from (string).

remarks: Used when a player who is carrying a riot shield dies or drops it; the corpus always passes the carried shield model and the tag "tag_weapon_left".

api.name: Detonate
api.description: Detonates the entity, optionally attributing the explosion to the given player.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The projectile or explosive entity to detonate.

parameters.name: player
parameters.description: The player to credit the explosion to.

remarks: Called on projectiles and placed explosives such as missiles, rockets, grenades, and thrown weapon objects.
The owner argument is passed when the kill should be credited to a specific attacker, and is omitted when the projectile simply explodes.

api.name: DiffTrack
api.description: Returns a lagged value between <from> and <to> based on <rate> and <deltaTime>.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Float, start of the range.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Float, end of the range.

parameters.name: rate
parameters.description: The rate at which the value converges.

parameters.name: deltaTime
parameters.description: The elapsed time for this step.

remarks: Used per component to ease a vehicle's current velocity toward a target velocity while a crash plays out.

api.name: DiffTrackAngle
api.description: Returns a lagged angle between <from> and <to> based on <rate> and <deltaTime>. Properly accounts for wrapping 2pi.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Float, start of the range.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Float, end of the range.

parameters.name: rate
parameters.description: Floating point.

parameters.name: deltaTime
parameters.description: Time elapsed.

api.name: DirectionalHitIndicator
api.description: Create a directional hit indicator.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The attacking player to show the hit indicator on.

parameters.name: victims0
parameters.description: A bit array of entities 0-31 that got hit.

parameters.name: victims1
parameters.description: A bit array of entities 32-63 that got hit.

remarks: Called on the attacking player from damage feedback code, after accumulating the entity numbers of everything hit into two bit arrays.

api.name: DisableAimAssist
api.description: Disables Aim assist on the entity. Entity has to be either a brush model or an actor or a vehicle or a script_model.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity to disable aim assist on.

remarks: Paired with EnableAimAssist to turn aim assist off for an entity while it should not be targeted, such as a scripted actor, turret, or vehicle.

api.name: DisableDeathStreak
api.description: Disable player's death streak.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player whose death streak is disabled.

remarks: Paired with EnableDeathStreak; used by score event and player logic to suppress death streak rewards.

api.name: DisableDestructiblePieces
api.description: Disables all destructible pieces that have this label set in the destructible gdt.

parameters.name: label
parameters.description: the name of the field listed in the destructible gdt to disable.

api.name: DisableDriverFiring
api.description: Enables or disables the driver's vehicle turret.

calledOn.name: vehicle
calledOn.description: The vehicle to set whether firing is disabled on.

parameters.name: disabled
parameters.description: Whether the driver should not be able to fire.

api.name: DisableGrenadeSuicide
api.description: Stops cooked grenades from killing the player.
remarks: Called once during level initialization rather than per player.

api.name: DisableGrenadeTouchDamage
api.description: Resets the grenade touch damage flag of the entity.

api.name: DisableGunnerFiring
api.description: Enables or disables firing for one of a vehicle's gunners.

calledOn.name: vehicle
calledOn.description: The vehicle whose gunner is affected.

parameters.name: gunnerIndex
parameters.description: The zero based index of the gunner to affect.

parameters.name: onoff
parameters.description: True to disable firing, false to enable it.

remarks: The gunner index is zero based; passing true disables that gunner's fire and false re-enables it.

api.name: DisableInvulnerability
api.description: Makes the player vulnerable to damage again. This is the default behavior.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player to make vulnerable.

remarks: Paired with EnableInvulnerability, typically around scripted sequences, last stand, and revive logic.

api.name: DisableOffhandSpecial
api.description: Disable the ability to activate a player's special offhand weapons.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player whose special offhand is disabled.

remarks: Paired with EnableOffhandSpecial; used by gadgets to block the special offhand while an ability is running.

api.name: DisableOffhandWeapons
api.description: Disable the player's offhand weapons.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player whose offhand weapons are disabled.

remarks: Paired with EnableOffhandWeapons, and usually called alongside DisableWeaponCycling and DisableUsability when taking control of the player.

api.name: DisableRoundStartDelay
api.description: Enable players weapon after round start delay.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player to remove the round start delay for.

remarks: Called per player from round start logic so the weapon becomes usable without waiting out the delay.

api.name: DisableSpawnPointList
api.description: Disables a spawn point list for the given teams.

parameters.name: list
parameters.description: The spawn point list to disable.

parameters.name: teamMask
parameters.description: A mask of the teams this affects.

remarks: The team mask is built with util::getTeamMask; the corpus only disables the fallback spawn point list.

api.name: DisableUsability
api.description: Disables usability for the player.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player to disable use interactions for.

remarks: Paired with EnableUsability to stop the player from triggering use prompts during scenes, killstreaks, and carried object logic.

api.name: DisableWeaponCycling
api.description: Disable the player's weapon cycling.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player who cannot cycle weapons.

remarks: Paired with EnableWeaponCycling; commonly used with DisableOffhandWeapons when a player is locked to a single weapon.

api.name: DisableWeaponFire
api.description: Disable the player's weapon fire.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player who cannot fire.

remarks: Paired with EnableWeaponFire, and used together with DisableWeaponCycling and DisableOffhandWeapons to fully lock down a player's weapon.

api.name: DisableWeapons
api.description: Disable the weapons of the player.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player whose weapons are disabled.

parameters.name: quick
parameters.description: Whether to disable the weapons quickly, without the lowering animation.

remarks: Paired with EnableWeapons; almost always called with no arguments, with the quick flag passed only occasionally.

api.name: DisconnectPaths
api.description: Disconnects the paths that intersect with the entity.

calledOn.name: target
calledOn.description: The entity to disconnect the paths on.

parameters.name: detailLevel
parameters.description: How detailed the cut part matches the entity. 0 or omitted: Box. 1: Convex hull fitting rough shape. 2: [SUPER EXPENSIVE] Use collision shape directly.

parameters.name: moveAllowed
parameters.description: Sets whether the silhouette moves with the entity (defaults to true).

remarks: If the entity is a `script_brushmodel` then it must have `DYNAMICPATH` set to disconnect paths.

api.name: Distance
api.description: Returns the distance between two points.

parameters.name: point1
parameters.description: The first point.

parameters.name: point2
parameters.description: The second point.

returns.description: The distance between the two points.

remarks: Used constantly for proximity checks; prefer DistanceSquared when comparing against a fixed range, since it avoids the square root.

api.name: Distance2D
api.description: Returns the distance between two points, ignores height difference.

parameters.name: point1
parameters.description: The first point.

parameters.name: point2
parameters.description: The second point.

returns.description: The horizontal distance between the two points.

remarks: Used for horizontal proximity checks where the height difference should be ignored, such as air vehicles above a ground target.

api.name: Distance2DSquared
api.description: Returns the squared distance between two points, ignores height difference.

parameters.name: point1
parameters.description: The first point.

parameters.name: point2
parameters.description: The second point.

returns.description: The squared horizontal distance between the two points.

remarks: Usually compared against a radius multiplied by itself, avoiding the square root of Distance2D.

api.name: DistanceSquared
api.description: Returns the squared distance between two points - this is cheaper than the actual distance as it doesn't involve a square root.

parameters.name: point1
parameters.description: The first point.

parameters.name: point2
parameters.description: The second point.

returns.description: The squared distance between the two points.

remarks: The most common distance check in the corpus; results are compared against a radius multiplied by itself rather than square rooted.

api.name: DoCowardsWayAnims
api.description: Gets whether the entity uses cowards way death animations.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The last-stand player.

returns.name: result
returns.description: The cowards way animation result.

remarks: Used by last stand suicide logic after giving and switching to the suicide weapon; the returned value is passed on as the duration of the suicide sequence.

api.name: DoDamage
api.description: Deals damage to the given entity.

calledOn.name: target
calledOn.description: The entity that the damage should be dealt upon.

parameters.name: health
parameters.description: The amount of damage to do.

parameters.name: sourcePosition
parameters.description: The source location that the damage comes from.

parameters.name: attacker
parameters.description: The entity that dealt the damage (such as an AI or player).

parameters.name: inflictor
parameters.description: The entity that the damage came from (such as a grenade or turret).

parameters.name: hitLoc
parameters.description: The location of the damage, which defaults to `none`.

parameters.name: mod
parameters.description: The means of death string. If not specified, the means of death will be `MOD_UNKNOWN`.

parameters.name: dFlags
parameters.description: Any flags associated with the damage being dealt. Defaults to 0 (no flags).

parameters.name: weapon
parameters.description: The weapon used to deal the damage.

parameters.name: destructiblePieceIndex
parameters.description: The destructible piece index from the destructible def GDT.

parameters.name: forcePain
parameters.description: When set to `true`, the target entity's pain time is reset to zero, forcing them to produce a pain reaction to the damage.

api.example: player DoDamage(25, gasEffectArea.origin, player.lastPoisonedBy, grenade_obj, 0, "MOD_EXPLOSIVE", 0, GetWeapon("tabun_gas_mp"), -1, false)
remarks: For the `dFlags` parameter, each flag corresponds to a particular bit position, allowing them to be combined. These are defined in `shared.gsh`.

api.name: DoesWeaponReplaceSpawnWeapon
api.description: Gets whether the new weapon replaces the spawn weapon as a valid alt-mode relationship.

parameters.name: spawnWeapon
parameters.description: The original spawn weapon.

parameters.name: newWeapon
parameters.description: The candidate replacement weapon.

returns.name: replacesSpawnWeapon
returns.description: Whether the new weapon replaces the spawn weapon.

remarks: This is true when the new weapon matches the spawn weapon alt-mode relationship and the weapon definition allows that replacement.

api.name: DontInterpolate
api.description: Pops the entity to its new position this frame instead of smoothly interpolating from its previous position.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity that should not interpolate.

remarks: Called right after teleporting or re-placing a model, such as a dropped carry object or an entity moved to a new spawn point, to avoid a visible slide.

api.name: DoubleXPTimerFired
api.description: Used to decrement consumable double xp promotions.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player whose double XP timer is decremented.

remarks: Called on the player from score handling when double XP time should be consumed.

api.name: DrawNode
api.description: Draws a node.

parameters.name: node
parameters.description: pathnode.

api.name: DrawTrajectory
api.description: Draws the vehicles trajectory.

parameters.name: show
parameters.description: Whether to draw trajectory or not.

api.name: DrivePath
api.description: Starts the vehicle driving this path and uses the vehicle physics, not locked to the spline, can only achieve turns that the physics can handle.

calledOn.name: vehicle
calledOn.description: The vehicle to drive along the path.

parameters.name: nodeIndex
parameters.description: The path or node to start driving from.

parameters.name: allowFreeDrive
parameters.description: This give the player free driving but script notifies when passing nodes on a vehcile spline.

remarks: Called on a vehicle after it has been attached to a path; the node argument is omitted to drive from the current position, or given as the attached path or current node.

api.name: DropItem
api.description: Drop an item with the given item name.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player dropping the item.

parameters.name: weapon
parameters.description: The weapon to drop.

parameters.name: dropTag
parameters.description: If specified drop and snap the weapon to this tag.

returns.description: The dropped item entity.

remarks: Returns the dropped item entity, which callers check with IsDefined before setting up its ammo or pickup behavior.
The optional tag is passed as "tag_origin" when the drop should snap to the entity origin.

api.name: DropNodEToFloor
api.description: Drop the node to the floor.

parameters.name: node
parameters.description: node to drop.

api.name: DropScavengerItem
api.description: Drop an item with the given item name. This item will be only available to those with the scavenger perk.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player dropping the scavenger item.

parameters.name: weapon
parameters.description: The weapon to drop.

returns.description: The dropped item entity.

remarks: The corpus drops either "scavenger_item" or "scavenger_item_hack" on player death, and uses the returned item entity to set its ammo contents.

api.name: DropWeapon
api.description: Drops the actor's weapon and returns the dropped weapon entity when successful.

calledOn.name: actor
calledOn.description: The actor dropping the weapon.

parameters.name: weapon
parameters.description: The weapon to drop.

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: The tag to throw the weapon from.

parameters.name: velocity
parameters.description: An optional initial velocity scalar or vector for the dropped weapon.

parameters.name: angularVelocity
parameters.description: An optional initial angular velocity for the dropped weapon.

parameters.name: scavengerOnly
parameters.description: Whether the dropped weapon should require the scavenger perk to be picked up.

returns.name: droppedWeapon
returns.description: The dropped weapon entity when the drop succeeds.

api.example: dropped = self DropWeapon( self.weapon, self.anim_gunHand, throwVel );
remarks: If the drop fails, no weapon entity is returned to script.
The velocity argument may be supplied as either a vector or a numeric value in script usage.

api.name: DualWieldWeapon
api.description: Gets the dual wield weapon for the current weapon.

returns.name: weapon
returns.description: The dual wield weapon object.

api.name: EACPathSet
api.description: Sets the value of a eac path drone.

parameters.name: vec3
parameters.description: The value.

api.name: Earthquake
api.description: Create an earthquake shaking effect at the given location.

parameters.name: scale
parameters.description: Magnitude scalar of the earthquake. Must be greater than 0.

parameters.name: duration
parameters.description: The duration of the earthquake. Must be greater than 0.

parameters.name: origin
parameters.description: The source location of the earthquake.

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description: The radius of the earthquake. Must be greater than 0.

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: When specified, the earthquake is shown only to the target player.

api.name: EnableAimAssist
api.description: Enables Aim assist on the entity. Entity has to be either a brush model or an actor or a vehicle or a script_model.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity to enable aim assist on.

remarks: Paired with DisableAimAssist; used on spawned AI, drones, and vehicles so players can lock onto them.

api.name: EnableAllDestructiblePieces
api.description: Enables all destructible pieces that were previously disabled.

api.name: EnableDeathStreak
api.description: Enable player's death streak.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player whose death streak is enabled.

remarks: Paired with DisableDeathStreak; called from player spawn and connect logic.

api.name: EnableGrenadeSuicide
api.description: Enables cooked grenades killing the player.

api.name: EnableGrenadeTouchDamage
api.description: Sets the grenade touch damage flag of the entity.

api.name: EnableInfluencer
api.description: Enables or disables the given influencer.

parameters.name: influencerId
parameters.description: The influencer to enable/disable.

parameters.name: enable
parameters.description: True to enable. False to disable.

remarks: Used by spawning logic and objective gametypes to switch spawn influencers on and off as flags change ownership.
The influencer id comes from a previously created influencer stored on the objective.

api.name: EnableInvulnerability
api.description: Makes the player invulnerable to damage.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player to make invulnerable.

remarks: Paired with DisableInvulnerability around scripted sequences, spawn protection, and last stand or revive logic.

api.name: EnableLinkTo
api.description: Enables linking for an entity, so it can be linked to another entity.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity to enable linking on.

remarks: Almost always called on a trigger or model just before LinkTo, so the entity follows its parent.

api.name: EnableLobbyJoins
api.description: Sets whether players can join the lobby.

parameters.name: enable
parameters.description: Whether to enable lobby joins.

api.name: EnableNavMeshTrigger
api.description: Enables/disables a given navmesh trigger.

parameters.name: targetname
parameters.description: The targetname of the trigger entity.

parameters.name: enable
parameters.description: Whether to enable disable the given volume for pathfinding.

api.name: EnableObstacle
api.description: Enables or disables the hkai obstacle associated with a given entity.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity whose obstacle is enabled or disabled.

parameters.name: enable
parameters.description: Whether to enable or disable the obstacle.

remarks: Used on vehicles to stop or restore their navmesh obstacle so AI pathing ignores or avoids them.

api.name: EnableOccluder
api.description: Enables or disables a named occluder.

parameters.name: occluderName
parameters.description: The name of the occluder.

parameters.name: enable
parameters.description: Whether to enable the occluder.

api.name: EnableOffhandSpecial
api.description: Enable the ability to activate a player's special offhand weapons.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player whose special offhand is enabled.

remarks: Paired with DisableOffhandSpecial; gadgets re-enable the special offhand once their effect ends.

api.name: EnableOffhandWeapons
api.description: Re-enables the player's offhand weapons, such as grenades and equipment.
remarks: Undoes DisableOffhandWeapons, and is usually called alongside EnableWeapons and EnableWeaponCycling when restoring a player's control.
Commonly used when a player leaves last stand, finishes a scripted scene, or stops using a killstreak or objective carry.

api.name: EnableRoundStartDelay
api.description: Enables the round start delay, which holds the player's weapon back until the round begins.
remarks: Called on each player from the round start logic in _globallogic_utils, and paired with DisableRoundStartDelay once play begins.

api.name: EnableSpawnPointList
api.description: Enables a spawn point list for the given teams.

parameters.name: list
parameters.description: The index of the spawn point list to enable, such as SPL_NORMAL or SPL_FALLBACK.

parameters.name: teamMask
parameters.description: A bit mask of the teams this affects, typically from util::getTeamMask.

remarks: The corpus only enables list 0 (SPL_NORMAL) and list 1 (SPL_FALLBACK), always with a team mask built by util::getTeamMask.

api.name: EnableUsability
api.description: Re-enables the player's ability to use usable entities.
remarks: Undoes DisableUsability, and is normally called when a player drops a carried objective, leaves a remote weapon, or finishes a scripted scene.

api.name: EnableWeaponCycling
api.description: Re-enables the player's ability to cycle between weapons.
remarks: Undoes DisableWeaponCycling, and is typically called together with EnableOffhandWeapons when restoring normal weapon control after last stand, a powerup, or a killstreak.

api.name: EnableWeaponFire
api.description: Re-enables the player's ability to fire the current weapon.
remarks: Undoes DisableWeaponFire, and is used where firing alone needs to be blocked while the weapon stays equipped.

api.name: EnableWeapons
api.description: Re-enables the player's weapons, taking them back out if they were put away.
remarks: Undoes DisableWeapons, and is called on respawn, after scripted scenes, and when a player stops hacking, carrying, or using an object.

api.name: EndCamAnimScripted
api.description: Ends the scripted camera animation currently playing for a player.

parameters.name: player
parameters.description: The player whose scripted camera animation ends.

remarks: Ends what CamAnimScripted started, and is called per player when a scene's camera is torn down.

api.name: EndExtraCamAnimScripted
api.description: Ends the scripted camera animation playing on one of a player's extra cameras.

parameters.name: player
parameters.description: The player to play animation on.

parameters.name: extra_cam_index
parameters.description: The extra camera index.

remarks: Ends what ExtraCamAnimScripted started; scene teardown calls it once per extra camera index, 0 through 3.

api.name: EndLobby
api.description: Ends the current lobby session.
remarks: Called from the end of game logic in _globallogic once the match is over.

api.name: EndLocationSelection
api.description: Ends the player's location selection, cancelling the placement.
remarks: Used to clean up location selection when the player dies, disconnects, switches weapon, or the game ends.

api.name: EnumerateWeapons
api.description: Return an array of weapon names for the weapons of weapon type in fastfile.

parameters.name: weaponType
parameters.description: The type of weapon to return(weapon or weaponfull).

remarks: Called with "weapon" or with an empty string, the latter apparently enumerating everything.
Used to build tables at level startup, for example collecting every hero gadget by checking each result's isGadget and isheroweapon fields.

api.name: ErrorMsg
api.description: Prints a non-fatal script error with the given message.

parameters.name: message
parameters.description: error message.

api.example: ErrorMsg( "No variants set up for move speed " + self.zombie_move_speed );
remarks: Used to report data or setup mistakes, often with the offending value concatenated into the message.
Frequently placed inside developer-only /# #/ blocks.

api.name: ExecDevGui
api.description: Executes a developer GUI command.

parameters.name: command
parameters.description: The devgui command string.

remarks: Called at level or system init to register a script's developer GUI, so it only matters in developer builds.

api.name: ExitLevel
api.description: Exits the current level.

parameters.name: savePersistent
parameters.description: Whether player info is retained. Observed calls pass false, or omit the argument entirely.

remarks: Called from the end of game logic and from map shutdown; almost every call site passes false.

api.name: ExperimentsGetVariant
api.description: Gets the variant for a user for an experiment.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player.

parameters.name: experimentName
parameters.description: The experiment name.

api.name: ExtraCamAnimScripted
api.description: Plays the camera script on an extracam player.

parameters.name: player
parameters.description: The player to play animation on.

parameters.name: extra_cam_index
parameters.description: The extra camera index.

parameters.name: cam_anim
parameters.description: The animation to play.

parameters.name: start_time
parameters.description: The start time of the animation.

parameters.name: align_origin
parameters.description: The origin to align to.

parameters.name: align_angles
parameters.description: The angles to align to.

parameters.name: lerp_duration
parameters.description: The lerp duration.

parameters.name: camera_name
parameters.description: The camera name.

parameters.name: ignoreProcessingInitialNoteTracks
parameters.description: Ignores processing the initial notetracks if the camera time starts earlier.

api.example: ExtraCamAnimScripted( player, n_index, str_camera_anim, GetTime(), v_origin, v_angles );
remarks: Observed calls pass only the first six arguments, using GetTime() as the start time, and are ended later with EndExtraCamAnimScripted.

api.name: FadeOverTime
api.description: Set a hud element to transition in color (or alpha) over time.  Normally setting the color (or alpha) of an element causes an immediate visual change. However, if the color (or alpha) gets set within <time> after calling fadeOverTime, then the hud element will transition to the new color over the remaining <time>.

parameters.name: time
parameters.description: The time to fade the element in seconds.

remarks: Set the element's color or alpha on the line right after this call; the change is what gets interpolated.
Widely used to fade HUD messages and icons in and out, including pulsing effects where the fade time matches the pulse duration.

api.name: FakeDamageFrom
api.description: Makes the player react as though damaged from the given direction, without applying damage.

parameters.name: dir
parameters.description: The direction to take damage from.

remarks: Used to give directional damage feedback for effects that do not go through the normal damage path.

api.name: FakeFire
api.description: Simulates gun fire.  Sound and radar blip.

parameters.name: owner
parameters.description: The player credited with the fake fire, usually the decoy or clone's owner.

parameters.name: origin
parameters.description: The origin the fake fire appears to come from.

parameters.name: weapon
parameters.description: The weapon the fake fire uses.

parameters.name: shotCount
parameters.description: The number of shots to simulate.

api.example: self FakeFire( owner, self.origin, weapon, shotCount );
remarks: Used by decoys and player clones to produce gunfire sound and radar blips; the decoy passes its own origin and can split a burst into two calls around an interrupt.

api.name: FGetArg
api.description: Gets an argument from the last read file line.

parameters.name: fileHandle
parameters.description: The file handle previously advanced with FReadLn.

parameters.name: argIndex
parameters.description: The zero-based index of the argument on the current line.

remarks: Only valid after FReadLn has read a line from the file; scripts loop while FReadLn returns a positive value and pull arguments by index.
Results are passed through int() or a string-to-vector helper when a non-string value is wanted.

api.name: FinalizeMatchRecord
api.description: Finalizes a match record.

api.name: FinalizeTrackedBlackBoardAttributes
api.description: Finalizes the tracked blackboard attributes for the AI actor.

calledOn.name: actor
calledOn.description: The AI actor.

remarks: Called once per archetype during AI initialization, after the individual blackboard attributes have been registered.

api.name: FindAnimByName
api.description: Find specified animation( using animation name ) in a specified animtree( using atr name).

parameters.name: tree
parameters.description: Anim tree name.

parameters.name: anim
parameters.description: Name of anim.

api.name: FindBestCoverNode
api.description: Find the best cover node for a given NPC given his state.
remarks: Called on the AI itself from behavior tree code; the result is undefined when no suitable node exists, so call sites check it before use.

api.name: FindBestCoverNodes
api.description: Find the best cover nodes for a given NPC given his state. Sorted by best.

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description: The search radius, usually the AI's goal radius or engagement distance.

parameters.name: origin
parameters.description: The origin to search around, usually the AI's goal position, its own origin, or its enemy's origin.

remarks: Returns the nodes sorted best first, so behavior tree code often takes index 0 directly.
Use FindBestCoverNode when only the single best node is wanted.

api.name: FindCoverNodeAtLocation
api.description: Finds a near by cover node for the character.

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description: search radius.

parameters.name: origin
parameters.description: search origin.

api.name: FindPath
api.description: Check if a path can be found between these positions.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: The position to path from, usually the entity's own origin.

parameters.name: end
parameters.description: The position to path to.

parameters.name: allowPartial
parameters.description: Whether to allow partial paths. Most call sites pass true.

parameters.name: checkDrop
parameters.description: Whether to check for drops. Every observed call passes false.

api.example: if ( self FindPath( self.origin, goalPos, true, false ) )
remarks: Used as a reachability test before committing an AI to a goal, often combined with MayMoveToPoint.
The path is only checked, not followed.

api.name: FindReacquireDirectPath
api.description: Finds a path directly to the enemy. Call ReacquireMove to use the path.

parameters.name: ignoreSuppression
parameters.description: Whether to ignore suppression when looking for a path. True makes a success more likely but may result in a more dangerous path.

api.name: FindReacquireNode
api.description: Finds a reacquire node when exposed.

api.name: FindReacquireProximatePath
api.description: Finds a path to a point that can see the enemy without leaving goal. Call ReacquireMove to use the path.

parameters.name: ignoreSuppression
parameters.description: Whether to ignore suppression when looking for a path. True makes a success more likely but may result in a more dangerous path.

api.name: FinishActorDamage
api.description: Does damage to an actor, usually as part of a damage callback.

calledOn.name: actor
calledOn.description: The actor the damage is happening on.

parameters.name: inflictor
parameters.description: The entity that causes the damage, such as a turret.

parameters.name: attacker
parameters.description: The entity that is attacking.

parameters.name: damage
parameters.description: The amount of damage done.

parameters.name: damageFlags
parameters.description: The flags to apply to the damage, where `0` is no flags.

parameters.name: meansOfDeath
parameters.description: The means of death associated with the damage.

parameters.name: weapon
parameters.description: The weapon that inflicted the damage.

parameters.name: point
parameters.description: The point that the damage occurred at.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: The direction of the damage.

parameters.name: hitLoc
parameters.description: The location of the hit.

parameters.name: damageOrigin
parameters.description: The position of the originator of the damage.

parameters.name: offsetTime
parameters.description: The time offset for the damage.

parameters.name: boneIndex
parameters.description: The index of the nearest bone.

parameters.name: surfaceType
parameters.description: The surface type of the hit location.

parameters.name: surfaceNormal
parameters.description: The surface normal at the hit location.

api.example: self FinishActorDamage( eInflictor, eAttacker, iDamage, iDFlags, sMeansOfDeath, sWeapon, vPoint, vDir, sHitLoc, vDamageOrigin, psOffsetTime, iBoneIndex, iSurfaceType, vSurfaceNormal )

api.name: FinishMeleeHit
api.description: Notifies the clients of the melee hit or miss.

parameters.name: Attacker
parameters.description: The entity that is attacking.

parameters.name: Weapon
parameters.description: The weapon number of the weapon used to inflict the damage.

parameters.name: Origin
parameters.description: (vector) The origin of the damage.

parameters.name: Direction
parameters.description: (vector) The direction of the damage.

parameters.name: boneIndex
parameters.description: Which bone was the closest to the hit.

parameters.name: shieldHit
parameters.description: Was the hit delivered against a shield.

parameters.name: hit
parameters.description: Was the hit successful or a swipe.

parameters.name: fromBehind
parameters.description: Was the hit from behind the victim.

api.example: self FinishMeleeHit( eAttacker, weapon, vOrigin, vDir, boneIndex, shieldHit, hit, fromBehind );
remarks: Called from the player melee callback in _globallogic_player, passing the callback's arguments straight through.

api.name: FinishPlayerDamage
api.description: Does damage to a player - usually as part of the damage callback.

parameters.name: Inflictor
parameters.description: The entity that causes the damage.(e.g. a turret).

parameters.name: Attacker
parameters.description: The entity that is attacking.

parameters.name: Damage
parameters.description: Integer specifying the amount of damage done.

parameters.name: damageFlags
parameters.description: Integer specifying flags that are to be applied to the damage.

parameters.name: meansOfDeath
parameters.description: Integer specifying the method of death.

parameters.name: Weapon
parameters.description: The weapon number of the weapon used to inflict the damage.

parameters.name: Point
parameters.description: Damage point.

parameters.name: Direction
parameters.description: (vector) The direction of the damage.

parameters.name: hitLoc
parameters.description: The location of the hit.

parameters.name: damageOrigin
parameters.description: Where the damage originated from.

parameters.name: offsetTime
parameters.description: The time offset for the damage.

parameters.name: boneIndex
parameters.description: Which bone was the closest to the hit.

parameters.name: surfaceNormal
parameters.description: The normal of the surface impacted.

api.example: self FinishPlayerDamage( eInflictor, eAttacker, iDamage, iDFlags, sMeansOfDeath, weapon, vPoint, vDir, sHitLoc, vDamageOrigin, psOffsetTime, boneIndex, vSurfaceNormal );
remarks: Called at the end of the player damage callback once script has finished modifying the damage; scripts sometimes substitute their own means of death, such as "MOD_POST_GAME".

api.name: FinishTraversal
api.description: Finishes the AI's current traversal.
remarks: Called from traversal behaviors and from the traversal callbacks in callbacks_shared once the animation is done.

api.name: FinishVehicleDamage
api.description: Does damage to an vehicle - usually as part of the damage callback.

parameters.name: Inflictor
parameters.description: The entity that causes the damage.(e.g. a turret).

parameters.name: Attacker
parameters.description: The entity that is attacking.

parameters.name: Damage
parameters.description: Integer specifying the amount of damage done.

parameters.name: damageFlags
parameters.description: Integer specifying flags that are to be applied to the damage.

parameters.name: meansOfDeath
parameters.description: Integer specifying the method of death.

parameters.name: Weapon
parameters.description: The weapon number of the weapon used to inflict the damage.

parameters.name: Point
parameters.description: Point of damage.

parameters.name: Direction
parameters.description: (vector) The direction of the damage.

parameters.name: hitLoc
parameters.description: The location of the hit.

parameters.name: offsetTime
parameters.description: The time offset for the damage.

parameters.name: DamageFromUnderneath
parameters.description: If the hit is underneath the vehicle.

parameters.name: modelIndex
parameters.description: which model in the dobj was hit.

parameters.name: partIndex
parameters.description: which bone was hit.

parameters.name: damageteammates
parameters.description: Whether to damage teammates or not.

api.example: self FinishVehicleDamage( eInflictor, eAttacker, iDamage, iDFlags, sMeansOfDeath, weapon, vPoint, vDir, sHitLoc, psOffsetTime, damageFromUnderneath, modelIndex, partName, false );
remarks: Called at the end of the vehicle damage callback; multiplayer passes false for damageteammates while zombies passes true.

api.name: FinishVehicleRadiusDamage
api.description: Does damage to an vehicle - usually as part of the damage callback.

parameters.name: Inflictor
parameters.description: The entity that causes the damage.(e.g. a turret).

parameters.name: Attacker
parameters.description: The entity that is attacking.

parameters.name: Damage
parameters.description: Integer specifying the amount of damage done.

parameters.name: innerDamage
parameters.description: Integer specifying the amount of inner damage done.

parameters.name: outerDamage
parameters.description: Integer specifying the amount of outer damage done.

parameters.name: damageFlags
parameters.description: Integer specifying flags that are to be applied to the damage.

parameters.name: meansOfDeath
parameters.description: Integer specifying the method of death.

parameters.name: Weapon
parameters.description: The weapon number of the weapon used to inflict the damage.

parameters.name: Point
parameters.description: (vector) The Point of the damage.

parameters.name: Radius
parameters.description: (float) The radius of the damage.

parameters.name: ConeRadius
parameters.description: (float) The radius of the cone damage.

parameters.name: ConeDirection
parameters.description: (vector) The direction of the cone damage.

parameters.name: offsetTime
parameters.description: The time offset for the damage.

api.example: self FinishVehicleRadiusDamage( attacker, attacker, 32000, 32000, 10, 0, "MOD_EXPLOSIVE", level.weaponNone, damageOrigin, 400, -1, ( 0, 0, 1 ), 0 );
remarks: Used both to forward a radius damage callback and to destroy a vehicle outright with a very large damage value and level.weaponNone.
Call sites that want no cone pass -1 for the cone radius with an upward cone direction.

api.name: FireWeapon
api.description: Fire the vehicle's weapon.

parameters.name: turret_index
parameters.description: The turret index, 0 being the main turret and 1 to 4 the gunners. Defaults to the main turret when omitted.

parameters.name: targetEnt
parameters.description: A target entity, used for guided missiles.

parameters.name: targetOffset
parameters.description: An offset from the target, only used for projectile and bomb weapons.

parameters.name: attacker
parameters.description: The entity that should take credit for the shot.

returns.description: The projectile entity that was fired, when the weapon creates one.

remarks: Turret and vehicle AI call this each time they decide to shoot, passing the current enemy as the target entity.
The returned missile entity is only captured where script needs to track the projectile.

api.name: FlagEnemyUnattackable
api.description: Flags the AI's current enemy as unattackable.
remarks: Called from behavior tree code when the AI fails to reach or engage its enemy, so it stops trying to attack that target.

api.name: FlashbackFinish
api.description: Finishes the flashback.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player.

remarks: Ends what FlashbackStart began, and is called on the player who owns the flashback gadget.

api.name: FlashbackStart
api.description: Starts the flashback and returns the new origin.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player.

parameters.name: weapon
parameters.description: The weapon in the player loadout.

remarks: Called on the player who owns the flashback gadget; the returned origin is offset before being used as the teleport destination, and the flashback is closed out with FlashbackFinish.

api.name: Flip180
api.description: Flips this vehicle 180 (for going forwards / backwards along a path).
remarks: Used on path-following vehicles to reverse their facing when they change direction along a path.

api.name: Float
api.description: Casts a string or an integer to a float.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: The string or integer value to convert to a float.

returns.description: The value as a float.

remarks: Commonly wraps CSV table lookups and other string data before arithmetic.
Also used to force floating point division, as in Float( score ) / Float( otherTeamScore ).

api.name: Floor
api.description: Returns the floor of floating point value <a>. This effectively rounds down Floor(2.7) == 2, Floor(3.9) == 3.

parameters.name: a
parameters.description: The value to round down.

returns.description: The largest whole value that is not greater than the argument.

remarks: Frequently combined with Int() when an integer result is needed, as in Int( Floor( minutesPlayed / quantum ) ).
The fractional part is often recovered with the pattern value - Floor( value ).

api.name: ForceGrenadeThrow
api.description: Forces the player to throw a held grenade.

api.name: ForceOffHandEnd
api.description: Force the player to not use offhand weapon.
remarks: Used to cancel an in-progress offhand or tool action, for example when a player stops using the hacker tool.

api.name: ForcePainOn
api.description: toggles pain.forcePain to true;  next damage reaction guarenteed.

api.name: ForceSlick
api.description: Sets whether the player is forced to be on a slick surface.

parameters.name: slick
parameters.description: : A boolean. True if the player is on a slick surface, and false otherwise.

api.name: ForceTeleport
api.description: Force Teleport the actor to a new position with the given origin and angles, regardless of wether it will be visible to the player or not.

calledOn.name: actor
calledOn.description: The actor to teleport.

parameters.name: position
parameters.description: The new position for the actor.

parameters.name: angles
parameters.description: The new angles for the actor.

parameters.name: updategoalpos
parameters.description: (bool) Update the script goal position to the teleport location. True by default.

parameters.name: resetEntity
parameters.description: (bool) Reset the entity behaviors.

remarks: Nearly all call sites pass the origin and angles of a node or struct that marks the destination.
The angles argument is often omitted when only the position matters.

api.name: ForwardRotateAroundUpByAngle
api.description: returns a vector that is the result of angles1 forward vector rotated around its up by degrees.

api.name: FPrintFields
api.description: Prints field data to an open file.

parameters.name: fileHandle
parameters.description: The handle of the file to write to, as returned by OpenFile.

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: The record to write, built as a single concatenated string of fields.

remarks: Used by the spawn logic debug dumps to write one tab separated record per call to a file opened with OpenFile.
The records it writes are read back with FReadLn and FGetArg.

api.name: FPrintln
api.description: Prints a line to an open file.

parameters.name: fileHandle
parameters.description: The handle of the file to write to, as returned by OpenFile.

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: The line of text to write.

remarks: Used with a file handle from OpenFile for debug and art dumps; an empty string writes a blank line.

api.name: FragButtonPressed
api.description: Check if the player is pressing the frag button.
remarks: Usually checked alongside SecondaryOffHandButtonPressed, AttackButtonPressed and MeleeButtonPressed to detect any player input.
Also used in wait loops so that a held button does not immediately retrigger an action.

api.name: FReadLn
api.description: Reads a line from an open file.

parameters.name: fileHandle
parameters.description: The handle of the file to read from, as returned by OpenFile.

returns.description: The number of fields read from the line.

remarks: Reads the next record from a file opened with OpenFile; the individual fields are then retrieved with FGetArg.
Call sites loop until the call returns a value of zero or less, which marks the end of the file.

api.name: FreerunSetHighScores
api.description: Sets the freerun high scores.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player to set the freerun high scores for.

parameters.name: score1
parameters.description: The best recorded time.

parameters.name: score2
parameters.description: The second best recorded time.

parameters.name: score3
parameters.description: The third best recorded time.

remarks: Called on a player in the freerun gametype with the times of the three best recorded runs for the active track.

api.name: FreeVehicle
api.description: Frees this vehicle instance.  It will unlink any players occupying the vehicle. It will change the vehicle into a vehicle corpse.  It will send a death notify on the vehicle.  Once called the vehicle cannot move anymore.
remarks: Typically called at the end of a vehicle death sequence in the shared vehicle death handling.

api.name: FreezeControls
api.description: Blocks or unblocks control input from this player.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player whose controls are being blocked or unblocked.

parameters.name: freezeState
parameters.description: Whether the player's controls are frozen.

remarks: Used to lock players in place during cinematics, loading and level transitions, then called again with false to restore control.
Call sites pass 1 and 0 as well as booleans.

api.name: FreezeControlsAllowLook
api.description: Blocks or unblocks control input from this player, but allows the player to look around.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player whose controls are being blocked or unblocked.

parameters.name: freezeState
parameters.description: Whether the player's movement controls are frozen.

remarks: Used where a player must be held in place but should still be able to look around, such as while grabbed by an enemy.
Always paired with a later call passing false to restore movement.

api.name: FXBlockSight
api.description: Uses a general entity and a radius to set a line of sight blocker on the server for some AI. Destroyed when the entity is freed.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: The entity whose origin is used for the line of sight blocker.

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description: The radius of the blocker.

remarks: Used by smoke grenades and the smokescreen gadget, passing the effect entity and the current radius of the cloud.

api.name: GadgetActivate
api.description: turns gadget on in slot.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player who owns the gadget.

parameters.name: slot
parameters.description: The gadget slot to activate. (integer).

parameters.name: weapon
parameters.description: The gadget weapon.

remarks: Called on the player, with the slot from GadgetGetSlot and the gadget weapon; GadgetDeactivate turns the gadget back off.

api.name: GadgetCharging
api.description: Sets the gadget charging state.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player who owns the gadget.

parameters.name: slot
parameters.description: The gadget slot. (integer).

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: undefined to get current state, true to set or false to unset. (boolean).

remarks: Called with only the slot to query the charging state, or with a second argument to set it.
Often used together with GadgetPowerReset when a gadget starts recharging.

api.name: GadgetDeactivate
api.description: turns gadget off in slot.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player who owns the gadget.

parameters.name: slot
parameters.description: The gadget slot to deactivate. (integer).

parameters.name: weapon
parameters.description: The gadget weapon.

parameters.name: penalty
parameters.description: The power penalty type.

remarks: The counterpart to GadgetActivate; the optional penalty argument is passed as a small integer constant at the call sites.

api.name: GadgetFlickering
api.description: Tests a gadget is flickering and can optionally set flickering.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player who owns the gadget.

parameters.name: slot
parameters.description: The gadget slot to test or apply flickering state. (integer).

parameters.name: flicker
parameters.description: Set gadget to flickering state if true (boolean).

parameters.name: length
parameters.description: Set gadget flickering length (integer).

remarks: Called with only the slot to query whether the gadget is flickering, which per gadget scripts expose as an is_flickering check.
Called with the extra arguments to start flickering for a given length.

api.name: GadgetGetSlot
api.description: Get gadget slot for weapon.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player who owns the gadget.

parameters.name: weapon
parameters.description: The gadget weapon to find the slot for.

returns.description: The slot index of the gadget, or a negative value if the weapon is not a gadget in the loadout.

remarks: The standard way to turn a gadget weapon into the slot index taken by the other Gadget functions.
Call sites treat a negative result as the weapon not being a gadget in the player's loadout.

api.name: GadgetIsActive
api.description: Returns true if the gadget is active.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player who owns the gadget.

parameters.name: slot
parameters.description: The gadget slot to test. (integer).

remarks: Backs the per gadget is_active checks in the ability scripts; slot 0 is used where a player only has one gadget.

api.name: GadgetIsPrimed
api.description: Returns true if the gadget is primed.

parameters.name: slot
parameters.description: The gadget slot to test. (integer).

api.name: GadgetIsReady
api.description: Returns true if the gadget is ready.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player who owns the gadget.

parameters.name: slot
parameters.description: The gadget slot to test. (integer).

remarks: Checked before using a gadget, usually together with GadgetIsActive and a non negative slot from GadgetGetSlot.

api.name: GadgetPowerChange
api.description: Applies a power change to the gadget power.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player who owns the gadget.

parameters.name: slot
parameters.description: The gadget slot to change the power of.

parameters.name: change
parameters.description: The amount to add to the gadget's power, which may be negative.

returns.description: The gadget's power after the change.

remarks: A change of zero is used to read the current power without altering it.
Negative values drain the gadget, positive values recharge it.

api.name: GadgetPowerGet
api.description: Gets the power remaining for gadget.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player who owns the gadget.

parameters.name: slot
parameters.description: The gadget slot to read the power of.

returns.description: The power remaining for the gadget.

remarks: Power is on a 0 to 100 scale at the call sites, which divide by 100 to get a fraction.
The result can be undefined, so scripts guard it with IsDefined or VAL before using it.

api.name: GadgetPowerReset
api.description: Applies a power reset.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player who owns the gadget.

parameters.name: slot
parameters.description: The gadget slot apply the power reset. (integer).

remarks: Used when a gadget is given back to the player, typically just before GadgetCharging is set.

api.name: GadgetPowerSet
api.description: Sets the power override to value. Works always.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player who owns the gadget.

parameters.name: slot
parameters.description: The gadget slot to set the power of.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: The power value to set, where 100 is full.

returns.description: The gadget's power after being set.

remarks: Call sites use 100 to fill a gadget and 0 to empty it, and slot 0 where the player has a single gadget.
Paired with GadgetPowerGet to save and restore a gadget's power across a state change.

api.name: GadgetSetActivateTime
api.description: Set the activation time of this gadget.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player who owns the gadget.

parameters.name: slot
parameters.description: The gadget slot to stamp.

parameters.name: time
parameters.description: The activation time in milliseconds.

remarks: Every call site passes GetTime(), stamping the gadget as having activated now.

api.name: GadgetSetEntity
api.description: Set the entity used by this gadget.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player who owns the gadget.

parameters.name: slot
parameters.description: The gadget slot.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: The entity used by the gadget.

remarks: Seen only in the vision pulse gadget, which registers the entity it spawned for the pulse.

api.name: GadgetStateChange
api.description: changes the gadget state in a slot.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player who owns the gadget.

parameters.name: slot
parameters.description: The gadget slot to activate. (integer).

parameters.name: weapon
parameters.description: The gadget weapon.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: The state to change it to.

remarks: The mod tools sources pass GADGET_ACTION_ constants such as GADGET_ACTION_PRIMED and GADGET_ACTION_ON for the state.

api.name: GadgetTargetResult
api.description: Reports whether a gadget's targeting attempt hit or missed.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player who owns the gadget.

parameters.name: hit_miss
parameters.description: hit or miss.

remarks: Called on the player after a targeted gadget resolves, with true for a hit and false for a miss.

api.name: GameHistoryFinishMatch
api.description: Tracks a finished match in the player's game history.

parameters.name: outcomeId
parameters.description: The reason the match ended, which corresponds to a `_globallogic.gsc` macro entry.

parameters.name: extraParameters
parameters.description: Additional parameters associated with the game outcome.

api.example: self GameHistoryFinishMatch( MATCH_KICKED, self.kills, self.deaths, self.score, scoreboardPosition, teamScoreRatio );

api.name: GameHistoryStartMatch
api.description: Starts match recording for game history.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player to start match recording for.

parameters.name: gameTypeEnum
parameters.description: The game type enumeration, as returned by GetGameTypeEnumFromName.

remarks: Every call site passes the result of GetGameTypeEnumFromName for the current gametype.

api.name: GameModeIsArena
api.description: Checks whether the current game mode is arena.

returns.name: isArena
returns.description: Whether the game mode is arena.

api.name: GameModeIsMode
api.description: Returns true/false if the current game mode is the given mode.

parameters.name: gamemode
parameters.description: The game mode constant to test the current mode against.

remarks: The mod tools sources pass GAMEMODE_ constants such as GAMEMODE_PRIVATE_MATCH and GAMEMODE_WAGER_MATCH; decompiled scripts show the raw integers.

api.name: GameModeIsUsingStats
api.description: Checks whether the current game mode uses stats tracking.

returns.name: usesStats
returns.description: Whether the game mode uses stats.

api.name: GameModeIsUsingXP
api.description: Checks whether the current game mode uses XP.

returns.name: usesXp
returns.description: Whether the game mode uses XP.

remarks: Used by the global logic of each session mode to decide whether the match counts as ranked.

api.name: GamepadUsedLast
api.description: Returns whether the player last used a gamepad rather than a keyboard and mouse.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player to query.

returns.description: True if the player last used a gamepad.

remarks: Scripts commonly combine this with level.console to decide between gamepad and keyboard control prompts.

api.name: GameRepThresholdExceeded
api.description: Notifies the game reputation system that a game limit threshold was exceeded.

parameters.name: thresholdId
parameters.description: The identifier of the game limit whose threshold was exceeded.

remarks: The corpus only calls this from the game rep scripts, passing the id stored in game["gameRep"]["gameLimit"]["id"].

api.name: GeneratePointsAroundCenter
api.description: Generates uniformly distributed points around a center position in the 2D (XY) plane.

parameters.name: origin
parameters.description: The center position to generate points around.

parameters.name: maxSearchRadius
parameters.description: The maximum radius away from the origin.

parameters.name: innerSpacing
parameters.description: The distance between points at the minimum radius.

parameters.name: minRadius
parameters.description: the minimum radius away from origin. should be between 0 and maxRadius (both inclusive).

parameters.name: outerSpacing
parameters.description: if defined, the distance between points will be Lerped from <innerSpacing> to [outerSpacing], to create a gradual distribution from minRadius to maxRadius.

parameters.name: distributionBias
parameters.description: (vec2) if defined, the density of the points will be changed gradually along the direction of this vector. the magnitude will be use as scalar, with 1 being the norm scale.

returns.description: An array of generated points.

remarks: Observed calls pass only the origin, maximum radius and inner spacing, sometimes with a minimum radius.
The returned array is often fed to array::random to pick a scattered target point.

api.name: GenerateRadioEvent
api.description: Searches animation selector table and returns an animation alias based on current state of the blackboard.

parameters.name: typeOfEvent

api.name: GenerateScriptEvent
api.description: Creates a script event at the actor's origin, with default radius.

parameters.name: origin
parameters.description: Source position of the event.

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description: Size of the event.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name of the event.

api.name: GetAbsMaxs

returns.description: The maximum corner of the entity's world-space bounds.

remarks: Usually paired with GetAbsMins to measure a model's size or to take the midpoint of its bounds.

api.name: GetAbsMins
api.description: Returns the minimum corner of the entity's absolute bounding box in world space.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity to query.

returns.description: The minimum corner of the entity's world-space bounds.

remarks: Usually paired with GetAbsMaxs to measure a model's size or to take the midpoint of its bounds.

api.name: GetActiveContractProgress
api.description: Gets the progress of an active contract for the player.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player.

parameters.name: contractIndex
parameters.description: The contract index.

returns.name: progress

api.name: GetActiveContractTimePassed

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player.

parameters.name: contractIndex
parameters.description: The contract index.

returns.name: timePassed
returns.description: The time passed in seconds.

api.name: GetActorArray
api.description: Returns an array of the actors in the level, optionally filtered by a key and value.

parameters.name: name

api.name: GetActorSpawnerArray
api.description: Returns an array of all of the actor spawners in a level.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name to search for.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: The key to search for.

api.name: GetActorSpawnerTeamArray
api.description: Returns an array of the actor spawners belonging to the given teams.

parameters.name: team
parameters.description: a team name, either 'axis', 'allies', or 'neutral'.

parameters.name: team

returns.description: An array of the matching actor spawners.

api.name: GetActorTeamArray
api.description: Returns an array of the actors belonging to the given teams.

parameters.name: team
parameters.description: a team name, either 'axis', 'allies', or 'neutral'.

parameters.name: team
parameters.description: any number of additional team names may be added, either 'axis', 'allies', or 'neutral'.

returns.description: An array of the matching actors.

remarks: Most calls pass a single team, often level.zombie_team, but several teams may be listed at once.

api.name: GetActorTeamCountRadius
api.description: Returns the number of human actor AI within a sphere on a given set of teams.

parameters.name: origin
parameters.description: The center of the sphere.

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description: The radius of the sphere.

parameters.name: team
parameters.description: Zero or more teams that should be included.

returns.name: actors
returns.description: The number of actors in the radius.

api.name: GetActorWeaponOptions
api.description: Returns the actor's current weapon options, such as the weapon camo option.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The actor to query.

returns.description: The actor's current weapon options.

remarks: Observed only as the second argument to SetActorWeapon, to preserve the current options while changing weapon.

api.name: GetAIArchetypeArray
api.description: Returns an array of the AI of the given archetype, optionally restricted to a team.

parameters.name: team
parameters.description: The archetype to search for, such as "zombie", "human" or "robot".

parameters.name: team
parameters.description: The team to restrict the search to.

returns.description: An array of the matching AI.

remarks: Archetype names seen in the corpus include "zombie", "human", "robot" and "mannequin".
Most calls pass only the archetype and leave the team unrestricted.

api.name: GetAIArray
api.description: Returns an array of the AI in the level, optionally filtered by a key and value.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The value to search for.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: The key to search on, such as "targetname" or "script_aigroup".

remarks: Filtered calls pass the value first and the key second, commonly "targetname", "script_noteworthy" or "script_aigroup".

api.name: GetAICount
api.description: Returns the current number of AI in the level.

returns.description: The current AI count.

remarks: Typically used to throttle spawning against an AI budget.

api.name: GetAILimit
api.description: Returns the max ai count set by script.

api.name: GetAimAngles
api.description: Returns an array with the angles of the aimTag and the relative aiming delta angles from this orientation.

api.name: GetAimLimitsFromEntry
api.description: Returns the aim limits stored under the given entry of the aim limit table.

calledOn.name: actor
calledOn.description: The actor whose aim limits are being looked up.

parameters.name: entry
parameters.description: The aim limit table entry to read.

returns.description: The aim limits for the entry.

remarks: Called on the behavior tree entity during cover and mocomp logic, with entries such as "cover", "cover_left_lean" and "cover_vantage".

api.name: GetAISpeciesArray

returns.description: An array of the matching AI.

remarks: Species values seen include "human", "robot", "dog", "zombie", "zombie_dog" and "all".
Results from several teams are often merged with ArrayCombine.

api.name: GetAITeamArray
api.description: Returns an array of the AI, including vehicle AI, belonging to the given teams.

parameters.name: team
parameters.description: a team name, either 'axis', 'allies', or 'neutral'.

parameters.name: team
parameters.description: any number of additional team names may be added, either 'axis', 'allies', or 'neutral'.

returns.description: An array of the matching AI.

remarks: One of the most used AI queries in the corpus, usually with a single team such as "axis" or "allies".
Several team names may be passed at once, and the results are often merged with ArrayCombine.

api.name: GetAITriggerFlags
api.description: Returns the spawn flags that will allow AI to activate triggers.

returns.description: The spawn flags allowing AI to activate triggers.

remarks: Each game mode's load script caches the result in level.aiTriggerSpawnFlags during initialization.

api.name: GetAllCharacterBodies
api.description: Returns all character body indices, even disabled ones, for the given session mode.
