returns.description: An array of character body indices.

api.name: GetAllCharacterHeads
api.description: Returns all character indices, even disabled ones, for the current session mode (or specified session mode).

parameters.name: sessionmode
parameters.description: Session Mode Index.

api.name: GetAllNodes
api.description: Returns all of the pathnodes in the level.

returns.description: An array of every node in the level.

remarks: Commonly filtered afterwards by node type, for instance to collect the traverse nodes at level load.

api.name: GetAllVehicleNodes
api.description: Returns all of the vehicle nodes in the level.

returns.description: An array of every vehicle node in the level.

remarks: Used by the shared vehicle system to collect vehicle paths, sometimes combined with script_origin entities.

api.name: GetAmmoCount
api.description: Returns the amount of ammo the player has for the given weapon.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player holding the weapon.

parameters.name: weapon
parameters.description: The weapon to query the ammo count for.

returns.description: The amount of ammo held for the weapon.

remarks: Frequently used to test whether a gadget or killstreak weapon is still charged before allowing its use.

api.name: GetAngleDelta
api.description: Returns the yaw the given animation rotates through, optionally over a time range.

parameters.name: animationName
parameters.description: Name of the animation.

parameters.name: startTime
parameters.description: Start time of the animation.

parameters.name: endTime
parameters.description: End time of the animation.

returns.description: The angle the animation rotates through.

remarks: Used by locomotion code to compensate an actor's facing for the rotation an arrival animation applies.

api.name: GetAngleFromBits
api.description: Gets the angle (0 - 360) from the (compressed) bits.

api.name: GetAngles
api.description: Returns the rotation of the entity.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity to query.

returns.description: The entity's angles.

remarks: Commonly passed straight to AnglesToForward, or indexed at [1] to read the entity's yaw.

api.name: GetAnglesToLikelyEnemyPath
api.description: Gets the angles towards the most likely enemy approach path for the AI actor.

calledOn.name: actor
calledOn.description: The AI actor.

returns.name: angles
returns.description: The angles towards the likely enemy path.

api.name: GetAngularVelocity
api.description: Returns the vehicle's current angular velocity.

calledOn.name: vehicle
calledOn.description: The vehicle to query.

returns.description: The current angular velocity.

remarks: Paired with SetAngularVelocity, most often scaling the current value down to damp a drone's spin.

api.name: GetAnimForCharacter
api.description: Returns the name of the animation to use for the character pose in the frontend.

parameters.name: characterIndex
parameters.description: The index of the character in the current game-mode's character table.

parameters.name: sessionmode
parameters.description: Session Mode Index.

api.name: GetAnimFrameCount
api.description: Returns the total number of frames in the given animation.

parameters.name: animation
parameters.description: a primitive animation: calling this function on a non-primitive animation will fail.

returns.description: The number of frames in the animation.

remarks: Used with IsAnimLooping to tell a real animation apart from a single-frame pose.

api.name: GetAnimLength
api.description: Returns the length of an animation in seconds.

parameters.name: animation
parameters.description: a primitive animation: calling this function on a non-primitive animation will fail.

returns.description: The length of the animation in seconds.

remarks: Often multiplied by 1000 to obtain milliseconds, or combined with GetAnimTime to convert a normalized time into seconds.

api.name: GetAnimTagOrigin
api.description: Returns the local tag position within the animation at the specified normalized time, has no consideration to bone hierarchy.

parameters.name: animationName
parameters.description: Name of the animation.

parameters.name: normalizedTime
parameters.description: 0.0 to 1.0 time within the animation.

parameters.name: tagName
parameters.description: Name of the tag to look up within the animation.

api.name: GetAnimTime
api.description: Returns the normalized playback time of the given animation on the entity.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity playing the animation.

parameters.name: animation
parameters.description: animation to manipulate.

returns.description: The normalized time through the animation.

remarks: The value runs from 0 to 1, so it is commonly multiplied by GetAnimLength to get a time in seconds.

api.name: GetAnyNodeArray

api.description: Given classname, returns archetype name if its an AITYPE or VEHICLE.

parameters.name: array

api.name: GetAssignedTeam

api.name: GetAtrLoaded

parameters.name: loadoutSlot

parameters.name: attachmentname_1

parameters.name: variantindex_1

parameters.name: attachmentname_2

parameters.name: variantindex_2

parameters.name: attachmentname_3

parameters.name: attachmentname_4

parameters.name: attachmentname_5

api.name: GetAttachmentNames

returns.description: The name of the tag that the model at the given slot is attached to.

parameters.description: key that name goes with.

remarks: Almost all call sites search by "targetname", passing either a literal node name or an entity's .target field.
The returned node is commonly handed straight to SetGoal for an AI.

api.name: GetNodeArray
api.description: Gets an array of nodes that have the given name, key pair.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: name to search for.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: key that name goes with.

remarks: Call sites search mainly by "targetname" or "script_noteworthy" to collect a group of authored nodes.

api.name: GetNodeArraySorted
api.description: Gets an array of nodes that have the given name, key pair, within given radius, sorts them.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: name to search for.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: key that name goes with.

parameters.name: pos
parameters.description: search origin.

parameters.name: r
parameters.description: the radius to sort in.

remarks: Observed uses sort a named set of retreat nodes by distance from an AI's origin using a large radius.

api.name: GetNodeEdge
api.description: Returns an array of points which corresponds to the node volume's traversal edge. The traversal edge is represented as a piecewise linear function.

parameters.name: node
parameters.description: node volume.

api.name: GetNodeIndexOnPath
api.description: Returns the index of the given node along the entity's current path.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The bot traversing the path.

parameters.name: node
parameters.description: The node to get the other node for.

remarks: Observed on bots mid traversal: the index is incremented and passed to GetNextTraversalNodeOnPath to find the next traversal on the path.

api.name: GetNodeMantleEdge
api.description: Gets the mantle edge data for a navigation node.

parameters.name: node
parameters.description: The navigation node.

returns.name: edge
returns.description: The mantle edge data.

api.name: GetNodeOffsetAngles
api.description: Returns the angles the actor thinks the node is facing, this can contain additional rotation from the node's actual angles.

parameters.name: node
parameters.description: The path node.

remarks: Call sites take the yaw component (index 1) and compare it against the actor's own yaw to work out how far it must turn to face the node.

api.name: GetNodeOffsetPosition
api.description: Returns the position the actor thinks the node's origin is at, this can be offset from where the actual node's position in the world is.

parameters.name: node
parameters.description: The path node.

remarks: Used to measure the distance from the actor to its node, and passed to UsePosition when an actor takes up a node.
It is normally called with the actor's own .node.

api.name: GetNodeOwner
api.description: Get the owner of the node.

parameters.name: node
parameters.description: which node to get the owner of.

api.name: GetNodeRegion
api.description: Returns the region of the give node, if there is one. Returns undefined otherwise.

parameters.name: node1
parameters.description: pathnode to check.

api.name: GetNodesInRadius
api.description: Gets all of the nodes (max of 256) within a cylinder, in unsorted order.

parameters.name: origin
parameters.description: location to search for nodes at.

parameters.name: maxRadius
parameters.description: maximum distance of nodes to return.

parameters.name: minRadius
parameters.description: maximum distance of nodes to return.

parameters.name: maxHeight
parameters.description: maximum height difference to origin. Defaults to 512.

parameters.name: nodeType
parameters.description: node type to search for, if not specified, returns all node types. 'Cover' will return all cover nodes.

parameters.name: maxNodes
parameters.description: the maximum number of nodes to return up to 256.

parameters.name: regionIndex
parameters.description: the region index the nodes should belong to.

remarks: Call sites commonly pass node type strings such as "Path" or "End", and an empty string to accept any type.

api.name: GetNodesInRadiusSorted
api.description: Gets all of the nodes (max of 256) within a cylinder, sorted by closest to <origin>.

parameters.name: origin
parameters.description: location to search for nodes at.

parameters.name: maxRadius
parameters.description: maximum distance of nodes to return.

parameters.name: minRadius
parameters.description: maximum distance of nodes to return.

parameters.name: maxHeight
parameters.description: maximum height difference to origin. Defaults to 512.

parameters.name: nodeType
parameters.description: node type to search for, if not specified, returns all node types. 'Cover' will return all cover nodes.

parameters.name: maxNodes
parameters.description: the maximum number of nodes to return up to 256.

remarks: Used to pick the closest usable node to a vehicle or player, with the node type given as a string such as "Path".

api.name: GetNonCheckpointData
api.description: Gets non-checkpoint data for the given key on the player.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: The data key to retrieve.

returns.name: value
returns.description: The stored value.

remarks: Used in campaign to read per player counters that must survive checkpoint reloads, such as "INCAPS", "REVIVES" and "lives".
Keys are often built by concatenating a prefix, an index and a field name.

api.name: GetNormalHealth
api.description: Get health in a normalized range of 0 to 1.

api.name: GetNormalizedCameraMovement
api.description: Get the player's camera movement normalized.
remarks: Returns the right stick input as a vector, so LengthSquared of the result being zero means the player is not moving the camera.

api.name: GetNormalizedMovement
api.description: Get the player's movement normalized.
remarks: Returns the player's left stick input, used to read raw movement intent rather than actual velocity.

api.name: GetNorthYaw
api.description: Get North Yaw.
remarks: Call sites feed it into Cos and Sin to build a north facing direction vector for compass and debug code.

api.name: GetNotetracksInDelta
api.description: Get a list of notetracks and times within a specific time delta of a specific time in an animation.

parameters.name: animation
parameters.description: the animation for which notetrack information is needed.

parameters.name: time
parameters.description: The time in the animation around which notetrack information is needed in the range 0-1.

parameters.name: time_delta
parameters.description: The amount of time around the time provided to check for notetracks in seconds defaults to 0.15.

api.name: GetNotetrackTimes
api.description: Gets an array of the times during an animation that the given notetrack occurs. The times returned are fractional (0 to 1).

parameters.name: animation
parameters.description: an animation.

parameters.name: noteTrack
parameters.description: a constant string with the name of the note track.

remarks: Call sites usually take the first entry of the array and multiply it by the animation length to schedule an event during playback.
The array is empty when the animation does not contain the note track, so code checks its size first.

api.name: GetNumberOfCollectiblesForLevel
api.description: Returns the number of collectibles for the given level.

parameters.name: mapName
parameters.description: The root map name.

api.name: GetNumChallengesComplete
api.description: Returns the number of challenges completed in a given mission.

parameters.name: mission_name
parameters.description: (string) The name of the mission to check completed challenges in.

api.name: GetNumConnectedPlayers
api.description: Returns the number of players that are connected to our game.  Ignores bots by default.

parameters.name: includeBots
parameters.description: The optional check to include test clients (bots). (bool).

remarks: Usually called with no arguments and compared against GetNumExpectedPlayers while waiting for a match to fill.

api.name: GetNumExpectedPlayers
api.description: Returns the number of players that we're expecting to join our game.
remarks: Zombies scripts compare the result to 1 to detect a solo game, and loop until GetNumConnectedPlayers catches up with it.

api.name: GetNumParts
api.description: Return number of bones in the model.

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: The model to get parts for.

api.name: GetNumVehicles
api.description: Gets the number of vehicles entities in the level.

api.name: GetNumZBarrierPieces
api.description: Returns number of pieces in specified zbarrier ent.
remarks: Almost always used as the bound of a for loop that operates on each barrier piece by index.

api.name: GetOccupantSeat
api.description: Get the seat index occupied by the given player.  -1 if player isn't in vehicle.

parameters.name: player
parameters.description: The player to get the seat index for.

remarks: Call sites treat seat 0 as the driver, and feed the returned index straight back into UseVehicle.

api.name: GetOffHandSecondaryClass
api.description: Get whether the player is using a flash or smoke.

api.name: GetOrientMode
api.description: Set the orient mode of this actor.

api.name: GetOrigin
api.description: Get the origin of the entity.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity to get the origin of.

returns.name: origin
returns.description: The origin of the entity as a 3D vector.

api.name: GetOtherNodeInNegotiationPair
api.description: Returns the other node of the passed in negotiation node. Returns the begin node if end is passed and vice versa.

parameters.name: node
parameters.description: The node to get the other node for.

remarks: Paired with GetNextTraversalNodeOnPath in bot traversal code to recover both ends of a traversal.
The result can be undefined, so call sites check it with IsDefined.

api.name: GetPartName
api.description: Get the bone name for the model and index.

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: The model to get parts for.

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: The bone index.

remarks: Used in damage handling to turn a hit bone index into a name that can be compared against known part names.

api.name: GetPathfindingRadius
api.description: Returns the radius used for pathfinding operations.
remarks: The only observed use draws the radius as a debug circle around an AI.

api.name: GetPathFixedOffset
api.description: Gets a fixed offset from the path for a specific vehicle.

api.name: GetPathLength
api.description: Gets the length of the path being used by this actor.

api.name: GetPathMetric
api.description: Get path metric for the path from the ai to origin.

parameters.name: origin
parameters.description: the goal for the path.

api.name: GetPathMode
api.description: Get the path mode of this actor.
remarks: Call sites compare the result against the string "dont move" to detect an AI that is currently held in place.

api.name: GetPathVariableOffset
api.description: Gets a variable offset from the path for a specific vehicle.

api.name: GetPerfectInfo
api.description: Forces the AI to become aware of this entity regardless of whether it can be seen or not.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: An entity to become aware of. Must be a sentient (i.e. AI or player).

parameters.name: updateSight
parameters.description: If true then it will update the last seen position also.

remarks: Commonly called with the actor's own .enemy, or with a player, to guarantee the AI reacts without needing line of sight.
The second argument is passed as 1 when the AI's last known enemy position should also be refreshed.

api.name: GetPerks
api.description: Gets all the player's active perks.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player to get the perks of.

returns.name: perks
returns.description: An array of the `specialty` names of the perks the player currently has. This is empty when the player has no perks.

api.name: GetPersonalThreatBias
api.description: Gets the personal threat bias for this sentient versus the other sentient.

calledOn.name: sentient
calledOn.description: The sentient to get the personal threat bias of.

parameters.name: enemy
parameters.description: The enemy to get threat bias for.

returns.name: result
returns.description: The bias.

api.name: GetPhysAcceleration
api.description: Gets the vehicles acceleration vector.

api.name: GetPlayerAngles
api.description: Get the player view angles.
remarks: Frequently passed to AnglesToForward to obtain the direction the player is looking.

api.name: GetPlayerAttachmentCosmeticVariantIndexes
api.description: Get the player's held weapon acvi.

parameters.name: weapon
parameters.description: The weapon to get acvi from.

remarks: Observed only when recording a player's weapon loadout, alongside the weapon's camo and variant data.

api.name: GetPlayerCameraPos
api.description: Get the player's camera position.
remarks: Used as the start point for traces and projectile origins, and as the eye position when computing angles to a target.

api.name: GetPlayerGenderType
api.description: Returns the gender string of the player.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: SessionMode.

remarks: The session mode argument is always supplied by CurrentSessionMode in the observed code.

api.name: GetPlayerGravity
api.description: Gets the gravity or gravity override value for the player.
remarks: Bot traversal code reads it to work out jump arcs before performing a traversal.

api.name: GetPlayerMovementState
api.description: Returns the player movement state for the match record.

api.name: GetPlayers
api.description: Returns an array of the currently connected players.

parameters.name: team
parameters.description: If specified, returns a list of players on a specific team. Valid values: `allies`, `axis`, `neutral`, and `all`.

returns.name: players
returns.description: A list of connected players.

remarks: When used without the team parameter, this function is analogous to the variable `level._players` and can be used interchangeably.

api.name: GetPlayerSelectedGesture
api.description: Get the equipped gesture.

parameters.name: gestureType
parameters.description: The type of gesture to get.

remarks: The gesture type is one of the small constants 0, 1 and 2, named GESTURE_TYPE_GOOD_GAME, GESTURE_TYPE_THREATEN and GESTURE_TYPE_BOAST in the mod tools sources.

api.name: GetPlayerSelectedGestureName
api.description: Get the equipped gesture animation name.

parameters.name: gestureType
parameters.description: The type of gesture to get.

remarks: Observed only when reporting a player's equipped specialist gestures by name in match telemetry.
It takes the same gesture type constants as GetPlayerSelectedGesture.

api.name: GetPlayerSelectedTaunt
api.description: Returns the index of the taunt the player has equipped for the given taunt type.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player whose equipped taunt is read.

parameters.name: tauntType
parameters.description: The taunt type to read, such as the first place taunt type.

returns.description: The index of the equipped taunt.

remarks: The corpus calls this at end of match to record which taunt the winning player has equipped.

api.name: GetPlayerSelectedTauntName
api.description: Returns the animation name of the taunt the player has equipped for the given taunt type.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player whose equipped taunt is read.

parameters.name: tauntType
parameters.description: The taunt type to read, such as the first place taunt type.

remarks: Used alongside GetPlayerSelectedTaunt when reporting end of match telemetry.

api.name: GetPlayerShowcaseWeapon
api.description: Returns the showcase weapon data of the player.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player whose showcase weapon is read.

returns.description: The showcase weapon data of the player.

api.name: GetPlayerSpawnId
api.description: Returns the current spawn id for the player, which identifies a single life for telemetry purposes.

parameters.name: player
parameters.description: The player to get the spawn id of.

returns.description: The spawn id of the player's current life.

remarks: The corpus uses the spawn id almost exclusively as a per-life key in BBPrint telemetry lines.

api.name: GetPlayerSpeed
api.description: Returns the current speed of the player.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player to get the speed of.

returns.description: The current speed of the player.

api.name: GetPlayerViewHeight
api.description: Returns the player's view height.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player to get the view height of.

returns.description: The player's view height.

remarks: Typically used as a vertical offset applied to a tag origin or a spawn position above the player.

api.name: GetPointInBounds
api.description: Returns a point within an entity's bounds, given ratios along each of its axes.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity whose bounds are sampled.

parameters.name: ratio_ForwardBack
parameters.description: 1.0 is full forward, -1.0 is full backwards.

parameters.name: ratio_LeftRight
parameters.description: 1.0 is full left, -1.0 is full right.

parameters.name: ratio_UpDown
parameters.description: 1.0 is full up, -1.0 is full down.

returns.description: The world position of the sampled point.

remarks: The corpus uses it to find the front, back and side extremities of a vehicle or trigger, and to walk the corners of a volume by passing combinations of 1 and -1.

api.name: GetPrevArrayKey
api.description: Returns the prev key of the input array, before the specified key.

parameters.name: array
parameters.description: Input array.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: The given key.

api.name: GetRandomCompatibleAttachmentsForWeapon
api.description: Returns an array of compatible attachments. If num desired attachments are specified then that many attachments will be returned if possible.

parameters.name: weapon
parameters.description: The weapon name.

parameters.name: numDesiredAttachments
parameters.description: Max number of compatible attachments desired. If the number is more than available attachments for the weapon, it will just not return that many.

api.name: GetRandomPointOnNavVolume
api.description: Get a random point on nav volume. Returns the position if found one, or undefined if not found.

calledOn.name: flying_ai
calledOn.description: The flying AI whose nav volume is sampled.

remarks: Callers check the result with IsDefined before using it, since no point may be found.

api.name: GetReacquireNode
api.description: Gets the reacquire node of this actor.

api.name: GetRefFromItemIndex
api.description: Returns the ref for a specified item index.

parameters.name: itemIndex
parameters.description: The item index to look up.

returns.description: The ref string for the item.

remarks: In the corpus it is always paired with GetBaseWeaponItemIndex and GetWeapon to turn a weapon into its base weapon.

api.name: GetReflectionLocs
api.description: Gets array of the locations of all of the reflection_probes in the level.

api.name: GetReflectionOrigin
api.description: Given a position, returns the position of the reflection probe in use there.

api.name: Getreplaygunlockonorigin
api.description: Returns the origin to use for the replay gun lock on against the given entity.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player holding the replay gun.

parameters.name: bool
parameters.description: : true or false.

returns.description: The world position to lock on to.

api.name: GetRetrievableWeapons
api.description: Returns an array of weapons that need watchers so they can be retrieved by the player.

returns.description: The array of retrievable weapons.

remarks: Called once during weapon object setup and cached on level.retrievableWeapons.

api.name: GetRootMapName
api.description: Returns the root map name of the current mission, or of the given map.

parameters.name: currentmap
parameters.description: the name of the current map.  If ommitted, use Dvar sv_mapname.

returns.description: The root map name, or undefined if there is none.

remarks: Almost always called with no argument, and the result is checked with IsDefined because it is undefined outside of a mission map.
Commonly used as the map key when reading or writing per map stats.

api.name: GetRoundsPlayed
api.description: Get rounds played in match state.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: The number of rounds played.

remarks: The corpus compares the result against level.roundLimit to decide whether the round limit has been reached.

api.name: GetScriptBrake
api.description: Gets the script brake value of a nitrous physics vehicle.

api.name: GetScriptBundle
api.description: Returns the script bundle struct.

api.name: GetScriptBundleList
api.description: Returns the script bundle list array.

api.name: GetScriptBundleNames
api.description: Returns all the names of the script bundles of the specified type in an array.

api.name: GetScriptBundles
api.description: Returns a list of script bundles based on the type.

api.name: GetScriptMoverArray
api.description: Returns an array of all of the script_origins in a level.

api.name: GetSeatFiringAngles
api.description: Retrieve the angles specifying the direction in which bullets, projectiles, etc. will be emitted from the weapon when it is fired.

calledOn.name: vehicle
calledOn.description: The vehicle or turret to read the seat from.

parameters.name: seatIndex
parameters.description: The index of the seat to get the firing angles for.

returns.description: The firing angles of the seat's weapon.

api.name: GetSeatFiringOrigin
api.description: Retrieve the location at the end of the barrel where bullets, projectiles, etc. are emitted when the gun is fired.

parameters.name: seatIndex
parameters.description: The seat to firing origin for.

api.name: GetSeatOccupant
api.description: Returns the entity occupying the given seat index, or undefined if the seat is empty.

calledOn.name: vehicle
calledOn.description: The vehicle or turret to read the seat from.

parameters.name: seat
parameters.description: 0 driver, 1-4 gunners, 5-10 passengers.

returns.description: The entity in the seat, or undefined if the seat is empty.

remarks: By far the most common use is GetSeatOccupant( 0 ) to get the driver of a vehicle or the user of a turret.
Callers guard the result with IsDefined, since an empty seat returns undefined.

api.name: GetSessStat
api.description: Gets a session stat for the player.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player.

parameters.name: statPath1
parameters.description: The first level of the stat path.

parameters.name: statPath2
parameters.description: The second level of the stat path.

parameters.name: statPath3
parameters.description: The third level of the stat path.

parameters.name: statPath4
parameters.description: The fourth level of the stat path.

parameters.name: statPath5
parameters.description: The fifth level of the stat path.

parameters.name: statPath6
parameters.description: The sixth level of the stat path.

parameters.name: statPath7
parameters.description: The seventh level of the stat path.

parameters.name: statPath8
parameters.description: The eighth level of the stat path.

returns.name: value
returns.description: The stat value.

api.name: GetSessStatArrayCount
api.description: Gets the array count of a session stat for the player.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player.

parameters.name: statPath1
parameters.description: The first level of the stat path.

parameters.name: statPath2
parameters.description: The second level of the stat path.

parameters.name: statPath3
parameters.description: The third level of the stat path.

parameters.name: statPath4
parameters.description: The fourth level of the stat path.

parameters.name: statPath5
parameters.description: The fifth level of the stat path.

parameters.name: statPath6
parameters.description: The sixth level of the stat path.

parameters.name: statPath7
parameters.description: The seventh level of the stat path.

parameters.name: statPath8
parameters.description: The eighth level of the stat path.

returns.name: count
returns.description: The array count.

api.name: GetShootAtPos
api.description: Returns the position an attacker would shoot at to hit this entity. For AI or players this is the eye position. For other entities it is the tag_eye if there is one, else the center of the entity's bounding box.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity that would be shot at.

parameters.name: attacker
parameters.description: The entity that will be shooting.

returns.description: The world position to shoot at.

remarks: Usually called with no argument and used as the end point of a BulletTrace or as the aim position for a turret or guided missile.

api.name: GetSkiptoName
api.description: Get the skip to name with the given index.

api.name: GetSkipTos
api.description: Get all skip tos for the level.

returns.description: The skip tos for the level.

remarks: Only used by campaign development scripts, which lowercase the result before parsing it.

api.name: GetSnapshotAckIndex
api.description: Get the snapshot acknowledgment index.

api.name: GetSnapshotIndexArray
api.description: Returns an array of the indices of current snapshots for all connected clients.

returns.description: The array of current snapshot indices.

api.name: GetSpawnerArray
api.description: Returns an array of the spawners in the level, optionally filtered by a key and value.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The value to search for.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: The key to match the value against, such as "targetname" or "script_noteworthy".

remarks: Called with no arguments to get every spawner, or with a value and the key to match it against, such as "targetname" or "script_noteworthy".

api.name: GetSpawnerTeamArray
api.description: Returns an array of all of the spawners in a level.

parameters.name: team
parameters.description: a team name, either 'axis', 'allies', or 'neutral'.

parameters.name: team
parameters.description: any number of additional team names may be added, either 'axis', 'allies', or 'neutral'.

api.name: GetSpawnStructForCharacter
api.description: Returns the targetname of the script_struct to use for the character pose in the frontend.

parameters.name: characterIndex
parameters.description: The index of the character in the current game-mode's character table.

parameters.name: sessionmode
parameters.description: Session Mode Index.

api.name: GetSpecialistIndex
api.description: Returns the specialist index for the player.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player whose specialist is read.

api.name: GetSpeed
api.description: Gets the current speed in inches per second.

calledOn.name: vehicle
calledOn.description: The vehicle to get the speed of.

returns.description: The current speed in inches per second.

remarks: Frequently divided by GetMaxSpeed() to get a normalized speed ratio, or compared against 0 to detect a stopped vehicle.

api.name: GetSpeedMPH
api.description: Gets the current speed in miles per hour.

calledOn.name: vehicle
calledOn.description: The vehicle to get the speed of.

returns.description: The current speed in miles per hour.

remarks: Used where a human readable speed is wanted, such as debug prints and thresholds on whether a vehicle is moving.

api.name: GetStance
api.description: Returns the stance of the player.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player to get the stance of.

returns.description: The player's stance, such as "prone", "crouch" or "stand".

remarks: The corpus compares the result against the strings "prone", "crouch" and "stand", often in a switch statement.

api.name: GetStartAngles
api.description: Get the starting angles for an animation, in world coordinates, given its current position, and angles.

parameters.name: origin
parameters.description: The current origin of the animation in world coordinates.

parameters.name: angle
parameters.description: The current angle set of the animation in world coordinates.

parameters.name: animation
parameters.description: The currently running animation.

parameters.name: animationTime
parameters.description: The animation time in 0-1 range.

returns.description: The starting angles of the animation in world coordinates.

api.example: v_ang = GetStartAngles( s.origin, s.angles, animation, time );
remarks: Usually called next to GetStartOrigin with the same arguments to get the full starting position and orientation of an animation.

api.name: GetStartOrigin
api.description: Get the starting origin for an animation, in world coordinates, given its current position, and angles.

parameters.name: origin
parameters.description: The current origin of the animation in world coordinates.

parameters.name: angle
parameters.description: The current angle set of the animation in world coordinates.

parameters.name: animation
parameters.description: The currently running animation.

parameters.name: animationTime
parameters.description: The starting animation time in 0-1 range.

returns.description: The starting origin of the animation in world coordinates.

remarks: The origin and angles passed in are commonly a tag origin and tag angles on the entity the animation is aligned to.
Usually called next to GetStartAngles with the same arguments.

api.name: GetStartTime
api.description: Returns the start time for the current round.

api.name: GetStealthSightValue
api.description: Get the current stealth sight value for this sentient seeing another sentient (floating point from 0.0 to 1.0).

calledOn.name: sentient
calledOn.description: The sentient doing the seeing.

parameters.name: otherSentient
parameters.description: The other sentient being seen.

remarks: Callers test the value against 0 to see whether the other sentient is visible at all, or take the maximum across a set of enemies.

api.name: GetSteering
api.description: Returns the steer factor of the vehicle.

api.name: GetStowedWeapon
api.description: Returns the weapon the entity currently has stowed.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity to get the stowed weapon of.

returns.description: The stowed weapon.

remarks: Read when saving or restoring a player's loadout.

api.name: GetStructField
api.description: Returns the value of a named field on a struct.

parameters.name: struct
parameters.description: The struct or bundle to read from.

parameters.name: fieldName
parameters.description: The name of the field to read.

remarks: The corpus uses it to read fields from script bundles by a name computed at runtime, which a normal field access cannot express.

api.name: GetSubStr
api.description: Returns the substring of the characters at index greater than or equal to the start index and less than the end index. The end index is optional and defaults to the end of the string.

parameters.name: string
parameters.description: The input string.

parameters.name: startIndex
parameters.description: The start index of the substring.

calledOn.description: The entity to gib.

parameters.name: gibtype

api.name: GiveAchievement
api.description: Awards an achievement to the given player.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player that earned the achievement.

parameters.name: achievementName
parameters.description: The name of the achievement.

api.name: GiveDecoration
api.description: Gives a decoration to the player.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player.

parameters.name: decorationName
parameters.description: The name of the decoration to give.

returns.name: result
returns.description: The result of giving the decoration.

remarks: Used in campaign to award medal decorations such as "cp_medal_all_collectibles", and the returned value is normally ignored.

api.name: GiveDedicatedShadow
api.description: Sets the model lod bias.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The player the dedicated shadow is given to.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: The entity to give a dedicated shadow for.

remarks: Called on a player with the entity that should cast a dedicated shadow for them, such as a vehicle they are riding or the player themselves.
Seen alongside SetModelLodBias when a player enters a killstreak vehicle.

api.name: GiveMaxAmmo
api.description: Give the weapon max ammo.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player to give ammo to.

parameters.name: weapon
parameters.description: The weapon to give ammo to.

remarks: Commonly applied to every weapon returned by GetWeaponsList to refill a player's whole inventory.
Often called right after GiveWeapon so the newly given weapon starts full.

api.name: GiveMissingUnlockTokens
api.description: Gives any missing unlock tokens to the player.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player.

returns.name: tokensGiven
returns.description: Whether any tokens were given.

api.name: GiveNextBaseWeapon
api.description: Give the player the next base weapon.

api.name: GiveStartAmmo
api.description: Give the weapon initial ammo.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player to give ammo to.

parameters.name: weapon
parameters.description: The weapon to give ammo to.

remarks: Used after giving or upgrading a weapon to set its ammo to the weapon's starting amount rather than the maximum.
Contrast with GiveMaxAmmo, which fills the weapon completely.

api.name: GiveUnlockToken
api.description: Gives an unlock token to the player.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player.

parameters.name: tokenType
parameters.description: The type of unlock token to give.

remarks: The argument is a count of tokens to award, typically 1, and campaign scripts pass an integer computed from rank or accolade progress.

api.name: GiveWeapon
api.description: Give a weapon to the player.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player to give the weapon to.

parameters.name: weapon
parameters.description: The weapon to give.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: The weapon options.

parameters.name: acvi
parameters.description: The attachment cosmetic variant index.

remarks: Almost always called with just the weapon; scripts follow it with GiveMaxAmmo or GiveStartAmmo to fill the new weapon.
The optional options and variant index arguments are only used when giving a randomized or customized weapon.

api.name: GiveWeaponNextAttachment
api.description: Give the weapon the next attachment.

parameters.name: attachmentPoint
parameters.description: The attachment point name.

remarks: Only seen in developer menu scripts, always with an empty attachment point string.

api.name: GlassRadiusDamage
api.description: Damages glass in the radius.

parameters.name: origin
parameters.description: Origin of damage.

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description: Radius of damage.

parameters.name: max_damage
parameters.description: Max damage, this is the damage at the origin.

parameters.name: min_damage
parameters.description: Max damage, this is the damage at the edge of the radius.

parameters.name: means_of_death
parameters.description: Means of death passed to the glass system from script, defaults to MOD_EXPLOSIVE.

remarks: Usually called with equal max and min damage to shatter every pane inside the radius.
The means of death argument is optional and is passed as a string such as "MOD_BURNED".

api.name: GrenadeExplosionEffect
api.description: Create a grenade explosion effect at the position.

parameters.name: position
parameters.description: Position of the fx.

api.name: GrenadeThrow
api.description: Throw a grenade. CheckGrenadeThrowPos() or CheckGrenadeThrow() must be called first.
remarks: Observed being triggered from animation notetracks on the animating AI.

api.name: GroundTrace
api.description: Allows script to do a point trace with MASK_SHOT + MASK_ITEM. Returns hit position, hit entity, hit surface normal.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: The trace start point.

parameters.name: end
parameters.description: The trace end point.

parameters.name: hitCharacters
parameters.description: When set to true, this will trace for character hits.

parameters.name: ignoreEntity
parameters.description: An entity to ignore during the trace. Pass false or undefined to ignore nothing.

parameters.name: ignoreWater
parameters.description: Optionally ignore water.

parameters.name: ignoreGlass
parameters.description: Optionally ignore glass.

returns.description: A struct containing fraction, position, entity, normal, and surfacetype.

remarks: Most often traced straight down a long distance to find the ground under a point, reading the "position" key of the result.
Pass undefined for the ignore entity when nothing should be skipped.

api.name: GroundType
api.description: Gets the ground surface type at a position.

parameters.name: position
parameters.description: The world position.

parameters.name: endPosition
parameters.description: The end position for the trace.

parameters.name: ignoreEnt1
parameters.description: The first entity to ignore.

parameters.name: ignoreEnt2
parameters.description: The second entity to ignore.

parameters.name: contentMask
parameters.description: The content mask for the trace.

returns.name: surfaceType
returns.description: The ground surface type name.

api.example: surface = GroundType( start, end, undefined, undefined );

api.name: HasActiveContractExpired
api.description: Checks whether an active contract has expired for the player.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player.

parameters.name: contractIndex
parameters.description: The contract index.

returns.name: expired
returns.description: Whether the contract has expired.

api.name: HasAGrenadePulledBack
api.description: check is a client has a grenade (any type including special) currently pulled back.

api.name: HasAsm
api.description: Check if this entity has an animation state machine (ASM).

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: The entity to check.

returns.name: hasAsm
returns.description: Whether the entity has ASM.

api.name: HasCollectedAllCollectibles
api.description: Checks whether the player has collected all collectibles.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player.

returns.name: hasAll
returns.description: Whether all collectibles have been collected.

remarks: Used in campaign to decide whether to award the all collectibles decoration.

api.name: HasCompletedAllGameChallenges
api.description: Checks whether the player has completed all game challenges.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player.

returns.name: completed
returns.description: Whether all game challenges are completed.

api.name: HasCyberComAbility
api.description: Checks whether the player has a specific cyber com ability.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player.

parameters.name: abilityName
parameters.description: The name of the ability to check.

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: The ability slot index.

returns.name: hasAbility
returns.description: Whether the player has the ability.

remarks: The result is compared against 2 to detect the upgraded version of an ability, and against 0 to detect that the player does not have it at all.
Ability names are the cybercom gadget names, for example "cybercom_es_strike".

api.name: HasCyberComRig
api.description: Checks whether the player has a specific cyber com rig.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player.

parameters.name: rigName
parameters.description: The name of the rig to check.

returns.name: hasRig
returns.description: Whether the player has the rig.

remarks: The result is compared against 2 to detect the upgraded version of a rig, so scripts store it as a status rather than a plain flag.
Rig names are the cybercom tactical rig names, for example "cybercom_proximitydeterrent".

api.name: HasDlcAvailable
api.description: Gets whether the player can use the DLC-content weapon.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player to check.

parameters.name: dlcWeapon
parameters.description: The DLC weapon.

returns.name: canUse
returns.description: Whether the user has the DLC required for this weapon.

api.name: HasGoal
api.description: Checks whether the AI actor has a specific goal.

calledOn.name: actor
calledOn.description: The AI actor.

parameters.name: goalId
parameters.description: The goal name to check for.

returns.name: hasGoal
returns.description: Whether the actor has the goal.

api.name: HashString
api.description: Computes a runtime hash of the given string.

parameters.name: input
parameters.description: The string to hash.

returns.name: hash
returns.description: The computed hash. *

api.name: HasMaxPrimaryWeapons
api.description: Returns true if the player has maximum primary weapons.
remarks: Checked by loadout code before giving a player another primary weapon.

api.name: HasPart
api.description: Returns whether the entity has the given tagname as part of its skeleton.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity whose skeleton is checked.

parameters.name: tagname
parameters.description: The tag to search for. (string).

parameters.name: modelname
parameters.description: The optional model name to help specify the part location. (string).

returns.description: Whether the entity has that part.

remarks: Used by gib and destructible character systems to test whether a tag is still attached before hiding or removing it.
The model name argument is optional and is omitted at every observed call site.

api.name: HasPath
api.description: Returns whether the AI currently has a path.

calledOn.name: sentient
calledOn.description: The AI to check.

returns.description: Whether the AI has a path.

remarks: Widely used in behavior tree conditions to tell whether an AI is moving or has stopped at its goal.

api.name: HasPerk
api.description: Returns whether the player has the given perk.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player to check.

parameters.name: perkName
parameters.description: The perk to check for.

returns.description: Whether the player has the perk.

remarks: Perk names are the specialty aliases, for example "specialty_fireproof" or "specialty_immuneemp".
The result is sometimes compared against 0 explicitly rather than used as a plain condition.

api.name: HasRiotShield
api.description: Return true if player has a riot shield in their inventory.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player to check.

returns.description: Whether the player has a riot shield.

remarks: Cached onto the player as a field by the riot shield script whenever their inventory changes.

api.name: HasSeasonPass
api.description: Checks whether the player has the season pass.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player.

parameters.name: passId
parameters.description: The season pass identifier.

parameters.name: param1
parameters.description: An additional parameter.

parameters.name: param2
parameters.description: An additional parameter.

returns.name: hasPass
returns.description: Whether the player has the season pass.

remarks: The corpus only calls this with a single argument of 0, when reporting end of match telemetry.

api.name: HasValidInterrupt
api.description: Return true if there is a valid interrupt with the given name alive on the current server frame.

calledOn.name: actor
calledOn.description: The AI actor to test.

parameters.name: interruptName
parameters.description: The name of the interrupt.

returns.description: Whether an interrupt with that name is currently valid.

remarks: Behavior tree code uses this to gate pain and react reactions, usually combined with checks such as HasPath().

api.name: HasWeapon
api.description: Returns true if the player has the given weapon.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player to check.

parameters.name: weapon
parameters.description: The weapon to check.

parameters.name: ignore_attachments
parameters.description: Only check the root weapon, ignore all the attachments.

returns.description: Whether the player currently has that weapon.

remarks: Nearly all call sites pass a weapon object and omit the second argument.

api.name: HeliTurretDogTrace
api.description: Determines if you helicopter turret can see the dog.

parameters.name: position
parameters.description: place that check if you can see if being performed.

parameters.name: dog
parameters.description: the dog that the helicopter wants to see.

parameters.name: hitNum
parameters.description: if you run this more than once make sure to populate this with the return of the last as it will increase efficiency.

api.example: dog.lastHit = self HeliTurretDogTrace( heli_turret_point, dog, dog.lastHit );
remarks: Call sites store the result back onto the dog and feed it in as the hitNum argument on the next check.

api.name: HeliTurretSightTrace
api.description: Determines if you helicopter turret can see an the players eyes.

parameters.name: position
parameters.description: place that check if you can see if being performed.

parameters.name: player
parameters.description: the player that the helicopter wants to see.

parameters.name: hitNum
parameters.description: if you run this more than once make sure to populate this with the return of the last as it will increase efficiency.

api.example: player.lastHit = self HeliTurretSightTrace( heli_turret_point, player, player.lastHit );
remarks: Call sites store the result on the player and pass it back in as hitNum on the next check.

api.name: Hide

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity to hide.

parameters.description: The name of the team to hide the entity from.

remarks: Team names come from values such as game["attackers"] or a player's pers["team"].

parameters.description: targetname of misc model(s).

api.name: HidePart
api.description: Hide part of an entity.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity whose part is hidden.

parameters.name: tagname
parameters.description: The tag to hide. All surfaces with a vertex weighted to the tag will be hidden and have no bullet collision. (string).

parameters.name: modelname
parameters.description: The optional model name to help specify the part location. (string).

parameters.name: bApplyToChildren
parameters.description: Optional flag to specify if we should apply the operation to children bones as well. (boolean).

api.name: HideViewModel
api.description: Hide the player's current view model.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player whose view model is hidden.

remarks: Used while a player is put into a scripted state, and paired with ShowViewModel() to restore it.

api.name: HideZBarrierPiece
api.description: Stops the indexed piece from being drawn.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The z-barrier entity.

parameters.name: pieceNumber
parameters.description: The zero based index of the piece to hide.

remarks: Zombies scripts loop over the barrier's pieces to hide them one at a time, and use ShowZBarrierPiece to draw them again.

api.description: Increments the bubblegum tokens used counter for the player.

api.name: IncrementLifeStat

api.name: IsAltMode

api.name: IsAnimLeaf
