calledOn.name: actor
calledOn.description: The behavior tree actor to check.

returns.description: True if a behavior tree action is running and it is looping.

api.name: IsDangerous
api.description: Returns true if the pathnode is dangerous for the given team.

parameters.name: team
parameters.description: Name of the team.

api.name: IsDedicated
api.description: Returns true/false if we are running on the dedicated server.

returns.description: True if the script is running on a dedicated server.

api.name: IsDeflected
api.description: Check if the actor has been deflected.

api.name: IsDoubleJumping
api.description: Returns true if the player is double jumping.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player to check.

returns.description: True if the player is double jumping.

remarks: Used alongside IsOnGround, IsWallRunning, IsMantling and IsSliding to classify a player's current traversal state.

api.name: IsDriverFiring
api.description: Checks if this driver is firing the vehicle turret.

calledOn.name: vehicle
calledOn.description: The vehicle to check.

returns.description: True if the driver is firing the vehicle turret.

api.name: IsDroppingWeapon
api.description: Returns true if the player is currently dropping their weapon.

api.name: IsEMPJammed
api.description: Returns true if this player is jammed by the emp, false otherwise.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity to test.

returns.description: True if the player is jammed by an EMP.

remarks: Killstreak and gadget code checks this before allowing activation, since a perk can stop a player being jammed.

api.name: IsEntity
api.description: Checks whether given variable is of type entity.

parameters.name: variable
parameters.description: The variable to test.

returns.description: True if the variable is an entity.

remarks: Commonly used inside asserts, or to tell an entity apart from a position vector before using it.

api.name: IsEventServiced
api.description: Set the specified event to serviced.

parameters.name: eventId
parameters.description: The identifier of the event (integer).

api.name: IsFiring
api.description: Returns true if the player is currently meleeing.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player to check.

api.name: IsFiringTurret
api.description: Checks whether this turret is firing. The entity must be a turret.

calledOn.name: turret
calledOn.description: The turret to check.

api.name: IsFlankedAtCoverNode
api.description: Returns true if the actor is flanked at its cover node.

calledOn.name: actor
calledOn.description: The actor at the cover node.

returns.description: True if the actor is flanked at its cover node.

remarks: AI cover logic pairs it with IsAtCoverNodeStrict and a canbeflanked check before deciding to leave or rotate at cover.

api.name: IsFlared
api.description: Check is a player is under the influence of a flare.

api.name: IsFloat
api.description: Checks whether this entity/variable is a float.

parameters.name: variable
parameters.description: The variable to test.

returns.description: True if the variable is a float.

remarks: Almost always paired with IsInt in an assert, because scripts accept either numeric type for values such as radii and attribute ranges.

api.name: IsFunctionPtr
api.description: Checks whether given variable is of type Function Pointer in script, useful to differentiate between Var and FuncPtr in Script.

parameters.name: variable
parameters.description: The variable to test.

returns.description: True if the variable is a function pointer.

remarks: Widely used to validate optional callbacks, usually as IsDefined( callback ) && IsFunctionPtr( callback ) or inside an assert before the callback is called.

api.name: IsGadgetMeleeCharging
api.description: Is the player in the process of melee charging.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player.

returns.description: True if the player is melee charging with a gadget.

api.name: IsGlobalStatsServer
api.description: Returns true if the game is a global stats ranked server.

api.name: IsGodMode
api.description: Checks whether this entity is in god mode.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: The entity to check.

returns.description: True if the entity is in god mode.

remarks: Traps and damage scripts check it before dealing damage, and some code drives self.takedamage from its result.

api.name: IsGrappling
api.description: Returns true if the player is currently grappling.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player to check.

returns.description: True if the player is currently grappling.

api.name: IsGrenadePosSafe
api.description: Checks a grenade throw target position is safe.

parameters.name: throwPos
parameters.description: (vector) position to throw at.

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description: (float) safety radius.

api.name: IsGrenadeWeapon
api.description: Checks whether the current weapon is a grenade.

returns.name: isGrenade
returns.description: Whether the weapon is a grenade.

api.name: IsGunnerFiring
api.description: Checks if this gun is currently firing.

calledOn.name: vehicle
calledOn.description: The vehicle to check.

parameters.name: gunnerIndex
parameters.description: The zero based index of the gunner seat to check.

returns.description: True if that gunner is firing.

remarks: Every observed call passes gunner index 0, the vehicle's first gunner seat.

api.name: IsHidden
api.description: Returns true if the entity is hidden.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity to check.

returns.description: True if the entity is hidden.

api.name: IsHost
api.description: Returns true if the player is the host.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player to check.

returns.description: True if the player is the host.

remarks: Frequently combined with level.splitscreen so that only the host drives shared game flow such as menus and end of game handling.

api.name: IsHostForBots
api.description: Returns true if the passed in entity is the host for bots.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player to check.

remarks: util_shared::getHostPlayerForBots loops over GetPlayers() and returns the first player for which this is true.

api.name: IsInAnyBadPlace
api.description: Returns whether the AI is in a bad place.

calledOn.name: actor
calledOn.description: The actor to check.

returns.description: True if the actor is standing in a bad place.

api.name: IsInArray
api.description: Returns true if the given value is present in the array.

parameters.name: array
parameters.description: The array to search.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: The value to search for.

returns.description: True if the value is present in the array.

remarks: Works with values of any type, including entities and strings, and is often called on an inline array( ... ) literal.

api.name: IsInGoal
api.description: Determine whether a given point is in the actor's current goal area.

calledOn.name: sentient
calledOn.description: The sentient whose goal area is checked.

parameters.name: point
parameters.description: The point to test against the goal area.

returns.description: True if the point lies within the actor's current goal area.

remarks: AI code typically pairs it with FindPath to confirm the actor can both reach the point and stay within its goal.

api.name: IsInMoveMode
api.description: Returns true if the player is in either of the given move modes.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player to check.

parameters.name: move_mode_1
parameters.description: The move mode to check for, such as "ufo".

parameters.name: move_mode_2
parameters.description: An optional second move mode to check for, such as "noclip".

returns.description: True if the player is in either of the given move modes.

remarks: Calls almost always pass "ufo" and "noclip" together, to skip gameplay logic for players flying around in a debug move mode.

api.name: IsInScriptedState
api.description: Checks if actor is in a scripted state (animscripted, custom, negotiation).

calledOn.name: actor
calledOn.description: The actor to check.

returns.description: True if the actor is in a scripted state.

remarks: Callers usually guard it with IsActor, and use it to skip gameplay effects on AI that scripted scenes currently control.

api.name: IsInSecondChance
api.description: To check if player is needs revive.

api.name: IsInsideHeightLock
api.description: Returns whether the entity is inside the height lock or not.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity to check.

api.name: IsInsideHeliHeightLock
api.description: Returns true if Helicopter is inside height mesh.

api.name: IsInt
api.description: Checks whether this entity/variable is an int.

parameters.name: variable
parameters.description: The variable to test.

returns.description: True if the variable is an int.

remarks: Often paired with IsFloat when a value may be either numeric type, and used to tell integer array keys apart from string keys.

api.name: IsInVehicle
api.description: Returns whether or not this player is currently occupying a vehicle.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player to check.

returns.description: True if the player is occupying a vehicle.

remarks: Commonly checked alongside IsRemoteControlling to skip logic for players who are not in normal on foot control.

api.name: IsItemLocked
api.description: Gets whether the given item is locked for the player.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player to check.

parameters.name: itemIndex
parameters.description: The index of the item.

returns.name: isLocked
returns.description: Whether the item is locked.

api.name: IsItemPurchased
api.description: Gets whether the given item has been purchased by the player.

parameters.name: itemIndex
parameters.description: The index of the item.

returns.name: hasPurchased
returns.description: Whether the item has been purchased.

api.name: IsItemRestricted
api.description: Returns whether an item is restricted.

parameters.name: itemRef
parameters.description: The reference name of the item to check.

returns.description: True if the item is restricted.

remarks: Loadout and supply drop code uses it to drop items that the current playlist or ruleset disallows.

api.name: IsKillstreak
api.description: Checks whether the current weapon is a killstreak weapon.

returns.name: isKillstreak
returns.description: Whether the weapon is a killstreak.

api.name: IsKnownEnemyInRadius
api.description: Returns whether the AI knows about an enemy within a radius of a position.

calledOn.name: actor
calledOn.description: The AI actor whose known enemies are checked.

parameters.name: position
parameters.description: The center of the radius to check.

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description: The radius to check within, in units.

returns.description: True if a known enemy is inside the radius, false otherwise.

remarks: Used by color-team node picking to reject cover nodes that have a known enemy nearby.

api.name: IsKnownEnemyInVolume
api.description: Returns whether the AI knows about an enemy inside a volume.

calledOn.name: actor
calledOn.description: The AI actor whose known enemies are checked.

parameters.name: volume
parameters.description: The volume entity to check inside.

returns.description: True if a known enemy is inside the volume, false otherwise.

remarks: Used alongside IsKnownEnemyInRadius when picking safe nodes for a color team.

api.name: IsLaserOn
api.description: Checks if the entity has laser turned on.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: The entity to check.

returns.name: isOn
returns.description: Whether the entity has laser on.

api.name: IsLauncher
api.description: Checks whether the current weapon is a launcher.

returns.name: isLauncher
returns.description: Whether the weapon is a launcher.

api.name: IsLinkedTo
api.description: Returns whether the entity is currently linked to the given entity.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity that may be linked.

parameters.name: other
parameters.description: The entity to test the link against.

returns.description: True if the entity is linked to the given entity, false otherwise.

remarks: Commonly used to check whether a player or projectile is attached to a vehicle or moving object before applying logic to it.

api.name: IsLoadingCinematicPlaying
api.description: Returns whether the loading cinematic is currently playing.

returns.description: True while the loading cinematic is playing, false otherwise.

remarks: Usually polled in a wait loop before starting gameplay or showing UI.

api.name: IsLocalGame
api.description: Returns true if the game local only.

api.name: IsLocalToHost
api.description: Returns whether the player is on the same physical machine as the match host.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player to test.

returns.description: True if the player is local to the host, false otherwise.

remarks: Used to exclude the host's own local players from stats and ranking bookkeeping.

api.name: IsLookingAt
api.description: Returns whether the player is looking at the given entity.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player whose view is tested.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: The entity to test whether the player is looking at.

returns.description: True if the player is looking at the entity, false otherwise.

api.example: if ( isplayer( self.enemy ) && self.enemy IsLookingAt( self ) ) {}
remarks: Often combined with a distance check before playing reaction dialogue or AI behavior.

api.name: IsMantling
api.description: Returns whether the player is currently mantling.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player to test.

returns.description: True if the player is mantling, false otherwise.

remarks: Frequently checked with IsOnLadder, IsOnGround, IsWallRunning and IsSliding to describe the player's current movement state.

api.name: IsMapSubLevel
api.description: Returns whether the given map is a sublevel of a mission rather than a mission start map.

parameters.name: currentmap
parameters.description: The name of the map to test. If omitted, the current map is used.

returns.description: True if the map is a sublevel, false otherwise.

remarks: Campaign scripts use it to decide whether saving, accolades or skipto handling should run on the current map.

api.name: IsMature
api.description: Returns whether the given player has graphic content enabled.

parameters.name: player
parameters.description: The player whose graphic content setting is checked.

returns.description: True if graphic content is enabled for the player, false otherwise.

remarks: Used to gate graphic scene content per player.

api.name: IsMeleeing
api.description: Returns whether the player is currently performing a melee attack.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player to test.

returns.description: True if the player is meleeing, false otherwise.

remarks: Bot and weapon scripts check it together with IsReloading, IsSwitchingWeapons and IsThrowingGrenade before starting another action.

api.name: Ismissileinsideheightlock
api.description: Returns whether the missile entity is inside its height lock.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The missile entity to test.

returns.description: Whether the missile is inside its height lock.

remarks: Used by the QR drone to confirm it is within its minimum and maximum height before treating itself as in range.

api.name: IsMoveSuppressed
api.description: Checks whether this actor is in a suppressed state ( blocked by friendly fire ).

api.name: IsMovingPlatform
api.description: Returns whether platform is a moving platform or not.

api.name: IsNavVolumeLoaded
api.description: Returns whether a navigation volume is loaded for the current map.

returns.description: True if a nav volume is loaded, false otherwise.

remarks: Killstreak scripts check it before spawning flying AI that need nav volume pathing.

api.name: IsNodeEnabled
api.description: returns true if the node is enabled, false otherwise.

parameters.name: node
parameters.description: The node to check.

api.name: IsNodeOccupied
api.description: Returns whether a node has been claimed by an AI.

parameters.name: node
parameters.description: The node to check.

returns.description: True if the node is occupied, false otherwise.

remarks: Spawner scripts pair it with a script side node_claimed flag when picking a free node.

api.name: IsNoTarget
api.description: Returns whether the sentient is marked as no target.

calledOn.name: sentient
calledOn.description: The sentient to test.

returns.description: True if the sentient is marked no target, false otherwise.

remarks: AI target selection checks it together with the ignoreme field and last stand state before choosing a player as an enemy.

api.name: IsOnGround
api.description: Returns whether the entity is on the ground.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity to test.

returns.description: True if the entity is on the ground, false otherwise.

remarks: Used for both players and AI actors, often to reject airborne targets or to wait until a character lands.

api.name: IsOnLadder
api.description: Returns whether the player is on a ladder.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player to test.

returns.description: True if the player is on a ladder, false otherwise.

remarks: Death handling checks it with IsMantling to decide whether a corpse should ragdoll.

api.name: IsOnSlide
api.description: Returns whether the player is currently sliding.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player to test.

returns.description: True if the player is on a slide, false otherwise.

remarks: Used with GetStance to treat sliding players like low profile targets.

api.name: IsPathDirect
api.description: Check whether the actor's current path is direct.

api.name: IsPathfinder
api.description: Returns whether the entity is registered with the navigation system, so it can do pathfinding and position queries.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: The entity to check.

returns.description: True if the entity is registered with the navigation system, false otherwise.

remarks: Vehicle setup checks it before relying on nav based movement for the vehicle.

api.name: IsPaused
api.description: Returns whether the entity is paused as part of a world pause.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity to test.

returns.description: True if the entity is paused, false otherwise.

remarks: AI behavior scripts check it to skip logic while an actor is frozen by a pause.

api.name: IsPlayer
api.description: Returns whether the given entity is a player.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: The entity to test.

returns.description: True if the entity is a player, false otherwise.

remarks: One of the most common guards in the corpus, usually applied to attacker, victim or enemy entities before using player only functions.

api.name: IsPlayerNumber
api.description: Returns true if the passed in int is a valid client number.

api.name: IsPlayerOnSameMachine
api.description: Returns whether this player is on the same machine as the given player.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player to test from.

parameters.name: player
parameters.description: The player to test against.

returns.description: True if both players are on the same machine, false otherwise.

remarks: Spectating and UI code uses it to keep split screen players on one machine from spectating each other.

api.name: IsPlayerSwimming
api.description: Returns whether the player is swimming.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player to test.

returns.description: True if the player is swimming, false otherwise.

remarks: Usually checked together with IsPlayerUnderwater and IsOnGround to describe the player's movement state.
Every observed call site uses the result directly as a boolean condition.

api.name: IsPlayerUnderwater
api.description: Returns whether the player is underwater.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player to test.

returns.description: True if the player is underwater, false otherwise.

remarks: Paired with IsPlayerSwimming for water movement, and used to drive drowning, gasping and underwater state flags.
Every observed call site uses the result directly as a boolean condition.

api.name: IsPlayingAnimScripted
api.description: Returns whether the entity is currently playing a scripted animation.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity to test.

returns.description: True if the entity is playing a scripted animation, false otherwise.

remarks: Used to skip AI or player logic while a scene has taken control of the entity's animation.

api.name: IsPointInNavVolume
api.description: Returns whether a given point is inside the named navigation volume.

parameters.name: position
parameters.description: The position to evaluate.

parameters.name: navVolumeName
parameters.description: The name of the navigation volume to test against.

returns.description: True if the point is inside the named volume, false otherwise.

remarks: Flying AI such as the wasp, hunter and parasite use it to keep their positions inside a nav volume.

api.name: IsPointOnNavMesh
api.description: Checks if a given point is valid on the NavMesh. This check performs all the necessary validation such as away from boundary, correct material, navmesh trigger, etc.

parameters.name: position
parameters.description: Position to evaluate.

parameters.name: entity/Radius
parameters.description: the point is for this entity to path to, or an estimate radius of the expected character radius. default to radius 0. Note: not passing in the entity can cause false positive when point is on NavMesh but too close to boundary / on wrong material / in disabled navmesh trigger; or false negative when big character's origin is far below NavMesh but still within tolerant height.

returns.description: True if the point is valid on the NavMesh, false otherwise.

remarks: Almost always passed the querying AI as the second argument so the check accounts for that character's radius.
A numeric radius is used instead when testing points for no particular entity, for example when fitting a spawn area.

api.name: IsPointOnStairs
api.description: Checks whether the given point is on stairs.

parameters.name: point
parameters.description: The position to check.

returns.name: onStairs
returns.description: Whether the point is on stairs.

api.name: IsPoisoned
api.description: Check is a player is under the influence of gas.

api.name: IsPosAtGoal
api.description: Returns whether a position is inside the actor's current goal.

calledOn.name: actor
calledOn.description: The AI actor whose goal is tested.

parameters.name: position
parameters.description: The position to check.

returns.description: True if the position is inside the current goal, false otherwise.

remarks: Behavior tree code uses it to check whether an animation end point or cover offset falls within the actor's goal radius.

api.name: IsPosInClaimedLocation
api.description: Returns whether a position is inside a location claimed by another sentient.

calledOn.name: sentient
calledOn.description: The sentient asking about the position.

parameters.name: position
parameters.description: The position to check.

returns.description: True if the position is claimed by another sentient, false otherwise.

remarks: Used before moving or teleporting to a spot, often together with PositionWouldTelefrag or a path check.

api.name: IsProfileBuild
api.description: Checks whether the current build is a profile build.

returns.name: isProfileBuild
returns.description: Whether this is a profile build.

api.name: IsRagdoll
api.description: Returns whether the entity is currently a ragdoll body.

calledOn.name: player_or_playercorpse
calledOn.description: The player, corpse or AI body to test.

returns.description: True if the entity is a ragdoll, false otherwise.

remarks: Checked together with isalive before applying damage effects or animations to a character.

api.name: IsReloading
api.description: Returns whether the player is currently reloading.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player to test.

returns.description: True if the player is reloading, false otherwise.

remarks: Bot logic checks it first in a chain with IsSwitchingWeapons, IsThrowingGrenade and IsMeleeing before starting a new action.

api.name: Isremotecontrol
api.description: Query whether this vehicle is usable by players.

calledOn.name: vehicle
calledOn.description: The vehicle to test.

remarks: Checked together with GetVehicleOwner when a vehicle dies, to give a controlling player time to see the destruction.

api.name: IsRemoteControlling
api.description: Returns whether the player is currently occupying a remote controlled entity.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player to test.

returns.description: True if the player is remote controlling an entity, false otherwise.

remarks: Often paired with IsInVehicle, and with util::isusingremote, when deciding whether normal player logic or UI applies.

api.name: IsRocketLauncher
api.description: Checks whether the current weapon is a rocket launcher.

returns.name: isRocketLauncher
returns.description: Whether the weapon is a rocket launcher.

api.name: IsSafeFromGrenade
api.description: Returns whether the actor is safe from a grenade it knows about.

calledOn.name: actor
calledOn.description: The AI actor to test.

returns.description: True if the actor is safe from the grenade, false otherwise.

remarks: Behavior tree cover logic uses the negated result to decide when an actor must leave its cover node.

api.name: IsSentient
api.description: Returns whether the given entity is a sentient, normally an AI actor, an AI vehicle or a player.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: The entity to test.

returns.description: True if the entity is a sentient, false otherwise.

remarks: Used as a guard before calling sentient only functions such as IsNoTarget on an arbitrary entity.

api.name: IsSlamming
api.description: Returns whether the player is currently performing a slam.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player to test.

returns.description: True if the player is slamming, false otherwise.

remarks: Used by gravity spike and glaive style weapons, both as a state check and as a wait loop condition.

api.name: IsSliding
api.description: Returns true if the player is sliding.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player to test.

returns.description: True if the player is currently sliding.

remarks: Commonly combined with the other movement state checks (IsOnGround, IsWallRunning, IsMantling, IsDoubleJumping) to classify how a player was moving.

api.name: IsSpawner
api.description: Checks whether this entity is a spawner.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: The entity to test.

returns.description: True if the entity is a spawner.

remarks: Used to tell spawner entities apart from spawned entities before running spawner-only logic.

api.name: IsSpawnPointVisible
api.description: Returns true or false if a point is visible to the given team.

parameters.name: point
parameters.description: Spawnpoint origin that needs to be checked.

parameters.name: angles
parameters.description: Spawnpoint angles that needs to be checked.

parameters.name: team
parameters.description: Team that we need to check against the point.

parameters.name: ignorePlayer
parameters.description: The player that we are spawning in.

api.name: IsSpecialistUnlocked
api.description: Checks whether the given player has unlocked specialists.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player to check.

returns.name: isUnlocked
returns.description: Whether the player has specialists unlocked.

api.name: IsSplitScreen
api.description: Returns true if the game is a splitscreen game.
remarks: Typically cached once into level.splitscreen at game start.

api.name: IsSprinting
api.description: Returns true if the player is sprinting.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player to test.

returns.description: True if the player is currently sprinting.

remarks: Often paired with IsSliding or IsOnGround to describe a player's movement state at the moment of a kill or a trap trigger.

api.name: IsStackedFire
api.description: Checks whether the current weapon uses stacked fire.

returns.name: isStacked
returns.description: Whether the weapon uses stacked fire.

api.name: IsStanceAllowed
api.description: Checks whether this actor can go to the given stance.

calledOn.name: actor
calledOn.description: The actor to test.

parameters.name: stance
parameters.description: (string) A stance, can be 'prone', 'crouch', 'stand'.

returns.description: True if the actor is allowed to adopt the given stance.

api.name: IsStarterPack
api.description: Returns true if the player has starter pack.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player to test.

returns.description: True if the player only owns the starter pack.

remarks: Used in rank progression to cap a starter pack player at level.maxRankStarterPack.

api.name: IsStartingClassDefault
api.description: Returns true if the starting class is the default class for the level.

api.name: IsStreamerReady
api.description: Is the players streamer ready.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player whose streamer is being checked.

parameters.name: streamKey
parameters.description: The stream request id to check, or -1 for none.

parameters.name: extra
parameters.description: Additional parameter.

returns.description: Whether the streamer is ready.

remarks: Called in a wait loop against a timeout, so that play does not start before every player's assets have streamed in.
Call sites either pass no arguments or pass a stream request id (-1 for none) plus a second flag argument.

api.name: IsString
api.description: Returns true if the given value is a string.

parameters.name: variable
parameters.description: The value that may or may not be a string.

returns.description: True if the value is a string.

remarks: Frequently used inside assert() to validate string parameters, and alongside IsDefined before comparing a value to a literal string.

api.name: IsStruct
api.description: Checks whether this variable is a struct object.

parameters.name: variable
parameters.description: variable that may or may not be a struct.

api.name: IsSubStr
api.description: Returns true if the value contains the given substring.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: The value to check for the substring.

parameters.name: substring
parameters.description: The substring to check for.

returns.name: result
returns.description: True if the value contains the given substring, false otherwise.

api.name: IsSuppressed
api.description: Checks whether this actor is in a suppressed state ( under fire ).

api.name: IsSuppressionWaiting
api.description: Checks whether this actor is still doing suppression wait.

api.name: IsSwitchingWeapons
api.description: Returns true if the player is currently switching weapons.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player to test.

returns.description: True if the player is currently switching weapons.

remarks: Used to defer actions until a weapon swap finishes, often in a while loop, and grouped with IsReloading, IsThrowingGrenade and IsMeleeing to detect a busy player.

api.name: IsTalking
api.description: Returns true if the player is talking via voice chat.

api.name: IsTestClient
api.description: Returns true if the player is a test client (Does not have a remote user).

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player to test.

returns.description: True if the player is a test client.

remarks: Used to exclude bots and test clients from logic meant for real players, such as loadout or audio handling.

api.name: IsThreateningMyProtectEntity
api.description: Returns true if the enemy is currently threatening my protect entity.

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: (sentient) The sentient to check.

api.name: IsThrowingGrenade
api.description: Returns true if the player is currently throwing a grenade.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player to test.

returns.description: True if the player is currently throwing a grenade.

remarks: Used to hold off weapon or state changes until the throw completes, often in a while loop, and grouped with IsReloading and IsSwitchingWeapons.

api.name: IsTouching
api.description: Gets whether the given entity is touching another entity (intersecting).

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity to check.

parameters.name: otherEntity
parameters.description: The other entity to check if they're touching.

parameters.name: extraBoundary
parameters.description: An additional boundary to use, if any.

returns.name: result
returns.description: Whether the entity is touching the other.

api.name: IsTouchingSwept
api.description: Gets whether the entity is touching another entity.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity to check.

parameters.name: other
parameters.description: The entity to check if they are touching.

parameters.name: minZ
parameters.description: The minimum z-difference there can be between the two entities.

parameters.name: maxZ
parameters.description: The maximum z-difference there can be between the two entities.

returns.name: touching
returns.description: Whether they're touching the other entity.

api.name: IsTouchingVolume
api.description: Returns true if entity is touching the volume.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity to test against the volume.

parameters.name: origin
parameters.description: Origin of the volume.

parameters.name: volumeMins
parameters.description: The min extents of the volume.

parameters.name: volumeMaxs
parameters.description: The max extents of the volume.

returns.description: True if the entity is touching the volume.

api.example: if ( crate IsTouchingVolume( origin + (0, 0, 40), mins, maxs ) )
remarks: The extents are usually taken from another entity with GetMins and GetMaxs, and the origin is the position the volume is tested at.

api.name: IsTraversing
api.description: Returns true if the player is traversing.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player to test.

returns.description: True if the player is currently traversing.

remarks: Usually checked with IsOnGround and IsWallRunning to confirm a player is in a stable state before acting on them.

api.name: IsTriggerEnabled
api.description: Returns true if trigger is enabled. False otherwise.

calledOn.name: trigger
calledOn.description: The trigger to test.

returns.description: True if the trigger is enabled.

remarks: Pairs with TriggerEnable, and is usually tested before treating a trigger as active.

api.name: IString
api.description: Casts a string to an istring.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: A string to cast to an istring.

returns.name: result
returns.description: The casted istring.

api.name: IsTurretFiring
api.description: Checks if this turret is firing.

api.name: IsTurretLockedOn
api.description: Checks whether this turret is locked onto a target. The entity must be a turret.

api.name: IsTurretReady
api.description: Query whether this vehicle's turret is ready for firing.

api.name: IsUsingNavVolume
api.description: Checks whether this entity is using Nav Volume. Note this is a relatively low level check. For general gameplay check whether an entity is flying, consider using IsAirborne.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: An entity object.

api.name: IsUsingOffHand
api.description: Returns true if player is using offhand weapon.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player to test.

returns.description: True if the player is currently using an offhand weapon.

remarks: Often followed by a check of the current offhand weapon to identify which offhand is in use.

api.name: IsUsingT7Melee
api.description: Gets whether the T7 melee system is being used.

returns.name: inUse
returns.description: Whether the T7 melee system is in use.

api.name: IsValidGametype
api.description: Returns true if the string is a valid game type.

parameters.name: gameType
parameters.description: a string to check.

api.name: IsVec
api.description: Returns true if the given value is a vector.

parameters.name: variable
parameters.description: The value that may or may not be a vector.

returns.description: True if the value is a vector.

remarks: Commonly used to accept either a position or an entity in the same parameter, falling back to the entity's origin when the value is not a vector.
Also used inside assert() to validate vector parameters.

api.name: IsVehicle
api.description: Returns true if the given entity is a vehicle.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: The entity that may be a vehicle.

returns.description: True if the entity is a vehicle.

remarks: Often used with IsAI to separate vehicle entities from AI actors when handling damage or spawned entities.

api.name: IsVehicleImmuneToDamage
api.description: This checks the vehicle GDT settings related to bulletdamage, grenadedamage, etc.

calledOn.name: vehicle
calledOn.description: The vehicle being damaged.

parameters.name: damageFlags
parameters.description: Integer specifying flags that are to be applied to the damage.

parameters.name: meansOfDeath
parameters.description: Integer specifying the method of death.

parameters.name: Weapon
parameters.description: The weapon number of the weapon used to inflict the damage.

returns.description: True if the vehicle is immune to the described damage.

api.example: if ( self IsVehicleImmuneToDamage( iDFlags, sMeansOfDeath, weapon ) )
remarks: Called from the vehicle damage callbacks with the damage flags, means of death and weapon passed straight through, to discard damage the vehicle is immune to.

api.name: IsVehicleManualControl
api.description: check if vehicle hkai behavior is enabled. Not to be confused with UseVehicle().

api.name: IsVehicleSeatOccupied
api.description: same as useby except you can specify a seat, 0 driver, 1-4 gunners, 5-10 passengers.

calledOn.name: vehicle
calledOn.description: The vehicle whose seat is being checked.

parameters.name: seat
parameters.description: 0 driver, 1-4 gunners, 5-10 passengers.

returns.description: Non-zero if the given seat is occupied.

remarks: Used by the vehicle rider scripts to find a free seat before assigning a rider.

api.name: IsVehicleSpawner
api.description: Checks whether this entity is a vehicle spawner.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: The entity that may be a vehicle spawner.

returns.description: True if the entity is a vehicle spawner.

remarks: Used with IsVehicle and IsSpawner to classify an entity before running spawner-specific setup.

api.name: IsVehicleTurretOverheating
api.description: Returns true if the vehicle turret weapon is overheating, else returns false.

calledOn.name: vehicle
calledOn.description: The vehicle whose turret is being checked.

parameters.name: gunnerIndex
parameters.description: which gun 0-3.

returns.description: True if that gunner's turret weapon is overheating.

api.name: IsVehicleUsable
api.description: Query whether this vehicle is usable by players.

api.name: IsWallRunning
api.description: Returns true if the player is wall running.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player to test.

returns.description: True if the player is currently wall running.

remarks: Frequently used with IsOnGround to block actions such as planting or using a trigger while a player is off the ground.

api.name: IsWallrunNode
api.description: returns true if the node has the PNF_WALLRUN flag set.

parameters.name: node
parameters.description: The pathnode to test.

returns.description: True if the node has the wallrun flag set.

remarks: Used by bot traversal code to detect wallrun traversals from the node a traversal ends on.

api.name: IsWeapon
api.description: Returns true if the given value is a weapon object.

parameters.name: weapon_object
parameters.description: The value that may be a weapon object.

returns.description: True if the value is a weapon object.

remarks: Used to guard access to weapon fields, and inside assert() to validate weapon parameters.
Weapon objects can also be used as array keys, so this is checked alongside IsString when inspecting keys.

api.name: IsWeaponOverheating
api.description: Gets whether this player weapon is overheating, or returns its heat value when requested.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player to query.

parameters.name: returnHeatValue
parameters.description: Whether to return the numeric heat value instead of a boolean overheating state.

parameters.name: weapon
parameters.description: An optional weapon override. When omitted, the player current weapon is used.

returns.name: result
returns.description: Either the overheating state or the heat value, depending on returnHeatValue.

remarks: When returnHeatValue is false or omitted, this returns a boolean overheating state.
When returnHeatValue is true, this returns the weapon heat value as a float.
For vehicle-controlled weapons, the native reads heat from the active vehicle weapon when applicable.

api.name: IsWeaponViewOnlyLinked
api.description: Returns whether or not this player is linked to an enity with weapon view only linking.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player to test.

returns.description: True if the player is view-only linked to an entity.

remarks: Grouped with IsRemoteControlling and IsInVehicle to detect players whose view is under script control.

api.name: IsWorldPaused
api.description: returns whether or not the world is currently paused.

returns.description: True if the world is currently paused.

api.name: IsZBarrier
api.description: Returns true if the entity called on is a zbarrier.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity to test.

returns.description: True if the entity is a zbarrier.

remarks: Used when walking a list of targets or junk entities to pick out the zbarriers among them.

api.name: IsZBarrierClosed
api.description: Returns true if the state of all of the zbarrier's pieces is 'closed'.

api.name: IsZBarrierOpen
api.description: Returns true if the state of all of the zbarrier's pieces is 'open'.

api.name: ItemWeaponSetAmmo
api.description: Set the weapon ammo to the given clip ammo and reserve ammo. Can give an alternate weapon index.

calledOn.name: item
calledOn.description: The weapon item or weapon script model to set ammo on.

parameters.name: clipAmmo
parameters.description: Ammo for the clip.

parameters.name: reserveAmmo
parameters.description: Reserve ammo.

parameters.name: altIndex
parameters.description: Alternate weapon index.

remarks: Called on a dropped weapon item or weapon script model to carry a player's remaining ammo onto the pickup.
The alternate index is passed as 1 to set the ammo of the weapon's alternate mode.

api.name: JoltBody
api.description: Jolts the vehicle.

calledOn.name: vehicle
calledOn.description: The vehicle to jolt.

parameters.name: joltPosition
parameters.description: The position of the jolt.

parameters.name: intensity
parameters.description: The intensity of the jolt.

parameters.name: speedFrac
parameters.description: A speed fraction to apply to the jolt. Most be betweeon 0 and 1.

parameters.name: deceleration
parameters.description: The deceleration to apply to this vehicle in miles per hour per second.

remarks: Seen in vehicle death handling, called with only the jolt position and intensity.

api.name: JumpButtonPressed
api.description: Check if the player is pressing the 'jump' button.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player whose input is being checked.

returns.description: True if the player is holding the jump button.

remarks: Usually polled in a loop alongside UseButtonPressed and SprintButtonPressed to let a player break out of a scripted state.

api.name: Kick
api.description: Kicks the specified player from the server.

parameters.name: clientNum
parameters.description: The client number of the player to kick.

parameters.name: reason
parameters.description: An optional reason displayed when kicking the player.

api.name: Kill
api.description: Kills this entity. If the entity could not be killed, errors. Automatically sets setCanDamage( true ).

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity to kill.

parameters.name: sourcePosition
parameters.description: The position that the damage comes from. Defaults to entity's origin.

parameters.name: attacker
parameters.description: The entity that dealt the damage (such as an AI or player).

parameters.name: inflictor
parameters.description: The entity that the damage came from (such as a grenade or turret).

parameters.name: weapon
parameters.description: weapon to do damage with.

remarks: Most call sites pass no arguments at all; the source position and attacker are supplied only when the kill needs to be credited or directed.

api.name: KillClientRadiantExploder
api.description: Deactivates a client side radiant exploder.

parameters.name: exploderId
parameters.description: The Radiant string name of the exploder to deactivate.

remarks: The exploder is identified by its Radiant string name, so call sites check IsString on the value first.

api.name: KillServer
api.description: kills the server.

api.name: Knockback
api.description: Turn knockback on and off for an actor.

parameters.name: true/false
parameters.description: if true, actor affected by knockback.

api.name: LaserOff
api.description: Turns off entity's laser sight.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The AI, turret or vehicle whose laser sight is turned off.

remarks: Pairs with LaserOn, and is used on turrets, sniper AI and vehicles when they stop tracking a target.

api.name: LaserOn
api.description: Turns on entity's laser sight.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The AI, turret or vehicle whose laser sight is turned on.

remarks: Pairs with LaserOff, and is used on turrets, sniper AI and vehicles when they begin tracking a target.

api.name: LastKnownPos
api.description: Returns the last known position of the given target, as tracked by this AI.

calledOn.name: sentient
calledOn.description: The AI whose knowledge of the target is queried.

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: The sentient whose last known position is wanted.

returns.description: The last position at which this AI knew the target to be.

remarks: Almost always called with self.enemy and fed straight into DistanceSquared, Distance2DSquared or VectorToAngles to decide how the AI should approach or face its enemy.

api.name: LastKnownTime
api.description: Returns the last time, in milliseconds, that this sentient was aware of the target. Awareness includes visibility as well as AI events such as footsteps and gunshots.

calledOn.name: sentient
calledOn.description: The sentient whose awareness is being queried.

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: The sentient to check awareness of.

returns.description: The game time, in milliseconds, at which the target was last known.

remarks: The result is compared against GetTime() to decide whether an AI has lost track of its enemy, using a give-up window of several seconds.
The target is normally checked with IsSentient() first, since only sentients are valid targets.

api.name: Launch
api.description: Launches an object so that it interacts with the world, using an initial velocity. From this point on the object no longer blocks missiles or bullets.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The object to launch.

parameters.name: initialVelocity
parameters.description: The initial velocity of the launch.

parameters.name: initialAngularVelocity
parameters.description: The initial angular velocity of the launch.

remarks: It is commonly used to scatter live grenades, for example when a player dies or a game object is reset.
Gravity is applied by the engine once the object is launched, so scripts that want a custom arc adjust the velocity themselves each toss.

api.name: LaunchBomb
api.description: Launches a bomb projectile of the given weapon from a position with an initial velocity, and returns the resulting projectile entity.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity that owns and launches the bomb.

parameters.name: weapon
parameters.description: The weapon to launch, as returned by GetWeapon().

parameters.name: origin
parameters.description: The world position to launch the bomb from.

parameters.name: velocity
parameters.description: The initial velocity of the bomb.

returns.description: The launched bomb entity.

remarks: It is used by air support killstreaks, with the launching plane or drone as the receiver so that the bomb is owned by that entity.
The returned entity is typically threaded off to watch for its own detonation or cleanup.

api.name: LaunchRagdoll
api.description: Turns this entity into a ragdoll and launches it with the given force.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity to turn into a launched ragdoll.

parameters.name: force
parameters.description: The force vector to launch the ragdoll with.

parameters.name: bonename
parameters.description: bone name to apply the force to.

remarks: The force is usually a normalized direction scaled by a magnitude, often with an upward component added so the body lifts off the ground.
It is commonly called on a corpse or an AI as part of death, gib, and knockback effects.

api.name: LaunchVehicle
api.description: Launch this physics vehicle.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The vehicle to launch.

parameters.name: force
parameters.description: The force of the launch.

parameters.name: targetPos
parameters.description: The target position.

parameters.name: immediate
parameters.description: Whether to launch immediately.

parameters.name: detach
parameters.description: Whether to detach the vehicle.

parameters.name: unknown
parameters.description: Unknown. *

api.name: Length
api.description: Returns the length of the given vector.

parameters.name: vector
parameters.description: The vector to measure.

returns.description: The length of the vector.

remarks: It is most often applied to the difference of two origins to get a distance, or to a velocity to get a speed.
Use LengthSquared() instead when the value is only compared against another distance, since it avoids the square root.

api.name: LengthSquared
api.description: Returns the squared length of the given vector, which is cheaper than the actual length because it avoids a square root.

parameters.name: vector
parameters.description: The vector to measure.

returns.description: The squared length of the vector.

remarks: Comparisons must square the other side too, for example LengthSquared( offset ) > radius * radius.
It is also used as a cheap non-zero test on direction and movement vectors before normalizing them.

api.name: LerpFloat
api.description: Returns a lerped value between <from> and <to> based on <time>.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Floating point value, start of the range.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Floating point value, end of the range.

parameters.name: time
parameters.description: Floating point value in the range of 0 - 1.

remarks: The fraction is normally computed as elapsed time divided by a total duration, so the call is repeated each frame while a value eases from one number to another.

api.name: LerpPosition
api.description: Interpolate an actor's position, and angles.

parameters.name: origin
parameters.description: (vector) the position to interpolate to.

parameters.name: angles
parameters.description: (vector) the angles to interpolate to.

api.name: LerpVector
api.description: Returns a lerped vector value between <from> and <to> based on <time>.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Vector, start of the range.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Vector, end of the range.

parameters.name: time
parameters.description: Floating point value in the range of 0 - 1.

returns.description: The vector interpolated between the two endpoints.

remarks: It is typically assigned to an origin each frame to slide an entity between two points, with the fraction derived from elapsed time or from a normalized distance.

api.name: LerpViewAngleClamp
api.description: Only works if the player is currently linked to another entity and angles aren't locked. Lerps the current view angle constraints to the provided ones over the specified time.

parameters.name: time
parameters.description: Lerp duration in seconds. A value of 0 means instantaneous.

parameters.name: accelTime
parameters.description: Acceleration time.

parameters.name: decelTime
parameters.description: Decelaration time.

parameters.name: rightArc
parameters.description: Angle to clamp view to the right.

parameters.name: leftArc
parameters.description: Angle to clamp view to the left.

parameters.name: topArc
parameters.description: Angle to clamp view to the top.

parameters.name: bottomArc
parameters.description: Angle to clamp view to the bottom.

api.example: player LerpViewAngleClamp( 0.2, 0.1, 0.1, rightArc, leftArc, topArc, bottomArc );
remarks: The corpus uses it while a player is linked for a scripted scene, easing the view limits in over a fraction of a second.
The four arc values default to 0 when the scene does not define them, which locks the view to straight ahead.

api.name: Line
api.description: Draws a debug line between two world positions for one server frame, or for the given duration.

parameters.name: args
parameters.description: The arguments.

remarks: Calls take the form Line( start, end, color, alpha, depthTest, duration ), where the color is an RGB vector with components in the 0 to 1 range and the duration is measured in server frames.
Every call site sits inside a devblock or a dev-only function, alongside Print3D() and Sphere().

api.name: LineList
api.description: Draws a list of debug lines.

parameters.name: param1
parameters.description: The first parameter.

parameters.name: param2
parameters.description: The second parameter.

parameters.name: param3
parameters.description: The third parameter.

parameters.name: param4
parameters.description: The fourth parameter.

parameters.name: param5
parameters.description: The fifth parameter.

api.name: LinkGuidedMissileCamera
api.description: set player eflags for the guided missile.

api.name: LinkNodes
api.description: Connects node1 to node2. Call it again with arguments flipped if you want a two-way connection.

parameters.name: node1
parameters.description: The node the connection starts from.

parameters.name: node2
parameters.description: The node the connection leads to.

remarks: The corpus links pairs of path nodes at runtime to open up navigation, for example after a blocker is removed or an elevator arrives.

api.name: LinkTo
api.description: Attaches this entity to another entity so that it follows that entity's movement.

calledOn.name: non_player_entity
calledOn.description: The entity to attach.

parameters.name: linktoEntity
parameters.description: The entity to attach this entity to.

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: The tag on the parent entity to attach to.

parameters.name: originOffset
parameters.description: The positional offset from the attach point.

parameters.name: anglesOffset
parameters.description: The angular offset from the attach point.

remarks: The tag and offsets are optional; called with just the parent entity, the linked entity keeps its current relative position.
WorldToLocalCoords() is used to compute the origin offset when linking an entity that is already positioned in the world.
Unlink() reverses the link.

api.name: LinkToBlendToTag
api.description: Attaches one entity to another, gradually lerping entity to the parents orientation.

parameters.name: linktoEntity
parameters.description: The entity to attach this thing to.

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: The tag to attach the entity to.

parameters.name: onlyYaw
parameters.description: Tells if blending only the yaw. Default to true.

parameters.name: collisionPhysics
parameters.description: Sets whether we should use collision physics. Defaults to false.

api.name: LinkToMissile
api.description: Links a player camera and controls to a missile.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player whose camera and controls are linked.

parameters.description: The missile entity to link the player to.

parameters.name: boost_enabled
parameters.description: : If true, the player can trigger missile boost.

parameters.name: brake_enabled
parameters.description: : If true, the player can trigger missile brake.

remarks: The remote missile killstreak links the player to the projectile right after spawning it, then unlinks during cleanup when the missile is destroyed.

api.name: LinkToUpdateOffset
api.description: Attaches one entity to another, gradually lerping entity to the parents orientation.

parameters.name: origin_offset
parameters.description: The origin offset.

parameters.name: angles_offset
parameters.description: The angles offset.

api.name: LinkTraversal
api.description: Creates a user edge connecting two path nodes.

parameters.name: node
parameters.description: Negotiation begin node.

remarks: It is called at runtime to enable a traversal once its geometry is in place, for example after a lift or a barrier moves.
The begin node is often the entity running the script, so the call reads LinkTraversal( self ).

api.name: LoadSentientEventParameters
api.description: Loads the global sentient event parameters for a given scriptbundle sentient events asset. (all AI will use these).

parameters.name: scriptBundle
parameters.description: String name of the script bundle to load.

remarks: The corpus calls it once during stealth setup, so the parameters apply globally to all AI.

api.name: LocalToWorldCoords
api.description: Transforms a point expressed in this entity's local space into world space.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity whose origin and angles define the local space.

parameters.name: localCoordinate
parameters.description: The point in the entity's local coordinates.

returns.description: The equivalent point in world coordinates.

remarks: Animation code uses it to turn an animation's local movement delta into the world position the entity will end up at.
WorldToLocalCoords() performs the inverse transform.

api.name: Log
api.description: Returns the logarithm of a number to base 10.

api.name: LogPrint
api.description: Prints a message to the server log.

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: The message to write to the server log.

api.name: LookAtEntity
api.description: Set this actor to look at the specified entity. Call this function without any entity specified to turn it off.

calledOn.name: actor
calledOn.description: The actor.

parameters.name: otherEntity
parameters.description: The other entity to look at. Skip this parameter to stop looking.

api.name: LookAtPos
api.description: Set this actor to look at the specified position. Call this function without any position specified to turn it off.

parameters.name: pos
parameters.description: the position to look at.

remarks: Scripts call it with a position to start the look and then call it again with no argument to release the actor's head.

api.name: LUINotifyEvent
api.description: Sends a notify from script to LUI.

calledOn.name: target
calledOn.description: When specified, the notify will only be sent to this player.

parameters.name: luiEventName
parameters.description: The LUI event name as an istring.

parameters.name: numOfArgs
parameters.description: The number of parameters to send in the event. This defaults to zero.

parameters.name: args
parameters.description: Exactly the number of previously specified arguments in the form of either istrings or integers.

api.name: LUINotifyEventToSpectators
api.description: Sends a notify from script to LUI for this player and for anyone spectating them.

calledOn.name: target
calledOn.description: The player the event is sent for.

parameters.name: luiEventName
parameters.description: The LUI event name, given as a localized string reference.

parameters.name: numOfArgs
parameters.description: The number of arguments that follow.

parameters.name: args
parameters.description: The event arguments.

remarks: The count passed as numOfArgs must match the number of trailing arguments; zero is used for events that carry no data.
It is used for player feedback that spectators should also see, such as score events, medals, killstreaks, and rank ups.

api.name: MagicBullet
api.description: Fires a bullet of the given weapon from a source position toward a destination position, without a firing weapon or animation.

parameters.name: weapon
parameters.description: Weapon type of the bullet.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: Where the bullet will be spawned.

parameters.name: destination
parameters.description: Where the bullet will be fired at.

parameters.name: attacker
parameters.description: Set the owner of the bullet to this.

parameters.name: targetent
parameters.description: The target of the bullet.

parameters.name: targetOffset
parameters.description: Offset the target by this vector.

returns.description: The projectile entity that was fired.

remarks: It is widely used for scripted gunfire and rockets in scenes, where the source and destination come from struct origins or from GetTagOrigin() on the shooter.
The optional attacker decides who gets credit for any damage, and the return value lets the script track the projectile it spawned.

api.name: MagicGrenade
api.description: Creates a "Magic" grenade from an actor.

parameters.name: origin
parameters.description: The starting point of the grenade toss.

parameters.name: targetPosition
parameters.description: The target point of the grenade toss.

parameters.name: timeToBlow
parameters.description: The grenade fuse time in seconds.

parameters.name: weapon
parameters.description: The grenade weapon to use (defaults to equipped grenade weapon).

api.name: MagicGrenadeManual
api.description: creates a "Magic" grenade from an actor.

parameters.name: origin
parameters.description: The starting point of the grenade toss.

parameters.name: velocity
parameters.description: The initial velocity vector for the grenade movement.

parameters.name: timeToBlow
parameters.description: The grenade fuse time in seconds.

api.name: MagicGrenadeManualPlayer
api.description: creates a "Magic" grenade from a player.

parameters.name: origin
parameters.description: The starting point of the grenade toss.

parameters.name: velocity
parameters.description: The initial velocity vector for the grenade movement.

parameters.name: weapon
parameters.description: The grenade weapon to base on.

parameters.name: timeToBlow
parameters.description: The grenade fuse time in seconds.

api.example: grenade = player MagicGrenadeManualPlayer( v_origin, (0, 0, 0), GetWeapon( "frag_grenade_web" ), weapon.fuseTime / 1000 );
remarks: The observed calls pass a zero velocity so the grenade simply drops at the given origin, and derive the fuse time from the weapon's fuseTime in milliseconds.

api.name: MagicGrenadePlayer
api.description: Creates a "Magic" grenade from a player.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player credited with throwing the grenade.

parameters.name: weapon
parameters.description: The grenade weapon to use.

parameters.name: origin
parameters.description: The starting point of the grenade toss.

parameters.name: velocity
parameters.description: The initial velocity vector for the grenade movement.

returns.description: The spawned grenade entity.

api.example: grenade = player MagicGrenadePlayer( weapon, origin, velocity );
remarks: The receiver is the player who gets credit for the grenade, which can differ from the entity that supplies the throw origin, as when an AI throws a grenade attributed to its enemy.

api.name: MagicGrenadeType
api.description: Spawns a grenade of the given weapon at a source location with the given velocity, owned by the calling entity.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity throwing the grenade.

parameters.name: weaponName
parameters.description: The name of the weapon.

parameters.name: sourceLoc
parameters.description: The world position the grenade starts at.

parameters.name: velocity
parameters.description: The initial velocity of the grenade.

parameters.name: timeToBlow
parameters.description: The grenade fuse time in seconds.

returns.description: The spawned grenade entity.

remarks: A zero velocity together with a small or zero fuse time is the usual pattern for detonating something in place, while a scaled forward vector is used for a real toss.
Unlike the entry's signature suggests, every observed call is made on an owner entity, and the weapon is a weapon object from GetWeapon() rather than a name string.

api.name: MagicMissile
api.description: Launches a projectile of the given weapon from a position with the given velocity, which determines both direction and speed.

calledOn.name: attacker
calledOn.description: The entity credited as the attacker.

parameters.name: weapon
parameters.description: - Weapon name.

parameters.name: position
parameters.description: - Position to launch from.

parameters.name: velocity
parameters.description: - Direction and force of launch.

parameters.name: targetent
parameters.description: The entity for the missile to home in on.

returns.description: The launched projectile entity.

api.example: self.projectile = passer MagicMissile( level.passingBallWeapon, self.visuals[0].origin, pass_vel );
remarks: The receiver becomes the attacker credited for the projectile, and the returned entity is stored so the script can track or clean it up.
The optional target entity makes the missile home in on that entity.

api.name: MakeFakeAI
api.description: Create a drone from script model, that can be moved around with simple commands.
remarks: It is called on a spawned script model so that scene and scripted code can drive it with AI style commands.

api.name: MakeGrenadeDud
api.description: Turns a grenade into a dud.

calledOn.name: grenade
calledOn.description: The grenade projectile to defuse.

remarks: The corpus calls it on a live grenade projectile to stop it from exploding, for example when the grenade lands in a disallowed area or its owner is no longer valid.

api.name: MakeLocalizedString
api.description: Make a localized string of the given string.

parameters.name: string
parameters.description: The string to translate.

returns.description: The localized text as a plain string.

remarks: It converts a localized string reference into a plain string so it can be concatenated, printed with IPrintLn(), or built into a devgui path.

api.name: MakePathfinder
api.description: Register a vehicle with Havok so it can do pathfinding and position query.

api.name: MakeSentient
api.description: Turn a vehicle or script mover into a sentient.
remarks: It is applied to vehicles, drones and decoy models so that AI treat them as targets and so that sentient queries such as IsSentient() succeed on them.

api.name: MakeTurretUnusable
api.description: Sets a turret to be unable to be used.

api.name: MakeTurretUsable
api.description: Sets a turret able to be used.

api.name: MakeUnusable
api.description: Sets this entity to be not usable by the player.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity to make unusable.

remarks: It pairs with MakeUsable(), and is typically called while an object is being carried, is already claimed, or is mid animation so that no further use prompt appears.

api.name: MakeUsable
api.description: Sets this entity to be usable by the player.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity to make usable.

parameters.name: team
parameters.description: The team that is allowed to use the object. Only for script movers.

remarks: It pairs with MakeUnusable(), and scripts toggle between the two as an object becomes available or is claimed.
The team argument is only passed for team restricted objects such as supply drop crates.

api.name: MakeVehicleUnusable
api.description: Sets this vehicle to be not usable by the player.

calledOn.name: vehicle
calledOn.description: The vehicle to make unusable.

remarks: It pairs with MakeVehicleUsable(), and killstreak vehicles call it right after spawning so players cannot mount them.

api.name: MakeVehicleUsable
api.description: Sets this vehicle to be usable by the player.

calledOn.name: vehicle
calledOn.description: The vehicle to make usable.

remarks: It pairs with MakeVehicleUnusable(), and scripts toggle between the two as a vehicle becomes available to ride or is taken over.

api.name: Map
api.description: Loads a new map.

parameters.name: mapName
parameters.description: The map to load.

parameters.name: savePersistent
parameters.description: if true then player info is retained.

api.name: Map_Restart
api.description: Restarts the map.

parameters.name: savePersistent
parameters.description: if true then player info is retained.

remarks: Game type logic calls it with true at the end of a round so player data survives the restart, while dev and skip-to code calls it with no argument.

api.name: MapExists
api.description: Returns true if the map with the given name exists on the server.

parameters.name: mapName
parameters.description: The map to check.

api.name: MapFloat
api.description: Returns a lerped value between <from> and <to> based on <time>. <time> is a value between <timeMin> and <timeMax>.

parameters.name: timeMin
parameters.description: Floating point value, min time value.

parameters.name: timeMax
parameters.description: Floating point value, max time value.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Floating point value, start of the result range.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Floating point value, end of the result range.

parameters.name: time
parameters.description: Floating point value in the range from <timeMin> to <timeMax>.

remarks: It is the standard way to convert a distance or other measured quantity into a score or scale factor.
Passing a from value greater than the to value inverts the mapping, which scripts use to fall off with distance.

api.name: MarkDestructibleDestroyed
api.description: set destructible destroyed.

calledOn.name: destructible
calledOn.description: The destructible entity to mark as destroyed.

remarks: It is only used by the destructible scripts, which call it on the destructible entity when its final piece is destroyed.

api.name: MarkNoVehicleNavMeshFaces
api.description: Update the novehicle flag on navmesh faces. This should only be used in MP map for now.

parameters.name: args
parameters.description: The center position, radius and height of the region to mark.

remarks: The corpus calls it with a center position, a radius and a height, to block a region of the navmesh off from vehicles.

api.name: MatchRecorderIncrementHeaderStat
api.description: Increments a header stat in the match recorder.

parameters.name: statName
parameters.description: The stat name.

parameters.name: amount
parameters.description: The amount to increment.

remarks: Used at game end for match summary values such as "winningTeam" and "checkpointRestoreCount".

api.name: MatchRecordGetWeaponIndex
api.description: Gets the weapon index of the given weapon for match data recording.

parameters.name: weapon
parameters.description: The weapon.

returns.name: weaponIdx
returns.description: The weapon index.

api.name: MatchRecordIncrementCheckpointStat
api.description: Increments a checkpoint stat in the match record for the player.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player.

parameters.name: checkpointIndex
parameters.description: The checkpoint index.

parameters.name: statName
parameters.description: The stat name to increment.

remarks: Campaign scripts pass the current skipto objective index as the checkpoint index and a named counter such as "destructibles_destroyed".

api.name: MatchRecordLogAdditionalDeathInfo
api.description: Logs additional death information to the match record.

parameters.name: attacker
parameters.description: The attacking entity.

parameters.name: victim
parameters.description: The victim entity.

parameters.name: weapon
parameters.description: The weapon used.

parameters.name: meansOfDeath
parameters.description: The means of death.

parameters.name: damage
parameters.description: The damage amount.

parameters.name: isHeadshot
parameters.description: Whether the kill was a headshot.

parameters.name: isLongshot
parameters.description: Whether the kill was a longshot.

parameters.name: hitLocation
parameters.description: The hit location index.

parameters.name: isRevenge
parameters.description: Whether the kill was a revenge.

parameters.name: isBackstab
parameters.description: Whether the kill was a backstab.

parameters.name: isMelee
parameters.description: Whether the kill was melee.

parameters.name: isWallbang
parameters.description: Whether the kill was a wallbang.

parameters.name: isHipfire
parameters.description: Whether the kill was from hipfire.

parameters.name: isADS
parameters.description: Whether the kill was from ADS.

parameters.name: extra1
parameters.description: Additional parameter.

parameters.name: extra2
parameters.description: Additional parameter.

parameters.name: extra3
parameters.description: Additional parameter.

api.example: MatchRecordLogAdditionalDeathInfo( attacker, victim, weapon, mod, 100, true, false, 0, false, false, false, false, false, false );
remarks: Multiplayer calls it once per death from the global logic player death handler, for values the engine's own match record death entry does not already carry.

api.name: MatchRecordLogChallengeComplete
api.description: Logs a challenge completion to the match record.

parameters.name: args
parameters.description: The player, challenge table number, challenge tier, item index and challenge name.

api.example: MatchRecordLogChallengeComplete( player, tableNumber, challengeTier, itemIndex, challengeString );
remarks: Called from shared persistence when a challenge tier is completed, with the player followed by the challenge table number, tier, item index and challenge name.

api.name: MatchRecordLogCybercoreEvent
api.description: Logs a cybercore event to the match record for the player.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player.

parameters.name: cybercoreId
parameters.description: The cybercore identifier.

parameters.name: position
parameters.description: The world position of the event.

parameters.name: param1
parameters.description: The first event parameter.

parameters.name: param2
parameters.description: The second event parameter.

remarks: The one campaign call site passes the cybercore weapon, the player's origin, the current time and a zero.

api.name: MatchRecordLogSpecialMoveDataForLife
api.description: Logs special movement data for the current life in the match record.

parameters.name: player
parameters.description: The player entity.

parameters.name: wallRunCount
parameters.description: Number of wall runs.

parameters.name: slideCount
parameters.description: Number of slides.

parameters.name: doubleJumpCount
parameters.description: Number of double jumps.

parameters.name: thrustJumpCount
parameters.description: Number of thrust jumps.

parameters.name: swimCount
parameters.description: Number of swims.

parameters.name: sprintCount
parameters.description: Number of sprints.

parameters.name: mantleCount
parameters.description: Number of mantles.

parameters.name: groundPoundCount
parameters.description: Number of ground pounds.

parameters.name: extra1
parameters.description: Additional movement counter.

parameters.name: extra2
parameters.description: Additional movement counter.

parameters.name: extra3
parameters.description: Additional movement counter.

parameters.name: extra4

parameters.description: Additional movement counter.

api.example: MatchRecordLogSpecialMoveDataForLife( player, wallRuns, slides, doubleJumps, thrustJumps, swims, sprints, mantles, groundPounds );
remarks: Multiplayer calls it once per death from record_special_move_data_for_life, optionally appending the killer and the killer's movement data after the victim's.

api.name: MatchRecordNewPlayer
api.description: Records that a new player has joined a match.

parameters.name: player
parameters.description: The player that joined the match.

returns.name: clientId
returns.description: The client ID of the player that should be used for tracking.

api.name: MatchRecordOvertimeRound

api.name: MatchRecordPlayerSpawned
api.description: Records that the player has spawned in the match record.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player.

remarks: Co-op calls it on the player as part of the spawn logic, alongside the checkpoint stat calls.

api.name: MatchRecordRoundEnd
api.description: Records the end of a round in the match record.
remarks: Pairs with MatchRecordRoundStart, called from the multiplayer global logic round handling.

api.name: MatchRecordRoundStart
api.description: Records the start of a round in the match record, so that round time stamps are captured.
remarks: Pairs with MatchRecordRoundEnd, called from the multiplayer global logic round handling.

api.name: MatchRecordSetCheckpointStat
api.description: Sets a checkpoint stat value in the match record for the player.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player.

parameters.name: checkpointIndex
parameters.description: The checkpoint index.

parameters.name: statName
parameters.description: The stat name to set.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: The value to set.

remarks: Campaign scripts pass the current skipto objective index as the checkpoint index, with names such as "start_difficulty", "end_difficulty" and "checkpoint_restores".
Use MatchRecordIncrementCheckpointStat instead to bump an existing counter.

api.name: MatchRecordSetCurrentLevelComplete
api.description: Marks the current level as complete in the match record.
remarks: Campaign calls it when a level finishes, immediately before MatchRecordSetLevelDifficultyForIndex.

api.name: MatchRecordSetLevelDifficultyForIndex
api.description: Sets the level difficulty for the given index in the match record.

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: The index.

parameters.name: difficulty
parameters.description: The difficulty value.

remarks: Campaign scripts record level.gameskill at several fixed indices, including the level start, the level end and the minimum and maximum difficulty reached.

api.name: Max
