parameters.name: a
parameters.description: A float or integer value.

parameters.name: b
parameters.description: A float or integer value.

remarks: Commonly used to clamp a value to a lower bound, and wrapped in Int() when an integer result is needed.

api.name: MayMoveFromPointToPoint
api.description: Check whether the actor can move from a given point to a given point. Does not check friendly fire and in goal radius unlike maymovetopoint.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: (point) start position.

parameters.name: end
parameters.description: (point) end position.

parameters.name: checkDrop
parameters.description: checks if the point would cause the AI to drop. Defaults to true.

parameters.name: checkDirect
parameters.description: checks if there are no obstructions between actor origin and <Position>.

api.example: if ( self MayMoveFromPointToPoint( midPoint, endPoint, true, true ) )
remarks: Animation selection and locomotion code uses it to validate the segments of a planned move before committing to an animation.
The two optional flags are frequently passed explicitly, and both are often false when only reachability matters.

api.name: MayMoveToPoint
api.description: Check whether the actor can move to a given point.

parameters.name: position
parameters.description: (point) The position that the actor may be able to move to.

parameters.name: checkDrop
parameters.description: checks if the point would cause the AI to drop. Defaults to true.

parameters.name: checkDirect
parameters.description: checks if there are no obstructions between actor origin and <Position>.

parameters.name: checkDrop
parameters.description: Whether to check for drops.

api.example: if ( self MayMoveToPoint( endPoint, false, false ) )
remarks: Often paired with FindPath to confirm that a candidate goal position is both reachable and clear.
Use MayMoveFromPointToPoint when the start of the move is not the actor's current origin.

api.name: MaySpawnEntity

returns.name: canSpawn

api.name: MaySpawnFakeEntity

returns.name: canSpawn

api.name: Melee

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: direction to attack, if not specified, uses direction to current enemy.

remarks: Called from behavior and animation scripts at the melee impact point of an attack animation, usually with no direction argument so the actor's current enemy is used.

api.name: MeleeButtonPressed
api.description: Check if the player is pressing the melee button.
remarks: Often combined with UseButtonPressed, AttackButtonPressed and FragButtonPressed to reject a use action while another input is held.

api.name: MeleePowerTime
api.description: Gets the melee power time of the current weapon.

returns.name: time
returns.description: The melee power time in seconds.

api.name: MeleeWithOffset
api.description: Makes this actor melee attack. Returns the entity hit, if any.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: A vector offset added to the actor's eye position from which to start the melee trace.

api.name: Min
api.description: Returns whichever of <a> or <b> is smallest.

parameters.name: a
parameters.description: A float or integer value.

parameters.name: b
parameters.description: A float or integer value.

remarks: Commonly used to clamp a value to an upper bound, and wrapped in Int() when an integer result is needed.

api.name: Missile_CreateAttractorEnt

parameters.name: strength

parameters.description: If set it will affect all projectiles inculding grenades and guided missiles.

parameters.name: alertRange
parameters.description: If set it send notify when missile breaches range(but will not repulse).

api.name: Missile_CreateAttractorOrigin

parameters.description: The strength of the attractor (maximum acceleration it can apply to a missile).

parameters.name: affectDist
parameters.description: The effective distance at which the missile can be affected.  The effect of the attractor falls off from <strength> to zero from the center to this distance away from the center.

parameters.name: affectAllProjectiles
parameters.description: If set it will affect all projectiles inculding grenades and guided missiles.

parameters.name: alertRange
parameters.description: If set it send notify when missile breaches range(but will not repulse).

parameters.name: affectDist
parameters.description: The effective distance at which the missile can be affected.  The effect of the attractor falls off from <strength> to zero from the center to this distance away from the center.

parameters.description: If set it will affect all projectiles inculding grenades and guided missiles.

parameters.name: alertRange
parameters.description: If set it send notify when missile breaches range(but will not repulse).

parameters.description: The strength of the Repulsor (maximum acceleration it can apply to a missile).

parameters.name: affectDist
parameters.description: The effective distance at which the missile can be affected.  The effect of the attractor falls off from <strength> to zero from the center to this distance away from the center.

parameters.name: affectAllProjectiles
parameters.description: If set it will affect all projectiles inculding grenades and guided missiles.

parameters.name: alertRange
parameters.description: If set it send notify when missile breaches range(but will not repulse).

api.name: Missile_DeleteAttractor
api.description: Deletes a missile attractor or repulsor.

parameters.name: attractor

api.name: Missile_DroneSetVisible

remarks: Pairs with Missile_SetTarget, and the result is normally guarded with IsDefined because an untargeted missile returns undefined.

api.name: Missile_Settarget
api.description: Sets the target of the missile to the given entity, and resets if no entity is specified.

parameters.name: targetOffset
parameters.description: Offset to the target location (vector3).

Read the current target back with Missile_GetTarget.

api.name: MissionFailed

remarks: Zombies game logic calls it when the game is over and the map should be restarted.

api.name: MissionHasCollectibles

parameters.name: currentmap
parameters.description: the name of the current map.  If ommitted, use Dvar sv_mapname.

remarks: Campaign collectible code passes GetRootMapName() and returns early when the mission has none.

api.name: MissionRestart

api.name: MoveTo

api.name: NavPointSightFilter
api.description: Given an array of navmesh points, filters the array based on navmesh visibility to an origin.

parameters.name: points
parameters.description: Array of navmesh points.

parameters.name: origin
parameters.description: Origin to check visibility from.

parameters.name: checksight
parameters.description: True to check sight, false otherwise.

returns.description: The subset of the input points that passed the filter.

remarks: Bot logic calls this to narrow a set of candidate navmesh points down to the ones reachable in sight of a chosen origin, usually assigning the result back over the original array.

api.name: NearClaimNode
api.description: Determine whether this actor is near its claim node.

calledOn.name: actor
calledOn.description: The actor whose claim node proximity is tested.

remarks: Used as a behavior tree service or condition on the behavior tree entity, so the actor is normally the AI currently being evaluated.

api.name: NearClaimNodeAndAngle
api.description: Determine whether this actor is near its claim node and nearly matches the angle.

api.name: NearNode
api.description: Determine whether this actor is near to a given path node.

calledOn.name: actor
calledOn.description: The actor whose proximity to the node is tested.

parameters.name: node
parameters.description: The path node to check.

remarks: Zombie logic combines this with an explicit comparison against self.coverNode, since a node the actor already owns is not always reported as near.

api.name: NeedsRevive
api.description: Used for mini maps to display compass icon.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The player whose revive state is set.

parameters.name: bool
parameters.description: Whether the player needs to be revived.

remarks: The global player logic clears this flag with false when the player is killed, in every game mode.

api.name: NewClientHudElem
api.description: Create a new hud element for a particular client.

parameters.name: client
parameters.description: The client for whom the hud element is created.

remarks: The returned element is normally stored on the owning player or on level, then configured by assigning fields such as x, y, alignX, horzAlign, fontScale, color and alpha.

api.name: NewDamageIndicatorHudElem
api.description: Creates a new damage indicator hud element for a particular client.

parameters.name: client
parameters.description: The client for whom the hud element is created.

remarks: Damage feedback scripts create one of these per player on connect and drive it with SetShader plus alpha changes.
Multiplayer skips it because that mode draws damage feedback in LUI instead.

api.name: NewDebugHudElem
api.description: Creates a new debug hud element.
remarks: Only appears inside developer blocks and devgui or debug scripts, and the returned element is configured with the same fields as one from NewHudElem.

api.name: NewHudElem
api.description: Create a new hud element.
remarks: Creates an element visible to everyone, so scripts store it on level; use NewClientHudElem or NewTeamHudElem to limit it to one player or one team.

api.name: NewScoreHudElem
api.description: Create a new score hud element for a particular client.

parameters.name: client
parameters.description: The client for whom the hud element is created.

remarks: Rank scripts create it once per player, guarded by an IsDefined check, and then set its alignment and position fields.

api.name: NewTeamHudElem
api.description: Create a new hud element for a particular team.

parameters.name: team
parameters.description: The team for whom the hud element is created. Must be 'axis', 'allies' or 'spectator'.

remarks: Shared hud, head icon and objective point helpers pass the team through from their caller, so the element is only drawn for players on that team.

api.name: NextPlayerRenderOption
api.description: Advances or reverses a player render option for the current held weapon configuration.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player whose render option should be changed.

parameters.name: optionName
parameters.description: The render option category to cycle.

parameters.name: forward
parameters.description: Whether to cycle forward instead of backward.

remarks: Observed optionName values include camo, meleecamo, reticle, and emblem.
The function also handles at least one additional string-based option in native code, but its exact script name is still unconfirmed.
For camo, meleecamo, and reticle, the function skips invalid render-option values until it finds a valid one.

api.name: NodesAreLinked
api.description: Returns true if node1 is connected to node2.

parameters.name: node1
parameters.description: first node.

parameters.name: node2
parameters.description: second node.

remarks: Links are treated as directional by callers, which test both NodesAreLinked( a, b ) and NodesAreLinked( b, a ) before linking or unlinking a pair.

api.name: NodesVisible
api.description: Returns true if these nodes are visible to one another, false otherwise.

parameters.name: node1
parameters.description: pathnode to check.

parameters.name: node2
parameters.description: pathnode to check against node1.

api.name: NotSolid
api.description: Unsets the solid flag, so that this object is no longer collidable.
remarks: Applied to spawned models, dropped pickups and effect entities so that players and AI can move through them.
Solid() restores collision.

api.name: NumRemoteClients
api.description: Returns the number of remote clients connected to the game.  Very useful for scaling content for coop play, and network balancing.

returns.description: The number of remote clients connected.

remarks: Shared utility code tests it as a boolean to detect whether the session has any remote players at all.

api.name: Obituary
api.description: Create an obituary for a character.

parameters.name: victim
parameters.description: The victim entity.

parameters.name: attacker
parameters.description: The attacker entity, which is the victim itself for a self inflicted death.

parameters.name: weapon
parameters.description: The weapon name.

parameters.name: weapon
parameters.description: The means of death as a string.

remarks: Called from the global player logic on death, passing the victim as attacker when the death was self inflicted.

api.name: Objective_Add
api.description: Adds or resets an objective entry with optional position, tracked entity, name, and owner data.

parameters.name: objectiveIndex
parameters.description: The objective index from 0 to 127.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: The objective state name.

parameters.name: positionOrEntity
parameters.description: An optional world position vector or tracked entity.

parameters.name: displayName
parameters.description: An optional localized objective display name.

parameters.name: owner
parameters.description: An optional owner entity.

remarks: Valid state values include empty, active, invisible, done, current, and failed.
When positionOrEntity is a vector, the objective uses a world position; when it is an entity, the objective tracks that entity.

api.name: Objective_ClearAllUsing
api.description: Clears the objective of all players using status.

parameters.name: objective_number
parameters.description: The ID of the objective to alter.

api.name: Objective_ClearEntity
api.description: Clears the entity previous set on the objective.

parameters.name: objective_number
parameters.description: The ID of the objective to alter.

remarks: Undoes an earlier Objective_OnEntity so the objective stops tracking that entity, typically when a carried object is dropped or returned.

api.name: Objective_ClearPlayerUsing
api.description: Sets the objective to be not being used by the specified player.

parameters.name: objective_number
parameters.description: The ID of the objective to alter.

parameters.name: player
parameters.description: The player who is no longer using the objective.

remarks: Paired with Objective_SetPlayerUsing, and called when the player stops capturing or carrying the object.

api.name: Objective_Delete
api.description: Deletes the objective.

parameters.name: objective_number
parameters.description: The ID of the objective to alter.

remarks: Scripts keep the objective ID on an entity or in a level array and delete it when the owning object, icon or killstreak goes away.

api.name: Objective_GetGamemodeFlags
api.description: Gets the gamemode flags for the objective.

parameters.name: objective_index
parameters.description: The ID of the objective.

returns.description: The gamemode flags currently set on the objective.

remarks: Pairs with Objective_SetGamemodeFlags, and shared game object code just returns the value straight through to its caller.

api.name: Objective_Icon
api.description: Set the objective icon.

parameters.name: objective_number
parameters.description: The ID of the objective to alter.

parameters.name: icon
parameters.description: The icon name.

remarks: The icon is a material name such as "waypoint_dogtags" or "compass_waypoint_defend", sometimes built by appending a per team suffix.
Usually called next to Objective_Position, Objective_SetColor and Objective_State when setting an objective up.

api.name: Objective_OnEntity
api.description: Sets the objective to get its position from an entity.

parameters.name: objective_number
parameters.description: The ID of the objective to alter.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: The entity to set the objective to.

remarks: Used so the marker follows a moving carrier, visual model or anchor entity instead of a fixed point set by Objective_Position.
Objective_ClearEntity releases the entity again.

api.name: Objective_Position
api.description: Set the objective position.

parameters.name: objective_number
parameters.description: The ID of the objective to alter.

parameters.name: position
parameters.description: The position to set.

remarks: Called repeatedly to move a marker, and superseded by Objective_OnEntity when the objective should follow an entity.

api.name: Objective_Set3D
api.description: Sets flag determining if 3D state for an objective is drawn.

parameters.name: objective_number
parameters.description: The ID of the objective to alter.

parameters.name: use3D
parameters.description: true if should render in hud.

parameters.name: unused
parameters.description: not used.

parameters.name: unused
parameters.description: not used.

parameters.name: unused
parameters.description: not used.

parameters.name: unused
parameters.description: not used.

api.example: Objective_Set3D( myObjNum, true, undefined, undefined, undefined, (0,0,70) )

api.name: Objective_SetColor
api.description: Sets a color for the objective that the icon will then be drawn with.

parameters.name: objective_index
parameters.description: The ID of the objective.

parameters.name: r/colorName
parameters.description: Red float value for objective, or color name set from the UIEditor as an IString.

parameters.name: g
parameters.description: Green float value for objective.

parameters.name: b
parameters.description: Blue float value for objective.

parameters.name: a
parameters.description: Alpha float value for objective. Default of 1.0 if not specified.

remarks: The named form is by far the most common, with localized string names such as &"FriendlyBlue" and &"EnemyOrange".
The component form is used when a script has a color vector to hand, passing the three elements plus an alpha.

api.name: Objective_SetFlag
api.description: Sets the gamemode flags for the objective.

parameters.name: objective_index
parameters.description: The ID of the objective to alter.

parameters.name: flag
parameters.description: - active, fadeoutonscreen, perk, drawdistance, drawname, in3d, clipToMap, primary.

parameters.name: true/false
parameters.description: turn the flag on or off.

api.name: Objective_SetGamemodeFlags
api.description: Sets the gamemode flags for the objective.  This function only works for modes not using 3d objectives (mp).

parameters.name: objective_index
parameters.description: The ID of the objective.

parameters.name: flags
parameters.description: script managed flags.

remarks: Objective_GetGamemodeFlags reads back the value set here.

api.name: Objective_SetInvisibleToAll
api.description: Sets the objective to be invisible to all players.

parameters.name: objective_number
parameters.description: The ID of the objective to alter.

remarks: Commonly called first to hide an objective from everyone, then followed by Objective_SetVisibleToPlayer for each player who should see it.

api.name: Objective_SetInvisibleToPlayer
api.description: Sets the objective to be invisible to the specified player.

parameters.name: objective_number
parameters.description: The ID of the objective to alter.

parameters.name: player
parameters.description: The player to whom the objective is now invisible.

remarks: Used to hide an objective per player, for example once that player has collected the item or is the owner of an enemy marker.

api.name: Objective_SetInvisibleToPlayerByIndex
api.description: Sets the objective to be invisible to the specified player.

parameters.name: objective_number
parameters.description: The ID of the objective to alter.

parameters.name: entnum
parameters.description: The entity number of the player to whom the objective is now invisible.

remarks: Takes a player index rather than a player entity, so it is used when looping over player slots instead of over player entities.

api.name: Objective_SetPlayerUsing
api.description: Sets the objective to being used by the specified player.

parameters.name: objective_number
parameters.description: The ID of the objective to alter.

parameters.name: player
parameters.description: The player who is using the objective.

remarks: Called when a player picks up or starts capturing the object, and cleared again with Objective_ClearPlayerUsing.

api.name: Objective_SetProgress
api.description: Sets the progress for the objective.

parameters.name: objective_index
parameters.description: The ID of the objective.

parameters.name: percent
parameters.description: percent float value for objective [0-1].

remarks: Callers clamp the value into the zero to one range, or derive it by dividing a percentage by 100.
Escort passes a small negative value to indicate progress running backwards.

api.name: Objective_SetSize
api.description: Sets a size for the objective that the icon will then be drawn at. Min is MIN_OBJECTIVE_ICON_SIZE = 5.

parameters.name: objective_index
parameters.description: The ID of the objective.

parameters.name: entity/float
parameters.description: The entity to get the size from or a sizeX.

parameters.name: float
parameters.description: If sizeX was used in prvious arg, this is sizeY.

api.name: Objective_SetUIModelValue
api.description: Set a UI Model Value for an objective.

parameters.name: objective_number
parameters.description: The ID of the objective to alter.

parameters.name: luiMenuDataName
parameters.description: precached name string for the data which we're trying to set.

parameters.name: luiMenuDataValue
parameters.description: value for the data which we're trying to set on the objective.

remarks: The single call site wraps it in a campaign objectives helper that forwards a data name and value supplied by the caller.

api.name: Objective_SetVisibleToAll
api.description: Sets the objective to be visible to all players.

parameters.name: objective_number
parameters.description: The ID of the objective to alter.

remarks: Resets any per player visibility applied through Objective_SetInvisibleToAll or Objective_SetInvisibleToPlayer.

api.name: Objective_SetVisibleToPlayer
api.description: Sets the objective to be visible to the specified player.

parameters.name: objective_number
parameters.description: The ID of the objective to alter.

parameters.name: player
parameters.description: The player to whom the objective is now visible.

remarks: Typically preceded by Objective_SetInvisibleToAll so that only the chosen players, such as an owner or an attacker, see the marker.

api.name: Objective_SetVisibleToPlayerByIndex
api.description: Sets the objective to be visible to the specified player.

parameters.name: objective_number
parameters.description: The ID of the objective to alter.

parameters.name: entnum
parameters.description: The entity number of the player to whom the objective is now visible.

remarks: Takes a player index rather than a player entity, so it is used when looping over player slots instead of over player entities.

api.name: Objective_State
api.description: Set a state for the objective.

parameters.name: objective_number
parameters.description: The ID of the objective to alter.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: The state to set.

remarks: Observed states are "active", "done" and "invisible", with "active" set when the objective appears and "done" when it is finished or removed.

api.name: Objective_Team
api.description: Sets the team that the objective is for. Allows having different objectives for each team.

parameters.name: objective_number
parameters.description: The ID of the objective to alter.

parameters.name: team
parameters.description: The team that the objective is for. Valid entries are 'allies', 'axis', 'team3', or 'none'.

remarks: The team is usually a team name held in a variable, such as self.team or game["attackers"], rather than a literal.
Typically called right after the objective is created, alongside the other Objective_ setters that configure it.

api.name: Objective_VisibleTeams
api.description: Sets which teams the objective is visible to, using a bitmask of team bits.

parameters.name: objective_number
parameters.description: The ID of the objective to alter.

parameters.name: team
parameters.description: A bitmask of the teams that can see the objective. Pass 0 to hide it from all teams.

remarks: The corpus passes a team bitmask such as level.spawnsystem.iSPAWN_TEAMMASK[team], combines masks with bitwise operators to exclude a team, and passes 0 to hide the objective from everyone.

api.name: OffhandSlot
api.description: Gets the offhand slot of the current weapon.

returns.name: slot
returns.description: The offhand slot name.

api.name: OffhandSpecialButtonPressed
api.description: Check if the player is pressing the gadget button.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player whose gadget button is being checked.

returns.description: Whether the player is currently pressing the gadget button.

remarks: Polled inside waittill_any-style loops, both to detect the initial press and in a while loop to wait for the button to be released.

api.name: OffhandWeaponsEnabled
api.description: Determine if offhand weapons are enabled for the player.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player to check.

remarks: Observed paired with WeaponCyclingEnabled() to test whether the player's weapon usage is currently restricted.

api.name: OpenFile
api.description: Opens a file for reading or writing.

parameters.name: fileName
parameters.description: The name of the file to open.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: The file open mode.

returns.description: The file handle, for use with FReadLn and CloseFile.

remarks: Every observed call is inside a developer-only block and stores the result in a variable used as a file handle for later writes.

api.name: OpenLUIMenu
api.description: Opens a precached LUI menu on the player and returns a handle to it.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player to open the menu on.

parameters.name: menuName
parameters.description: The name of the LUI menu to open. Must be precached.

parameters.name: persistent
parameters.description: Whether the menu should remain open when the player dies. Defaults to `false`.

returns.name: menuIndex
returns.description: The handle index of the opened menu.

remarks: The returned handle is normally stored on the player so it can be passed to CloseLUIMenu later.
Most call sites pass only the menu name and omit the persistent argument.

api.name: OpenMenu
api.description: Open the menu with the given menu index.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player to open the menu for.

parameters.name: menuIndex
parameters.description: The menu index.

remarks: The argument is usually a menu name looked up in the game table (for example game["menu_start_menu"]), but literal names such as "InitialBlack" are also used.
Paired with CloseMenu to dismiss the menu again.

api.name: OpenMenuNoMouse
api.description: Open the menu with the given menu index.

parameters.name: menuIndex
parameters.description: The menu index.

api.name: OrientMode
api.description: Set the orient mode of this actor.

parameters.name: orientMode
parameters.description: (const string) OrientMode must be 'face angle', 'face current', 'face direction', 'face enemy', 'face enemy or motion', 'face goal', 'face motion', 'face point', or 'face default'.

parameters.name: faceAngle
parameters.description: (float) The yaw angle to face if orient mode is 'face angle'.

parameters.name: directionVector
parameters.description: (vector) The direction vector to face if orient mode is 'face direction'.

parameters.name: facePosition
parameters.description: (vector) The point to face if orient mode is 'face point'.

remarks: "face default" is by far the most common call and is used to restore normal facing after a scripted orientation.
The extra argument is only passed for the modes that need it, such as a yaw for "face angle" or a direction vector for "face direction".

api.name: OverrideSpawnflags
api.description: Sets the spawnflags on this entity.  Used for patching.

parameters.name: spawnflags
parameters.description: The spawnflags value to override with.

remarks: Only one call site exists in the corpus, applying replacement spawnflags to a trigger entity.

api.name: PackRgba
api.description: Packs rgba into a single int.

parameters.name: red
parameters.description: as a float 0.0-1.0.

parameters.name: green
parameters.description: as a float 0.0-1.0.

parameters.name: blue
parameters.description: as a float 0.0-1.0.

parameters.name: alpha
parameters.description: as a float 0.0-1.0.

api.name: PathDistance
api.description: Returns the approximate/semi-accurate path distance between two points or undefined if no path can be found.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: The point to path from.

parameters.name: end
parameters.description: The point to path to.

parameters.name: generatePathForAccurateDist
parameters.description: If set to true, a real path will be generated and the total length of the path segments will be returned.

parameters.name: pathEnt
parameters.description: Only used when generatePathForAccurateDist is set. pathEnt will be used for generating a path, so it will respect the movement type. Only supported for actors.

parameters.name: pathDistanceType
parameters.description: The method of pathdistance calculation. Two options are PATHDIST_APPROXIMATE(using getApproximateFuturePositions), PATHDIST_CORNERPREDICTED (using getCornerPredictor).

parameters.name: maxCornerPredictions
parameters.description: Maximum number of cornerPrediction steps when PATHDIST_CORNERPREDICTED is used. Handles the edge case when cornerPrediction may not ever finish stepping the path all the way.

returns.description: The path distance between the two points, or undefined if no path can be found.

api.example: approx_dist = PathDistance( self.origin, goal_pos, true, self, level.pathdist_type );
remarks: Most calls pass just the two points for a cheap approximate distance.
When accuracy matters the corpus passes true along with the pathing entity and level.pathdist_type as the calculation method.

api.name: PathFixedOffset
api.description: Sets a fixed offset for this vehicle to travel on a vehicle path.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: The offset to apply. A vector in the form (forward, right, up).

remarks: Cleared again with PathFixedOffsetClear.

api.name: PathFixedOffsetClear
api.description: Clears the vehicles fixed offset.
remarks: Vehicle AI clears both offsets together, calling PathVariableOffsetClear and PathFixedOffsetClear back to back when resetting a vehicle's path following.

api.name: PathMode
api.description: Set the path mode of this actor.

parameters.name: pathMode
parameters.description: (const string) PathMode must be 'dont move', 'move allowed', or 'move delayed'.

parameters.name: clearPath
parameters.description: (integer) 1 to clear path.

parameters.name: pathDelay
parameters.description: (float) Amount of time (seconds) to wait if path mode is 'move delayed'.

remarks: "move delayed" is nearly always given both extra arguments, with a randomized delay of a second or two.
"dont move" and "move allowed" are called with the mode alone, and are used to lock and unlock an actor's movement around scripted behavior.

api.name: PathMove
api.description: Moves the entire path for this vehicle to the specific origin and angles.

parameters.name: nodeIndex
parameters.description: Which node to move to the new location (it moves the whole path not just this node).

parameters.name: newOrigin
parameters.description: The new position.

parameters.name: newAngles
parameters.description: The new angles.

api.name: PathMoveClear
api.description: Clears the moved path for this vehicle.  If not cleared then all paths taken will be moved.

api.name: PathVariableOffset
api.description: Sets a variable offset for this vehicle to travel on a vehicle path.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: The offset to apply. A vector in the form (forward, right, up).

parameters.name: time
parameters.description: The interval, in seconds, at which to choose a new offset.

remarks: Used by flying vehicles to make path following look less rigid, and cleared with PathVariableOffsetClear.

api.name: PathVariableOffsetClear
api.description: Clears the vehicles variable offset.
remarks: Undoes a previous PathVariableOffset, and is typically called immediately before PathFixedOffsetClear.

api.name: PhysicsExplosionCylinder
api.description: Creates a physics explosion in a cylinder that pushes physics objects away from the given position.

parameters.name: position
parameters.description: The origin of the cylinder.

parameters.name: outerRadius
parameters.description: The outer radius of the cylinder.

parameters.name: innerRadius
parameters.description: The inner radius of the cylinder.

parameters.name: magnitude
parameters.description: The magnitude of the explosion.

remarks: Used by wide knockback weapons such as the thundergun, commonly with an outer radius of 600, an inner radius of 240 and a magnitude of 1.

api.name: PhysicsExplosionSphere
api.description: Creates a physics explosion in a sphere that pushes physics objects away from the given position.

parameters.name: position
parameters.description: The origin of the sphere.

parameters.name: outerRadius
parameters.description: The outer radius of the sphere.

parameters.name: innerRadius
parameters.description: The inner radius of the sphere.

parameters.name: magnitude
parameters.description: The magnitude of the explosion.

parameters.name: outerDamage
parameters.description: The optional outer damage.

parameters.name: innerDamage
parameters.description: The optional inner damage.

remarks: Usually called with just the first four arguments to push physics objects without dealing damage.
The inner radius is always smaller than or equal to the outer radius, often around three quarters of it.

api.name: PhysicsJetThrust
api.description: Creates a physics jet thrust.

parameters.name: origin
parameters.description: origin of the thrust.

parameters.name: weaponFacingDir
parameters.description: The weapon facing direction.

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description: The radius of the thrust.

parameters.name: magnitude
parameters.description: The magnitude of the thrust.

parameters.name: angleLimit
parameters.description: The angle limit for the thrust.

api.name: PhysicsJolt
api.description: Create a physics radius jolt.

parameters.name: position
parameters.description: The origin of the jolt.

parameters.name: outerRadius
parameters.description: The outer radius of the jolt.

parameters.name: innerRadius
parameters.description: The inner radius of the jolt.

parameters.name: impulse
parameters.description: The impulse created by the explosion.

api.name: PhysicsLaunch
api.description: Permanently turn this entity into a physics object with an intial force vector at the specified point.

parameters.name: contact_point
parameters.description: The point to apply the initial force.

parameters.name: initial_force
parameters.description: The force vector to apply.

remarks: The contact point is usually the entity's own origin, with a randomized or computed velocity vector as the force.
Both arguments can be omitted to let the entity simply become a physics object.

api.name: PhysicsTrace
api.description: Performs a capsule physics trace from start to end and returns an associative array describing the hit.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: The trace start position.

parameters.name: end
parameters.description: The trace end position.

parameters.name: mins
parameters.description: The minimum capsule bounds. Defaults to (0, 0, 0).

parameters.name: maxs
parameters.description: The maximum capsule bounds. Defaults to (0, 0, 0).

parameters.name: ignoreEntity
parameters.description: An entity to ignore during the trace. Defaults to the world.

parameters.name: mask
parameters.description: A physics trace mask bitfield controlling collision filtering.

returns.description: An associative array containing fraction, position, entity, normal, and surfacetype.

api.example: trace = PhysicsTrace( start, end, ( 0, 0, 0 ), ( 0, 0, 0 ), self, PHYSICS_TRACE_MASK_VEHICLE_CLIP )

api.name: PhysicsTraceEx
api.description: Physics trace, ignoring characters. Returns the full trace structure.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: The start point.

parameters.name: end
parameters.description: The end point.

parameters.name: mins
parameters.description: trace capsule min.

parameters.name: maxs
parameters.description: trace capsule max.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: entity to ignore.

parameters.name: playerClip
parameters.description: collide with the player solid mask instead of ai solid mask.

returns.description: The trace result, keyed with the hit information such as position and normal.

remarks: Almost always called with a symmetric capsule and self as the ignored entity, then read for the hit position and surface normal.
Used by flying vehicles for clearance checks and by weapons to find a surface to spawn effects on.

api.name: PickupAmmoEvent
api.description: Lets the client know a weapon was picked up.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player that picked up the ammo.

parameters.name: weapon
parameters.description: : Weapon to use for the event.

remarks: Called on the picking-up player when an ammo pickup item is collected; the weapon argument is omitted at both observed sites.

api.name: PickUpGrenade
api.description: Pick up a grenade.

api.name: PickupSoundPlayer
api.description: Gets the pickup sound player index.

returns.name: playerIndex
returns.description: The pickup sound player index.

api.name: PickupWeaponEvent
api.description: Lets the client know a weapon was picked up.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player that picked up the weapon.

parameters.name: weapon
parameters.description: : Weapon to use for the event.

remarks: Called on the picking-up player when a dropped weapon item is collected, passing the weapon that was picked up.

api.name: PingPlayer
api.description: Flashes a player on their teammate's compasses.

api.name: PixBeginEvent

api.name: PlayerLinkTo
api.description: Attaches the player to an entity. Any entity rotation is added to the player's view, allow the player to look around. Rotating the parent entity/tag will not move the player's eye position, but only the player's view angles. Thus, the player's eye position is locked in place, always directly above the parent tag.

parameters.name: linktoEntity
parameters.description: The entity to attach the player to.

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: The tag to attach the player to.

parameters.name: viewFraction
parameters.description: How much the change in the tag's rotation effects the players view. Defaults to 0.

parameters.name: rightArc
parameters.description: Angle to clamp view to the right. Defaults to 180.

parameters.name: leftArc
parameters.description: Angle to clamp view to the left. Defaults to 180.

parameters.name: topArc
parameters.description: Angle to clamp view to the top. Defaults to 180.

parameters.name: bottomArc
parameters.description: Angle to clamp view to the bottom. Defaults to 180.

parameters.name: useTagAngles
parameters.description: Determines how the player's view will be tilted. 'False' (default) means that the orientation of the tag when the player is linked will appear flat to the player. Any rotation from that orientation will tilt the player's view. 'True' means that only a tag angles of (0,0,0) will appear flat to the player. Any rotation from (0,0,0) will tilt the player's view.

parameters.name: autoRecenter
parameters.description: Players view will auto recenter to the tag he is linked to. use tag angles must be true.

remarks: Most calls pass only the entity, or the entity and a tag such as "tag_origin".
When the view needs clamping, all of the view arguments are passed positionally, using undefined for the tag when there is none.
Undone with Unlink.

api.name: PlayerLinkToAbsolute
api.description: Attaches the player to an entity. No view movement is allowed.  The player's eye position will remain fixed relative to the parent entity/tag. Thus, pitching and rolling will cause the player's eye position to move. (But the player entity always remains vertical).

parameters.name: locktoEntity
parameters.description: The entity to attach the player to.

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: The tag to attach the player to.

remarks: Used for teleports and scripted scenes, where the player must be held exactly on a tag with no view freedom.
The tag is nearly always "tag_origin" or "tag_player", and the link is released with Unlink.

api.name: PlayerLinkToBlend
api.description: Only works if the player is currently linked to another entity and angles aren't locked. Lerps the current view angle constraints to the provided ones over the specified time.

parameters.name: parent
parameters.description: The entity to attach the player to.

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: The tag to attach the player to.

parameters.name: posTime
parameters.description: Lerp duration in seconds. Default is 1.

parameters.name: posAccelTime
parameters.description: Acceleration time. Default is 0.

parameters.name: posDecelTime
parameters.description: Decelaration time. Default is 0.

parameters.name: angleTime
parameters.description: angle Lerp duration in seconds. Default is <time>.

parameters.name: angleAccelTime
parameters.description: angle Acceleration time. Default is 0.

parameters.name: angleDecelTime
parameters.description: angle Decelaration time. Default is 0.

api.name: PlayerLinkToDelta
api.description: Attaches the player to an entity. Any entity rotation is added to the player's view, allow the player to look around. The player's eye position will remain fixed relative to the parent entity/tag. Thus, pitching and rolling will cause the player's eye position to move. (But the player entity always remains vertical).

parameters.name: linktoEntity
parameters.description: The entity to attach the player to.

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: The tag to attach the player to.

parameters.name: viewFraction
parameters.description: How much the change in the tag's rotation effects the players view. Defaults to 0.

parameters.name: rightArc
parameters.description: Angle to clamp view to the right. Defaults to 180.

parameters.name: leftArc
parameters.description: Angle to clamp view to the left. Defaults to 180.

parameters.name: topArc
parameters.description: Angle to clamp view to the top. Defaults to 180.

parameters.name: bottomArc

parameters.name: useTagAngles
parameters.description: Determines how the player's view will be tilted. 'False' (default) means that the orientation of the tag when the player is linked will appear flat to the player. Any rotation from that orientation will tilt the player's view. 'True' means that only a tag angles of (0,0,0) will appear flat to the player. Any rotation from (0,0,0) will tilt the player's view.

parameters.name: autoRecenter
parameters.description: Players view will auto recenter to the tag he is linked to. use tag angles must be true.

remarks: Typically called with a view fraction of 1 and four clamp angles, which restricts how far the player can look while linked.
Used for rides, flingers and door animations, and released with Unlink.

api.name: PlayerLinkWeaponViewToDelta

parameters.name: linktoEntity

parameters.description: Angle to clamp view to the top. Defaults to 180.

parameters.name: useTagAngles

Any rotation from that orientation will tilt the player's view. 'True' means that only a tag angles of (0,0,0) will appear flat to the player. Any rotation from (0,0,0) will tilt the player's view.

api.name: PlaySoundOnTag

api.name: PopulateCyberComUnlocks
api.description: Populates the cyber com unlock data for the player.

api.name: PositionQuery_Filter_Directness
api.description: Directness filter compute the direction information for each of the positions, relative to <origin> and <target>.

parameters.name: queryStruct
parameters.description: result from PositionQuery_Source function. each point contained here will have direction info computed.

parameters.name: origin
parameters.description: usually the position of AI before move.

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: the position AI is trying to approach.

parameters.name: resultVarName
parameters.description: by default the result directness value will be stored in pointStruct.directness, but can be override by this string.

remarks: Applied to the struct returned by PositionQuery_Source_Navigation, before the points are scored.
The target is often not a real position to reach but a direction reference, such as an origin projected along the entity's forward vector to bias movement.

api.name: PositionQuery_Filter_DistanceToGoal
api.description: Calculate the distance to <entity>.goalpos. If the point is in <entity>.goalradius, the distance will be 0. the result is in pointStruct.distToGoal.

parameters.name: queryStruct
parameters.description: result from PositionQuery_Source function.".

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: the entity used to check goal.".

remarks: Applied to the struct returned by PositionQuery_Source_Navigation, usually with the querying AI itself as the entity.
Often combined with other position query filters before the points are scored and the best one is chosen.

api.name: PositionQuery_Filter_InClaimedLocation
api.description: Check if the locations are inside other sentients claimed locations <entity>.inClaimedLocation.

parameters.name: queryStruct
parameters.description: result from PositionQuery_Source function.".

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: the entity used to check goal.".

remarks: Applied to the struct returned by PositionQuery_Source_Navigation so AI can avoid points already claimed by other sentients.
Usually called with the querying AI itself as the entity.

api.name: PositionQuery_Filter_Sight
api.description: Sight filter do sight check on each of the positions to a target position, and store the result in pointStruct.visibility (boolean).

parameters.name: queryStruct
parameters.description: result from PositionQuery_Source function. each point contained here will be used to check sight against <targetPosition>. ".

parameters.name: targetPosition
parameters.description: the position to check sight.".

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: offset to add on each point before sight checking. this is usually something like: offset = ai GetEye() - ai.origin. default to (0,0,0). ".

parameters.name: visibleBy_Ent
parameters.description: if defined, the corresponding sight check function on Actor or Vehicle will be called. Otherwise the checks just do simple bullet tracing.".

parameters.name: numOfPassedToEarlyOut
parameters.description: if defined and bigger than 0, the filter will early out after found this many passed sight checks. this is useful if the points are pre sorted by score and we don't care about lower scored ones.".

parameters.name: ignoreEnt
parameters.description: ignore entity during trace. if [visibleBy_Ent] is defined, it is already ignored internally. ".

parameters.name: resultVarName
parameters.description: by default the results will be stored in pointStruct.visibility, but can be override by this string. ".

api.example: PositionQuery_Filter_Sight( queryResult, self.enemy.origin, self GetEye() - self.origin, self, 0, self.enemy );
remarks: The offset argument is almost always self GetEye() - self.origin, so the check is made from eye height at each candidate point.
An early out count of 0 is passed when every point must be checked; a small positive count is used when only a few visible points are needed.

api.name: PositionQuery_Source_Navigation
api.description: Generate points around <origin>, between <minSearchRadius> and <maxSearchRadius> and within <halfHeight> height difference. For ground AI, the points will be on Nav Mesh; for flying AI, the points will be in Nav Volume. Only the points in pathable area will be kept. If the <origin> itself is in pathable area, all the points are guaranteed to be reachable from <origin>. If the <origin> is outside pathable area, all the points will still be in pathable areas surrounding <origin>, but reach-abilities cannot be guaranteed.

parameters.name: origin
parameters.description: Position to start the search around.

parameters.name: minSearchRadius
parameters.description: the minimum radius away from origin.

parameters.name: maxSearchRadius
parameters.description: the maximum radius away from origin. can equal to minSearchRadius.

parameters.name: halfHeight
parameters.description: the max height difference (both positive and negative) away from origin.

parameters.name: innerSpacing
parameters.description: the distance between points in.

parameters.name: reachableBy_Ent
parameters.description: if defined, it will be used to make sure all the points are reachable by this entity from <origin> (not the entity's current position). Can pass in a float number radius to get points on NavMesh. Can also pass in string 'navvolume_small' or 'navvolume_big' to get points on navvolume. Note passing in entity radius only gives rough estimate, not correct result.

parameters.name: outerSpacing
parameters.description: if defined, the distance between points will be Lerped from <innerSpacing> to [outerSpacing], to create a gradual distribution.

parameters.name: distributionBias
parameters.description: (vec2) if defined, the density of the points will be changed gradually along the direction of this vector. the magnitude will be use as scalar, with 1 being the norm scale.

remarks: The result struct is then passed through PositionQuery_Filter_* functions before its .data points are scored and one is picked.

api.description: Instructs the bot to release the double jump button.

calledOn.name: bot
calledOn.description: The bot player.

api.name: ReloadButtonPressed
api.description: Check if the player is pressing the 'usereload' button.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player whose input is checked.

returns.description: True if the player is currently pressing the reload button.

remarks: Used to let the player skip or interrupt scenes and interactions by holding reload.

api.name: ReloadWeaponAmmo
api.description: Set the weapon's ammoclip from the ammo.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player whose weapon clip is refilled.

parameters.name: weapon
parameters.description: The weapon to be reloaded.

remarks: The only call site loops over the player's primary weapons to refill each clip when they are revived.

api.name: RemoteControlTurret
api.description: Remote control into a turret.

parameters.name: turret
parameters.description: the remote controlled turret.

api.name: RemoteControlTurretOff
api.description: Stops remote controlling a turret.

parameters.name: turret
parameters.description: the remote controlled turret.

api.name: RemoveForceNoCull
api.description: Removes the force-no-cull flag. Entity will now be culled by portals.

api.name: RemoveInfluencer
api.description: Removes the given influencer.

parameters.name: influencerId
parameters.description: The identifier of the influencer to remove.

remarks: Paired with the spawn influencer creation builtins; scripts also remove the id from their own tracking arrays afterwards.

api.name: RemoveNoSunShadow
api.description: Removes the no-sunshadow flag.

api.name: RemoveSentientEventListener
api.description: De-Registers entity to listen to a specific event. if event is undefined, entity will stop listening to all the evnets.

parameters.name: event
parameters.description: The event name.

api.name: ReportLootConsume
api.description: Reports a loot consumption event for the player.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player.

parameters.name: itemName
parameters.description: The name of the consumed item, for example the GobbleGum name.

parameters.name: quantity
parameters.description: The number of times the item was consumed.

remarks: Zombies reports each GobbleGum the player used at the end of a game, once per pack entry that was actually consumed.

api.name: ReportLootReward
api.description: Reports a loot reward event for the player.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player.

parameters.name: itemName
parameters.description: The name of the item rewarded.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: The source of the reward.

api.name: ReportMTU
api.description: Reports MTU data for the given round.

parameters.name: roundNumber
parameters.description: The round number.

remarks: Called once per round in zombies. The mod tools source notes that in network debug instrumented builds it causes a network spike report to be generated.

api.name: ReportStubUsage
api.description: Reports stub usage to the engine for diagnostics.

api.name: Reset
api.description: Reset a HUD element to its default state.

api.name: ResetActiveContractProgress
api.description: Resets the progress of an active contract for the player.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player.

parameters.name: contractIndex
parameters.description: The contract index.

api.name: ResetAILimit
api.description: Clears any previous restrictions on the max number of AI.

api.name: ResetAnimations
api.description: Reset player animations after a body type change.
remarks: Both zombies call sites use it after swapping the player to or from an alternate body type.

api.name: ResetCharacterCustomization
api.description: Resets all of the character customization to what is in the player stats.

api.name: ResetDestructible
api.description: Resets the destructible entity back to its start state.

api.name: ResetDoubleJumpRechargeTime
api.description: Resets the double jump recharge timer as if the player had just used it.
remarks: Gadgets such as the heat wave and shock field call it on affected players to deny them an immediate double jump.

api.name: ResetFlashBack
api.description: Resets the players flashback history.

api.name: ResetFOV
api.description: Replace the current FOV by the default FOV.
remarks: Typically called during player spawn or game restart to clear any FOV set earlier in the match.

api.name: ResetGlass
api.description: Server side glass struct loops through all glass and resets to inital state.
remarks: Called at round setup in gametypes that restore the map between rounds, such as Fire Team.

api.name: ResetInactivityTimer
api.description: Resets the inactivity timer for the player.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player.

api.name: ResetMissileDetonationTime
api.description: Resets the timer for a grenade or missile to its max fuse time.

parameters.name: time
parameters.description: Override the reset timer from the weapon and specify the time left.

remarks: Called on a grenade or projectile entity, usually right after it is spawned or lands, to control when it detonates.
Passing 0 makes the projectile detonate immediately; passing no argument restores the weapon's own fuse time.

api.name: ResetQoSGameDataPayload
api.description: Resets the Quality of Service game data payload.

api.name: ResetSpreadOverride
api.description: Reset the player's aim spread to 255.

api.name: ResetTimeout
api.description: Resets the server timeout.
remarks: Called from long-running game logic such as spawn and end-of-game loops to keep the server from timing out.

api.name: ResetVehicleFromDropDeploy
api.description: Reset vehicle properties from drop deploy so that it may behave as normal.

api.name: ResetVisibilityCacheWithinRadius
api.description: Reset the viscache for sentients within the specified radius.

parameters.name: origin
parameters.description: Center of reset bounds.

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description: Distance around the origin to scan for sentients.

api.name: ResumeSpeed
api.description: Sets the vehicle to resume its path speed.

parameters.name: acceleration
parameters.description: The acceleration to apply to this vehicle in miles per hour per second.

remarks: Pairs with SetSpeed: vehicle path logic calls SetSpeed( 0, ... ) to brake at a node and ResumeSpeed to get moving along the path again.
Called with no argument the vehicle resumes without a scripted acceleration override.

api.name: ReturnPlayerControl
api.description: After controlling a vehicle from script using something like setvehgoalpos(), if the vehicle is being driven by a player, you call this function to return control of the vehicle to the player.

api.name: Revive
api.description: Revive the player.

api.name: ReviveObituary
api.description: Create an revive obituary for a character.

parameters.name: victim
parameters.description: The victim entity.

api.name: RevivePlayer
api.description: Callback from script to get player out of last stand, increases health, removes damage timer, should clear screen of damageFX.
remarks: Used by the last stand and revive systems, and by dev GUI commands, to take a player out of last stand.

api.name: Rotate
api.description: Causes a script entity to rotate, rotating around its origin.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity to rotate.

parameters.name: rotationVector
parameters.description: The rotation to apply about each axis, given as a pitch, yaw, and roll vector.

api.name: RotatePitch
api.description: Rotate this entity to the given pitch.

parameters.name: pitchAngle
parameters.description: The new pitch angle in degrees.

parameters.name: time
parameters.description: The time to rotate in seconds.

parameters.name: accelerationTime
parameters.description: The time spent accelerating in seconds.

parameters.name: decelerationTime
parameters.description: The time spent decelerating in seconds.

remarks: The angle is relative, so values such as -90 or 180 tip the entity by that amount from its current pitch.
The optional acceleration and deceleration times are given in seconds and are included in the total rotation time.

api.name: RotatePoint
api.description: Returns <angle> lerped angle value.

parameters.name: point
parameters.description: A point.

parameters.name: angles
parameters.description: An angle.

remarks: Commonly used to turn a local space offset into a world space offset by rotating it by an entity's angles, then adding it to that entity's origin.

api.name: RotatePointAroundAxis
api.description: returns a vector that is the result of point rotated around the axis vector by num degrees.

api.name: RotateRoll
api.description: Rotate this entity to the given roll angle.

parameters.name: rollAngle
parameters.description: The new roll angle in degrees.

parameters.name: time
parameters.description: The time to rotate in seconds.

parameters.name: accelerationTime
parameters.description: The time spent accelerating in seconds.

parameters.name: decelerationTime
parameters.description: The time spent decelerating in seconds.

remarks: The angle is relative to the entity's current roll, so switches and levers are commonly thrown with values such as -90 or -120.

api.name: RotateTo
api.description: Rotate this entity to the given world rotation value.

parameters.name: angles
parameters.description: The new world angle to rotate to.

parameters.name: time
parameters.description: The time to rotate in seconds.

parameters.name: accelerationTime
parameters.description: The time spent accelerating in seconds.

parameters.name: decelerationTime
parameters.description: The time spent decelerating in seconds.

api.example: mover RotateTo( s_goal.angles, n_time, n_time / 2, n_time / 2 );
remarks: Unlike RotateYaw, RotatePitch and RotateRoll, the angles given are absolute world angles, commonly taken from a target struct or computed with VectorToAngles.
Scripts usually wait on the entity's "rotatedone" notify, or simply wait the given time, before continuing.

api.name: RotateVelocity
api.description: Rotate this entity at a particular velocity for a given time.

parameters.name: rotateVelocity
parameters.description: The rotational velocity to rotate.

parameters.name: time
parameters.description: The time to rotate in seconds.

parameters.name: accelerationTime
parameters.description: The time spent accelerating in seconds.

parameters.name: decelerationTime
parameters.description: The time spent decelerating in seconds.

remarks: Used for spinning debris and tumbling objects; passing the rotation time as the acceleration or deceleration time gives a smooth spin up or spin down.

api.name: RotateYaw
api.description: Rotate this entity to the given yaw.

parameters.name: yawAngle
parameters.description: The new yaw angle in degrees.

parameters.name: time
parameters.description: The time to rotate in seconds.

parameters.name: accelerationTime
parameters.description: The time spent accelerating in seconds.

parameters.name: decelerationTime
parameters.description: The time spent decelerating in seconds.

remarks: The angle is relative to the entity's current yaw, so doors are swung with values such as 180 and continuous spinners repeat RotateYaw( -360, duration ) in a loop.
The optional acceleration and deceleration times are in seconds and are included in the total rotation time.

api.name: Savegame_Create
api.description: Creates a save game.

parameters.name: saveName
parameters.description: The name of the save game.

remarks: Campaign autosave logic calls it with no argument; the skipto system passes a name when saving for a specific map.

api.name: Savegame_GetSavedMap
api.description: Gets the map name from the current save game.

returns.name: mapName
returns.description: The saved map name.

api.name: Savegame_GetSavedQueuedMap
api.description: Gets the queued map name from the current save game.

returns.name: mapName
returns.description: The saved queued map name.

api.name: Savegame_ResetCampaignProgress
api.description: Resets the campaign progress in the save game.

api.name: SayAll
api.description: Write a client chat message from this client to everybody.

parameters.name: message
parameters.description: A localizable message to send to all players.

api.name: SayTeam
api.description: Write a client chat message from this client to everybody on their team.

parameters.name: message
parameters.description: A localizable message to send to all players on the player's team.

api.name: SbTimePlayed
api.description: Reports time played to the scoreboard.

api.name: ScaleOverTime
api.description: Set a hud element to scale over time.

parameters.name: time
parameters.description: The time to scale the element in seconds.

parameters.name: width
parameters.description: The new width of the material.

parameters.name: height
parameters.description: The new height of the material.

api.example: hud_elem ScaleOverTime( 0.05, int( big_width ), int( big_height ) );
remarks: Used for progress bars and pulsing HUD text; a pulse is done by scaling up and then scaling back to the original width and height.

api.name: ScreenShake
api.description: Create a screen shake event on the given point.

parameters.name: sourcePoint
parameters.description: The position of the earthquake.

parameters.name: scalepitch
parameters.description: The scale of the shake in player's pitch. Max is 100; Accurate to 2 decimal places.

parameters.name: scaleyaw
parameters.description: The scale of the shake in player's yaw. Max is 100; Accurate to 2 decimal places.

parameters.name: scaleroll
parameters.description: The scale of the shake in player's roll. Max is 100; Accurate to 2 decimal places.

parameters.name: duration
parameters.description: Duration in seconds.

parameters.name: durationfadeup
parameters.description: Duration in seconds, included in base duration. Default is 0. Value of -1 means duration - durationfadeup.

parameters.name: durationfadedown
parameters.description: Duration in seconds, included in base duration. Default is -1. Value of -1 means duration - durationfadedown.

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description: The radius of shake, dampens as you move away from entity. Default is 0 = shake is global.

parameters.name: frequencypitch
parameters.description: The scaled speed of the shake's pitch. Default is 1. Max is 100; Accurate to 2 decimal places.

parameters.name: frequencyyaw
parameters.description: The scaled speed of the shake's yaw. Default is 1. Max is 100; Accurate to 2 decimal places.

parameters.name: frequencyroll
parameters.description: The scaled speed of the shake's roll. Default is 1. Max is 100; Accurate to 2 decimal places.

parameters.name: exponent
parameters.description: The scale is multiplied by itself 'exponent' times to determine how the shake falls off. Default is 1 which is a linear falloff. Max is 100; Accurate to 2 decimal places.

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: Target is given if screen shake is to be shown to particular client only.

remarks: Call sites pass the full argument list; passing a player as the final argument restricts the shake to that client.

api.name: Script_Owner
api.description: Sets the script owner properties.

parameters.name: param1
parameters.description: The first parameter.

parameters.name: param2
parameters.description: The second parameter.

parameters.name: param3
parameters.description: The third parameter.

parameters.name: param4
parameters.description: The fourth parameter.

api.name: SeatGetWeapon
api.description: Returns the weapon name for the specified seat.  Undefined if there isn't a weapon. Only driver and gunner seats can have weapons.

parameters.name: seatIndex
parameters.description: The seat to get weapon for.

remarks: Turret and vehicle AI code reads the seat weapon to look up its range, damage or fire behavior; seat 0 is the driver seat on single seat vehicles and turrets.

api.name: SecondaryButtonPressedLocal
api.description: Check if the local player is pressing the secondary button (BUTTON_B).

api.name: SecondaryOffhandButtonPressed
api.description: Check if the player is pressing the secondary offhand button.
remarks: Usually tested alongside AttackButtonPressed, FragButtonPressed and MeleeButtonPressed to detect any player input.

api.name: SeeRecently
api.description: Check to see if the AI saw the given sentient in the past <time>. If called on a non-sentient, just does a cansee check.

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: (entity) The entity to check.

parameters.name: time
parameters.description: (int) seconds.

remarks: Behavior tree code calls it on an AI with its current enemy and a small window of a few seconds to decide whether the enemy is still effectively visible.

api.name: SendFaceEvent
api.description: Broadcast to the client a face event.

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: Face event index (string).

remarks: The index passed is looked up in level.face_event_handler.events, which maps a notify name to its registered face event.

api.name: SendKillstreakDamageEvent
api.description: Send a killstreak damage event to the client.

parameters.name: damage
parameters.description: How much damage was done.

remarks: Called on the killstreak owner when their killstreak vehicle takes damage, so the client can display the hit feedback.

api.name: ServerFieldGetValue
api.description: Get the value of a serverfield from a given player.

parameters.name: player
parameters.description: player to get value from.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: name of field to retrieve.

api.name: Serverfieldregister
api.description: Register a server field. Server fields are variable bit length fields communicated from client to server.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Unique name to identify the field.

parameters.name: numBits
parameters.description: How many bits to use for the field. Valid values are in the range of 1-32. Only ask for as many as you need.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Type of the field. Currently supported types "int" or "float".

parameters.name: callback
parameters.description: Function that gets called when the value changes (each client can toggle this bit independently of the others).

api.example: RegisterServerField("my_field", 2, "int"); // registers an int field with 2 bits of resolution, that can hold the values 0,1,2,3.

api.name: ServiceEvent
api.description: Set the specified event to serviced.

parameters.name: eventId
parameters.description: The identifier of the event (integer).

api.name: ServiceEventsInRadius
api.description: Set the events within a radius to serviced.

parameters.name: origin
parameters.description: Source position.

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description: Radius of events to service (-1 for all).

remarks: The single call site passes a radius of -1 to service every outstanding event for the AI.

api.name: SessionModeAbbreviation
api.description: Returns abbreviation of the current session mode, or "default" if none.

api.name: SessionModeIsCampaignGame
api.description: Returns true/false if the current session mode is a campaign game.
remarks: Used throughout shared scripts to gate campaign only behavior, often together with SessionModeIsZombiesGame.

api.name: SessionModeIsCampaignZombiesGame
api.description: Returns whether the current session is a campaign game running in zombies mode.

returns.description: True if the session is a campaign game in zombies mode, false otherwise.

remarks: Used throughout the campaign scripts to branch the bonus zombies (Dead Ops style) variants of a level away from the normal campaign flow.

api.name: SessionModeIsMultiplayerGame
api.description: Returns whether the current session is a multiplayer game.

returns.description: True if the session is a multiplayer game, false otherwise.

remarks: Commonly used in shared scripts to branch behavior that differs between multiplayer and the campaign or zombies modes.

api.name: SessionModeIsOnlineGame
api.description: Returns whether the current session is an online game.

returns.description: True if the session is an online game, false otherwise.

remarks: The game logic scripts cache the result once on level start as level.onlinegame.
Often combined with SessionModeIsPrivate or SessionModeIsSystemlink to distinguish ranked online play from private, systemlink or splitscreen play.

api.name: SessionModeIsPrivate
api.description: Returns whether the current session is a private match.

returns.description: True if the session is a private match, false otherwise.

remarks: Used to relax ranked restrictions, for example skipping item lock checks on bot loadouts, and is reported as the private_match field in match telemetry.

api.name: SessionModeIsPrivateOnlineGame
api.description: Returns whether the current session is a private online game.

returns.description: True if the session is a private online game, false otherwise.

api.name: SessionModeIsSystemlink
api.description: Returns whether the current session is a systemlink game.

returns.description: True if the session is a systemlink game, false otherwise.

remarks: The game logic scripts cache the result once on level start as level.systemlink.
Gametype scripts test it together with SessionModeIsOnlineGame and IsSplitScreen to detect local splitscreen play.

api.name: SessionModeIsZombiesGame
api.description: Returns whether the current session is a zombies game.

returns.description: True if the session is a zombies game, false otherwise.

remarks: Widely used in the shared game logic to disable multiplayer-only features such as the scoreboard, damage feedback and team handling in zombies.

api.name: SetAARStat
api.description: Sets an after-action report stat on the player.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player to set the stat on.

parameters.name: stat
parameters.description: The name of the after-action report stat, for example "lobbyPopup" or "surveyId".

parameters.name: args
parameters.description: Either the value to store, or an index followed by the value.

remarks: Called at the end of a match to populate the post-game lobby report, with values such as "lobbyPopup", "surveyId" and "hardcore".
The trailing arguments are either a single value or an index followed by a value.

api.name: SetAcceleration
api.description: Sets the acceleration of this vehicle.

calledOn.name: vehicle
calledOn.description: The vehicle to set the acceleration on.

parameters.name: acceleration
parameters.description: The acceleration of the vehicle in miles per hour per second.

remarks: Vehicle scripts usually pass a value taken from the vehicle settings, sometimes scaled by a boost multiplier for evasive movement.

api.name: SetActionSlot
api.description: Assigns what the given player action slot does.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player whose action slot is being set.

parameters.name: slot
parameters.description: The action slot number.

parameters.name: actionSlotType
parameters.description: The type of slot, for example "weapon", "altMode" or an empty string to clear it.

parameters.name: weapon
parameters.description: The weapon the slot triggers, for slot types that use one.

remarks: Passing an empty string as the type clears the slot.
Slot 3 is commonly set to "altMode", while "weapon" slots take the weapon to trigger as a third argument.

api.name: SetActorWeapon
api.description: Sets the weapon an actor is using.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The actor to set the weapon on.

parameters.name: weaponname
parameters.description: The weapon to give the actor.

parameters.name: weaponOptions
parameters.description: The packed weapon options, typically obtained from GetActorWeaponOptions.

remarks: Callers pass the actor's existing options from GetActorWeaponOptions to preserve attachments and camo when swapping weapons.
Passing level.weaponNone leaves the actor without a weapon.

api.name: SetAILimit
api.description: Allows you to specify a max number of active AI - which over-rides the MAX_AI functionality in the engine, when it comes time to spawn in new AI.  Setting the value higher will not give you more AI than the system supports.

api.name: SetAirResistance
api.description: Sets the speed at which air resistance maxes out.

parameters.name: maxAirResistanceSpeed
parameters.description: speed at which air resistance maxes out (MPH).

api.name: SetAISpread
api.description: Sets the spread of this turret when used by an AI.

parameters.name: spread
parameters.description: The spread of the turret in degrees.

api.name: SetAngularVelocity
api.description: Sets the angular velocity of a vehicle in degrees per second.

calledOn.name: vehicle
calledOn.description: The vehicle to set the angular velocity on.

parameters.name: angularVelocity
parameters.description: The angular velocity to set.

remarks: Pass a zero vector to stop the vehicle spinning.
Hover vehicles commonly damp their spin by feeding GetAngularVelocity multiplied by a stabilize factor back in.

api.name: SetAnim
api.description: Blends an animation or animtree node on this entity towards a goal weight.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity to play the animation on.

parameters.name: animation
parameters.description: The animation or animtree node to change.

parameters.name: weight
parameters.description: Goal weight of this animation. Defaults to 1.0.

parameters.name: time
parameters.description: Time to transition to this weight in seconds. Defaults to 0.2.

parameters.name: rate
parameters.description: Playback rate of the animation. Defaults to 1.0.

remarks: Callers most often pass a weight of 1 to play an animtree node, with a blend time of 0 for an immediate switch.
Use SetAnimKnobRestart instead when the animation must restart even if it was already playing.

api.name: SetAnimForceNew
api.description: Debug only functionality that adds a new instance of an animation to an animtree setting its time to a specific point.

parameters.name: animation
parameters.description: The animation or animtree node to change.

parameters.name: weight
parameters.description: Goal weight of this animation. Defaults to 1.0.

parameters.name: time
parameters.description: Time to set this animation to after adding it. Defaults to 0.

parameters.name: goalTime
parameters.description: Time to transition to this weight in seconds. Defaults to 0.2.

parameters.name: rate
parameters.description: Playback rate of the animation. Defaults to 1.0.

api.name: SetAnimKnob
api.description: See "SetAnim.

parameters.name: animation
parameters.description: The animation or animtree node to change.

parameters.name: weight
parameters.description: Goal weight of this animation. Defaults to 1.0.

parameters.name: time
parameters.description: Time to transition to this weight in seconds. Defaults to 0.2.

parameters.name: rate
parameters.description: Playback rate of the animation. Defaults to 1.0.

api.name: SetAnimKnobAll
api.description: See "SetAnim.

parameters.name: animation
parameters.description: The animation or animtree node to change.

parameters.name: root
parameters.description: An ancestor of the animation.

parameters.name: weight
parameters.description: Goal weight of this animation. Defaults to 1.0.

parameters.name: time
parameters.description: Time to transition to this weight in seconds. Defaults to 0.2.

parameters.name: rate
parameters.description: Playback rate of the animation. Defaults to 1.0.

api.description: See "SetAnim.

parameters.name: root

parameters.name: weight
parameters.description: Goal weight of this animation. Defaults to 1.0.

parameters.name: time
parameters.description: Time to transition to this weight in seconds. Defaults to 0.2.

parameters.name: rate
parameters.description: Playback rate of the animation. Defaults to 1.0.

api.name: SetAnimKnobAllLimitedRestart
api.description: See "SetAnim.

parameters.name: animation

parameters.name: root
parameters.description: An ancestor of the animation.

parameters.name: weight
parameters.description: Goal weight of this animation. Defaults to 1.0.

parameters.name: time
parameters.description: Time to transition to this weight in seconds. Defaults to 0.2.

parameters.name: rate
parameters.description: Playback rate of the animation. Defaults to 1.0.

api.name: SetAnimKnobAllRestart
api.description: See "SetAnim.

parameters.name: animation
parameters.description: The animation or animtree node to change.

parameters.name: root
parameters.description: An ancestor of the animation.

parameters.name: weight
parameters.description: Goal weight of this animation. Defaults to 1.0.

parameters.name: time
parameters.description: Time to transition to this weight in seconds. Defaults to 0.2.

parameters.name: rate
parameters.description: Playback rate of the animation. Defaults to 1.0.

api.name: SetAnimKnobLimited
api.description: See "SetAnim.

parameters.name: animation
parameters.description: The animation or animtree node to change.

parameters.name: weight
parameters.description: Goal weight of this animation. Defaults to 1.0.

parameters.name: time
parameters.description: Time to transition to this weight in seconds. Defaults to 0.2.
