api.name: SetAnimKnobLimitedRestart
api.description: See "SetAnim.

parameters.name: animation
parameters.description: The animation or animtree node to change.

parameters.name: weight
parameters.description: Goal weight of this animation. Defaults to 1.0.

parameters.name: time
parameters.description: Time to transition to this weight in seconds. Defaults to 0.2.

parameters.name: rate
parameters.description: Playback rate of the animation. Defaults to 1.0.

api.name: SetAnimKnobRestart
api.description: Sets the entity's animation and restarts it from the beginning, even if it was already playing.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity to play the animation on.

parameters.name: animation
parameters.description: The animation or animtree node to change.

parameters.name: weight
parameters.description: Goal weight of this animation. Defaults to 1.0.

parameters.name: time
parameters.description: Time to transition to this weight in seconds. Defaults to 0.2.

parameters.name: rate
parameters.description: Playback rate of the animation. Defaults to 1.0.

api.name: SetAnimStateFromASD
api.description: Puts the entity into the named animation state defined in its animation state definition (ASD).

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity to set the animation state on.

parameters.name: asdName
parameters.description: The name of the animation state in the entity's ASD.

remarks: Used on AI and player clones to drive scripted states such as "laststand", "idle" and fall or getup animations.
Zombie weapon scripts build the state name at runtime, for example from a fall direction and a leg suffix.

api.name: SetAnimTime
api.description: Get the animation time for the given animation.

api.description: Sets the normalized playback time of the named animation on this entity.

calledOn.name: entity

parameters.name: animation
parameters.description: animation to manipulate.

api.name: SetArchive

api.name: SetArenaPoints
api.description: Sets the player's arena points.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player whose arena points are being set.

parameters.name: point
parameters.description: points.

api.name: SetAssassinationEnabled
api.description: Enable or disable assassinations on the AI.  Also turns on/off the can assassinate indicator.

parameters.name: flag
parameters.description: Whether to use infrared material or not (boolean).

api.name: SetAttachmentCosmeticVariantIndex

parameters.name: weapon
parameters.description: The weapon full name.

parameters.name: attachmentName
parameters.description: The attachment name of the weapon.

parameters.name: acvi
parameters.description: The attachment cosmetic variant index.

api.name: SetAttachmentCosmeticVariantIndexes

calledOn.name: entity

parameters.name: acvi

remarks: The zombies pack-a-punch machine uses it so the displayed weapon model matches the camo and attachment variants of the player's weapon.

api.name: SetAvoidanceMask
api.description: Sets which other characters this Havok character avoids while moving.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The character to set the avoidance mask on.

parameters.name: Mask
parameters.description: (const string) Mask must be 'avoid all', 'avoid none', 'avoid actor', 'avoid ai'(actors+vehicles), 'avoid player', or 'avoid vehicle'.

remarks: Archetype scripts set it when an AI spawns, and clones or scripted actors are usually given "avoid none" so they do not push other characters around.

api.name: SetAvoidanceProperty
api.description: Set the avoidance properties of this Havok character.

parameters.name: Property
parameters.description: (const string) Property must be 'collision penalty' or 'dodge penalty'.

parameters.name: Value
parameters.description: (float) The value to set the property to.

api.name: SetBallPassAllowed
api.description: Enables or disables ball passing for the given player.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player to allow/disallow passing the ball on.

parameters.name: isAllowed
parameters.description: Whether ball passing is allowed.

api.name: SetBlockWeaponPickup
api.description: Blocks or allows the player picking up other weapons while holding the given weapon.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player holding the weapon.

parameters.name: weapon
parameters.description: The weapon that blocks pickups while held.

parameters.name: enabled
parameters.description: Whether weapon pickup should be blocked.

remarks: Set on killstreak, carry and objective weapons when they are given, and cleared with a value of false when the weapon is taken away.

api.name: SetBlur
api.description: Blurs this player's screen over a period of time.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The player whose screen is blurred.

parameters.name: target_blur
parameters.description: The final blur. The value is pixels for Gaussian blur at 640x480. Must be a floating point value greater than 0.

parameters.name: time
parameters.description: Time in seconds.

remarks: Called with a target blur of 0 to fade the blur back out, for example on respawn or when an effect ends.

api.name: SetBodyRenderOptions
api.description: Sets the body, helmet and head render options on an entity.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity whose render options are being set.

parameters.name: bodyRenderOptions
parameters.description: The packed body render options - calculated with GetHeroBodyRenderOptions.

parameters.name: helmetRenderOptions
parameters.description: The packed helmet render options - calculated with GetHeroHelmetRenderOptions.

parameters.name: headRenderOptions
parameters.description: The packed head render options - calculated with GetHeroHeadRenderOptions.

remarks: Used when building player clones so the clone renders like the player it copies; call sites pass the same packed value for all three arguments.

api.name: SetBombTimer
api.description: Sets one of the match state bomb timers, used by the HUD to count down.

parameters.name: flagBit
parameters.description: The flag bit to change.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: The new value of the bit.

remarks: Gametypes set an absolute game time in milliseconds, computed from GetTime, and pass 0 to clear the timer.
The timers are addressed by short labels such as "A" and "B".

api.name: SetBrake
api.description: Turns the hand brake of a physics vehicle on or off.

calledOn.name: vehicle
calledOn.description: The vehicle whose brake is being set.

parameters.name: bool
parameters.description: True or 1 to turn on the brake, false or 0 otherwise.

remarks: Vehicle scripts brake when a vehicle should hold position and release the brake before it starts moving again.

api.name: SetBuoyancyOffset
api.description: Sets the buoyancy offset that changes the height at which this vehicle floats in water.

calledOn.name: vehicle
calledOn.description: The vehicle to set the buoyancy offset on.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: A height offset from water surface.

remarks: A negative offset sinks the vehicle further below the water surface.

api.name: SetBurn
api.description: Sets this entity burning for the given time.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity to set burning.

parameters.name: time
parameters.description: Time to burn for ( greater than 0 ).

remarks: Passing 0 puts the fire out, which the game logic does when a player dies or respawns.

api.name: SetCameraSpikeActive
api.description: Sets the state of a player's camera spike.

parameters.name: toggle
parameters.description: 0 for off, 1 for on.

api.name: SetCanDamage
api.description: Sets whether this entity can be damaged, which lets it respond to bullet and explosive hits.

calledOn.name: script_model, script_origin or script_brushmodel
calledOn.description: The entity to set the can damage flag on.

parameters.name: canDamage
parameters.description: The can damage flag.

remarks: Widely used on script models and brushmodels to make scripted props destructible, and set back to 0 to make them ignore damage again.

api.name: SetCarryingObject
api.description: Enable or disable the player carrying object flag. Disables doublejump and juke.

parameters.name: onoff
parameters.description: True to enable, false otherwise.

api.example: self SetCarryingObject( true );  // disables doublejump and juke

api.name: SetCharacterBodyStyle
api.description: Sets the character body style for the player's current body type, resetting that style's colors to default.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player whose body style is being set.

parameters.name: characterBodyTypeIndex
parameters.description: The index of the character body type.

remarks: Zombies character setup calls it after SetCharacterBodyType, usually followed by SetCharacterHelmetStyle.

api.name: SetCharacterBodyType
api.description: Sets the character body type for the player, resetting all other customization to the default for that body type.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player whose body type is being set.

parameters.name: characterBodyTypeIndex
parameters.description: The index of the character body type.

parameters.name: characterHeadTypeIndex
parameters.description: The index of the character head type.

remarks: Zombies maps call it with the player's character index when assigning a playable character, then set the body and helmet styles.

api.name: SetCharacterHelmetStyle
api.description: Sets the character helmet style for the player's current helmet type, resetting that style's colors to default.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player whose helmet style is being set.

parameters.name: characterBodyTypeIndex
parameters.description: The index of the character body type.

remarks: Called after SetCharacterBodyType and SetCharacterBodyStyle when setting up a character's appearance.

api.name: SetClearanceCeiling
api.description: Sets a new clearance ceiling. If the value is larger than the current ceiling, cut faces will be invalidated.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: The value for the clearance ceiling.

api.name: SetClientCGObjectiveText
api.description: Sets the objective text shown only on this client.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player to show the objective text to.

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: The objective text to show, or an empty string to clear it.

remarks: The game logic UI code passes an empty string to clear the text, and otherwise supplies the per-team objective or score text.

api.name: SetClientCompass
api.description: Sets the compass dvar only on this client.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player to set the dvar for.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: The value to set.

remarks: Zombies disables the compass this way as part of the per-client dvar setup done when a player connects.

api.name: SetClientDrawTalk
api.description: Sets the cg_drawTalk dvar only on this client.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player to set the dvar for.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: The value to set.

remarks: The game logic sets it to 3 for every connecting player in all three modes.

api.name: SetClientFocalLength
api.description: Sets cg_focalLength dvar only on this client.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: The focal length value to set (float).

api.name: SetClientHUDHardcore
api.description: Sets the ui_hud_hardcore dvar only on this client.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player to set the dvar for.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: The value to set.

remarks: Zombies clears it as part of the per-client dvar setup done when a player connects.

api.name: SetClientMiniScoreboardHide
api.description: Hides or shows the mini scoreboard only on this client.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player to set the dvar for.

parameters.name: enable
parameters.description: True/1 to hide, false/0 otherwise.

remarks: Set on connect to hide the mini scoreboard, then cleared once the player is fully initialized and in the game.

api.name: SetClientNameMode
api.description: Alters the way that the player name is updated, to prevent cheating by spectators altering their name to communicate with active players.

parameters.name: nameMode
parameters.description: Either "auto_change" or "manual_change".

remarks: Gametype scripts call this once during setup, almost always with "auto_change".

api.name: SetClientNumLives
api.description: Sets scr_numLives dvar only on this client.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player to set the value on.

parameters.name: numLives
parameters.description: The number of lives to set for this client.

remarks: Called on a connecting player alongside SetClientPlayerSprintTime to push per-client gametype settings.

api.name: SetClientPlayerPushAmount
api.description: Sets playerPushAmount dvar only on this client.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player to set the value on.

parameters.name: amount
parameters.description: The player push amount to set for this client.

api.name: SetClientPlayerSprintTime
api.description: Sets player_sprintTime dvar only on this client.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player to set the value on.

parameters.name: time
parameters.description: The sprint time to set for this client.

remarks: Used when a player spawns or connects, to apply the level's sprint time to that client only.

api.name: SetClientProfileVar
api.description: Sets a client profile variable on the player.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player.

parameters.name: varName
parameters.description: The profile variable name.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: The value to set.

api.name: SetClientScriptMainMenu
api.description: Sets g_scriptMainMenu dvar only on this client.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player to set the main menu for.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: The name of the menu to use as this client's script main menu.

remarks: Callers pass a menu name previously stored in the game table, such as game["menu_start_menu"] or game["menu_class"].

api.name: SetClientThirdPerson
api.description: Set the client to be third person.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player to change the camera mode for.

parameters.name: onoff
parameters.description: Whether the client should be in third person.

remarks: Spawn code turns third person on for special modes and back off when returning to normal play.

api.name: SetClientThirdPersonAngle
api.description: Sets cg_thirdPerson dvar only on this client.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player to set the third person camera angle for.

parameters.name: angle
parameters.description: The third person camera angle to set for this client.

remarks: Zombies code sets a non-zero angle for special third person views and resets it to 0 afterwards.

api.name: SetClientUIVisibilityFlag
api.description: Sets a HUD visibility flag only on this client.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player whose UI visibility flag is being set.

parameters.name: flagName
parameters.description: The name of the UI visibility flag to set.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: The value to set the flag to, 0 to hide and 1 to show.

remarks: Common flags in the corpus are "hud_visible", "weapon_hud_visible", "g_compassShowEnemies" and "killcam_nemesis".
Scripts that hide UI with a value of 0 normally restore it with a matching call passing 1.

api.name: SetClock
api.description: Set a clock HUD element to count down over a time period.

calledOn.name: hud_clock_element
calledOn.description: The HUD element to display the clock on.

parameters.name: time
parameters.description: The new timer time in seconds to count down.

parameters.name: time
parameters.description: The time in seconds represented by a full cycle of the hand, for instance a stopwatch would be 60s.

parameters.name: material
parameters.description: The material for the hud clock.

parameters.name: width
parameters.description: The width of the material.

parameters.name: height
parameters.description: The height of the material.

remarks: The countdown runs on the engine side, so callers typically wait out the same duration before notifying that the timer finished.

api.name: SetClockUp
api.description: Set a clock HUD element to count up over a time period.

parameters.name: time
parameters.description: The new timer time in seconds to count up.

parameters.name: fullTime
parameters.description: The time in seconds represented by a full cycle of the hand, for instance a stopwatch would be 60s.

parameters.name: material
parameters.description: The material for the hud clock.

parameters.name: width
parameters.description: The width of the material.

parameters.name: height
parameters.description: The height of the material.

api.name: SetClone
api.description: Marks the entity as a clone.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity to mark as a clone.

remarks: Clone setup calls this after SetContents, once the clone's model and collision have been configured.

api.name: SetCOD7DecodeFX
api.description: Set the hudelem string to display with a decode effect.

calledOn.name: hud_element
calledOn.description: The HUD element to apply the decode effect to.

parameters.name: decodeTime
parameters.description: Time for each letter to decode.

parameters.name: decayStart
parameters.description: Time to wait before starting the text decay effect.

parameters.name: decayDuration
parameters.description: How long to spend decaying.

remarks: Used on HUD message titles and text right after SetText or SetValue, with the decay start derived from the message duration in milliseconds.

api.name: SetContents
api.description: Sets contents of the entity to the given content.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity to set the contents of.

parameters.name: content
parameters.description: The content to set for the entity.

returns.description: The entity's contents before the call.

remarks: Returns the entity's previous contents, so scripts store it before setting 0 and pass it back later to restore collision.
Nested calls such as ent SetContents( ent SetContents( 0 ) & ~mask ) are used to clear individual contents bits.

api.name: SetControllerLightbarColor
api.description: Sets the controller lightbar color.

parameters.name: r
parameters.description: Red component.

parameters.name: g
parameters.description: Green component.

parameters.name: b
parameters.description: Blue component.

api.name: SetControllerUIModelValue
api.description: Sets a data value for a given lui menu, the data name has to be precached and the value as well, if its a string.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player whose controller UI model is being set.

parameters.name: uiModelDataPathFromController
parameters.description: The precached UI model data path, relative to the controller.

parameters.name: uiModelValue
parameters.description: The value to store at that path.

remarks: The path is a dotted UI model path such as "hudItems.armorPercent" or "AbilityWheel.Selected1", and values observed are numbers or short strings.

api.name: SetCullDist
api.description: Set the cull distance for a level.

parameters.name: cullDistance
parameters.description: The cull distance to use for the level.

remarks: Levels set this once at startup; dev GUI code stores the level value and restores it after temporarily passing 0.

api.name: SetCurrentSpectatorClient
api.description: Sets which client this player is currently spectating.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The spectating player.

parameters.name: client
parameters.description: The player entity to spectate.

remarks: Menu code resolves the requested client number with a player lookup and only calls this when that player is defined.

api.name: SetCurrentWeaponSpinLerp
api.description: Set the current weapon's spin.

parameters.name: spin
parameters.description: The spin value.

api.name: SetCursorHint
api.description: Attaches a cursor hint to the entity.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity to attach the cursor hint to.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: The type of cursor hint to attach, such as `HINT_NOICON`.

parameters.name: cursorHintEnt
parameters.description: The associated entity that provides data to the cursor hint, if any.

api.name: SetCyberComAbilities
api.description: Sets the cyber com abilities flags for the player at the given index.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player.

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: The ability slot index.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: The abilities value.

api.name: SetCyberComAbility
api.description: Sets a cyber com ability on the player.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player.

parameters.name: abilityName
parameters.description: The name of the ability to set.

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: The ability slot index.

returns.name: result
returns.description: The result code.

remarks: Callers pass the ability name and its upgrade state, taken from the player's cybercom ability data.

api.name: SetCyberComAbilityFlags
api.description: Sets the cyber com ability flags for the player.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player.

parameters.name: flags
parameters.description: The ability flags to set.

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: The ability index.

api.name: SetCyberComActiveType
api.description: Sets the active cyber com type for the player.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player.

parameters.name: activeType
parameters.description: The cyber com ability type to make active.

remarks: The value passed is the ability's type field, which is also used to index the ability wheel UI model.

api.name: SetCyberComRig
api.description: Sets a cyber com rig on the player.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player.

parameters.name: rigName
parameters.description: The name of the rig to set.

parameters.name: equip
parameters.description: Whether to equip the rig immediately.

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: The rig slot index.

returns.name: result
returns.description: The result code.

remarks: Tactical rig code calls this with the rig type and its upgrade state, adding a slot argument when a specific slot is targeted.

api.name: SetCyberComRigsFlags
api.description: Sets the cyber com rigs flags for the player.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player.

parameters.name: flags
parameters.description: The tactical rig flags to set.

remarks: Called during cybercom setup alongside SetCyberComActiveType and the per-ability flag setters.

api.name: SetCyberComUpgradeFlags
api.description: Sets the cyber com upgrade flags for the player.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player.

parameters.name: flags
parameters.description: The upgrade flags to set.

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: The upgrade index.

api.name: SetDamageStage
api.description: Sets the damage stage of the vehicle.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity whose damage stage is set.

parameters.name: stage
parameters.description: The damage stage to set.

remarks: Helicopter killstreak code raises the stage as damage is taken and passes 0 to reset it when the vehicle is restored.

api.name: SetDangerous
api.description: Set this node to be a dangerous node for a particular team. works only on pathnodes.

parameters.name: team
parameters.description: Name of the team.

parameters.name: flag
parameters.description: True if dangerous. False otherwise.

api.name: SetDebugSideSwitch
api.description: Sets the debug side switch value.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: The side switch value.

api.name: SetDeceleration
api.description: Sets the deceleration for this vehicle.

parameters.name: deceleration
parameters.description: The deceleration of the vehicle in miles per hour per second.

api.name: SetDedicatedShadow
api.description: Enabled or Disables dedicated shadow for a model.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity to enable or disable the dedicated shadow on.

parameters.name: flag
parameters.description: Whether the dedicated shadow is enabled.

api.name: SetDefaultDropPitch

api.description: Set the desired default pitch for a vehicle.

calledOn.description: The vehicle to set the default pitch on.

parameters.name: pitch
parameters.description: The default pitch to use.

api.name: SetDemoIntermissionPoint

parameters.description: Far end (should be greater than 0).

parameters.description: Near blur.

parameters.name: farBlur
parameters.description: Far blur.

api.name: SetDisabledTargetHint
api.description: Set target not selected hint.

calledOn.description: The player to show the hint for.

parameters.description: The weapon to use for the hint.

api.description: Sets the value of a dvar.

parameters.name: dvarName
parameters.description: The name of the dvar.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: The value to set.

api.name: SetElectrified
api.description: Electrify the entity for the given time.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity to electrify.

parameters.name: time
parameters.description: The time in seconds to stay electrified.

remarks: Zombies traps and the tesla gun apply this for short durations of around one to two seconds.

api.name: SetElectrifiedState
api.description: Sets the player into the electrified state for 3rd person anim purposes. Different from SetElectrified() which plays the postfx.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player to put into the electrified state.

parameters.name: electrified
parameters.description: Whether the player should be in the electrified state.

remarks: The lightning gun turns the state on while the victim is being shocked and turns it off again afterwards.

api.name: SetEMPJammed
api.description: Sets whether a player/client is affected by EMP.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity to jam.

parameters.name: isJammed
parameters.description: Whether the player should be EMP jammed.

remarks: The EMP killstreak and EMP grenade jam players, and cleanse gadgets or dev commands clear it by passing false.

api.name: SetEnableNode
api.description: Enables or disables the given pathnode.

parameters.name: node
parameters.description: The node to enable or disable.

parameters.name: truefalse
parameters.description: Whether the node should be enabled.

remarks: Level scripts disable cover and path nodes at setup and re-enable them later by passing the opposite flag.

api.name: SetEnemyModel
api.description: Sets the model of the actor that actors enemies will see to the given model name.

calledOn.name: actor
calledOn.description: The entity to set the enemy-facing model on.

parameters.name: modelName
parameters.description: The name of the model that enemies will see.

remarks: Killstreak vehicles set an alternative, usually darker, model so that enemies see a different silhouette.

api.name: SetEnterTime
api.description: Sets the player's session enter time.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player whose enter time is being set.

parameters.name: time
parameters.description: The time, in milliseconds, to record as the enter time.

remarks: Scripts call this with getTime() when a player enters play, as part of spawn and respawn logic.

api.name: SetEntGravityTrajectory
api.description: Sets the gravity trajectory type for the entity.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The entity whose gravity trajectory is being set.

parameters.name: trajectory
parameters.description: 0 = TR_GRAVITY, 1 = TR_MOON_GRAVITY.

remarks: Used to switch entities between normal and low gravity, for example in the moon gravity zombies scripts.

api.name: SetEntityAnimRate
api.description: Sets the animation playback rate of the entity (zombies only).

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity whose animation rate is being set.

parameters.name: rate
parameters.description: The animation rate multiplier.

api.name: SetEntityOwner
api.description: Sets an entity as the AI's owner. The owner will never be targeted by that AI.

calledOn.name: actor
calledOn.description: The AI whose owner is being set.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: The entity to make the owner, commonly the player who spawned the AI.

remarks: Typically called on AI spawned on behalf of a player, such as dogs and player clones, passing the owning player.

api.name: SetEntityPaused
api.description: Sets whether a given entity is paused, stopping it from advancing normally.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity to pause or unpause.

parameters.name: ignore
parameters.description: True to pause the entity, false to let it advance normally.

remarks: Used to freeze AI in place, for example mannequins and zombies, and called again with false to resume them.

api.name: SetEntityTarget
api.description: Set an entity as the AI's target. This is for special cases only. Do not set AI or player targets with this.

calledOn.name: actor
calledOn.description: The AI whose target is being set.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: An entity to target (cannot be server only entity).

parameters.name: threat
parameters.description: A fraction of maximum possible threat an AI can have. Must be in 0 to 1 range. Defaults to 1.

parameters.name: tagName
parameters.description: Tag to aim/shoot at on this entity. Defaults to tag_eye for actors/players".

remarks: The threat argument is passed as 1 when the AI should treat the entity as its top priority target.
Called on AI such as clones, squad members and scripted enemies to force them onto a specific target.

api.name: SetEntityWeapon
api.description: Sets the weapon entity field of the entity from script.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity whose weapon field is being set.

parameters.description: The weapon to record on the entity, or level.weaponNone to clear it.

remarks: Paired with Attach and Detach when attaching or removing a weapon world model, and called with level.weaponNone to clear the weapon.

api.name: SetEverHadWeaponAll
api.description: Set the EverHadAllPlayerHeldWeapons flag of the player.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player whose flag is being set.

parameters.name: flag
parameters.description: True to set the flag, false to clear it.

remarks: Set around loadout and killstreak weapon changes so that temporary weapons do not affect the player's ever-had weapon tracking, then cleared again with false.

api.name: SetExcludeTeamForTrigger
api.description: Set the team that this trigger will not react to. Reacts to all other teams.

calledOn.name: trigger
calledOn.description: The trigger to configure.

parameters.name: teamName
parameters.description: The name of the team that the trigger will not respond to. Must be either 'axis', 'allies', 'team3', 'team4', 'team5', 'team6' or 'none'.

remarks: Commonly used on the damage or enemy trigger of a deployed weapon object so that it only reacts to players not on the owner's team.

api.name: SetExpFog
api.description: Creates an exponential fog.

parameters.name: startDist
parameters.description: The distance, in world units, at which the fog begins.

parameters.name: halfwayDist
parameters.description: The distance, beyond the startDist, at which the scene will be 50% fogged.

parameters.name: red
parameters.description: The red component of the fog as a value between 0.0 and 1.0.

parameters.name: green
parameters.description: The green component of the fog as a value between 0.0 and 1.0.

parameters.name: blue
parameters.description: The blue component of the fog as a value between 0.0 and 1.0.

parameters.name: transitionTime
parameters.description: transition time in seconds.

remarks: Art scripts effectively disable fog by passing very large start and halfway distances with a zero transition time.

api.name: SetFakeFire
api.description: Simulates gun fire.  Sound and radar blip.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity to enable or disable fake fire on.

parameters.name: enabled
parameters.description: Whether to enable fake fire.

api.name: SetFixedNodeSafeVolume
api.description: Set this actor's fixed node safe volume.

parameters.name: volumeEntity
parameters.description: (entity) The safe volume entity.

api.name: SetFlashBanged
api.description: Sets whether an actor is under a flashbang effect.

calledOn.name: actor
calledOn.description: The actor to flash or unflash.

parameters.name: flashed
parameters.description: True if the actor is under the effect of a flashbang, false otherwise.

parameters.name: strength
parameters.description: If actor is flashed, how severely they were initially affected. Between 0.0 and 1.0 (full strength).

api.name: SetFlashbangImmunity
api.description: Sets whether an actor is succeptable to flashbangs.

parameters.name: immune
parameters.description: If the actor can be affected by flashbangs.

api.name: SetForceNoCull
api.description: Sets the force-no-cull flag. Entity will not be culled by portals.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity that should never be culled.

remarks: Applied to script models, effects and vehicles that must stay visible when the player is outside the portal that contains them.

api.name: SetFOVForKillcam
api.description: Sets the fov for use with this killcam entity.  Setting it to zero makes it use the default fov.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The killcam entity to set the field of view on.

parameters.name: fov
parameters.description: The fov you want to use for the killcam.

api.name: SetFreeCameraLockOnAllowed
api.description: Sets whether the AI is allowed to be locked onto by the demo free camera.

calledOn.name: actor
calledOn.description: The AI to allow or disallow lock on for.

parameters.name: allowed
parameters.description: True to allow the free camera to lock on, false otherwise.

remarks: Typically disabled while an AI is being spawned or scripted, and re-enabled with true once it is in normal play.

api.name: SetGameEndTime
api.description: Sets the time the current match will end.

parameters.name: time
parameters.description: The absolute time, in milliseconds, at which the match ends, or 0 to stop the timer.

remarks: Called with 0 to stop and hide the match timers.
Gametypes recompute an absolute time from getTime() plus the remaining milliseconds, including after a host migration.

api.name: SetGametypeSetting
api.description: Sets the value of a gametype setting.

parameters.name: setting
parameters.description: The setting name as a string.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: The new value for the setting.

api.name: SetGameTypeString
api.description: Set the game type string for the game.

parameters.name: gameType
parameters.description: A string containing the game type.

api.name: SetGoal
api.description: Sets this AI's goal, which may be a position, node, entity or volume.

calledOn.name: sentient
calledOn.description: The AI whose goal is being set.

parameters.name: pos
parameters.description: The goal to move to: a position, node, entity or volume.

parameters.name: forced
parameters.description: (bool) should go directly to this pos/node/entity. Forced means AI will get within approx 4 units of the entity.

parameters.name: goalradius
parameters.description: radius of the goal. Applicable for entity and position/node and not the volume or forcedGoal.

parameters.name: goalheight
parameters.description: height of the goal. Applicable for entity and position/node and not the volume or forcedGoal.

remarks: By far the most common way to move AI in the corpus, usually with just the goal, and with the forced flag set to 1 when the AI must go directly there.
SetGoalPos, SetGoalNode, SetGoalEntity and SetGoalVolume are alternate names that call into this function.

api.name: Setgoalentity
api.description: Sets this AI's goal to the given entity. This is an alternate name that calls into SetGoal.

calledOn.name: sentient
calledOn.description: The AI whose goal is being set.

parameters.name: pos
parameters.description: The entity to use as the goal.

parameters.name: forced
parameters.description: (bool) should go directly to this pos/node/entity. Forced means AI will get within approx 4 units of the entity.

parameters.name: goalradius
parameters.description: radius of the goal. Applicable for entity and position/node and not the volume or forcedGoal.

parameters.name: goalheight
parameters.description: height of the goal. Applicable for entity and position/node and not the volume or forcedGoal.

api.name: Setgoalnode
api.description: Sets this AI's goal to the given node. This is an alternate name that calls into SetGoal.

calledOn.name: sentient
calledOn.description: The AI whose goal is being set.

parameters.name: pos
parameters.description: The node to use as the goal.

parameters.name: forced
parameters.description: (bool) should go directly to this pos/node/entity. Forced means AI will get within approx 4 units of the entity.

parameters.name: goalradius
parameters.description: radius of the goal. Applicable for entity and position/node and not the volume or forcedGoal.

parameters.name: goalheight
parameters.description: height of the goal. Applicable for entity and position/node and not the volume or forcedGoal.

remarks: Usually passed a node from getNode, with the forced flag set to 1 when the AI must go directly to it.

api.name: Setgoalpos
api.description: Sets this AI's goal to the given position. This is an alternate name that calls into SetGoal.

calledOn.name: sentient
calledOn.description: The AI whose goal is being set.

parameters.name: pos
parameters.description: The position to use as the goal.

parameters.name: forced
parameters.description: (bool) should go directly to this pos/node/entity. Forced means AI will get within approx 4 units of the entity.

parameters.name: goalradius
parameters.description: radius of the goal. Applicable for entity and position/node and not the volume or forcedGoal.

parameters.name: goalheight
parameters.description: height of the goal. Applicable for entity and position/node and not the volume or forcedGoal.

remarks: Commonly passed an entity origin, optionally with a goal radius as the third argument.

api.name: Setgoalvolume
api.description: Sets this AI's goal to the given volume. This is an alternate name that calls into SetGoal.

calledOn.name: sentient
calledOn.description: The AI whose goal is being set.

parameters.name: pos
parameters.description: The volume to use as the goal.

parameters.name: forced
parameters.description: (bool) should go directly to this pos/node/entity. Forced means AI will get within approx 4 units of the entity.

parameters.name: goalradius
parameters.description: radius of the goal. Applicable for entity and position/node and not the volume or forcedGoal.

parameters.name: goalheight
parameters.description: height of the goal. Applicable for entity and position/node and not the volume or forcedGoal.

remarks: Usually passed a volume entity fetched with getEnt, so the AI stays within a defend area.

api.name: Setgoalvolumeauto
api.description: Set this AI 's goal. Any of the above function name will work. They all call into SetGoal function internally.

parameters.name: pos
parameters.description: /<node>/<entity>/<volume>.

parameters.name: forced
parameters.description: (bool) should go directly to this pos/node/entity. Forced means AI will get within approx 4 units of the entity.

parameters.name: goalradius
parameters.description: radius of the goal. Applicable for entity and position/node and not the volume or forcedGoal.

parameters.name: goalheight
parameters.description: height of the goal. Applicable for entity and position/node and not the volume or forcedGoal.

api.name: SetGoalYaw
api.description: Set the goal yaw direction for this vehicle. Goal yaw is ignored if vehicle doesn't stop at goal. Lookat entity has priority over goal yaw.

calledOn.name: vehicle
calledOn.description: The vehicle whose goal yaw is being set.

parameters.name: integer
parameters.description: The yaw direction of the target: 0 to 360 integer value.

remarks: Helicopter scripts commonly derive the yaw from a node's or the vehicle's own angles[1], or randomize it with randomInt( 360 ).

api.name: SetGrapplableType
api.description: Sets how an entity is grappled.

calledOn.name: target
calledOn.description: The entity that the grappleable type should be set on.

parameters.name: grappleType
parameters.description: The grapple type ID, corresponding to an entry in `grapple.gsh`.

api.name: SetGravity
api.description: sets the gravity in inches per second per second.

parameters.name: gravity
parameters.description: The gravity to set.

api.name: SetGunnerTargetEnt
api.description: Set the target entity for this vehicle gunner.

calledOn.name: vehicle
calledOn.description: The vehicle whose gunner is being aimed.

parameters.name: targetEntity
parameters.description: The entity for the gunner to target.

parameters.name: targetOffset
parameters.description: An offset from the target's origin to aim at.

parameters.name: gunnerIndex
parameters.description: Which gun, 0-3.

remarks: Called every time a vehicle gunner acquires a new target, with an offset used to aim above or below the target's origin.
SetGunnerTargetVec is the equivalent for aiming at a fixed position.

api.name: SetGunnerTargetVec
api.description: Set the target position for this vehicle turret gunner.

calledOn.name: vehicle
calledOn.description: The vehicle whose gunner is being aimed.

parameters.name: targetPosition
parameters.description: The position to aim at.

parameters.name: gunnerIndex
parameters.description: which gun 0-3.

remarks: Often paired with GetGunnerTargetVec to point a second turret at the same position as the first.
SetGunnerTargetEnt is the equivalent for tracking an entity.

api.name: SetGunnerTurretOnTargetRange
api.description: Set the range at which the gunner_turret_on_target notify will occur.

calledOn.name: vehicle
calledOn.description: The vehicle whose gunner is being configured.

parameters.name: gunnerIndex
parameters.description: Which gun, 0-3.

parameters.name: range
parameters.description: In degrees.

remarks: Vehicle scripts set this once at spawn from the vehicle's gunner_turret_on_target_range setting.

api.name: SetHeliDogfighting
api.description: Sets the vehicle (intended for VTOLs only) to be in dogfighting mode (dogfights with the vehicle's focus entity).

calledOn.name: vehicle
calledOn.description: The vehicle to put into, or take out of, dogfighting mode.

parameters.name: enabled
parameters.description: true to enable dogfighting, false otherwise.

api.name: SetHeliHeightCap
api.description: Pulls the heli back down below the height mesh.

calledOn.name: vehicle
calledOn.description: The vehicle to enable or disable the height cap on.

parameters.name: enabled
parameters.description: true to enable, false otherwise.

api.name: SetHeliHeightLock
api.description: Locks the heli to the height mesh.

calledOn.name: vehicle
calledOn.description: The vehicle to lock to, or release from, the height mesh.

parameters.name: enabled
parameters.description: true to enable lock, false otherwise.

remarks: Toggled off while a vehicle needs to move freely in height, such as when landing or being controlled by script, and back on afterwards.

api.name: SetHeliHeightPatchEnabled
api.description: Enabled or disables the specified heli height lock path.

parameters.name: targetname
parameters.description: All heli height lock patches with this target name.

parameters.name: enabled
parameters.description: Turn it on or off.

parameters.name: player
parameters.description: The player to modify the setting for; if undefined, it applies to everyone.

remarks: Patches are usually switched as a group, enabling one targetname and disabling the others as the objective changes.
The player argument is passed so the change only applies to that player's vehicle.

api.name: SetHideonClientWhenScriptedAnimCompleted
api.description: Hides the entity on the client once its scripted animation ends.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: The entity to hide once its scripted animation completes.

remarks: Used by the scene system on entities that should disappear when their scripted animation finishes.

api.name: SetHighDetail
api.description: Enables or disables high detail rendering for a model.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity to enable or disable high detail rendering on.

parameters.name: flag
parameters.description: True to enable high detail rendering, false to disable it.

remarks: Mostly applied to hero AI and story props that appear in cinematics, and turned off again with false when they no longer need the extra detail.

api.name: SetHighlighted
api.description: Highlight the player.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player to highlight.

parameters.name: onoff
parameters.description: True to highlight the player, false to stop highlighting.

api.name: SetHintLowPriority
api.description: Sets this as a low priority hint which is lower priority then everything other then turrets and dropped weapons.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The trigger whose hint priority is being set.

parameters.name: bool
parameters.description: True to make this a low priority hint, false otherwise.

remarks: Applied to use triggers on deployed objects such as combat robots, remote weapons and mines so their hint does not override more important ones.

api.name: SetHintString
api.description: Sets a hint string for the given entity.

calledOn.name: trigger
calledOn.description: The trigger entity.

parameters.name: hintString
parameters.description: The hint string that will be displayed to the player.

parameters.name: extraParameters
parameters.description: Additional arguments may be interpolated into the hint string.

api.example: t_door SetHintString( "Press and Hold ^3[{+activate}]^7 to transmit unlock code" )

api.name: SetHintStringForPerk
api.description: Shows this hint string to the player if the player has the specified perk.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity whose hint string is being set.

parameters.name: perk
parameters.description: The perk that the player needs to have to see this hint string.

parameters.name: hintString
parameters.description: The hint string that will be displayed to the player that has the perk.

remarks: Used on supply drop crates so that players with the equipment-detection perk see a different hint string.

api.name: SetHintStringForPlayer
api.description: Sets the trigger hint string for one specific player.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The trigger whose hint string is being set for one player.

parameters.name: player
parameters.description: The player that will see the hint string.

parameters.name: hintString
parameters.description: The hint string that will be displayed to the player.
Additional arguments may be appended to the hint string in the same way as SetHintString.

remarks: The hint string is usually a localized string reference, and passing an empty string clears the hint for that player.
It is typically called on a trigger, including the per-player trigger of a unitrigger.

api.name: SetHostMigrationStatus
api.description: Sets the host migration status.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Whether host migration is in progress.

remarks: The gametype host migration scripts set the status to true when a migration begins and back to false when it ends.

api.name: SetHostMigrationValue
api.description: Sets a host migration value.

parameters.name: statPath1
parameters.description: The first level of the stat path.

parameters.name: statPath2
parameters.description: The second level of the stat path.

parameters.name: statPath3
parameters.description: The third level of the stat path.

parameters.name: statPath4
parameters.description: The fourth level of the stat path.

parameters.name: statPath5
parameters.description: The fifth level of the stat path.

parameters.name: statPath6
parameters.description: The sixth level of the stat path.

parameters.name: statPath7
parameters.description: The seventh level of the stat path.

parameters.name: statPath8
parameters.description: The eighth level of the stat path.

api.name: SetHoverParams
api.description: Set the hovering parameters.

calledOn.name: vehicle
calledOn.description: The hovering vehicle to configure.

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description: The hovering range.

parameters.name: speed
parameters.description: Speed to hover at (MPH).

parameters.name: accel
parameters.description: Acceleration to hover at (MPH/s).

remarks: Hovering vehicles such as drones, helicopters and sentinels set this once during their spawn setup.
A radius of 0 is used when the vehicle should hold its position exactly.

api.name: SetIgnoreEnt
api.description: Set a sentient entity to ignore another specific sentient entity or not.

calledOn.name: sentient
calledOn.description: The sentient that should ignore the other entity.

parameters.name: sentient
parameters.description: The entity to ignore or stop ignoring.

parameters.name: ignored
parameters.description: Whether to ignore the given entity.

remarks: It is applied per pair of entities, so it is called again with false to stop ignoring the other entity.

api.name: SetIgnoreEntForTrigger
api.description: Ignores this entity when doing trigger sight traces. Currently only works for trigger_radius_use.

calledOn.name: trigger
calledOn.description: The trigger whose sight traces should ignore the entity.

parameters.name: entityToIgnore
parameters.description: The entity that will be ignored during sight trace checks.

remarks: The only corpus use is a hacker trigger ignoring the weapon object it belongs to, so the object does not block its own sight trace.

api.name: SetIgnoreMeGroup
api.description: Make first group ignored by second group.

parameters.name: ignoredGroup
parameters.description: The group that will be ignored.

parameters.name: ignoringGroup
parameters.description: The group that will do the ignoring.

remarks: The group names are script-defined threat group names, not team names.

api.name: SetIgnorePauseWorld
api.description: Sets whether a given entity will advance normally when the world is paused.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity to exempt from the world pause.

parameters.name: ignore
parameters.description: Whether or not to advance normally when the world is paused.

remarks: It is applied to entities that must keep running while the world is paused, such as players, scripted models, projectiles and effect emitters.

api.name: SetIncludeMeshes
api.description: Sets a streamer hint entity to include mesh data.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The streamer hint entity to configure.

parameters.description: Whether the hint should include mesh data.

remarks: It is called on a streamer hint entity right after it is created.

api.name: SetInfluenceAt
api.description: Sets the influence value on the influence map, returns true/false if the value was set.

parameters.name: influenceMapIndex
parameters.description: Index of the influence map.

parameters.name: origin
parameters.description: The location to set the influence value.

parameters.name: influence
parameters.description: The influence value to set.

api.name: SetInfluencerTeamMask
api.description: Sets the team mask for the given influencer.

parameters.name: influencerId
parameters.description: The id of the influencer returned when it was created.

parameters.name: teamMask
parameters.description: A bit mask of the teams the influencer applies to.

remarks: The mask is normally built with util::getTeamMask or util::getOtherTeamsMask so an influencer only affects friendly or enemy spawning.

api.name: SetInfluencerTimeout
api.description: Sets the timeout for the influencer in seconds from current time.

parameters.name: influencerId
parameters.description: The id of the influencer returned when it was created.

parameters.name: time
parameters.description: The number of seconds from now at which the influencer expires.

api.name: SetInfraredVision
api.description: Switches using the infrared vision (infrared visionset and thermal characters).

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player whose vision is changed.

parameters.name: isInfraredVision
parameters.description: Whether using infrared vision.

remarks: It is enabled while a player is controlling a remote killstreak and disabled again when that control ends.

api.name: SetInitialPlayersConnected
api.description: Set initialPlayersConnected bool in match state to true.
remarks: Each game mode calls it once during level startup, after the initial players have joined.

api.name: SetInventoryHeldWeapon
api.description: Sets the player's inventoryHeldWeapon.

parameters.name: weapon
parameters.description: The held weapon to be set as inventoryHeldWeapon. Use undefined to clear the inventoryHeldWeapon.

api.name: SetInventoryWeapon
api.description: Set the inventory weapon.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player whose inventory weapon is set.

parameters.name: weapon
parameters.description: The weapon to set, or level.weaponNone to clear it.

remarks: The killstreak scripts set the inventory weapon when a killstreak is granted and clear it with level.weaponNone when it is used or lost.

api.name: SetInvisibleToAll
api.description: Set entity invisible to all players.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity to hide from every player.

remarks: It is commonly used to hide triggers and objective models from every player, and is paired with SetVisibleToAll or SetVisibleToPlayer to bring them back.

api.name: SetInvisibleToPlayer
api.description: Make the entity invisible to the player.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity to hide from the given player.

parameters.name: player
parameters.description: The player to set the entity invisible to.

parameters.name: setInvisible
parameters.description: True if entity has to be invisible to player. False otherwise.

remarks: The second argument is usually omitted, which hides the entity from that player.
It pairs with SetVisibleToPlayer for per-player visibility of models and triggers.

api.name: SetJitterParams
api.description: Set the jitter parameters. Set everything to 0 to stop jittering. Vehicle ignores jitter parameters when on ground.

parameters.name: rangeVector
parameters.description: The jitter range vector.

parameters.name: minPeriod
parameters.description: Minimum time in seconds to switch jitter direction. Default 0.5 sec.

parameters.name: maxPeriod
parameters.description: Maximum time in seconds to switch jitter direction. Default 1.0 sec.

api.example: self SetJitterParams( (0,0,20), 0.5, 1.5 ); // Jitter up or down randomly within 20 units, switching every 0.5 to 1.5 seconds

api.name: SetJumpHeight
api.description: Set the global jump height of all players.  Minimum value of 0, maximum value of 1023.

parameters.name: height_in_inches
parameters.description: The height to jump in inches.

api.name: SetLightColor
api.description: Sets the current color of the light, as an RGB vector.

parameters.name: color
parameters.description: An RGB vector with components in the range 0 to 1. The given values get rounded before they are stored. (vector3).

api.name: SetLightExponent
api.description: Sets the current exponent of the light.

parameters.name: exponent
parameters.description: A new value for the exponent of the light. This should be an integer in the range of 0 to 100. (integer).

api.name: SetLightFovRange
api.description: Sets the current fov range of the light.

parameters.name: fov_outer
parameters.description: A new value for the outer FOV of the light, in degrees. This cannot be larger than the fov when the map was compiled, or less than 1. (float).

parameters.name: fov_inner
parameters.description: A new value for the inner FOV of the light, in degrees. This cannot be larger than fov_outer, or less than 0. If not specified, the map value is used. (float).

api.name: SetLightingOnly
api.description: Sets a streamer hint entity to only hint lighting data.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The streamer hint entity to configure.

parameters.description: Whether the hint should cover lighting data only.

api.name: SetLightingState
api.description: Changes lighting state for the map.

parameters.name: newLightState
parameters.description: new state to change to. Lighting state defaults to 1 at start of game.

api.name: SetLightIntensity
api.description: Sets the current intensity of the light.

parameters.name: intensity
parameters.description: A new value for the intensity of the light. 1 is fullbright, but values can be larger than 1. (float).

api.name: SetLightRadius
api.description: Sets the current radius of the light.

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description: A new value for the radius of the light. This cannot be larger than the radius when the map was compiled. (float).

api.name: SetLocalProfileArrayVar
api.description: Sets a value in a local profile array.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: The profile key.

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: The array index.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: The value to set.

api.name: SetLocalProfileVar
api.description: Sets a variable in the local profile.

parameters.name: varName
parameters.description: The name of the profile variable.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: The value to store.

remarks: It is used for client-side preferences such as first-time flags and tutorial warning counters, and pairs with GetLocalProfileVar.
Integer values are passed as well as strings.

api.name: SetLookAtEnt
api.description: Set the entity this vehicle will orient towards.

calledOn.name: vehicle
calledOn.description: The vehicle that will orient towards the target.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: The entity to orient towards.

remarks: Vehicle scripts set it to the current enemy or turret target so the vehicle faces it while moving.

api.name: SetLookAtOrigin
api.description: Set the origin this vehicle will orient towards.

calledOn.name: vehicle
calledOn.description: The vehicle that will orient towards the position.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: The world position to orient towards.

remarks: It is used in place of SetLookAtEnt when the vehicle should face a fixed world position, such as a charge destination.

api.name: SetLowReady
api.description: set the player into low ready weapon state.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity wielding the weapon.

parameters.name: enable
parameters.description: true to set this state.

remarks: It is enabled while a player is busy with an interaction such as the magic box or a gadget, then disabled again afterwards.

api.name: SetLUIMenuData
api.description: Sets a data value for a given lui menu, the data name has to be precached and the value as well, if its a string.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player whose menu data is set.

parameters.name: luiMenuHandle
parameters.description: handle to the lui menu opened.

parameters.name: luiMenuDataName
parameters.description: precached name string for the data which we're trying to set.

parameters.name: luiMenuDataValue
parameters.description: value for the data which we're trying to set on the menu.

remarks: The handle comes from opening the menu with OpenLUIMenu, or from GetLUIMenu for an already open one.
Values passed are strings, integers and floats depending on the data name.

api.name: SetMantleEnabled
api.description: Sets the mantle enabled flag on the vehicle.

parameters.name: enabled
parameters.description: True to set the mantle enabled, false otherwise.

api.name: SetMapCenter
api.description: Set the center of the map (used by the network code to optimize position data).

parameters.name: mapCenter
parameters.description: The map center.

remarks: Every gametype calls it once during setup with the center computed for the map.

api.name: SetMapNameString
api.description: Set the map name string.

parameters.name: mapName
parameters.description: A string containing the map name.

api.name: SetMatchFlag
api.description: Flags a bit in the match state.

parameters.name: flagBit
parameters.description: The flag bit to change.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: The new value of the bit.

remarks: Flag names seen in the corpus include "bomb_timer", "bomb_timer_a", "final_killcam" and "disableIngameMenu".
The value is an integer, normally 0 or 1.

api.name: SetMatchTalkFlag
api.description: Flags a bit in the match talk state.

parameters.name: flagBit
parameters.description: The flag bit to change.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: The new value of the bit.

remarks: Flag names seen in the corpus include "EveryoneHearsEveryone", "DeadChatWithDead" and "DeadChatWithTeam".

api.name: SetMaxAccelerationScale
api.description: Sets the max acceleration scale for this physics vehicle.

parameters.name: scale
parameters.description: The acceleration scale of the physics vehicle.

remarks: The scale multiplies the vehicle's default acceleration, so scripts often divide a desired value by GetDefaultAcceleration.
It is normally set alongside SetMaxSpeedScale.

api.name: SetmaxHealth
api.description: Sets the max health of this entity.

parameters.name: health
parameters.description: The new max health.

remarks: It is used to raise the health ceiling of spawned entities such as clones, turrets and deployable weapons before their health is set.

api.name: SetMaxPitchRoll
api.description: Sets max pitch and roll angle for this vehicle.

parameters.name: pitch
parameters.description: Max pitch angle.

parameters.name: roll
parameters.description: Max roll angle.

remarks: Helicopter style vehicles set a pitch of 0 when they should only bank, limiting the motion to roll.

api.name: SetMaxSpeedScale
api.description: Sets the max speed scale for this physics vehicle.

parameters.name: scale
parameters.description: The max speed scale of the physics vehicle.

remarks: The scale multiplies the vehicle's default max speed, so scripts often divide a desired speed by GetMaxSpeed.
It is normally set alongside SetMaxAccelerationScale.

api.name: SetMinDesiredTurnYaw
api.description: The vehicle will not update its desired yaw until the min turn yaw is reached. Set it to 0 to clear it.

parameters.name: yaw
parameters.description: The min desired turn yaw to set.

remarks: The only corpus use is the quadtank, which sets it once during its vehicle setup.

api.name: SetMiniMap
api.description: Sets the minimap bounds and material.

parameters.name: material
parameters.description: Sets the material.

parameters.name: upperLeftX
parameters.description: Upper left X value.

parameters.name: upperLeftY
parameters.description: Upper left Y value.

parameters.name: lowerRightX
parameters.description: Lower right X value.

parameters.name: lowerRightY
parameters.description: Lower right Y value.

api.example: SetMiniMap( material, northwest[0], northwest[1], southeast[0], southeast[1] );
remarks: The compass script calls it once with the map corners taken from the minimap corner entities.

api.name: SetMissileBrake
api.description: Tells a remote missile to disable brake.

parameters.name: flag
parameters.description: True to enable or disable missile brake.

remarks: The remote missile script only ever disables the brake, when the missile begins its guided flight.

api.name: SetMissileCoasting
api.description: Tells a remote missile to start coasting at a reduced speed.

parameters.name: flag
parameters.description: True to start coasting at reduced speed.

remarks: The remote missile script enables coasting once the missile has stopped being actively guided.

api.name: SetMissileOwner
api.description: Sets the missile entity owner.

calledOn.name: missile
calledOn.description: The missile whose owner is set.

parameters.description: The player to make the owner of the missile.

remarks: The weapon object script uses it to transfer ownership of a projectile to another player, for example after it is hacked.

api.name: SetMode
api.description: Set the mode of a turret.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: The turret mode. Possible modes are "auto_ai", "manual", "manual_ai" and "auto_nonai.

api.name: SetModel
api.description: Set the model for the entity.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity whose model is set.

parameters.name: modelAlias
parameters.description: Name of the model.

remarks: Passing "tag_origin" gives a script entity no visible geometry, and an empty string clears the model.

api.name: SetModelLodBias
api.description: Sets the model level of detail bias on the player, forcing higher detail models to be used at distance.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player whose model level of detail bias is changed.

parameters.name: bias
parameters.description: The lod bias to apply. A value of 0 reverts to the default model lod bias.

remarks: Killstreak scripts raise the bias while a player is viewing the world from a remote camera, then call it again with 0 to restore the default.

api.name: SetMoveSpeedScale
api.description: Sets the speed scale multiplier for the entity.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity, usually a player, whose movement speed is scaled.

parameters.name: speedScaleMultiplier
parameters.description: The speed scale multiplier, where 1 is normal movement speed.

remarks: Scripts slow or speed up a player by passing a fraction such as 0.3 or 1.2, and restore normal movement by passing 1.
The current value can be read back with GetMoveSpeedScale, which loadout code multiplies by a modifier before setting it again.

api.name: SetMovingPlatformEnabled
api.description: Sets whether the entity should be enabled as a moving platform.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity that should (or should not) be a moving platform.

parameters.name: isEnabled
parameters.description: Whether to enable the moving platform.

api.name: SetNearGoalNotifyDist
api.description: Set distance near goal at which near_goal notification should be sent once.

calledOn.name: vehicle
calledOn.description: The vehicle that will send the near_goal notification.

parameters.name: dist
parameters.description: Distance from the goal position, in world units, at which the notification is sent.

remarks: Vehicle setup functions call this once when the vehicle spawns, so that a "near_goal" notify fires when the vehicle comes within the given distance of its goal.

api.name: SetNemesisXUID
api.description: Sets the Nemesis XUID.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The player whose nemesis XUID is set.

parameters.name: nemesisXuidString
parameters.description: The Nemesis XUID string.

remarks: Match end logic calls this with the XUID stored on the player's persistent data so the nemesis is known to the client.

api.name: SetNodePriority
api.description: Enable or disable the priority for this node.

parameters.name: node
parameters.description: (node) A priority allowed node.

parameters.name: enable
parameters.description: (boolean) True if this node is enabled.

api.name: SetNoLOSOnTargetsHint
api.description: Set target not selected hint.

parameters.name: weapon
parameters.description: : Weapon to use for the event.

api.name: SetNonCheckpointData
api.description: Sets non-checkpoint data for the given key on the player.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: The data key to set.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: The value to store.

remarks: Campaign scripts use it for per-player counters that must survive outside of checkpoint saves, such as "INCAPS", "REVIVES" and "lives".
Keys are sometimes built by concatenation, for example "accolades" plus an index plus "value".

api.name: SetNormalHealth
api.description: Set health of entity. Input health is normalized.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity, usually a player, whose health is set.

parameters.name: normalHealth
parameters.description: Health in normalized form. Range 0 - 1.

remarks: Health overlay and regeneration code computes a fraction of max health and passes it here rather than assigning self.health directly.

api.name: SetNoSunShadow
api.description: Sets the no-sunshadow flag.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity that should stop casting a sun shadow.

remarks: Called once on a spawned model, such as a pickup, to stop it from casting a sun shadow.

api.name: SetNoTargetsHint
api.description: Set target not selected hint.

parameters.name: weapon
parameters.description: : Weapon to use for the event.

api.name: SetObjectivePointStatus
api.description: Objective status set in the match state.

parameters.name: objective_index
parameters.description: The objective index in the matchstate.

parameters.name: team
parameters.description: The team of the objective.

parameters.name: percent
parameters.description: Percentage completed.

api.name: SetOffhandPrimaryClass
api.description: Set whether the player is using a grenade or gear.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player whose primary offhand class is set.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The offhand weapon to set as the primary offhand class.

remarks: Gametype and wager scripts call this when giving a player a new primary offhand so the client knows which offhand class is equipped.

api.name: SetOffhandSecondaryClass
api.description: Set whether the player is using a flash or smoke grenade.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player whose secondary offhand class is set.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The offhand weapon to set as the secondary offhand class.

remarks: Called alongside SetOffhandPrimaryClass when a gametype hands a player a new set of offhand weapons.

api.name: SetOffhandVisible
api.description: Enable or disable visibility of the offhand weapon.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player whose offhand weapon visibility is changed.

parameters.name: onoff
parameters.description: Whether the offhand weapon model is visible.

remarks: Weapon code turns the offhand model on when a grenade is pulled back and off again once the throw, weapon change, death or disconnect ends the sequence.

api.name: SetOnTargetAngle
api.description: Set the angle range at which the turret_on_target notify will occur.

calledOn.name: turret_or_vehicle
calledOn.description: The turret or vehicle whose on-target angle is set.

parameters.name: angle
parameters.description: In degrees (float).

parameters.name: gunnerIndex
parameters.description: Which gun, 0-3.

remarks: Vehicle setup code calls this once so that self.turretontarget becomes true when the turret is aimed within the given angle.
The gunner index is optional; omitting it applies the angle without selecting a specific gun.

api.name: SetOrigin
api.description: Set the player's origin.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player to move.

parameters.name: origin
parameters.description: The world position to move the player to.

remarks: Teleport code commonly pairs this with SetPlayerAngles, passing the origin and angles of a struct or spawn point.

api.name: SetOwner
api.description: Sets the entity owner.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity to set the ownership of. Must not be an actor or player.

parameters.name: owner
parameters.description: The player that owns the entity.

api.name: SetParagonIconId
api.description: Sets the player's paragon icon id.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player whose paragon icon is set.

parameters.name: paragonIconId
parameters.description: the paragon rank id.

remarks: Rank code calls this next to SetParagonRank when applying a player's paragon progression.

api.name: SetParagonRank
api.description: Sets the player's paragon rank.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player whose paragon rank is set.

parameters.name: paragonRankId
parameters.description: the paragon rank id.

remarks: Rank code calls this next to SetParagonIconId when applying a player's paragon progression.

api.name: SetPathTransitionTime
api.description: Set the time it takes for a vehicle to lerp on to a spline.

parameters.name: time
parameters.description: The transition time.

api.name: SetPauseWorld
api.description: pauses playback of animations and effects, but doesn't affect the server tick the way slomo does.

parameters.name: pause
parameters.description: Whether or not to pause the world.

remarks: Calls come in pairs: scripts pause the world around a scene or transition and unpause it with a matching 0 or false call.

api.name: SetPerk
api.description: give the specified perk.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player to give the perk to.

parameters.name: perkName
parameters.description: The name of the perk to give, such as "specialty_gpsjammer".

remarks: Loadout code loops over a player's perk list and calls this once per perk name.
Perk names are the "specialty_" strings, for example "specialty_deadshot" or "specialty_fallheight".

api.name: SetPerkForTrigger
api.description: Set the perk that the player must have for this trigger will react to.

calledOn.name: trigger
calledOn.description: The trigger that will only respond to players holding the perk.

parameters.name: perkName
parameters.description: The name of the perk that the trigger will respond to.

remarks: Used on a trigger created for an equipment item so that only players with the named perk can interact with it.

api.name: SetPerks
api.description: Sets a hud element to be a perks element.

parameters.name: client
parameters.description: client we should be showing the perks of.

api.name: SetPersonalIgnore
api.description: Makes this sentient ignore another sentient for a period of time.

calledOn.name: sentient
calledOn.description: The sentient that should ignore the target.

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: The sentient to ignore.

parameters.name: durationSeconds
parameters.description: An optional ignore duration in seconds. Defaults to a built-in value.

api.name: SetPersonalThreatBias
api.description: Sets a personal threat bias for this sentient versus the other sentient.  It lasts for the given duration.

parameters.name: enemy
parameters.description: The enemy to set threat bias for.

parameters.name: threatBias
parameters.description: The threat bias amount.

parameters.name: duration
parameters.description: How long this threat bias lasts in seconds.

remarks: Large negative biases make the sentient ignore a target for a while, and large positive biases force it to prefer one.
The duration is in seconds and is optional; omitting it is seen in AI scripts that then clear the bias with a later call passing 0.

api.name: SetPhysAcceleration
api.description: Sets the vehicles acceleration vector.

calledOn.name: vehicle
calledOn.description: The vehicle whose physics acceleration is set.

parameters.name: acceleration
parameters.description: The acceleration vector, in world units per second squared.

remarks: Vehicle death and drone scripts use it to apply a downward gravity-like acceleration, and pass ( 0, 0, 0 ) to remove any acceleration.

api.name: SetPhysAngles
api.description: Sets the angles on the phys structure.

calledOn.name: vehicle
calledOn.description: The vehicle whose physics angles are set.

parameters.name: anglesVector
parameters.description: The desired angles.

remarks: Seen only in vehicle death handling, where the desired forward vector is converted with VectorToAngles before being passed in.

api.name: SetPhysParams
api.description: Sets the collision bounds for an actor.

calledOn.name: actor
calledOn.description: The actor whose collision bounds are set.

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description: size of the actor.

parameters.name: minsz
parameters.description: min height of the actor.

parameters.name: maxsz
parameters.description: max height of the actor.

remarks: Zombie and AI spawn setup calls this with a radius of 15 and a height of 0 to 72 for standing actors, or 0 to 24 for crawling and quadruped actors.
It is commonly followed by SetPitchOrient when setting up a quadruped.

api.name: SetPitchOrient
api.description: Set pitch orientation.

calledOn.name: actor
calledOn.description: The actor that should orient its pitch to the surface it moves over.

remarks: Called once during spawn setup for actors that must pitch to follow the ground, such as quadrupeds, dogs and monkeys.

api.name: SetPlacementHint
api.description: Sets the placement hint string that will be displayed for this player.

parameters.name: onoff
parameters.description: true if the hint should say that the weapon can be placed, false if not.

api.name: SetPlaneBarrelRoll
api.description: Set the goal Roll direction for this plane. PLANE_ON_CURVE has priority over ROLL if this is not set.

parameters.name: number
parameters.description: The number of rolls.

parameters.name: time
parameters.description: The goal roll time.

api.name: SetPlaneGoalPos
api.description: Set the target position, speed, angles for this vehicle.

parameters.name: goalPosition
parameters.description: The goal position.

api.name: SetPlayerAngles
api.description: Set the player's view angles.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player whose view angles are set.

parameters.name: angles
parameters.description: The view angles to set.

remarks: Teleport code calls this immediately after SetOrigin, passing the angles of the same struct or spawn point.

api.name: SetPlayerCollision
api.description: Use to turn on off the collision with the player.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity whose collision with players is enabled or disabled.

parameters.name: on_off
parameters.description: Whether players collide with the entity.

remarks: Widely used to let players pass through props, debris and other players, and called again with true to restore collision.

api.name: SetPlayerCurrentObjective
api.description: Sets the current objective information on the player.

parameters.name: objective_index
parameters.description: The objective index in the matchstate.

parameters.name: objective_type
parameters.description: Type of the objective.

api.name: SetPlayerCurrentStreak
api.description: Sets the current kill streak count on the player.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player whose current kill streak count is set.

parameters.name: currentStreak
parameters.description: The current kill streak count.

remarks: Every observed call passes 0, resetting the streak on death, on spawn, or when killstreak progress is cleared.

api.name: SetPlayerGravity
api.description: Sets the gravity override value for the player.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player whose gravity override is set.

parameters.name: gravity
parameters.description: The gravity to set.
