remarks: Used to give a player a custom gravity, for example a low-gravity area, and with 0 while the player is driving.

api.name: SetPlayerIgnoreRadiusDamage
api.description: Set the player to take or ignore radius damage.

parameters.name: flag
parameters.description: true to ignore radius damage, false otherwise.

api.name: SetPlayerNameString
api.description: Set the player name string for a HUD element.

calledOn.name: hud_element
calledOn.description: The hud element that will display the player's name.

parameters.name: player
parameters.description: The player whose name the hud element displays.

remarks: Used by end-of-match hud messages to show the names of the top players in a hud element.

api.name: SetPlayerRenderOptions
api.description: Sets the player render options.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player whose render options are set.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: The player render options.

remarks: Loadout code sets the options computed for a class, and passes 0 to clear them.

api.name: SetPlayerSpread
api.description: Sets the spread of this turret when used by the player.

parameters.name: spread
parameters.description: The spread of the turret in degrees.

api.name: SetPlayerStateLoadoutBonusCards
api.description: Set the player state to have bonus card info, for codcaster to view it.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player whose state is updated with bonus card info.

parameters.name: customClass
parameters.description: The class number of the loadout to publish.

remarks: Called from loadout code next to SetPlayerStateLoadoutWeapons, with the player's current class number.

api.name: SetPlayerStateLoadoutWeapons
api.description: Set the player state to have primary and secondary weapon info, for codcaster to view it.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player whose state is updated with weapon info.

parameters.name: customClass
parameters.description: The class number of the loadout to publish.

remarks: Called from loadout code next to SetPlayerStateLoadoutBonusCards, with the player's current class number.

api.name: SetPotentialThreat
api.description: In non-combat situations. This is mostly useful for friendlies.

parameters.name: dir
parameters.description: direction of the threat. This is the angle from which the NPC should expect danger.

api.name: SetPulseFX
api.description: Set the hudelem string to display with a "Pulse" effect.

calledOn.name: hud_element
calledOn.description: The hud element whose string is displayed with the pulse effect.

parameters.name: speed
parameters.description: Time (in milliseconds) each letter takes to type out.

parameters.name: decayStart
parameters.description: Time to wait before starting the string's decay effect.

parameters.name: decayDuration
parameters.description: How long to spend decaying.

remarks: Hud message code uses a speed of 100 and a decay duration of 1000, with the decay start set to how long the message should stay up.

api.name: SetQoSGameDataPayload
api.description: Sets the Quality of Service game data payload.

api.name: SetRank
api.description: Sets the player's rank, and optionally the prestige level.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player whose rank is being set.

parameters.name: rankId
parameters.description: The rank id.

parameters.name: prestigeLevel
parameters.description: The prestige level.

remarks: The prestige argument is optional; the corpus often calls it with the rank id alone.
Used by the shared rank system when a player levels up, and by bot setup to give bots a rank.

api.name: SetRedactFX
api.description: Set the hudelem string to display with a redact effect.

parameters.name: decayStart
parameters.description: Time to wait before starting the text decay effect.

parameters.name: decayDuration
parameters.description: How long to spend decaying.

parameters.name: redactDecayStart
parameters.description: Time to wait before starting the redact decay effect.

parameters.name: redactDecayDuration
parameters.description: How long to spend decaying.

api.name: SetRepairPaths
api.description: Sets whether pathing is automatically repaired when the AI moves off its predefined path.

calledOn.name: actor
calledOn.description: The actor to change path repairing on.

parameters.name: on_off
parameters.description: Whether to enable repair paths.

remarks: Archetype scripts disable repair paths while an actor is under scripted or custom movement, and re-enable them afterwards.

api.name: SetReviveHintString
api.description: Sets the revive hint string shown on a revive trigger, optionally limited to one team.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The revive trigger to set the hint string on.

parameters.name: hintString
parameters.description: The localized hint string to display.

parameters.name: team
parameters.description: The team to show the hint to.

remarks: Called on the downed player's revive trigger, with a localized string reference and the downed player's team.

api.name: SetRiotshieldFailHint
api.description: Sets the failure hint shown when a riot shield cannot be deployed.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player to show the hint to.

parameters.name: weapon
parameters.description: : Weapon to use for the event.

remarks: The riot shield script calls it on the player with no arguments when shield placement fails.

api.name: SetRotorSpeed
api.description: Sets the rotor speed of a helicopter.

calledOn.name: vehicle
calledOn.description: The helicopter vehicle to set the rotor speed on.

parameters.name: speed
parameters.description: The rotor speed, where 0 is stopped and 1 is full speed.

remarks: Vehicle death and AI scripts spin rotors down to 0 when the helicopter is destroyed or parked, and back up to 1 when it becomes active.

api.name: SetRoundsPlayed
api.description: Sets the number of rounds played in the match state.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: The number of rounds played.

remarks: Game logic passes game["roundsplayed"] in multiplayer, and the current zombies round number in zombies.

api.name: SetSavedDvar
api.description: Sets the value of a persisted dvar.

parameters.name: dvarName
parameters.description: The name of the dvar.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: The value to set.

api.name: SetScale
api.description: Sets the model scale on a script model or script mover.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The script model or mover to scale.

parameters.name: scale
parameters.description: The scale factor.

remarks: Widely used on spawned script models to resize pickups, props and effects, either with a literal factor or a value stored on the entity or struct.

api.name: SetScanningPitch
api.description: Set the pitch that the turret attempts to use while scanning for enemies.

parameters.name: pitch
parameters.description: of the turret (up and down) in degrees.

api.name: SetScoreboardColumns
api.description: Sets the scoreboard's columns.

parameters.name: column1
parameters.description: The first column.

parameters.name: column2
parameters.description: The second column.

parameters.name: column3
parameters.description: The third column.

parameters.name: column4
parameters.description: The fourth column.

parameters.name: column5
parameters.description: The fifth column.

parameters.name: extraColumns
parameters.description: Zero or more additional columns, if required.

api.name: SetScriptMoverFlag
api.description: Sets a script mover flag (0 to 7) on a script mover entity.

calledOn.name: non_player_entity
calledOn.description: The script mover entity to set the flag on.

parameters.description: The flag index to set.

remarks: The riot shield script sets flag 0 on the deployed shield entity, commented as SCRIPTMOVER_FLAG_RIOTSHIELD.

api.name: SetSeatOccupied
api.description: Sets this seat to be occupied/disabled (for players.

parameters.name: seat
parameters.description: 0 driver, 1-4 gunners, 5-10 passengers.

parameters.name: onoff
parameters.description: true to enable, false otherwise.

api.name: SetSessStat
api.description: Sets the indicated stat.

parameters.name: statPath
parameters.description: The path to the stat to set the value for.

api.name: SetShader
api.description: Sets the material of a HUD element, along with its display size.

calledOn.name: hud_element
calledOn.description: The HUD element to set the material on.

parameters.name: materialname
parameters.description: The name of the material to set.

parameters.name: width
parameters.description: The width of the material.

parameters.name: height
parameters.description: The height of the material.

remarks: Nearly every call passes an explicit width and height with the material name.
An empty material name is used with a width and height to create a plain colored bar, such as a debug health bar.

api.name: SetSharedViewPort
api.description: Sets the view mode to shared or independent. Shared combines all views into a single viewport, changes how input is handled, and puts the camera into scripted camera mode.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: Whether to use a shared viewport, false for default splitscreen behavior.

remarks: Dead Ops enables the shared viewport for its single shared camera and turns it off temporarily around certain pickups.

api.name: SetSkipTos
api.description: Sets the current skipto for the campaign skipto system.

parameters.name: skipto
parameters.description: The skipto name.

remarks: Called with a lowercased skipto name, and with an empty string to clear the current skipto.

api.name: SetSlowMotion
api.description: Sets the current slow motion timescale interpolation.

parameters.name: startTimescale
parameters.description: The initial timescale.

parameters.name: endTimescale
parameters.description: The final timescale. Default to 1.

parameters.name: deltaTime
parameters.description: The time to go from start to end timescale. Default to 1. (in seconds).

remarks: Killcams ramp from 1.0 down to 0.25 and then back up to 1.0 to restore normal speed.
Host migration uses SetSlowMotion( 1, 1, 0 ) to snap the timescale back to normal instantly.

api.name: SetSpawnClientFlag
api.description: Sets a flag on a client's spawn client data in the spawning system.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player whose spawn client data is being flagged.

parameters.name: flag
parameters.description: The flag to set, given by name.

remarks: The only observed use is the tactical insertion script setting "SCDFL_DISABLE_LOGGING" on the spawning player.

api.name: SetSpawnPointRandomVariation
api.description: Random value will be added into the spawn point weighting calculation.

parameters.name: variation
parameters.description: random range will be [0, variation].

api.name: SetSpawnPointsBaseWeight
api.description: Applies an additional spawn score to spawn points that face a given objective position within an angle.

parameters.name: teamMask
parameters.description: The mask of teams this command affects.

parameters.name: objectivePosition
parameters.description: The objective position used in the facing calculation.

parameters.name: angle
parameters.description: The maximum accepted angle.

parameters.name: score
parameters.description: The additional score to apply.

api.example: SetSpawnPointsBaseWeight( util::getOtherTeamsMask( team ), trigger.origin, facing_angle, level.spawnsystem.objective_facing_bonus );
remarks: Capture the Flag builds the team mask with util::getOtherTeamsMask and uses the flag trigger's origin as the objective position.

api.name: SetSpawnWeapon
api.description: Sets the weapon that this player will spawn with.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player whose spawn weapon should be changed.

parameters.name: weapon
parameters.description: The weapon to spawn with.

parameters.name: switchImmediate
parameters.description: Whether to switch to the spawn weapon immediately.

remarks: The native decomp clearly confirms the weapon argument and selecting the weapon immediately.
An optional switchImmediate boolean is documented based on observed script usage.

api.name: SetSpeed
api.description: Sets the target speed, and optionally the acceleration and deceleration, for this vehicle.

calledOn.name: vehicle
calledOn.description: The vehicle to set the speed on.

parameters.name: speed
parameters.description: The speed of the vehicle in miles per hour.

parameters.name: acceleration
parameters.description: The acceleration of the vehicle in miles per hour per second.

parameters.name: deceleration
parameters.description: Deceleration. If not specified, set to be equal to half of accleration.

remarks: Very commonly called with speed alone; acceleration and deceleration are added when a smooth ramp is wanted.
Passing 0 brings the vehicle to a stop over its deceleration, while SetSpeedImmediate changes the speed instantly.

api.name: SetSpeedImmediate
api.description: Sets the speed and acceleration for this vehicle instantly, in the goal direction if there is a goal and otherwise the current direction.

calledOn.name: vehicle
calledOn.description: The vehicle to set the speed on.

parameters.name: speed
parameters.description: The speed of the vehicle in miles per hour.

parameters.name: acceleration
parameters.description: The acceleration of the vehicle in miles per hour per second.

parameters.name: deceleration
parameters.description: Deceleration. If not specified, set to be equal to half of accleration.

remarks: Most calls pass 0 to stop a vehicle dead, without the ramp that SetSpeed would apply.

api.name: SetSpreadOverride
api.description: Set the player's aim spread.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: The value to set.

api.name: SetSprintCooldown
api.description: Sets the player's sprint cooldown duration.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player to set the sprint cooldown on.

parameters.name: duration
parameters.description: The cooldown duration in seconds.

remarks: Team and player setup scripts pair it with SetSprintDuration, passing 0 to remove any cooldown between sprints.

api.name: SetSprintDuration
api.description: Sets how long the player can sprint for.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player to set the sprint duration on.

parameters.name: duration
parameters.description: The sprint duration in seconds.

remarks: Player setup routines call it with 4 seconds and follow it with SetSprintCooldown, while special states such as power ups use much longer durations.

api.name: SetStableMissile
api.description: Set the stable missile flag of the entity.

parameters.name: flag
parameters.description: Set to true if the stable flag should be set. False otherwise.

api.name: SetStairsExitTransform
api.description: Sets the base transform for the exit stairs animation using the current position in the looping animation.

calledOn.name: actor
calledOn.description: The actor leaving the stairs animation.

remarks: Called on the behavior tree entity from the locomotion archetype utility when leaving a stairs traversal.

api.name: SetStance
api.description: Sets the stance of the player.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player to set the stance on.

parameters.name: stance
parameters.description: The stance to set, one of "crouch", "prone" or "stand".

remarks: Only "stand", "crouch" and "prone" are used in the corpus, most often to force a player upright after a scripted sequence.

api.name: SetStealthSight
api.description: Sets the stealth sight parameters used for a given awareness level.

parameters.name: awareness
parameters.description: "unaware", "low_alert", "high_alert", or "combat".

parameters.name: timeDecay
parameters.description: float value of seconds stealth sight takes to fall off completely (0 for never/infinite).

parameters.name: timeDistMin
parameters.description: float value of seconds stealth sight takes to grow completely at min range (0 for never/infinite).

parameters.name: timeDistMax
parameters.description: float value of seconds stealth sight takes to grow completely at max range (0 for never/infinite).

parameters.name: distMin
parameters.description: float value of the min distance.

parameters.name: distMax
parameters.description: float value of the max distance.

parameters.name: extendSight
parameters.description: indicates of sight continues beyond max range at the max rate.

remarks: The stealth level script configures all four awareness levels up front, with higher alert levels growing sight faster and at longer range.

api.name: SetStealthSightAwareness
api.description: Sets the current stealth sight awareness state for this sentient.

calledOn.name: sentient
calledOn.description: The sentient whose awareness state is being set.

parameters.name: awareness
parameters.description: "unaware", "low_alert", "high_alert", "combat", or undefined to disable it (default disabled).

parameters.name: decayEnabled
parameters.description: if true stealth sight will decay when other sentient is not in sight (default true).

remarks: The stealth awareness script passes the sentient's current awareness level and toggles decay as stealth mode changes.
The awareness names match those configured through SetStealthSight.

api.name: SetStealthSightValue
api.description: Sets the current stealth sight value this sentient has for another sentient, from 0.0 to 1.0.

calledOn.name: sentient
calledOn.description: The sentient doing the seeing.

parameters.name: otherSentient
parameters.description: The other sentient to set the value for.

parameters.name: newValue
parameters.description: The new stealth sight value, from 0.0 to 1.0.

remarks: The stealth awareness script uses 0 to forget a target and 1 to treat it as fully seen.

api.name: SetSteeringMode
api.description: Sets the steering mode for the actor.

calledOn.name: actor
calledOn.description: The actor to set the steering mode on.

parameters.name: steeringMode
parameters.description: The steering mode, one of "normal steering", "slow steering" or "vignette steering".

remarks: The human archetype switches between "normal steering" and "vignette steering", and escort robots use "slow steering".

api.name: SetStowedWeapon
api.description: Sets the weapon shown stowed on the player's back.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The player to set the stowed weapon on.

parameters.name: weaponName
parameters.description: The weapon name to attach (string).

remarks: Called with a weapon object rather than a weapon name string, and with level.weaponNone to clear the stowed weapon.

api.name: SetSunShadowSplitDistance
api.description: Sets the sun shadow split distance for the player.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player to set the split distance for.

parameters.name: distance
parameters.description: split distance. Setting of 0 reverts to the default split distance.

remarks: Applied per player from a value stored on the player in the shared utility script.

api.name: SetSwitchNode
api.description: Sets a switch node pair for this vehicle, so it changes from one path node onto another.

calledOn.name: vehicle
calledOn.description: The vehicle to set the switch node on.

parameters.name: sourceNode
parameters.description: The switch source node.

parameters.name: destNode
parameters.description: The switch destination node.

remarks: Used to detour a vehicle onto another path, for example choosing a train junction between stations.

api.name: SetTacticalWheel
api.description: Sets whether this player will be able to use the cybercom tactical wheel or not.

parameters.name: enabled
parameters.description: turn on or off.

api.name: SetTargetAlreadyInUseHint
api.description: Sets the hint shown when the target is already in use.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player to show the hint to.

parameters.name: weapon
parameters.description: The weapon to use for the event.

remarks: The cybercom targeting code selects one of several hint builtins by failure reason, passing the targeting weapon.

api.name: SetTargetAlreadyTargetedHint
api.description: Sets the hint shown when the target is already being targeted.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player to show the hint to.

parameters.name: weapon
parameters.description: The weapon to use for the event.

remarks: The cybercom targeting code selects one of several hint builtins by failure reason, passing the targeting weapon.

api.name: SetTargetedEntityEndTime
api.description: Sets the end time of the currently targeted entity, for display on the client side in the UI.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player whose targeting UI is updated.

parameters.name: weapon
parameters.description: The weapon (player should have this weapon).

parameters.name: endtime
parameters.description: The end time of the targeted entity.

remarks: The heat seeking missile script sets the target's killstreak end time while locking on, and passes 0 to clear it.
Usually paired with SetTargetedMissilesRemaining for the same weapon.

api.name: SetTargetedMissilesRemaining
api.description: Sets the number of missiles still needed to destroy the target, for display on the client side in the UI.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player whose targeting UI is updated.

parameters.name: weapon
parameters.description: The weapon (player should have this weapon).

parameters.name: missilesRemaining
parameters.description: The amount of missiles remaining to destroy the target.

remarks: The heat seeking missile script updates it as hits land, and passes 0 when there is no target.
Usually paired with SetTargetedEntityEndTime for the same weapon.

api.name: SetTargetEnt
api.description: Sets the entity that this waypoint or head icon should follow. In multiplayer the entity should already be a broadcasting entity, as with Objective_OnEntity.

calledOn.name: hud_element
calledOn.description: The waypoint or head icon to point at the entity.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: The entity to target.

remarks: Used to attach head icons and objective points to a moving entity, such as the current flag carrier.

api.name: SetTargetEntity
api.description: Sets the entity that this turret aims at.

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: The entity to target.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: The offset from the target position.

parameters.name: turretIndex
parameters.description: The turret index.

remarks: Turret scripts pick a target from a list of manual targets and re-issue the call whenever the target changes.
Passing an offset aims at a point relative to the target's origin.

api.name: SetTargetingAbortedHint
api.description: Sets the hint shown when targeting is aborted.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player to show the hint to.

parameters.name: weapon
parameters.description: The weapon to use for the event.

remarks: The cybercom targeting code selects one of several hint builtins by failure reason, passing the targeting weapon.

api.name: SetTargetOORHint
api.description: Sets the hint shown when the target is out of range.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player to show the hint to.

parameters.name: weapon
parameters.description: The weapon to use for the event.

remarks: The cybercom targeting code selects one of several hint builtins by failure reason, passing the targeting weapon.

api.name: SetTargetOrigin
api.description: Sets the target origin of this turret or vehicle weapon.

calledOn.name: turret_or_vehicle
calledOn.description: The turret or vehicle weapon to aim.

parameters.name: origin
parameters.description: The world position for the turret to target.

remarks: Turret and vehicle scripts recompute a target vector each frame and feed it straight to this function.

api.name: SetTargetWrongTypeHint
api.description: Set target validity failure hint.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player to show the hint to.

parameters.name: weapon
parameters.description: The weapon to use for the event.

api.name: SetTargetYaw
api.description: Set the target yaw direction for this vehicle. Goal yaw has priority over target yaw.

calledOn.name: vehicle
calledOn.description: The vehicle to set the target yaw on.

parameters.name: yaw
parameters.description: The yaw direction of the target.

remarks: Killstreak vehicles pass their own current yaw plus a speed dependent offset to make the vehicle bank into a turn.

api.name: SetTeam
api.description: Sets the entity team.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity to assign to a team.

parameters.name: team
parameters.description: The team to assign the entity to.

api.name: SetTeamForTrigger
api.description: Set the team that this trigger will react to.

calledOn.name: trigger
calledOn.description: The trigger to set the team on.

parameters.name: teamName
parameters.description: The name of the team that the trigger will respond to. Must be either 'axis', 'allies', 'team3' or 'none'.

remarks: Scripts pass "none" for triggers that any player may use, or a player's .team so that only that team can use the trigger.

api.name: SetTeamSatellite
api.description: Sets whether a team has Spyplane or not.

parameters.name: team
parameters.description: The name of a team. Must be either Must be 'axis', 'allies', 'team3' or 'none'.

parameters.name: availability
parameters.description: Whether the team has Satellite; defaults to false.

remarks: Called whenever the count of a team's active satellites changes, so the state is recomputed rather than toggled.

api.name: SetTeamScore
api.description: Set a team's score.

parameters.name: team
parameters.description: The name of a team. Must be either 'axis' or 'allies' or 'team3'.

parameters.name: score
parameters.description: The new team score.

remarks: The game logic keeps the authoritative score in game["teamScores"] and calls this to push it to the engine.

api.name: SetTeamSpyplane
api.description: Sets whether a team has Spyplane or not.

parameters.name: team
parameters.description: The name of a team. Must be either Must be 'axis', 'allies', 'team3' or 'none'.

parameters.name: availability
parameters.description: Whether the team has Spyplane; defaults to false.

remarks: The UAV script passes the clamped count of active spyplanes for the team rather than a plain on or off value.

api.name: SetTenthsTimer
api.description: Set a timer HUD element to count down in tenths of a second.

parameters.name: time
parameters.description: The new timer time.

api.name: SetTenthsTimerUp
api.description: Set a timer HUD element to count up in tenths of a second.

parameters.name: time
parameters.description: The new timer time.

api.name: SetText
api.description: Set HUD text for this element.

calledOn.name: element
calledOn.description: The HUD text element to set the text of.

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: A localized string to set as the text.

parameters.name: extraParameters
parameters.description: If the text is localized, this can be used to interpolate additional values into the resulting text.

api.name: SetThreatBias
api.description: Set threat bias of second group against first group.

parameters.name: againstGroup
parameters.description: (string) threat bias group against.

parameters.name: forGroup
parameters.description: (string) threat bias group for.

parameters.name: threatBias
parameters.description: (int) threat bias value.

remarks: Level scripts usually call it in both directions for a pair of groups, and use large magnitudes (thousands) to make one group effectively ignore or fixate on the other.

api.name: SetThreatBiasAgainstAll
api.description: Set the threatbias a group has against all others.

parameters.name: group
parameters.description: (string) threat bias group name.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: (int) threat bias value.

api.name: SetThreatBiasGroup
api.description: Set or clear threat bias group of an AI or player.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The AI or player to place in a threat bias group.

parameters.name: threat_bias_group
parameters.description: (string) threat bias group name. If none, remove actor from current threat bias group.

remarks: The group names are arbitrary script defined strings that must match the ones passed to SetThreatBias.
It is called on players as well as AI, typically right after spawn.

api.name: SetTimer
api.description: Set a timer HUD element to count down.

calledOn.name: hud_timer_element
calledOn.description: The HUD element to display the countdown on.

parameters.name: time
parameters.description: The new timer time.

api.name: SetTimerUp
api.description: Set a timer HUD element to count up.

parameters.name: time
parameters.description: The new timer time.

api.name: SetTmodeProvider
api.description: Enables (or disables) the actor to provide tmode traces to the player.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The actor to enable or disable as a tmode provider.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: (int) 1-enable 0-disable.

remarks: Campaign scripts enable it on hero AI and disable it again with a matching call passing 0.

api.name: SetTopDownCameraYaw
api.description: Set the top down camera yaw that is used in DOA to get the player controls to work correctly in bgpmove.

parameters.name: yaw_angle
parameters.description: The yaw angle to set.

remarks: Only the Dead Ops Arcade scripts use it, and only with 0 or 180 as the arena orientation changes.

api.name: SetTopScorer
api.description: Sets the top scorer for the end game screen.

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: position [0..2] of the player.

parameters.name: player
parameters.description: player who is the top scorer.

parameters.name: taunt
parameters.description: players selected taunt index.

parameters.name: gesture0
parameters.description: players selected gesture type 0 index.

parameters.name: gesture1
parameters.description: players selected gesture type 1 index.

parameters.name: gesture2
parameters.description: players selected gesture type 2 index.

parameters.name: weapon
parameters.description: players weapon.

parameters.name: weaponRenderOptions
parameters.description: players weapon renderoptions.

parameters.name: acvi
parameters.description: players attachment cosmetic variant indexes.

api.example: SetTopScorer( i, player, tauntIndex, gesture0Index, gesture1Index, gesture2Index, GetWeapon( "ar_standard" ) );
remarks: The end of match logic calls it once per podium position, passing zeros and level.weaponNone when no taunt, gesture or showcase weapon is available.

api.name: SetTurningAbility
api.description: If this is higher, helicopters can make sharper turns to match goal positions better.

calledOn.name: vehicle
calledOn.description: The vehicle to set the turning ability on.

parameters.name: turningAbility
parameters.description: Between 0.001 and 1.0. Defaults to 0.5.

api.name: SetTurretAccuracy
api.description: Currently does nothing.

api.name: SetTurretCarried
api.description: Sets whether a turret is being carried.

parameters.name: flag
parameters.description: True if the turret is being carried.

api.name: SetTurretMinimapVisible
api.description: Sets whether a turret is visible on the minimap.

parameters.name: flag
parameters.description: True if the turret is visible on the minimap.

api.name: SetTurretNode
api.description: Set this turretnode to use this turret.

parameters.name: node
parameters.description: The turret node to connect to the turret.

parameters.name: turret
parameters.description: The turret to connect to the node.

api.name: SetTurretOwner
api.description: Sets the turret entity owner.

api.name: SetTurretSpinning
api.description: Set the minigun spin for the turret on this entity. Works for vehicles also.

calledOn.name: turret
calledOn.description: The turret or vehicle whose turret should spin.

parameters.name: onoff
parameters.description: Turn it on or off (boolean).

remarks: Vehicle and turret scripts spin the barrel up when a target is acquired and call it again with false when the turret goes idle or is destroyed.

api.name: SetTurretTargetEnt
api.description: Set the target entity for this vehicle turret.

calledOn.name: vehicle
calledOn.description: The vehicle whose turret should track the target.

parameters.name: targetEntity
parameters.description: The target.

parameters.name: targetOffset
parameters.description: The target offset.

remarks: Scripts commonly pass a small upward offset so the turret aims at the target's torso rather than its origin.
SetTurretTargetVec is used instead when the aim point is a plain position with no entity to track.

api.name: SetTurretTargetRelativeAngles
api.description: Sets the target angles for this vehicle turret, relative to the vehicle's own angles.

calledOn.name: vehicle
calledOn.description: The vehicle whose turret should be aimed.

parameters.name: relativeAngles
parameters.description: The target angle.

parameters.name: turretIndex
parameters.description: 0 for turret, 1-4 for gunners.

remarks: Passing (0, 0, 0) recenters the turret so that it points straight forward relative to the vehicle.
The optional index selects which turret is aimed, which vehicles with gunner turrets use.

api.name: SetTurretTargetVec
api.description: Set the target position for this vehicle turret.

calledOn.name: vehicle
calledOn.description: The vehicle whose turret should be aimed.

parameters.name: targetPosition
parameters.description: The position of the target.

remarks: Used in place of SetTurretTargetEnt when the turret should hold a fixed world position, for example the last known position of a lost target.

api.name: SetTurretType
api.description: Sets the turret Type, Sentry or TOW.

calledOn.name: turret
calledOn.description: The turret to set the type on.

parameters.description: The turret type to use.

api.name: SetTypewriterFX
api.description: Set the hudelem string to display with a redact effect.

parameters.name: letterTime
parameters.description: Time it take for each letter to type in.

parameters.name: decayStart
parameters.description: Time to wait before starting the text decay effect.

parameters.name: decayDuration
parameters.description: How long to spend decaying.

api.name: SetupFieldOpsKitLoadouts
api.description: Sets up all the field ops custom classes (using slots 6 through 9).

parameters.name: mapname
parameters.description: The map to load the field ops kits for.

api.name: SetValue
api.description: Set a value HUD element to a given value.

calledOn.name: hud_value_element
calledOn.description: The HUD element to set the value on.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: The value to set the element to.

remarks: Widely used to refresh a numeric HUD element in place, including with string values for text elements.

api.name: SetVehGoalPos
api.description: Set the target position for this vehicle. Returns true if it can find a path.  If it fails to find a path the vehicle will be stopped.

calledOn.name: vehicle
calledOn.description: The vehicle to move.

parameters.name: goalpos
parameters.description: The goal position.

parameters.name: stopAtGoal
parameters.description: Whether the vehicle should slow down to stop at the goal position.

parameters.name: usepath
parameters.description: set to 1 to use pathfinding.

remarks: Scripts that enable pathfinding test the return value and pick a different destination when it comes back false.
Vehicles then wait on the "goal" notify to know that they arrived.

api.name: SetVehicleAvoidance
api.description: Turns on and off vehicle avoidance.

calledOn.name: vehicle
calledOn.description: The vehicle to enable or disable avoidance on.

parameters.name: enabled
parameters.description: True to enable avoidance, false otherwise.

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description: The avoidance radius.

parameters.name: priority
parameters.description: Vehicles will avoid everything that is the same priority or higher.  Default priority is 1.

remarks: Mod tools scripts note that this is ORCA avoidance, and drones enable it once at spawn without passing a radius or priority.

api.name: SetVehicleDamageMeter
api.description: Sets the vehicle damage meter.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player driving the vehicle.

parameters.name: damage
parameters.description: the amount of damage normalized 0..1.

remarks: Called on the driving player with the damage the vehicle has taken divided by its maximum health.

api.name: SetVehicleDrivableDuration
api.description: Sets the drivable duration for the players vehicle (intended for use with client side display purposes).

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player driving the vehicle.

parameters.name: duration
parameters.description: the drivable duration in milliseconds.

remarks: Set alongside SetVehicleDrivableEndTime so the client can display how much drive time is left.

api.name: SetVehicleDrivableEndTime
api.description: Sets the vehicle drivable end time.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player driving the vehicle.

parameters.name: endTime
parameters.description: the drivable end time in milliseconds.

remarks: Set immediately after SetVehicleDrivableDuration, with the end time computed from the current game time plus that duration.

api.name: SetVehicleFocusEntity
api.description: Sets the focus entity for a player driven vehicle (currently only supported by helicopters).  This will attempt to make the vehicle orient towards the focus target.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player driving the vehicle.

parameters.name: focusEntity
parameters.description: The entity to focus on.

remarks: Passing undefined clears the current focus entity.

api.name: SetVehicleForDropDeploy
api.description: Set vehicle properties so that it can be dropped into a map.

calledOn.name: vehicle
calledOn.description: The vehicle to prepare for a drop deploy.

api.name: SetVehicleLockedOnByEnt
api.description: Sets the vehicle locked on by entity.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player driving the vehicle.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: an entity that acquired a missile lock on the player's vehicle.

remarks: The vehicle script picks the closest attacker holding a lock and reports it to the driving player.

api.name: SetVehicleManualControl
api.description: Turns on and off vehicle hkai behavior. Not to be confused with UseVehicle().

parameters.name: enabled
parameters.description: True to enable vehicle  hkai behavior, false otherwise.

api.name: SetVehicleType
api.description: Sets the vehicles type.

calledOn.name: vehicle
calledOn.description: The vehicle to change the type of.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: The type name.

remarks: Killstreak scripts swap a vehicle to its player driven variant when a player takes control, then restore the value they stored in .original_vehicle_type afterwards.

api.name: SetVehicleWeaponWaitDuration
api.description: Sets the weapon wait duration for the players vehicle (intended for use with client side display purposes).

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player driving the vehicle.

parameters.name: duration
parameters.description: the weapon reload (or recharge) duration in milliseconds.

remarks: Always paired with SetVehicleWeaponWaitEndTime on the same player so the client can draw a reload meter.

api.name: SetVehicleWeaponWaitEndTime
api.description: Sets the vehicle weapon wait end time.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player driving the vehicle.

parameters.name: endTime
parameters.description: the weapon wait end time in milliseconds.

remarks: Called right after SetVehicleWeaponWaitDuration, with GetTime plus the same duration.

api.name: SetVehMaxSpeed
api.description: Overrides the maximum speed for this vehicle.

calledOn.name: vehicle
calledOn.description: The vehicle to override the maximum speed on.

parameters.name: speed
parameters.description: The speed to set.

remarks: Passing 0 is used to hold a vehicle in place, and the original value is restored from a script variable afterwards.

api.name: SetVehVelocity
api.description: Sets the linear velocity of this vehicle.

calledOn.name: vehicle
calledOn.description: The vehicle to set the velocity on.

parameters.name: velocity
parameters.description: The vehicle velocity.

remarks: Scripts read self.velocity and write back a modified vector to add an impulse, or pass (0, 0, 0) to stop the vehicle dead.

api.name: SetVehWeapon
api.description: Set the vehicle's weapon.

calledOn.name: vehicle
calledOn.description: The vehicle to set the weapon on.

parameters.name: weaponName
parameters.description: The name of the weapon.

remarks: Used to swap a vehicle between firing modes, for example between the straight and arcing rocket pods of the quadtank.

api.name: SetVelocity
api.description: Set the velocity of the player.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player to set the velocity on.

parameters.name: velocity
parameters.description: The velocity to set.

remarks: Commonly used to push a player away from a blast or up from a jump pad, combining the result of GetVelocity with an added direction vector.
Passing (0, 0, 0) brings the player to an immediate stop.

api.name: SetViewAngleResistance
api.description: Sets the zones in the player's view cone in which resistance will be applied in the direction of the view limit.

parameters.name: rightArc
parameters.description: Angle to resist against the right plane of the view cone.

parameters.name: leftArc
parameters.description: Angle to resist against the left plane of the view cone.

parameters.name: topArc
parameters.description: Angle to resist against the top plane of the view cone.

parameters.name: bottomArc
parameters.description: Angle to resist against the bottom plane of the view cone.

parameters.name: snapTo
parameters.description: false when the resistance will be blended to over time. True by default.

api.name: SetViewClamp
api.description: Set the view clamp for the player, which only works during `AnimScripted`.  Ranges are relative to tag_camera.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player to set the view clamp on.

parameters.name: right
parameters.description: The right view clamp.

parameters.name: left
parameters.description: The left view clamp.

parameters.name: top
parameters.description: The top view clamp.

parameters.name: bottom
parameters.description: The bottom view clamp.

api.name: SetViewModelDepthOfField
api.description: Set the view model depth of field of the player.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: Start DOF ( >= 0 ).

parameters.name: end
parameters.description: End DOF ( >= 0 ).

api.name: SetVisibleToAll
api.description: Makes the entity visible to all players, undoing any per player or per team visibility restriction.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity to make visible to everyone.

remarks: Commonly used to reset a trigger or model that was previously restricted with SetVisibleToPlayer or SetVisibleToTeam.

api.name: SetVisibleToAllExceptTeam
api.description: Makes the entity visible to every team except the given team.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity to hide from the given team.

parameters.name: team
parameters.description: The team that should not see this entity.

remarks: Used on placed weapons and equipment so the owning or ignored team cannot see them.
Pairs with SetVisibleToTeam and SetVisibleToAll.

api.name: SetVisibleToPlayer
api.description: Makes the entity visible only to the given player.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity to restrict to a single player.

parameters.name: player
parameters.description: The player who should see this entity.

remarks: Applied to triggers, models, sound entities and effect handles so only one player perceives them.
Call SetVisibleToAll on the entity to lift the restriction.

api.name: SetVisibleToTeam
api.description: Makes the entity visible only to the given team.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity to restrict to a single team.

parameters.name: team
parameters.description: The team that should see this entity.

remarks: Pairs with SetVisibleToAllExceptTeam, which restricts the entity the other way around.

api.name: SetVisionSetForPlayer
api.description: Applies a server side vision set override to the player, transitioning over the given time.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player.

parameters.name: visionsetName
parameters.description: The name of the vision set to transition into.

parameters.name: transitionTime
parameters.description: How long, in seconds, the transition should take.

remarks: Typically called when a player enters or leaves a special view such as a drone or mortar camera, with a matching call to restore the previous vision set.

api.name: SetVolFog
api.description: Sets the level's exponential height fog parameters.

parameters.name: startDist
parameters.description: The start distance of the fog.

parameters.name: halfwayDist
parameters.description: The halfway distance of the fog.

parameters.name: halfwayHeight
parameters.description: The halfway height of the fog.

parameters.name: baseHeight
parameters.description: The base height of the fog.

parameters.name: colorR
parameters.description: The red component of the fog color.

parameters.name: colorG
parameters.description: The green component of the fog color.

parameters.name: colorB
parameters.description: The blue component of the fog color.

parameters.name: maxOpacity
parameters.description: The maximum opacity of the fog.

api.example: SetVolFog( level.fognearplane, level.fogexphalfplane, level.fogexphalfheight, level.fogbaseheight, r, g, b, 0.4 );
remarks: Called at level load and from art setup scripts, usually with values stored on level.
The color components are supplied as normalized values rather than 0 to 255.

api.name: SetVoteNoCount
api.description: Sets the number of No votes.

parameters.name: noCount
parameters.description: Number of 'no' votes.

api.name: SetVoteString
api.description: Sets the string for a vote.

parameters.name: string
parameters.description: The vote string.

api.name: SetVoteTime
api.description: Sets the start time for a vote.

parameters.name: time
parameters.description: The vote time in ms.

api.name: SetVoteYesCount
api.description: Sets the number of Yes votes.

parameters.name: noCount
parameters.description: Number of 'yes' votes.

api.name: SetWarGameData
api.description: Creates a WAR specific HUD progress element.

parameters.name: momentumProgress
parameters.description: , <momentumMultiplier>, <momentumBlitzkriegTime>.

api.name: SetWaterDrops
api.description: Sets the number of water drops shown on the player's view.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player to set the water drop count on.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Number of water drops (should be >= 0).

remarks: Called with zero to clear the effect when the player leaves the water.

api.name: SetWaveWaterGeneratorAmplitude
api.description: Sets the wave water amplitude of the generator.

parameters.name: generatorName
parameters.description: The generator name.

parameters.name: amplitude
parameters.description: The amplitude for the generator.

api.name: SetWayPoint
api.description: Turns a hud element into a waypoint, optionally with an offscreen material and distance display.

calledOn.name: hud_element
calledOn.description: The hud element to turn into a waypoint.

parameters.name: constantSize
parameters.description: Whether the hud element keeps a constant size on screen.

parameters.name: offscreenMaterialName
parameters.description: The material to draw when the waypoint is offscreen.

parameters.name: isDistanceShown
parameters.description: Whether the distance to the waypoint is displayed above it.

parameters.name: noOffscreen
parameters.description: Whether to suppress the offscreen arrow indicators.

remarks: Used on objective points, head icons and death icons after the hud element is created.
Most call sites pass only the constant size flag, with the offscreen material given for objective style waypoints.

api.name: SetWeapon
api.description: Sets the weapon associated with a non player entity.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity to set the weapon on.

parameters.name: weapon
parameters.description: The weapon to set.

remarks: Mostly used on killcam entities so the killcam reports the correct weapon, and on projectiles and props that need a weapon.
Often paired with SetWeaponOptions to apply the weapon's cosmetic options.

api.name: SetWeaponAmmoClip
api.description: Sets the ammo currently in the given weapon's clip for the player.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player whose weapon ammo is being set.

parameters.name: weapon
parameters.description: The weapon whose clip ammo is being set.

parameters.name: ammo
parameters.description: The number of rounds to put in the clip.

remarks: Most call sites pass weapon.clipSize to fill the clip, for example at ammo caches and on weapon give.
Usually paired with SetWeaponAmmoStock, which sets the reserve ammo.

api.name: SetWeaponAmmoFuel
api.description: Sets the fuel ammo of the given weapon for the player.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player whose weapon fuel is being set.

parameters.name: weapon
parameters.description: The weapon whose fuel is being set.

parameters.name: fuel
parameters.description: The amount of fuel to set.

remarks: Used when restoring a saved weapon state, alongside SetWeaponAmmoClip and SetWeaponAmmoStock.

api.name: SetWeaponAmmoStock
api.description: Sets the reserve ammo of the given weapon for the player.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player whose weapon ammo is being set.

parameters.name: weapon
parameters.description: The weapon whose reserve ammo is being set.

parameters.name: ammo
parameters.description: The number of reserve rounds to set.

remarks: Commonly paired with SetWeaponAmmoClip, which sets the ammo in the clip.
Passing zero is used to strip a weapon's reserve ammo without taking the weapon away.

api.name: SetWeaponFriendlyHacking
api.description: Sets whether a friendly is hacking the target that the player's weapon is aimed at.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player holding the weapon.

parameters.name: weapon
parameters.description: The weapon (player should have this weapon).

parameters.name: isFriendlyHacking
parameters.description: Set to true if a friendly is hacking the target.

remarks: Observed only in the heatseeking missile logic, alongside SetWeaponFriendlyTargeting and SetWeaponFriendlyTargetLocked.

api.name: SetWeaponFriendlyTargeting
api.description: Sets whether the player's weapon is currently targeting a friendly.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player holding the weapon.

parameters.name: weapon
parameters.description: The weapon (player should have this weapon).

parameters.name: isFriendlyTargeting
parameters.description: Set to true if a friendly is targetting.

remarks: Observed only in the heatseeking missile logic, alongside SetWeaponFriendlyHacking and SetWeaponFriendlyTargetLocked.

api.name: SetWeaponFriendlyTargetLocked
api.description: Sets whether the player's weapon has locked on to a friendly target.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player holding the weapon.

parameters.name: weapon
parameters.description: The weapon (player should have this weapon).

parameters.name: isFriendlyTargetLocked
parameters.description: Set to true if a friendly is target locked.

remarks: Observed only in the heatseeking missile logic, alongside SetWeaponFriendlyTargeting and SetWeaponFriendlyHacking.

api.name: SetWeaponHackPercent
api.description: Sets the hack completion percentage shown for the player's weapon.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player holding the weapon.

parameters.name: weapon
parameters.description: The weapon whose hack percentage is being set.

parameters.name: heat
parameters.description: The hack completion percentage to set.

remarks: Used by the hacker tool to drive its progress display, and reset to zero when the hack starts or is cancelled.

api.name: SetWeaponHeatPercent
api.description: Set the weapon heat percentage.

parameters.name: weapon
parameters.description: The weapon (player should have this weapon).

parameters.name: heat
parameters.description: The heat percent to set.

api.name: SetWeaponLockOnPercent
api.description: Sets the lock on completion percentage for the player's weapon.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player holding the weapon.

parameters.name: weapon
parameters.description: The weapon whose lock on percentage is being set.

parameters.name: heat
parameters.description: The lock on completion percentage, from 0 to 100.

remarks: Driven each frame while a heatseeking missile acquires a lock, and reset to zero when the lock is lost.

api.name: SetWeaponOptions
api.description: Sets the weapon cosmetic options on a non player entity.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity to set the weapon options on.

parameters.name: weaponOptions
parameters.description: The weapon options to set.

remarks: Used alongside SetWeapon on display entities such as the pack a punch barrier so the shown weapon keeps its camo and attachments.

api.name: SetWeaponOverheating
api.description: Sets the overheating state and heat value of the player's weapon.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player whose weapon heat is being set.

parameters.name: overheat
parameters.description: Whether the weapon is overheating.

parameters.name: heatval
parameters.description: The new heatval of the weapon (0 to 100).

parameters.name: weapon
parameters.description: If present set this specific weapon otherwise set the player's current weapon.

remarks: Used when restoring a saved weapon state, and forced to a full heat value to make a weapon play its non quick drop animation.
Omitting the weapon argument applies the change to the player's current weapon.

api.name: SetWeaponRenderOptions
api.description: Sets the weapon render options, such as camo and displayed personalization, on a weapon model entity.
remarks: Observed on standalone weapon models, where only the camo index is supplied and the personalization flags are all disabled.

api.name: SetWinningPlayer
api.description: Sets a player to be the winner.

parameters.name: player
parameters.description: The player to set as the winning player.

api.name: SetWinningTeam
api.description: Sets a team to be the winner.

parameters.name: team
parameters.description: The team name of the winning team. Must be 'axis', 'allies' or 'none'.

api.name: SetWorldFogActiveBank
api.description: Sets world fog volumes active bank mask.

parameters.name: bankMask
parameters.description: Active bank.

api.name: SetYawSpeed
api.description: Sets the yaw turn rate and acceleration for this vehicle.

calledOn.name: vehicle
calledOn.description: The vehicle to set the yaw speed on.

parameters.name: speed
parameters.description: The speed of the vehicle in angles per second.

parameters.name: acceleration
parameters.description: The acceleration of the vehicle in angles per second^2.

parameters.name: deceleration
parameters.description: Deceleration. If not specified, set to be equal to acceleration.

remarks: Call sites almost always pass all three arguments, often deriving the acceleration and deceleration from the speed.

api.name: SetZBarrierColModel
api.description: Sets the collision model used by a zbarrier entity.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The zbarrier entity to set the collision model on.

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: The name of the collision model to use.

api.name: SetZBarrierPieceState
api.description: Sets the state of the indexed piece of a zbarrier, optionally scaling the animation playback speed.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The zbarrier entity that owns the piece.

parameters.name: pieceNumber
parameters.description: The piece index.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: State to set - valid states are open, opening, closed and closing.

parameters.name: animationScalar
parameters.description: Valid range 0.1 - 2.0, changes the playback speed of the animation in the set state - numbers less than 1.0 are faster.

remarks: Widely used to open and close board pieces on barricades, magic boxes and perk machines.
Zombie scripts also pass a targetted_by_zombie state that the documented state list does not mention.

api.name: SetZombieName
api.description: Sets this actor's zombie name.

calledOn.name: actor
calledOn.description: The actor to name.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The name to display for the zombie.

api.name: ShellShock
api.description: Starts the named shellshock effect on the player for the given duration.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player to shell shock.

parameters.description: The shell shock alias to apply.
parameters.name: shellshockName
duration
parameters.description: duration in seconds. The duration must be between 0 and 60 seconds.

parameters.name: allowReduceShellShockPerk
parameters.description: true if shell shock perk should be reduced.

remarks: The first argument names a shellshock asset such as damage_mp, teargas or default.
Short durations are used for damage feedback, while gas and script sequences use durations of several seconds or more.

api.name: Shoot
api.description: Makes this actor shoot.

parameters.name: accuracyModifier
parameters.description: (floating point number).

api.name: ShootTurret
api.description: Makes the turret fire a shot.

calledOn.name: turret
calledOn.description: The turret to fire.

api.name: ShootUp
api.description: Gives an entity vertical movement.

parameters.name: float
parameters.description: upwards velocity.

api.name: ShouldDoInitialWeaponRaise
api.description: Sets whether the given weapon plays its first raise animation the next time the player switches to it.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player who owns the weapon.

parameters.name: weapon
parameters.description: The weapon to set the first raise anim state for.

parameters.name: boolShoulddoraise
parameters.description: Whether the weapon should do the initial raise.

remarks: Observed being set to false right after giving a weapon and before switching to it immediately, to skip the first raise animation.

api.name: ShouldFaceMotion
api.description: Returns whether the AI should face its direction of motion.

calledOn.name: actor
calledOn.description: The AI actor being queried.

returns.description: True if the actor should face its motion direction.

remarks: Used in locomotion behavior tree code to decide between facing the movement direction and holding a separate aim direction.

api.name: ShouldHoldGroundAgainstEnemy
api.description: Returns whether the actor should hold its ground rather than advance, because the enemy is within its fight distance.

calledOn.name: actor
calledOn.description: The AI actor being queried.

returns.description: True if the enemy is close enough that the actor should hold ground.

remarks: Used as a behavior tree condition to choose between combat in place and repositioning.

api.name: ShouldStartArrival
api.description: Returns whether the actor should begin its arrival at the current node.

calledOn.name: actor
calledOn.description: The AI actor being queried.

returns.description: True if the actor should start its arrival.

remarks: Used as a behavior tree condition in the locomotion utility code before playing an arrival animation.

api.name: ShouldStartTraversal
api.description: Returns whether the actor should begin a traversal.

calledOn.name: actor
calledOn.description: The AI actor being queried.

returns.description: True if the actor should start the traversal.

remarks: Tested together with the presence of a traversal start node before running the traversal behavior.

api.name: ShouldUseCoverNode
api.description: Returns whether the actor should use its current cover node as cover.

calledOn.name: actor
calledOn.description: The AI actor being queried.

returns.description: True if the actor should use the cover node.

remarks: Almost always combined with IsAtCoverNodeStrict and a HasPath check to confirm the actor is settled at the node.

api.name: Show
api.description: Makes the entity visible again after it was hidden.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity to make visible.

remarks: Pairs with Hide, and is used on models, spawned props and player entities.

api.name: ShowAllParts
api.description: Shows all previously hidden parts of the entity's model.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity whose model parts are shown.

remarks: Pairs with HideAllParts, and is used on assembled models whose individual parts were hidden.

api.name: ShowInDemo
api.description: Makes the entity visible in demo playback.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player to show.

remarks: Observed being called on script models just before Show, so the entity also appears in recorded demos.

api.name: ShowInfoVolume
api.description: Enables an info volume to be drawn for debugging, using the given color and alpha.

parameters.name: entnum
parameters.description: The entity number of the info volume, as returned by GetEntityNumber on the volume.

parameters.name: rgbColor
parameters.description: The rgb color that the info volume will be drawn with.

parameters.name: alpha
parameters.description: The alpha that the info volume will be drawn with.

remarks: The entity number is normally obtained by calling GetEntityNumber on the volume entity itself.
The zone manager uses it to visualize zone volumes with a low alpha.

api.name: ShowMiscModels
api.description: Shows all misc models that have the given targetname.

parameters.name: targetname
parameters.description: The targetname of the misc model or models to show.

remarks: Pairs with HideMiscModels to swap between intact and destroyed sets of map geometry.
The targetname is often built at runtime by appending an index or suffix to a prefix.

api.name: ShowPart
api.description: Shows a part of an entity's model that was previously hidden.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity whose model part is shown.

parameters.name: tagname
parameters.description: The tag to show. All surfaces with a vertex weighted to the tag will be shown.

parameters.name: modelname
parameters.description: The optional model name to help specify the part location.

parameters.name: bApplyToChildren
parameters.description: Whether to apply the operation to child bones as well.

remarks: Pairs with HidePart, which is what gib and destructible systems use to hide the same tags.
When applying to children the model name is commonly passed as an empty string and the third argument as true.

api.name: ShowToPlayer
api.description: Shows the entity to a single given player, leaving it hidden for everyone else.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity to show.

parameters.name: player
parameters.description: The player to show the entity to.

remarks: Used after Ghost or SetInvisibleToAll to make an entity visible to just one player.

api.name: ShowToTeam
api.description: Shows the entity to a particular team.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity to show.

parameters.name: team
parameters.description: The team to show the entity to.

remarks: Pairs with HideFromTeam, for example on dogtags that only one team should be able to see.

api.name: ShowViewModel
api.description: Shows the player's current view model.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player whose view model is shown.

remarks: Pairs with HideViewModel, which scripts call while a player is riding, scripted, or otherwise not holding their weapon.

api.name: ShowZBarrierPiece
api.description: Allows the indexed piece of a zbarrier to be drawn.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The zbarrier entity that owns the piece.

parameters.name: pieceNumber
parameters.description: The index of the piece to show.

remarks: Pairs with HideZBarrierPiece; barrier repair and magic box scripts toggle individual chunk indices.
It is called on a zbarrier entity, often reached through a barrier's .zbarrier field.

api.name: SightConeTrace
api.description: Determines how much the entity can be seen from the given position, using the same check that is used by grenades. Performs multiple sight traces and returns an approximation of how much of the entity is visible from the given point, between 0 and 1.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity whose visibility is measured.

parameters.name: sightPosition
parameters.description: The point the sight starts at.

parameters.name: ignoreEntity
parameters.description: An entity to ignore when doing the traces.

parameters.name: coneForward
parameters.description: The forward direction of the cone, whose base is at the sight position. Must be normalized.

parameters.name: coneAngle
parameters.description: Angle in degrees from the line of sight to the edge of the cone. Defaults to 65.

remarks: Commonly called with just the sight position and an entity to ignore, and the result compared against 0 or a small threshold.
The cone direction is typically supplied as AnglesToForward of the viewer's angles when it is used at all.

api.name: SightTracePassed
api.description: Does a sight trace from start to end and returns true if nothing was hit.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: The start point of the trace.

parameters.name: end
parameters.description: The end point of the trace.

parameters.name: hitCharacters
parameters.description: Whether characters should be hit by the trace.

parameters.name: ignoreEntity
parameters.description: An entity to ignore.

returns.description: True if the trace reached the end point without hitting anything.

remarks: Stealth and visibility checks almost always pass 0 for hitCharacters and either undefined or the observer as the ignored entity.
Endpoints are usually eye positions or an origin raised by a fixed height.

api.name: Sin
api.description: Returns the sine of an angle given in degrees.

parameters.name: angle
parameters.description: An angle in degrees.

returns.description: The sine of the angle.

remarks: Paired with Cos to build direction vectors and to step around a circle when drawing debug shapes.

api.name: SkillUpdate
api.description: Updates the skill rating for a player or team.

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: The player or team identifier.

parameters.name: skillDelta
parameters.description: The skill rating change.

remarks: It is called once at the end of a match from the global logic, with the winner and whether the game is team based.

api.name: SnapshotAcknowledged
api.description: Returns 1 if all clients have acknowledged the snapshot or the timeout has expired. Otherwise returns undefined.

parameters.name: array
parameters.description: The array returned by GetSnapshotIndexArray.

remarks: It is used together with GetSnapshotIndexArray, whose returned array is polled until it acknowledges.

api.name: Solid
api.description: Sets the solid flag on the entity so that it becomes collidable.

calledOn.name: ent
calledOn.description: The entity to make solid.

remarks: Pairs with NotSolid, and is used most often on clip and blocker script models that are toggled during gameplay.

api.name: SortHeldWeapons
api.description: Sorts the player's held weapons to remove empty slots.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player whose held weapons are sorted.

remarks: It is called after weapons are given or taken so the weapon slots stay contiguous.

api.name: SoundExists
api.description: Returns true if the given sound alias exists.

parameters.name: soundName
parameters.description: The sound alias to check.

returns.description: True if the sound alias exists.

remarks: Scripts use it to guard playback of aliases built at runtime, such as a prefix with an appended index.

api.name: SoundGetAlias
api.description: The the string alias of a sound from the hashed sound id. Will return undefined if no sound is found.

parameters.name: soundId
parameters.description: the hashed sound id of the alias.

api.name: SoundGetPlaybackTime
api.description: Returns the playback time of the given sound alias in milliseconds.

parameters.name: soundName
parameters.description: The sound alias.

returns.description: The playback time of the sound in milliseconds.

remarks: Scripts multiply the result by 0.001 to wait for the sound to finish, so the value is in milliseconds.
It is commonly used with dialogue and VO aliases to time follow-up logic.

api.name: Spawn
api.description: Spawns an entity of the given class name at the given origin. The additional parameters required depend on the class name being spawned.

parameters.name: className
parameters.description: The class name of the entity to spawn.

parameters.name: origin
parameters.description: The position to spawn the entity at.

parameters.name: spawnFlags
parameters.description: The spawn flags for the entity. Use `0` for no flags.

parameters.name: angles
parameters.description: The angles to spawn the entity at.

returns.name: spawned
returns.description: The spawned entity.

parameters.name: className
parameters.description: The class name of the entity to spawn.

parameters.name: origin
parameters.description: The position to spawn the entity at.

parameters.name: spawnFlags
parameters.description: The spawn flags for the entity. Use `0` for no flags.

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description: The radius of the trigger.

parameters.name: height
parameters.description: The height of the trigger.

parameters.name: centered
parameters.description: Whether the trigger should be vertically centered on the origin. Defaults to `false`.

returns.name: spawned
returns.description: The spawned entity.

parameters.name: className
parameters.description: The class name of the entity to spawn.

parameters.name: origin
parameters.description: The position to spawn the entity at.

parameters.name: spawnFlags
parameters.description: The spawn flags for the entity. Use `0` for no flags.

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description: The radius of the trigger.

parameters.name: height
parameters.description: The height of the trigger.

returns.name: spawned
returns.description: The spawned entity.

parameters.name: className
parameters.description: The class name of the entity to spawn.

parameters.name: origin
parameters.description: The position to spawn the entity at.

parameters.name: spawnFlags
parameters.description: The spawn flags for the entity. Use `0` for no flags.

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description: The radius of the use trigger. Defaults to the `useRadius` dvar value.

parameters.name: height
parameters.description: The height of the use trigger. Defaults to `96`.

returns.name: spawned
returns.description: The spawned entity.

parameters.name: className
parameters.description: The class name of the entity to spawn.

parameters.name: origin
parameters.description: The position to spawn the entity at.

parameters.name: spawnFlags
parameters.description: The spawn flags for the entity. Use `0` for no flags.

parameters.name: width
parameters.description: The width of the box trigger.

parameters.name: length
parameters.description: The length of the box trigger.

parameters.name: height
parameters.description: The height of the box trigger.

returns.name: spawned
returns.description: The spawned entity.

api.name: SpawnActor
api.description: Spawns an actor from an actor spawner, if possible (the spawner won't spawn if the player is looking at the spawn point, or if spawning would cause a telefrag).

parameters.name: AIType
parameters.description: The AI type, given as the name of a spawner asset.

parameters.name: origin
parameters.description: The position to spawn the actor at.

parameters.name: angles
parameters.description: The angles to spawn the actor at.

parameters.name: targetname
parameters.description: Sets the targetname of the spawned entity.

parameters.name: forcespawn
parameters.description: Whether to force the spawn even if it may be visible to the player.

parameters.name: fullyaware
parameters.description: Whether to give the AI full awareness of all enemies.

parameters.name: spawnerEnt
parameters.description: If passed in, the fields of this spawner entity are duplicated to the newly spawned actor.

returns.description: The spawned actor entity.

remarks: Nearly every call passes true for forcespawn, with the targetname given as an empty string or undefined.
Zombie scripts additionally pass true for fullyaware when spawning scripted enemies.

api.name: SpawnCollision
api.description: Spawns a script mover that is used only for collision.

parameters.name: modelname
parameters.description: The name of the collision model to spawn.

parameters.name: targetname
parameters.description: The targetname to give the spawned collision.

parameters.name: origin
parameters.description: The position of the collision.

parameters.name: angles
parameters.description: The angles to spawn the collision at.

returns.description: The spawned collision entity.

remarks: Map patch scripts call it in bulk with collision_ prefixed models and the targetname "collider".
The angles are frequently built with VectorScale on a single axis.

api.name: SpawnFromSpawner
api.description: Spawns an actor or vehicle from a spawner, if possible (the spawner won't spawn if the player is looking at the spawn point, or if spawning would cause a telefrag) Unsupplied optional fields will use flag values from the entity.

calledOn.name: actor_or_vehicle_spawner
calledOn.description: The actor or vehicle spawner to spawn from.

parameters.name: targetname
parameters.description: Sets the targetname of the spawned entity.

parameters.name: forcespawn
parameters.description: Whether to force the spawn even if it may be visible to the player.

parameters.name: makeroom
parameters.description: Whether to remove an undeletable entity if necessary to spawn a new one.

parameters.name: infinitespawn
parameters.description: Whether to skip incrementing the spawn count.

parameters.name: classnameOverride
parameters.description: Overrides the spawner's classname.

returns.description: The spawned actor or vehicle entity.

remarks: It is called on an actor or vehicle spawner entity, most often with forcespawn set to true.
Calling it with no arguments falls back to the spawner's own flag values.

api.name: SpawnFX
api.description: Spawns an effect entity at a position, which must then be started with TriggerFX.

parameters.name: fxName
parameters.description: The effect to spawn. The effect has to be precached.

parameters.name: position
parameters.description: The position to play the effect at.

parameters.name: forward
parameters.description: The forward vector of the effect.

parameters.name: up
parameters.description: The up vector of the effect.

returns.description: The spawned effect entity.

api.example: fx_ent = SpawnFX( level._effect[ fxid ], v_pos, v_forward, v_up );
remarks: The effect must already be cached, and is normally passed as a cached handle such as level._effect[ id ] or fx::get( id ).
Callers keep the returned entity so the looping effect can be deleted later.

api.name: SpawnHelicopter
api.description: Spawns a helicopter vehicle owned by the given entity.

parameters.name: owner
parameters.description: The owner entity, usually the player who called in the vehicle.

parameters.name: origin
parameters.description: The location to spawn at.

parameters.name: angles
parameters.description: The angles to spawn at.

parameters.name: vehicleName
parameters.description: The vehicle name.

parameters.name: modelName
parameters.description: The model name.

returns.description: The spawned helicopter entity.

remarks: Killstreak scripts use it for dropships, drones and gunships, passing the vehicle info name and then the model name.
The model name may be passed as an empty string when the vehicle info already supplies one.

api.name: SpawnNapalmGroundFlame
api.description: Spawn a napalm ground flame at the origin with the direction.

parameters.name: origin
parameters.description: The origin of the flame.

parameters.name: weapon
parameters.description: The weapon.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: The direction of the flame.

parameters.name: time
parameters.description: The time to live.

api.name: SpawnPathNode
api.description: Spawn a dynamically created path node or cover node.

parameters.name: classname
parameters.description: The class name.

parameters.name: origin
parameters.description: The origin.

parameters.name: angles
parameters.description: The view angles.

parameters.name: key1
parameters.description: Key 1.

parameters.name: value1
parameters.description: Value for key 1.

parameters.name: key2
parameters.description: Key 2.

parameters.name: value2
parameters.description: Value for key 2.

api.example: node = SpawnPathNode( "node_pathnode", origin, angles, k1, v1 );
remarks: The observed calls all spawn "node_pathnode" and pass key and value pairs only when they are defined.

api.name: SpawnPlane
api.description: Spawns a plane at the given origin, owned by the given player.

parameters.name: player
parameters.description: The owner of the plane, usually the player who called it in.

parameters.name: classname
parameters.description: The class of the entity to spawn.

parameters.name: origin
parameters.description: The location to spawn at.

parameters.name: spawnflags
parameters.description: Optional spawn flags.

returns.description: The spawned plane entity.

remarks: Air support killstreaks spawn it with the classname "script_model" at the start of a flight path.

api.name: SpawnSpectator
api.description: Spawns the player, does not send any notifies.

parameters.name: origin
parameters.description: origin to spawn.

parameters.name: angles
parameters.description: angles to spawn.

api.name: SpawnStruct
api.description: Spawns (creates) an empty struct.

returns.name: struct
returns.description: The newly created struct.

api.name: SpawnTimedFX
api.description: Spawns a broadcast entity that plays an oriented timed FX using the weapon's property projExplosionEffect.

parameters.name: weapon
parameters.description: The weapon whose explosion effect is spawned.

parameters.name: origin
parameters.description: The position to spawn the effect at.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: The direction of the effect. Defaults to (0, 0, 1).

parameters.name: time
parameters.description: How long the effect lasts, in seconds. Defaults to 10.

parameters.name: team
parameters.description: The team the effect belongs to. Defaults to TEAM_FREE.

returns.description: The spawned effect entity.

api.example: ent = SpawnTimedFX( smokeWeapon, position, dir_up, effectLifetime );
remarks: It is used by grenade scripts such as smoke, tabun and incendiary, passing the grenade weapon and the impact position.
The team argument is passed as self.team so the effect is owned by the thrower's team.

api.name: SpawnTurret
api.description: Unsupported function. Do not use.

parameters.name: args
