parameters.description: Optional arguments accepted by this broken function.

returns.name: result
returns.description: The unknown result returned by this broken function.

remarks: This entry is marked Broken because the function is not considered usable in practice.

api.name: SpawnVehicle
api.description: Spawns a new vehicle and returns a reference to it.

parameters.name: vehicletype
parameters.description: The vehicle type to spawn.

parameters.name: origin
parameters.description: The position of the vehicle.

parameters.name: angles
parameters.description: The angles to spawn the vehicle at.

parameters.name: targetname
parameters.description: The targetname to give the vehicle.

parameters.name: destructibledef
parameters.description: The destructible definition to use to make this vehicle a destructible.

returns.description: The spawned vehicle entity.

remarks: Killstreak vehicles are commonly spawned with the targetname "dynamic_spawn_ai".
The vehicle type is either a vehicle asset name or a spawner name.

api.name: Sphere
api.description: Draws a debug sphere.

parameters.name: args
parameters.description: The arguments.

api.example: Sphere( origin, radius, color, alpha, 1, sides, duration );
remarks: Sphere must be called from the context of a devblock.
Calls pass origin and radius first, then optionally color, alpha, a depth test flag, the number of sides and a duration in server frames.

api.name: SphericalCone
api.description: Draws a debug spherical cone.

parameters.name: origin
parameters.description: The cone origin.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: The cone direction.

parameters.name: angle
parameters.description: The cone angle.

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description: The cone radius.

parameters.name: color
parameters.description: The color.

parameters.name: depthTest
parameters.description: Whether to depth test.

parameters.name: duration
parameters.description: The display duration.

parameters.name: segments
parameters.description: The number of segments.

api.name: SprintButtonPressed
api.description: Returns whether the player is pressing the sprint button.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player to check.

returns.description: True while the player is holding the sprint button.

remarks: It is often polled in a loop alongside UseButtonPressed, JumpButtonPressed and MeleeButtonPressed to wait for player input.

api.name: SPrintF
api.description: Generates a string that, given a string template with numbered field specifiers (such as `{0}`), will replace the specifiers with the values passed in the remaining arguments.

parameters.name: template
parameters.description: The template string.

parameters.name: args
parameters.description: Zero or more arguments to interpolate into the template string.

returns.name: result
returns.description: The interpolated string.

api.example: value = SPrintF("{0} is the first string", "first"); // value = "first is the first string"

api.name: SprintUpRequired
api.description: Force the player to release the sprint button before sprinting.

api.name: Sqrt
api.description: Returns the square root of the given value.

parameters.name: a
parameters.description: A float or integer value.

returns.description: The square root of the value.

remarks: It is most often used to convert a squared distance from DistanceSquared back into a real distance.

api.name: StanceButtonPressed
api.description: Returns whether the player is pressing the stance button.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player to check.

returns.description: True while the player is holding the stance button.

remarks: It is typically polled in a loop to wait for the player to press or release the stance button.

api.name: StartBinocs
api.description: Start Binoculars on player.

api.name: StartCameraTween
api.description: Start a camera tween, call this right before a camera pop to do a blend.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The player or camera entity.

parameters.name: time
parameters.description: How long to do the blend.".

remarks: It is called on a player right before setting a new camera position so the move blends over the given time.

api.name: StartCoverArrival
api.description: Runs cover arrival animscript on an actor.

parameters.name: startPos
parameters.description: the offset to start the arrival animation from.

parameters.name: yawAngles
parameters.description: the arrival angle.

api.name: StartFadingBlur
api.description: Blurs the screen for the player, then fades the blur out to 0 over a period of time.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The player to blur the screen for.

parameters.name: blur_amount
parameters.description: The initial blur amount, in pixels for Gaussian blur at 640x480. Must be greater than 0.

parameters.name: time
parameters.description: How long the fade out will take, in seconds.

remarks: Health scripts call it on each hit to produce a short damage blur, with larger amounts and longer fades for heavier damage.

api.name: StartFiring
api.description: Starts a turret firing.

calledOn.name: turret
calledOn.description: The turret to start firing.

remarks: Pairs with StopFiring, which the machine gun turret scripts call to end the burst.

api.name: StartHostMigration
api.description: Initiates a host migration.
remarks: It is called from the global logic of each game mode, and takes no arguments.

api.name: StartMission
api.description: Start the (server side) mission script for the specified mission - all loading (on all clients) should be completed before calling - use client side LoadMission to load missions.

parameters.name: mission_index
parameters.description: index of the mission name to start - mission names can be retrieved by calling GetMissions to return the available mission array.

api.name: StartPath
api.description: Starts the vehicle following this path.

calledOn.name: vehicle
calledOn.description: The vehicle to start moving along its path.

remarks: Called on a vehicle after its start node has been set up, commonly from vehicle spawn code to send it along its path.

api.name: StartPoisoning
api.description: Starts the poisoned state on the player.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The player to start poisoning.

remarks: Used by the tabun gas weapon when a player enters a gas area, and ended with a matching StopPoisoning call when the player leaves it or dies.

api.name: StartRagdoll
api.description: Begin ragdoll physics for this entity.  Does nothing if the entity is already a ragdoll.

calledOn.name: player_or_playercorpse
calledOn.description: The player, corpse or AI to turn into a ragdoll.

parameters.name: immediate
parameters.description: Start the ragdoll immediately and don't do the velocity capture on the client.

remarks: Usually called with no arguments on a corpse or a dying AI; a value of 1 is passed when the ragdoll must start immediately, for example when a gadget or explosion throws the body.

api.name: StartResurrectViewAngleTransition
api.description: Finishes the flashback.
remarks: Only seen in the resurrect gadget script, called on the player as the resurrect sequence hands control back.

api.name: StartRevive
api.description: Starts the revive sequence on a player. <reviver> is the one administering aid to the player this is called on.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The downed player being revived.

parameters.name: reviver
parameters.description: The player administering aid to the downed player.

remarks: Called on the downed player with the reviver as the argument, and paired with StopRevive if the revive is interrupted.

api.name: StopAllRumbles
api.description: Stop all the rumbles playing right now.
remarks: Typically called during level load or round reset to clear any rumble left playing.

api.name: StopAnimScripted
api.description: Halts animscript on this entity.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity whose scripted animation is stopped.

parameters.name: blend
parameters.description: The blend out time for the animation.

parameters.name: ImmediateStop
parameters.description: Stop the animation immediatly on the client side (no client/server time sync).

remarks: Almost always called with no arguments to drop an actor out of a scripted animation; a blend time of 0 is passed when the animation must end instantly.

api.name: StopBinocs
api.description: Stop binoculars on the given player.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player to stop binoculars on.

api.name: StopCarryTurret
api.description: UnLinks the auto turret from the player and sets it on the ground.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player carrying the turret.

parameters.name: turret
parameters.description: The turret entity to put down.

parameters.name: origin
parameters.description: The new origin of turret.

parameters.name: angles
parameters.description: The new angles of turret.

remarks: Observed only with the turret entity argument; the origin and angles are left off so the turret is placed where the player is aiming.

api.name: StopDemoRecording
api.description: Stops demo recording.
remarks: Called from the game logic at the end of a match to close out the recorded demo.

api.name: StopFireWeapon
api.description: Stop firing the vehicle's main weapon.

api.name: StopFiring
api.description: Stops a turret firing.

calledOn.name: turret
calledOn.description: The turret to stop firing.

remarks: Used on machine gun turrets alongside StopShootTurret when the turret loses its target.

api.name: StopJukeMove
api.description: Stops the player juke movement in progress.

api.name: StopLocalSound
api.description: Stops the local sound.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player the local sound is playing for.

parameters.name: soundName
parameters.description: The sound alias to stop.

remarks: Used to cancel lock-on and seeker loops started for a single player, often next to a StopRumble call for the same event.

api.name: StopLook
api.description: Stops the AI actor from looking at a target.

calledOn.name: actor
calledOn.description: The AI actor.

api.name: StopLoopSound
api.description: Stops the looping sound with an optional fadetime.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity playing the looping sound.

parameters.name: fadetime
parameters.description: Time in seconds to fade the sound out.

remarks: Pairs with PlayLoopSound, usually on a dedicated script_origin sound entity that the script then deletes.
Fade times observed are small fractional values such as 0.5, 1 and 2 seconds.

api.name: StopMission
api.description: fire Mission_Stop event to terminate the current mission.

api.name: StopMoveSlide
api.description: Stops the movement caused by MoveSlide().

api.name: StopPoisoning
api.description: Stops the poisoned state on the player.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The player to stop poisoning.

remarks: Used by the tabun gas weapon to end the state started by StartPoisoning once the player leaves the gas.

api.name: StopRevive
api.description: Stops the revive behavior on a player when the revive did not complete. <reviver> is the one administering aid to the player this is called on.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The downed player whose revive is cancelled.

parameters.name: reviver
parameters.description: The player who was administering aid to the downed player.

remarks: Called on the downed player when the reviver moves away or is interrupted, undoing an earlier StartRevive.

api.name: StopRumble
api.description: Stops the named rumble playing on the entity.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity the rumble is playing on.

parameters.name: rumbleName
parameters.description: The name of the rumble to stop.

remarks: Commonly called next to StopShellShock when a player respawns or is cleansed of effects.
The rumble name given is the same alias that started the loop, for example "stinger_lock_rumble" for weapon lock-on.

api.name: StopShellShock
api.description: Stops the shell shock sequence for the player.
remarks: Frequently called on respawn or on state cleanup, immediately before StopRumble.

api.name: StopShootTurret
api.description: Stops a turret from firing.

calledOn.name: turret
calledOn.description: The turret to stop shooting.

remarks: Observed on machine gun turrets together with StopFiring when the turret gives up its target.

api.name: StopSound
api.description: Stops the given sound on an entity. Remark: Wait between StopSound() and delete() or the sound will not stop.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity to stop the sound on.

parameters.name: aliasName
parameters.description: The sound to stop on the entity.

api.name: StopSounds
api.description: Stops all sounds on an entity. Remark: you must have a wait between StopSounds() and delete() or the sounds will not stop.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity to stop the sounds on.

api.name: StreamerModelHint
api.description: Force a model to be loaded for a set period of time.

parameters.name: modelname
parameters.description: The name of the model.

parameters.name: duration
parameters.description: Length of time (in seconds) to keep it loaded.

remarks: Typically called just before a model swap, such as hinting a vehicle death model a few seconds ahead of the vehicle being destroyed.

api.name: StreamerRequest
api.description: Executes a streamer request.

parameters.name: command
parameters.description: The command, which is one of: "set", "clear" or "play".

parameters.name: hintAssetName
parameters.description: The name of the streamer hint asset, if applicable.

api.name: StrEndsWith
api.description: Returns true/false if <string> ends with <substring>. Case sensitive.

parameters.name: string
parameters.description: String to search.

parameters.name: substring
parameters.description: Substring to search with.

remarks: Widely used to test name suffixes such as "_lh" for left-hand weapon variants or "_ai" for AI vehicles.

api.name: StrIsFloat
api.description: Check if a string is a float.

parameters.name: string
parameters.description: : The string to check.

remarks: Used by the table loading code to decide whether a cell should be converted to a float, after StrIsInt has been ruled out.

api.name: StrIsInt
api.description: Check if a string is an int.

parameters.name: string
parameters.description: : The string to check.

remarks: Used to validate string data before converting it with Int, for example script_parameters on a spawner or a column read out of a CSV table.

api.name: StrIsNumber
api.description: Check if a string is a number.

parameters.name: string
parameters.description: : The string to check.

remarks: Used to guard string to number conversions, for instance checking a dvar string or a variadic argument before treating it as a value.

api.name: StrStartsWith
api.description: Returns true/false if <string> starts with <substring>. Case sensitive.

parameters.name: string
parameters.description: String to search.

parameters.name: substring
parameters.description: Substring to search with.

remarks: Commonly used to match name prefixes, such as testing a killstreak name against a prefix or a scene mode against "capture".

api.name: StrStrip
api.description: Strip whitespace from right and left side of string.

parameters.name: string
parameters.description: : The string to strip.

remarks: Used when reading CSV tables so that padded header and row cells compare correctly against the empty string.

api.name: StrTok
api.description: Tokenizes <string> by the delimiters <delim>. Returns the array of string tokens.

parameters.name: string
parameters.description: The input string.

parameters.name: delim
parameters.description: The delimiter to tokenize by.

remarks: Very common for splitting mapper-authored fields such as script_parameters, script_noteworthy or classname on a single character delimiter.
Each character of the delimiter string is treated as a separator; use StrTok2 to split on a whole string.

api.name: StrTok2
api.description: Tokenizes <string> by a single delimiter string.  doesn't treat the delimiter string as a series of characters, but as a string.

parameters.name: string
parameters.description: The input string.

parameters.name: delim
parameters.description: The delimiter to tokenize by.

parameters.name: case_sensitive
parameters.description: true if test is case sensitive.

remarks: Used when the delimiter is a whole word, such as stripping a "_zombietron_" or "_ricochet" infix out of an asset name.
All observed call sites omit the case sensitivity argument.

api.name: Suicide
api.description: Kills the player immediately as a suicide.
remarks: Used by game logic to kill a player without an attacker, for example on team change, on leaving last stand, or from the in-game suicide menu option.

api.name: SwitchMap_Load
api.description: Start loading a map/level.

parameters.name: mapName
parameters.description: the name of the map to preload.

remarks: Preloads the next level in the background; SwitchMap_SetLoadingMovie is called before it and SwitchMap_Switch performs the actual transition later.

api.name: SwitchMap_Preload
api.description: Starts preloading a map switch.

parameters.name: mapName
parameters.description: The map name to preload.

parameters.name: gameType
parameters.description: An optional gametype name. Defaults to coop.

parameters.name: lighting
parameters.description: An optional lighting index.

remarks: When gameType is omitted, the native uses coop.

api.name: SwitchMap_SetLoadingMovie
api.description: Set the loading movie to play.

parameters.name: movie_name
parameters.description: The name of the movie.

remarks: Called immediately before SwitchMap_Load so that the intro or outro movie plays over the level transition.

api.name: SwitchMap_Switch
api.description: Switch to the loaded map/level.
remarks: Completes a transition begun by SwitchMap_Load, called from the level end and callback code.

api.name: SwitchStartNode
api.description: Swaps the start node for this vehicle.

calledOn.name: vehicle
calledOn.description: The vehicle whose start node is swapped.

parameters.name: sourceNode
parameters.description: The start node to switch from.

parameters.name: destNode
parameters.description: The start node to switch to.

remarks: Observed on a scripted train to redirect it at a junction by swapping the start node pair for the chosen station.

api.name: SwitchToOffHand
api.description: Switch to the offhand weapon.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player to switch weapons for.

parameters.name: weapon
parameters.description: The offhand weapon to switch to.

remarks: Called during loadout giving to bring up the player's primary, secondary or special offhand weapon.

api.name: SwitchToWeapon
api.description: Switch to a different weapon or cycle weapons if no weapon is given.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player to switch weapons for.

parameters.name: weaponObject
parameters.description: The weapon to switch to.

remarks: Very commonly used to restore a stored weapon such as self.lastActiveWeapon or the primary loadout weapon after a scripted sequence or last stand.

api.name: SwitchToWeaponImmediate
api.description: Switches the player to the given weapon without playing the put-away animation for the current weapon, or cycles weapons when no weapon is given.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player to switch weapons for.

parameters.name: weaponObject
parameters.description: The weapon to switch to. If omitted, the player cycles weapons.

remarks: Scripts use it to restore a weapon instantly, for example putting back self.lastActiveWeapon when a player leaves last stand, or arming a carried object weapon.

api.name: TableLookup
api.description: Looks up the row whose search column holds the given value and returns the value of another column in that row.

parameters.name: filename
parameters.description: The table to look up, either a csv path or a table id from TableLookupFindCoreAsset.

parameters.name: searchColumnNum
parameters.description: The column number of the stats table to search through.

parameters.name: searchValue
parameters.description: The value to use when searching the <search column num>.

parameters.name: returnValueColumnNum
parameters.description: The column number value to return after we find the correct row.

remarks: The value comes back as a string, so callers commonly wrap it in int() when the column holds a number.
The first argument accepts either a table path such as "gamedata/stats/cp/cp_statstable.csv" or a table id returned by TableLookupFindCoreAsset.

api.name: TableLookupColumnCount
api.description: look up the number of columns in a table.

parameters.name: filename
parameters.description: The table to look up.

api.name: TableLookupColumnForRow
api.description: Returns the value of the given column in the given row of a table.

parameters.name: filename
parameters.description: The table to look up, either a csv path or a table id from TableLookupFindCoreAsset.

parameters.name: searchRowNum
parameters.description: The row number of the string table to search through.

parameters.name: searchColumnNum
parameters.description: The column number of the string table to search through.

remarks: Usually follows TableLookupRowNum, which supplies the row number, or iterates rows up to TableLookupRowCount.
The first argument accepts either a csv path or a table id returned by TableLookupFindCoreAsset.

api.name: TableLookupFindCoreAsset
api.description: Returns the asset id of a string table, which can be passed in place of the filename to the other table lookup functions.

parameters.name: filename
parameters.description: The table to look up, given as a csv path.

remarks: Scripts resolve the id once and cache it on level (for example level.statsTableID), then pass it to TableLookup, TableLookupRowNum and TableLookupColumnForRow instead of the csv path.

api.name: TableLookupIString
api.description: Looks up the row whose search column holds the given value and returns another column of that row as a localized string.

parameters.name: filename
parameters.description: The table to look up, either a csv path or a table id from TableLookupFindCoreAsset.

parameters.name: searchColumnNum
parameters.description: The column number of the stats table to search through.

parameters.name: searchValue
parameters.description: The value to use when searching the <search column num>.

parameters.name: returnValueColumnNum
parameters.description: The column number value to return after we find the correct row.

remarks: Used instead of TableLookup for columns holding display text, such as perk names and score event labels.

api.name: TableLookupRow
api.description: Returns an array holding the value of every column in the given row.

parameters.name: filename
parameters.description: The table to look up, given as a csv path.

parameters.name: rowNum
parameters.description: The row num of the row in table to return.

remarks: The returned array is indexed by column number, so scripts read a header row once and then use its entries to name the columns.
Row indices usually come from a loop bounded by TableLookupRowCount.

api.name: TableLookupRowCount
api.description: Returns the number of rows in a table.

parameters.name: filename
parameters.description: The table to look up, given as a csv path.

remarks: Almost always used as the bound of a loop that then calls TableLookupRow or TableLookupColumnForRow for each row.

api.name: TableLookupRowNum
api.description: Returns the number of the first row whose search column holds the given value.

parameters.name: filename
parameters.description: The table to look up, either a csv path or a table id from TableLookupFindCoreAsset.

parameters.name: searchColumnNum
parameters.description: The column number of the stats table to search through.

parameters.name: searchValue
parameters.description: The value to use when searching the <search column num>.

remarks: Paired with TableLookupColumnForRow when several columns of the same row are needed, so the search is only done once.

api.name: TakeAllWeapons
api.description: Takes every weapon away from the player.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player to take the weapons from.

remarks: Typically the first step of rebuilding a loadout, followed by GiveWeapon and SwitchToWeaponImmediate.

api.name: TakePlayerControl
api.description: Takes driving control of the vehicle away from the player controlling it.

calledOn.name: vehicle
calledOn.description: The vehicle the player is controlling.

remarks: Called on the remote controlled vehicle itself, for example when a QR drone starts crashing or a player is pulled out of a VTOL.

api.name: TakeWeapon
api.description: Takes the given weapon away from the player.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player to take the weapon from.

parameters.name: weapon
parameters.description: The weapon to take.

parameters.name: ignore_attachments
parameters.description: Only check the root weapon, ignore all the attachments.

remarks: Use TakeAllWeapons to clear every weapon at once.
Scripts also call it before giving the same weapon again, so that its ammo is replenished.

api.name: Tan
api.description: Returns the tan of an angle.

parameters.name: angle
parameters.description: An angle in degrees.

api.name: Target_BoundingIsUnderReticle
api.description: Returns true if the player's cursor is roughly inside of the target's bounding box.

parameters.name: player
parameters.description: The player entity.

parameters.name: targetEntity
parameters.description: The entity that is the target.

parameters.name: maxDistance
parameters.description: The maximum distance to check for target intersection.

remarks: Used by lock-on weapons such as the hacker tool to confirm a candidate target, alongside Target_ScaleMinMaxRadius.
The maximum distance passed in the corpus is the weapon's lockOnMaxRange.

api.name: Target_ClearReticleLockOn
api.description: Cancels any lock-on sequence on the hud.

api.name: Target_GetArray
api.description: Returns an array of the entities currently registered as targets with Target_Set.
remarks: Lock-on and killstreak scripts often merge the result with level.MissileEntities using ArrayCombine before picking a target.

api.name: Target_GetOffset
api.description: Returns the target offset that was registered for the entity with Target_Set.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: The entity that is the target.

remarks: The result can be undefined, so callers default it to ( 0, 0, 0 ) before passing it to Missile_SetTarget.

api.name: Target_IsInCircle
api.description: Returns whether a target is within a given radius from the center of the player's screen.

parameters.name: targetEntity
parameters.description: The entity that is the target.

parameters.name: player
parameters.description: The player entity.

parameters.name: fov
parameters.description: The player's field of view.

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description: radius of the circle, centered at the center of the screen.

parameters.name: zoffset
parameters.description: if entity is not in target array, use optional zoffset for target pos.

remarks: The player argument is normally self, the player doing the aiming, and a field of view of 65 is the value used throughout the lock-on code.

api.name: Target_IsInRect
api.description: Returns whether a target is within a given rectangle, centered in the center of the player's screen.

parameters.name: targetEntity
parameters.description: The entity that is the target.

parameters.name: player
parameters.description: The player entity.

parameters.name: fov
parameters.description: The player's field of view.

parameters.name: halfwidth
parameters.description: half the width of the rectangle.

parameters.name: halfheight
parameters.description: half the height of the rectangle.

api.name: Target_IsTarget
api.description: Returns whether an entity is currently registered as a target with Target_Set.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: The entity to check.

remarks: Usually guards a Target_Remove call so that an entity is only unregistered once.

api.name: Target_OriginIsInCircle
api.description: Returns whether a world position is within a given radius from the center of the player's screen.

parameters.name: origin
parameters.description: The origin to test.

parameters.name: player
parameters.description: The player entity.

parameters.name: fov
parameters.description: The player's field of view.

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description: radius of the circle, centered at the center of the screen.

remarks: The origin based counterpart of Target_IsInCircle, used by the grapple and replay gun for points that are not registered targets.

api.name: Target_Remove
api.description: Removes an entity from the list of targets.

parameters.name: targetEntity
parameters.description: The entity that is the target.

remarks: Undoes Target_Set, and is normally guarded by Target_IsTarget.
Killstreak scripts call it when the entity is destroyed or its owner loses it.

api.name: Target_ScaleMinMaxRadius
api.description: Returns the ratio from 0-1 of where the target is in relation to the radius min and radius max.

parameters.name: targetEntity
parameters.description: The entity that is the target.

parameters.name: player
parameters.description: The player entity.

parameters.name: fov
parameters.description: The player's field of view.

parameters.name: radius_min
parameters.description: radius of the circle, centered at the center of the screen.

parameters.name: radius_max
parameters.description: radius of the circle, centered at the center of the screen.

api.example: scale = Target_ScaleMinMaxRadius( target, self, level.hackerToolLockOnFOV, radiusInner, radiusOuter );
remarks: Lock-on code tests the result against 0 to decide whether the target is inside the outer radius at all.
The heat seeking missile passes 0 as the minimum radius so that the whole circle is used.

api.name: Target_Set
api.description: Registers an entity as a target and draws it on the hud.

parameters.name: targetEntity
parameters.description: The entity that is the target.

parameters.name: targetOffset
parameters.description: The offset of the target position from the entity's origin.

remarks: Pairs with Target_Remove, which unregisters the entity again.
The optional offset is normally a z lift such as ( 0, 0, 50 ) so that the marker sits on the body of the vehicle.

api.name: Target_SetAllowHighSteering
api.description: Target will allow incoming missiles to steer more, making the target easier to hit.

parameters.name: targetEntity
parameters.description: The entity that is the target.

parameters.name: bool
parameters.description: Whether incoming missiles may steer harder toward the target.

remarks: The corpus only ever enables it, on helicopter gunner targets, immediately after Target_Set.

api.name: Target_SetAttackMode
api.description: Sets how missiles and rockets should approach the target.

parameters.name: targetEntity
parameters.description: The entity that is the target.

parameters.name: modeName
parameters.description: "top" or "direct".

api.name: Target_SetJavelinOnly
api.description: Target will only draw on player's hud when they are looking through the Javelin-weapon's site.

parameters.name: targetEntity
parameters.description: The entity that is the target.

parameters.name: modeName
parameters.description: "top" or "direct".

api.name: Target_SetOffscreenShader
api.description: Sets the material that is used when a target clamps to the edge of the screen.  The target must have already been created with target_set().

parameters.name: targetEntity
parameters.description: The entity that is the target.

parameters.name: materialname
parameters.description: The shader for the quad drawn over the target.

api.name: Target_SetOffset
api.description: Sets the offset for a particular target.

parameters.name: targetEntity
parameters.description: The entity that is the target.

parameters.name: targetOffset
parameters.description: The offset of the target position from the entity's origin.

api.name: Target_SetShader
api.description: Changes the material of a target.  The target must have already been created with target_set().

parameters.name: targetEntity
parameters.description: The entity that is the target.

parameters.name: materialname
parameters.description: The shader for the quad drawn over the target.

api.name: Target_SetTurretAquire
api.description: Sets whether the target can be acquired and attacked by SAM turrets.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: The entity to set the flag.

parameters.name: bool
parameters.description: false if you want the SAM turret to ignore the targe. default is true.

remarks: The corpus only passes false, right after Target_Set, so that friendly killstreak vehicles are ignored by SAM turrets.

api.name: Target_StartReticleLockOn
api.description: Begins the lock-on sequence for the target on the hud.  This affects the animation of the vehicle reticle.

parameters.name: targetEntity
parameters.description: The entity that is the target.

parameters.name: duration
parameters.description: The amount of time between now and fully locked-on, in seconds.

api.name: TeamOpsShowHUD
api.description: Shows or hides the TeamOps HUD.

parameters.name: show
parameters.description: Whether to show the HUD, 1 to show and 0 to hide.

remarks: Hidden with 0 before an event is announced and when it stops, shown with 1 just after TeamOpsStart.

api.name: TeamOpsStart
api.description: Starts a TeamOps event.

parameters.name: teamOpsID
parameters.description: The TeamOps ID.

parameters.name: rewardIndex
parameters.description: The index of the chosen reward within the event's reward list.

parameters.name: startTime
parameters.description: The game time the event started, as returned by GetTime().

parameters.name: duration
parameters.description: The length of the event in seconds.

remarks: Callers follow it with TeamOpsShowHUD( 1 ) and one TeamOpsUpdateProgress call per team to reset progress.

api.name: TeamOpsUpdateProgress
api.description: Updates the TeamOps progress shown for a team.

parameters.name: team
parameters.description: The team to update, for example "allies" or "axis".

parameters.name: progress
parameters.description: The progress value.

remarks: Called once per team with 0 when the event starts, then again as the team scores.

api.name: Teleport
api.description: Teleports the actor to a new position, optionally facing new angles.

calledOn.name: actor
calledOn.description: The actor to teleport.

parameters.name: position
parameters.description: (point) The actor's new position.

parameters.name: angles
parameters.description: (vector) The actor's new angles.

remarks: Mostly used to move AI to a spawn point or back to a stored origin; the angles argument is often omitted when only the position matters.

api.name: TestSpawnPoint
api.description: Returns true if the player would not be in a solid when spawned at the given point.

parameters.name: point
parameters.description: the point to test.

api.name: ThreatBiasGroupExists
api.description: Check if a threat bias group exists.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: threat bias group name.

api.name: Throw
api.description: force a script exception (from a builtin call).

api.name: ThrowButtonPressed
api.description: Returns whether the player is pressing the throw button.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player to check.

remarks: Polled inside a loop to detect the button being held, for example while charging a glaive throw or skipping a scene.

api.name: ThrowGrenade
api.description: Instructs the AI actor to throw a grenade.

calledOn.name: actor
calledOn.description: The AI actor.

parameters.name: grenadeWeapon
parameters.description: The grenade weapon to throw.

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: The target position or entity.

returns.name: thrown
returns.description: Whether the grenade was thrown.

api.name: TmodeSetServerUser
api.description: Informs the server whether the entity is using tmode.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: Whether the entity is using tmode, 1 for using and 0 for not using.

api.name: ToggleNoVehicleFaceTraversability
api.description: Set whether the entity can use NoVehicleFaces. This should only be used in MP map for now.

api.name: ToLower
api.description: Returns the given string converted to lower case.

parameters.name: string
parameters.description: The string to convert.

remarks: Widely used to normalize dvar values, map names and table entries before comparing them against lower case literals.

api.name: ToUpper
api.description: Returns the given string converted to upper case.

parameters.name: string
parameters.description: The string to convert.

remarks: Mostly used to build upper case table keys and stat names, and to format debug text.

api.name: TracePassedOnNavMesh
api.description: Runs a trace on the NavMesh to see whether a character can move straight from the start position to the end position.

parameters.description: start of the trace.

parameters.name: end

parameters.name: characterRadius
parameters.description: the radius of the capsule used in trace. default to 0.

parameters.name: materialFlags

api.name: TrackBlackBoardAttribute
api.description: Begins tracking a blackboard attribute for the AI actor.

calledOn.name: actor
calledOn.description: The AI actor.

parameters.name: attributeName
parameters.description: The name of the blackboard attribute to track, matching the name passed to Blackboard::RegisterBlackBoardAttribute.

remarks: Every corpus call sits inside a dev block ( /# #/ ) and immediately follows a Blackboard::RegisterBlackBoardAttribute call for the same attribute, guarded by IsActor( self ).
Attribute names are the lower case, underscore prefixed names used by the blackboard system, such as "_locomotion_speed".

api.name: TrackHeroPowerActivated
api.description: Tracks that the player activated a hero power.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player.

parameters.name: heroPowerId
parameters.description: The hero power identifier.

api.name: TrackHeroPowerAvailable
api.description: Tracks that a hero power became available for the player.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player.

parameters.name: heroPowerId
parameters.description: The hero power identifier.

api.name: TrackHeroPowerExpired

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player.

parameters.name: heroPowerId
parameters.description: The hero power identifier.

parameters.name: wasActive
parameters.description: Whether the power was active when it expired.

parameters.name: duration
parameters.description: The duration the power was active.

parameters.name: kills

api.name: TrackWeaponFireNative

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player.

parameters.name: weapon
parameters.description: The weapon fired.

parameters.name: shotsFired
parameters.description: Number of shots fired.

parameters.name: shotsHit
parameters.description: Number of shots that hit.

parameters.name: shotsMissed
parameters.description: Number of shots missed.

parameters.name: damage
parameters.description: Total damage dealt.

parameters.name: isADS
parameters.description: Whether the player was aiming down sights.

parameters.name: extra1
parameters.description: Additional parameter.

parameters.name: extra2
parameters.description: Additional parameter.

api.example: self TrackWeaponFireNative( curWeapon, 1, self.hits, 1, self.class_num, weaponPickedUp, self.primaryLoadoutGunSmithVariantIndex, self.secondaryLoadoutGunSmithVariantIndex );

api.name: TraverseMode

parameters.name: traverseMode

api.name: TriggerEnable

parameters.name: timeDelay
parameters.description: The time delay for the fx to play.

api.name: TriggerIgnoreTeam

remarks: Typically called on a use trigger right after it is created, next to UseTriggerRequireLookAt.

api.name: TrimPathtoAttack
api.description: Trims the path to attack.

api.name: TurnedHuman

api.name: Type

parameters.name: param1

api.name: UmbraGate_Set

api.name: UndoLastStand

api.name: Unlink

api.name: UnlinkFromMissile

api.name: UnlockSongByAlias

api.name: UnSetPerk

api.name: UnSetTurretNode

api.name: UpdateClientNames

api.name: UpdateNavTriggers

api.name: UpdateStatRatio

api.name: UpdateTrackedBlackboardAttribute

api.name: UpdateUnlockedAttachmentBits

parameters.description: The anim tree to set.

remarks: Called with the file's #animtree, or with an explicit $tree name such as $critter when using another tree.

api.name: UseBuildKitWeaponModel
api.description: Use a build kit weapon model.

parameters.name: player
parameters.description: The player whose build kit data will be used.

parameters.name: weapon
parameters.description: The weapon to base the build kit on.

parameters.name: camoIndex
parameters.description: The index of the camo to override the build kit's camo with.

parameters.name: upgraded
parameters.description: bool whether this should be the upgraded version. If so extclip and fmj will be added.

api.example: weapon_model UseBuildKitWeaponModel( player, weapon, camo, upgraded );
remarks: Used in zombies to build wall buy and box weapon models that reflect the player's build kit.

api.name: UseButtonPressed
api.description: Check if the player is pressing the use button.
remarks: Commonly polled inside a while loop with waits to detect a held use button.

api.name: UseBy
api.description: Uses the entity with the passed in entity as the activator.
remarks: Used to trigger a use trigger from script, which fires its usual trigger notify; passing the trigger itself is used when no player activator is known.

api.name: UseCoverNode
api.description: Tells this actor to use the given cover node. This is invalid if the actor's keepclaimednode flag is set. Returns true or false depending on whether the actor can claim the node.

parameters.name: pathNode
parameters.description: The path node to use as cover.

api.name: UsePosition
api.description: Override where the actor should run to. This overrides the goal pos and the claimed node.

parameters.name: position
parameters.description: The position for the actor to run to.

parameters.name: arrivalfinalposition
parameters.description: The arrivalfinalposition if this is an arrival.

remarks: Used heavily by the archetype behavior tree code to steer an actor to a computed navmesh position.

api.name: UseReacquireNode
api.description: Use the given reacquire node.

parameters.name: node
parameters.description: (path node) the node to use.

api.name: UseServerVisionset
api.description: Switches using the server supplied (via SetVisionSetForPlayer()) visionset.

parameters.name: useIt
parameters.description: Whether using the server override visionset.

remarks: Turned on when the player takes control of a remote killstreak and turned off again when control ends.

api.name: UseTriggerIgnoreUseHoldTime
api.description: Set the require look at flag for the trigger.

api.name: UseTriggerRequireLookAt
api.description: Set the require look at flag for the trigger.
remarks: Typically called on a use trigger during setup, right after TriggerIgnoreTeam.

api.name: UseTriggerRequireLookToward
api.description: Set the require look along flag for the trigger.

parameters.name: enabled
parameters.description: Whether the trigger requires looking toward.

api.name: UseVehicle
api.description: same as useby except you can specify a seat, 0 driver, 1-4 gunners.

parameters.name: userEntity
parameters.description: The player to use the vehicle.

parameters.name: seat
parameters.description: 0 driver, 1-4 gunners, 5-10 passengers.

remarks: Called on the vehicle entity to place a player into it, almost always seat 0 for remote controlled killstreaks.

api.name: UseWeaponHideTags
api.description: Hides tags on this entity based on the hidetags value of the provided weaponname.

parameters.name: weaponName
parameters.description: The name of the weapon to base the tags to hide on.

remarks: Used in zombies alongside UseWeaponModel when building wall buy and craftable weapon models.

api.name: UseWeaponModel
api.description: Use a weapon model.

parameters.name: weaponName
parameters.description: The name of the weapon to base the tags to hide on.

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: The name of a model to use. If none is specified the world model for the weapon will be used.

parameters.name: weaponOptions
parameters.description: The weapon options.

remarks: The model argument is often the weapon's own worldmodel, and the options come from a GetWeaponOptions or CalcWeaponOptions call.

api.name: VectorCross
api.description: Returns the cross product of two vectors.

parameters.name: vectorA
parameters.description: The first vector.

parameters.name: vectorB
parameters.description: The second vector.

remarks: Most often crossed with (0, 0, 1) to get a horizontal side vector from a forward direction.

api.name: VectorDot
api.description: Returns the dot product of two vectors.

parameters.name: vectorA
parameters.description: The first vector.

parameters.name: vectorB
parameters.description: The second vector.

remarks: Usually called on normalized vectors so the result can be compared against a cosine threshold or passed to ACos for an angle.

api.name: VectorFromLineToPoint
api.description: Given a line and a point P, this returns a vector perpendicular to the line and pointing from the line to P.

parameters.name: SegmentA
parameters.description: One point on the line.

parameters.name: SegmentB
parameters.description: Another point on the line.

parameters.name: P
parameters.description: The point.

api.name: VectorLerp
api.description: Linear interpolates between two vectors.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: The vector whose value is used when fraction is 0.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: The vector whose value is used when fraction is 1.

parameters.name: fraction
parameters.description: The fraction of the way between vectors.  Values less than 0 or greater than 1 do linear extrapolation.

remarks: Commonly used to ease a position or an angle set toward a target, either at a fixed fraction such as 0.5 or at elapsed time divided by total time.

api.name: VectorNormalize
api.description: Returns a normalized copy of this vector.

parameters.name: vector
parameters.description: The vector to normalize.

remarks: Almost always applied to the difference of two origins to get a unit direction, then scaled by a distance or a speed.
Frequently paired with AnglesToForward and VectorToAngles.

api.name: VectorProjection
api.description: Returns the vector projection of vector a onto vector b.

parameters.name: vectorA
parameters.description: The vector to project.

parameters.name: vectorB
parameters.description: The vector to project onto.

returns.description: The component of the first vector that lies along the second vector.

remarks: Used for bounce and slide math: projecting an impact velocity onto a surface normal gives the component to negate or to remove from the original velocity.

api.name: VectortoAngles
api.description: Returns a set of angles corresponding to the given vector.

parameters.name: vector
parameters.description: The vector to convert to angles.

remarks: Typically given the difference of two origins so that the result faces one entity toward the other.
Often combined with VectorNormalize, or indexed at [1] to keep only the yaw.

api.name: VehCanSee
api.description: Gets whether the given vehicle can see the given entity.

calledOn.name: vehicle
calledOn.description: The vehicle to check the ability to see on.

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: The entity to check whether the vehicle can see.

returns.name: canSee
returns.description: Whether the vehicle can see the entity.

api.name: VehDriverAimAtCrosshairs
api.description: Enables or disables the driver turret aiming at the crosshairs (aiming at the crosshairs overrides all other aim targets and is the default behavior).

parameters.name: AimAtCrosshairs
parameters.description: True to aim the turret at the crosshairs.

remarks: Called on a scripted vehicle to hand its driver turret back to the crosshairs, or to release it so another aim target can take over.

api.name: VehicleClass
api.description: Defines or queries a vehicle class.

parameters.name: className
parameters.description: The vehicle class name.

parameters.name: param1
parameters.description: The first class parameter.

parameters.name: param2
parameters.description: The second class parameter.

parameters.name: param3
parameters.description: The third class parameter.

parameters.name: param4
parameters.description: The fourth class parameter.

api.name: VehicleMoveUpButtonPressed
api.description: Returns whether the player is pressing the vehicle move up button.
remarks: Polled in a loop, usually inside a util helper that waits for the button to be pressed.

api.name: VehSeenRecently
api.description: Gets whether the given vehicle has seen the given entity within the recent period specified.

calledOn.name: vehicle
calledOn.description: The vehicle to check on.

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: The entity to check whether the vehicle has seen recently.

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: The number of seconds prior to now that the vehicle must have seen the target within.

returns.name: wasRecentlySeen
returns.description: Whether the entity was recently seen by the vehicle.

api.name: Vibrate
api.description: Causes a script entity to vibrate, rotating around its origin, along a given vector dir.

calledOn.name: entity
calledOn.description: The entity to vibrate.

parameters.name: directionVector
parameters.description: The direction of the vibration.

parameters.name: amplitude
parameters.description: The amount of the vibration in degrees.

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: The period of the vibration in seconds.

parameters.name: time
parameters.description: The length of time of the vibration in seconds.

remarks: Called on a script model or clone model, for example a perk machine or a barrier chunk being knocked.
The direction vector is usually an axis scaled by VectorScale.

api.name: VideoPause
api.description: Pause video playback.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: name of movie to pause.  do not add a file suffix (like .mp4).

api.name: VideoPrime
api.description: Preload the first second of a movie.  Call this several seconds before the movie needs to play to prevent any delay.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: name of movie to play.  do not add a file suffix (like .mp4).

parameters.name: loop
parameters.description: Set this to true if the movie should automatically restart when it reaches the end.

remarks: The single observed use primes a video a couple of lines before the matching VideoStart call for the same name.

api.name: VideoStart
api.description: Start a video for playback on an in-game surface.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: name of movie to play.  do not add a file suffix (like .mp4).

parameters.name: loop
parameters.description: Set this to true if the movie should automatically restart when it reaches the end.

remarks: Paired with VideoStop using the same video name to stop playback.
Looping videos pass true for the second argument; one shot videos omit it.

api.name: VideoStop
api.description: Stop a video being played on an in-game surface.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: name of movie to stop.  do not add a file suffix (like .mp4).

remarks: Takes the same name that was passed to VideoStart, and is also used to stop a video before restarting it.

api.name: VideoUnpause
api.description: Unpause video playback.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: name of movie to pause.  do not add a file suffix (like .mp4).

api.name: ViewKick
api.description: Give the player a view kick.

parameters.name: damage
parameters.description: The damage to inflict.

parameters.name: origin
parameters.description: The origin of the kick.

remarks: The observed calls pass an integer damage amount and the origin of the source that shook the player, so the kick comes from that direction.

api.name: VisionSetLastStand
api.description: Sets players' laststand vision.  Optionally give a transition time from the current vision.

parameters.name: visionName
parameters.description: Vision to transition to.

parameters.name: transitionTime
parameters.description: How long, in seconds, to take transitioning to the new vision set if a transition is possible.  Default is one second.

remarks: Passing an empty string clears the last stand vision back to normal.

api.name: VisionSetLerpRatio
api.description: Determines if you can see an item.  Checks distance and view cone before the trace to increase efficency.

parameters.name: float
parameters.description: ratio between 0 and 1.

api.name: VisionSetNaked
api.description: Set the vision and its duration.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The vision set name.

parameters.name: duration
parameters.description: The duration of the vision.

remarks: Restoring the level default vision is done by passing the mapname dvar, typically after a killcam, a host migration, or a temporary effect vision.
A duration of 0 snaps immediately, while a nonzero duration blends over that many seconds.

api.name: WalkUnderwater
api.description: Sets if a player should walk while underwater.

parameters.name: boolean
parameters.description: true if player should walk underwater.  False if player should swim.

remarks: Used in matched pairs, set to true while a scripted underwater sequence runs and back to false afterward.

api.name: WeaponCyclingEnabled
api.description: Determine if weapon cycling is enabled for the player.

returns.description: Whether weapon cycling is enabled.

remarks: Observed only in guard conditions alongside OffhandWeaponsEnabled before letting the player use a quest weapon.

api.name: WeaponHasAttachment
api.description: Gets whether the given weapon has all of the attachments specified.

parameters.name: weapon
parameters.description: The weapon.

parameters.name: attachment
parameters.description: An attachment name to check for.

parameters.name: extraAttachments
parameters.description: Zero or more additional attachment names.

returns.name: hasAttachments
returns.description: Whether the weapon has the specified attachments.

api.name: WeaponHasAttachmentAndUnlocked
api.description: Checks if the given weapon have all the attachments specified. Additionally, checks that they are also all unlocked for challenge stat purposes.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player that has the weapon (and needs checking whether they have the attachments unlocked on).

parameters.name: weapon
parameters.description: The weapon.

parameters.name: attachments
parameters.description: The attachment names to check.

returns.name: hasAndUnlocked
returns.description: Whether the weapon has the attachments specified and if the player has them unlocked.

api.name: WeaponLockCount
api.description: returns the number of active lock objects (i.e. those with at least lock started or lock set active).

api.name: WeaponLockDetect
api.description: Sets the tartget as detected.  Will clear any existing hard lock.  Use WeaponLockStart() to start lock.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: : An entity.

parameters.name: slot
parameters.description: :  The slot to operate on (up to MAX_SIMULTANEOUS_LOCKONS).

remarks: Used on the player while a heat seeking weapon has found a candidate target but has not begun locking on yet, before WeaponLockStart.

api.name: WeaponLockFinalize
api.description: Locks player's weapon onto an entity.  Implies WeaponLockStart(), so this may be called to jump to a hard lock.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: : An entity.

parameters.name: slot
parameters.description: :  The slot to operate on (up to MAX_SIMULTANEOUS_LOCKONS).

remarks: Called on the player after WeaponLockStart once the lockon time has elapsed, and cleared later with WeaponLockFree.
Multi lock weapons pass the slot index of the target being locked.

api.name: WeaponLockFree
api.description: Clears player's weapon lock.

parameters.name: slot
parameters.description: The weapon slot. Default is 0.

remarks: Clears the lock set up by WeaponLockStart and WeaponLockFinalize, typically when the target is lost or the weapon is put away.
Usually called with no arguments, next to WeaponLockTargetTooClose and WeaponLockNoClearance resets.

api.name: WeaponLockNoClearance
api.description: When set true, the player will be unable to fire their lockon weapon, and will recieve a hint print telling them that there is an obstruction.

parameters.name: bool
parameters.description: : true or false.

parameters.name: slot
parameters.description: The weapon slot. Default is 0.

remarks: Cleared with false as part of the same reset block as WeaponLockFree and WeaponLockTargetTooClose.
Multi lock scripts pass the slot index as the second argument.

api.name: WeaponLockRemoveSlot
api.description: removes the given slot values and compresses the remaining slots  (i.e. 1,2,3 with 2 removed becomes 1,3,blank).

parameters.name: slot
parameters.description: The weapon slot. Default is 0.

remarks: Called on the player when one target drops out of a multi lock list, using that target's slot index.
Passing -1 is used when the whole lock list has been emptied.

api.name: WeaponLockStart
api.description: Begins player's weapon lockon sequence (hud effects, etc).  Will clear any existing hard lock.  Use WeaponLockFinalize() to complete lock.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: : An entity.

parameters.name: slot
parameters.description: :  The slot to operate on (up to MAX_SIMULTANEOUS_LOCKONS).

remarks: Begins the lockon on the player and is completed by WeaponLockFinalize, or abandoned with WeaponLockFree.
Multi lock weapons pass the index of the new slot, for example the current size of their lock list.

api.name: WeaponLockTargetTooClose
api.description: When set true, the player will be unable to fire their lockon weapon, and will recieve a hint print telling them that they are too close.

parameters.name: bool
parameters.description: : true or false.

parameters.name: slot
parameters.description: The weapon slot. Default is 0.

remarks: Set to true while the target is within the minimum range, and cleared with false alongside WeaponLockFree and WeaponLockNoClearance.

api.name: WeaponPlayEjectBrass
api.description: Play the eject brass FX for a weapon.

api.name: WeaponSwitchButtonPressed
api.description: Check if the player is pressing the weapon switch button.
remarks: Polled on the player to let the weapon switch button interrupt a scripted sequence or cancel a held special weapon.

api.name: WorldEntNumber
api.description: Returns the entity number for the world.

api.name: WorldToLocalCoords
api.description: Transform the given world point into the local space of the entity.

parameters.name: worldCoords
parameters.description: The point in world coordinates (vector3).

api.example: trigger LinkTo( self, "", self WorldToLocalCoords( trigger.origin ), ( 0, 0, 0 ) );
remarks: Almost always used to compute the offset argument for LinkTo so that an entity keeps its current world position when it is linked.

api.name: WorldTrace
api.description: Trace from start to end.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: The trace start point.

parameters.name: end
parameters.description: The trace end point.

remarks: The observed uses trace short horizontal probes around a point to test for nearby world geometry.

api.name: ZBarrierPieceUseAlternateModel
api.description: Sets the indexed piece to use the alternate model.

parameters.name: pieceNumber
parameters.description: The piece index.

api.name: ZBarrierPieceUseAttachWeapon
api.description: Sets the indexed piece to attach the zbarrier's weapon to tag_weapon (and tag_weapon_left if it's dual wield).

parameters.name: pieceNumber
parameters.description: The piece index.

remarks: Used on the pack a punch zbarrier so that the weapon being upgraded rides on the given piece.

api.name: ZBarrierPieceUseBoxRiseLogic
api.description: Sets the indexed piece to use the box rise logic.

parameters.name: pieceNumber
parameters.description: The piece index.

remarks: Called on the magic box zbarrier during setup, once per piece that should rise with the box (pieces 3 and 4 in the shipped boxes).

api.name: ZBarrierPieceUseDefaultModel
api.description: Sets the indexed piece to use the default model.

parameters.name: pieceNumber
parameters.description: The piece index.

remarks: Used on board barriers to swap a repaired chunk back from the upgraded model set by ZBarrierPieceUseUpgradedModel.

api.name: ZBarrierPieceUseUpgradedModel
api.description: Sets the indexed piece to use the upgraded model.

parameters.name: pieceNumber
parameters.description: The piece index.

remarks: Used by the carpenter powerup to show the reinforced version of a board chunk, and reverted with ZBarrierPieceUseDefaultModel.

api.name: ZBarrierSupportsZombieReachThroughAttacks
api.description: Returns true if this zbarrier supports zombie reach through attacks.
remarks: Checked on the zbarrier of the zombie's current entrance node before running reach through attack behavior.

api.name: ZBarrierSupportsZombieTaunts
api.description: Returns true if this zbarrier supports zombie taunt anims.
remarks: Checked on the zbarrier of the zombie's current entrance node before playing taunt animations at the barrier.

api.name: ZeroGravityVolumeOff
api.description: Disables Zero Gravity Volume.

parameters.name: volumeName
parameters.description: The volume name.

remarks: The observed use iterates the keys of a volume table to turn every zero gravity volume off, mirroring ZeroGravityVolumeOn.

api.name: ZeroGravityVolumeOn
api.description: Enables Zero Gravity Volume.

parameters.name: volumeName
parameters.description: The volume name.

remarks: The observed use iterates the keys of a volume table to turn every zero gravity volume on, and is undone with ZeroGravityVolumeOff.

api.name: HasAnimStateFromASD
api.description: Checks whether this actor has the given animstate in its ASD.

calledOn.name: actor
calledOn.description: The actor to check.

parameters.name: animState
parameters.description: The animstate name to look up.

returns.name: hasAnimState
returns.description: Whether the actor has the specified animstate in its ASD.

api.name: SetLastStandPrevWeap
api.description: Sets the previous weapon used by this player for last stand handling.

calledOn.name: player
calledOn.description: The player to update.

parameters.name: weapon
parameters.description: The weapon to store as the player's previous last stand weapon.

api.name: BotSightTracePassed
api.description: Checks whether this bot has line of sight to the target entity.

calledOn.name: bot
calledOn.description: The bot performing the sight trace.

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: The target entity to test visibility against.

parameters.name: targetPosition
parameters.description: An optional explicit target position to trace toward instead of the target entity eye or centroid position.

returns.name: passed
returns.description: Whether the bot sight trace passed.

remarks: When targetPosition is omitted, the trace uses the target eye position for players and actors, or the entity centroid otherwise.
